summary: Autonomous driving planning requires selecting trajectories that remain safe, rule-compliant, and comfortable under complex multi-agent interactions, yet robust closed-loop decision making in planning-critical scenes remains challenging. Existing diffusion- and RL-based planners often rely on generic rewards and use relational structure mainly for representation, limiting how planning-critical rollouts shape policy improvement. We present GRID-Planner, a graph--reward integrated diffusion planning framework that aligns generative planning with structured relational signals. Specifically, GRID-Planner combines graph-aware importance weighting, a time-indexed relational reward surrogate, and an advantage-weighted diffusion objective with on-policy self-distillation, forming a rollout-return-advantage-update loop without explicit likelihoods. Experiments on nuPlan and interPlan show that, compared with the diffusion-only baseline, GRID-Planner reduces collision rate, lane deviation, and jerk by 35.8\%, 60.8\%, and 27.4\%, respectively, and improves the planning score by 3.4\%. Project website: https://github.com/yangzhaojason/GRID-Planner.
summary_zh: 自动驾驶规划需要在复杂多智能体交互场景下选择安全、合规且舒适的轨迹，然而在规划关键场景中实现稳健的闭环决策仍然充满挑战。现有的基于扩散模型和强化学习的规划器通常依赖通用奖励函数，并主要将关系结构用于表征，这限制了规划关键性轨迹对策略优化的引导作用。我们提出了GRID-Planner，一种图—奖励联合的扩散规划框架，将生成式规划与结构化关系信号对齐。具体而言，GRID-Planner结合了图感知的重要性加权、时间索引的关系奖励替代函数，以及带有策略自蒸馏的优势加权扩散目标，形成了无需显式似然的轨迹回报—优势—更新闭环。在nuPlan和interPlan上的实验表明，与仅使用扩散模型的基线相比，GRID-Planner将碰撞率、车道偏离和 jerk 分别降低了35.8%、60.8%和27.4%，并将规划得分提升了3.4%。项目网站：https://github.com/yangzhaojason/GRID-Planner。
tldr: GRID-Planner introduces a graph-integrated diffusion planning framework with relational reward shaping and advantage-weighted self-distillation, improving closed-loop driving safety and comfort on nuPlan and interPlan benchmarks.
tldr_zh: GRID-Planner提出了一个图集成扩散规划框架，通过关系奖励塑形和优势加权自蒸馏，在nuPlan和interPlan基准上改善了闭环驾驶的安全性和舒适性。

title: TS-WAM: Temporal Latent Actions and World-Action Coupling for Vision-Language Robot Control
summary: Many vision-language-action policies rely on action-labeled robot demonstrations and lack an explicit mechanism for predicting future visual states. These limitations hinder learning from action-free videos and can encourage overfitting to demonstration conditions, weakening generalization and robustness. We present TS-WAM, a lightweight Teacher-Student World-Action Model that addresses these challenges through self-supervised temporal learning and explicit future prediction. Its vlm-jepa framework learns from heterogeneous data, including robot demonstrations and action-free human videos, using an EMA target branch without requiring a separately trained external teacher. By coupling vlm-jepa with delta-lwm, TS-WAM learns to predict latent actions from the current observation and instruction and uses them to predict future visual features that guide action generation at inference. A unified end-to-end training architecture jointly optimizes temporal representation learning, visual dynamics, and robot control without a separate latent-action or world-model pretraining stage. The EMA target branch is removed at inference, keeping the deployed policy lightweight. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and SimplerEnv, together with real-world manipulation experiments on Franka Research 3 and RevoTron, demonstrate that TS-WAM achieves strong manipulation performance, generalization, and robustness.
summary_zh: 许多视觉-语言-动作策略依赖于带动作标注的机器人演示数据，缺乏预测未来视觉状态的显式机制。这些局限性阻碍了从无动作视频中学习，并可能加剧对演示条件的过拟合，削弱泛化能力与鲁棒性。我们提出TS-WAM，一种轻量级的教师-学生世界-动作模型，通过自监督时序学习和显式未来预测应对上述挑战。其vlm-jepa框架能够从异构数据中学习，包括机器人演示和无动作人类视频，利用EMA目标分支，无需单独训练外部教师模型。通过将vlm-jepa与delta-lwm相结合，TS-WAM学习从当前观测和指令中预测潜在动作，并利用这些动作预测未来视觉特征，从而在推理阶段指导动作生成。统一端到端的训练架构联合优化时序表示学习、视觉动态和机器人控制，无需单独的潜在动作或世界模型预训练阶段。在推理过程中移除EMA目标分支，保持部署策略的轻量性。在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和SimplerEnv上的实验，以及在Franka Research 3和RevoTron上的真实世界操作实验表明，TS-WAM在操作性能、泛化能力和鲁棒性方面均表现出色。
tldr: TS-WAM introduces a lightweight Teacher-Student World-Action Model that couples self-supervised temporal latent action learning with future visual prediction for vision-language robot control, improving generalization and robustness across simulated and real manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: TS-WAM 提出了一种轻量级教师-学生世界-动作模型，通过将自监督时间潜在动作学习与未来视觉预测相结合，提升了视觉-语言机器人控制中的泛化性和鲁棒性。

title: Trajectory-based Diffusion from One-shot Human Video for Generalizable Manipulation
summary: Imitation learning enables robots to perform complex tasks by leveraging human-collected demonstrations. However, most existing approaches require labor-intensive data collection with additional teleoperation systems, which hinders scalability. Human videos represent a natural source of data that implicitly contain knowledge of manipulation behaviors. However, transferring them to robots remains challenging due to the visual domain gap and the absence of explicit action labels. In this work, we introduce TDV, a trajectory-based framework that leverages data generation to enable generalizable manipulation. TDV focuses on task-relevant objects by leveraging plug-and-play 6D pose estimation techniques to extract object trajectories from human videos, thereby mitigating the impact of irrelevant backgrounds and varying viewpoints. As a modality-agnostic intermediate representation, trajectories are inherently independent of the visual domains and different embodiments, enabling efficient data generation. Our method outperforms previous approaches on RLBench simulation tasks, achieving near 100\% success rates across seven tasks. In real-world experiments, TDV enables cross-embodiment generalization manipulation from one-shot human demonstrations by leveraging efficient trajectory generation techniques.
summary_zh: 模仿学习使机器人能够利用人类收集的示范执行复杂任务。然而，现有的大多数方法需要耗费大量人力进行数据采集，并配备额外的遥操作系统，这阻碍了其可扩展性。人类视频作为一种天然的数据来源，隐式地包含了操作行为的知识。然而，由于视觉域差距和缺乏明确的动作标签，将这些视频迁移至机器人仍然具有挑战性。在本工作中，我们提出了TDV，一种基于轨迹的框架，利用数据生成实现可泛化的操作能力。TDV通过利用即插即用的6D姿态估计技术从人类视频中提取物体轨迹，聚焦于任务相关物体，从而减轻无关背景和不同视角的影响。作为一种与模态无关的中间表示，轨迹天然独立于视觉域和不同本体，能够实现高效的数据生成。我们的方法在RLBench仿真任务中优于先前的方法，在七个任务上实现了接近100%的成功率。在真实世界实验中，TDV通过利用高效的轨迹生成技术，实现了从单次人类示范到跨本体泛化操作的能力。
tldr: TDV extracts object trajectories from one-shot human videos via 6D pose estimation and uses them as a modality-agnostic intermediate representation to generate robot manipulation data, achieving near 100% success on RLBench and real-world cross-embodiment generalization.
tldr_zh: TDV通过6D姿态估计从单次人类视频中提取物体轨迹，并将其作为模态无关的中间表示来生成机器人操作数据，在RLBench和真实世界中实现了接近100%的成功率和跨本体泛化。

title: Comfortably Stuck: Evaluation Pitfalls in Bench2Drive's Closed-Loop Protocol
summary: Closed-loop evaluation is widely regarded as a more faithful way to assess end-to-end (E2E) driving models than open-loop evaluation, and Bench2Drive, built on the CARLA simulator, has become the dominant benchmark for it. We show that its evaluation protocol itself contains pitfalls that can misrepresent the models scored on it. Bench2Drive's comfort metric, adapted from nuPlan, has several implementation errors and a segmentation scheme that rewards standing still, so it mostly measures how long a vehicle stays stationary, correlating with stationary time at r = 0.97 across eight models. We propose a corrected, distance-based metric that cuts that correlation to r = 0.06. Under it, the strong driving-score/comfort tradeoff the original metric reports is no longer detectable once models are compared at matched driving speed, which suggests that comfort trades against how fast a model drives rather than against how well it drives. We also uncover two pitfalls in how the harness supplies navigation signals: the default controller can replace a model's own steering with an angle toward the route target point, and the target point supplied at evaluation time can differ substantially from what a model saw in training. We demonstrate both on UniAD and VAD, where their effects differ sharply, and argue that future closed-loop evaluations should check for them. We will release all fixes as standalone code, so corrected comfort scores can be obtained from logged trajectories without re-running closed-loop simulation.
summary_zh: 闭环评估被广泛认为是比开环评估更真实地评价端到端（E2E）驾驶模型的方式，而基于CARLA模拟器构建的Bench2Drive已成为该领域的主流基准。我们发现其评估协议本身存在若干缺陷，可能导致被评模型得分失真。Bench2Drive的舒适性指标源自nuPlan，但存在多处实现错误以及奖励静止不动的分段方案，因此该指标主要衡量车辆保持静止的时长，在八个模型上与静止时间的相关系数达r=0.97。我们提出一个修正的、基于距离的指标，将该相关性降至r=0.06。在该指标下，原始指标所报告的强驾驶得分与舒适性之间的权衡关系在模型以匹配的行驶速度进行比较时不再可检测，这表明舒适性实际上是与模型行驶速度进行权衡，而非与其驾驶质量进行权衡。我们还发现了评估框架在提供导航信号方面的两个缺陷：默认控制器可能用朝向路线目标点的角度替代模型自身的转向输出，且评估时提供的目标点可能与模型在训练中看到的差异显著。我们在UniAD和VAD上同时验证了这两点，其影响在这两个模型上差异明显，并建议未来的闭环评估应对此进行检查。我们将以独立代码形式发布所有修正，使修正后的舒适性得分可直接从记录轨迹中获取，无需重新运行闭环仿真。
tldr: This paper identifies evaluation pitfalls in the Bench2Drive closed-loop driving benchmark, including a flawed comfort metric and navigation signal inconsistencies, and proposes corrected metrics and analysis that reveal comfort trades against driving speed rather than driving quality.
tldr_zh: 该论文指出了Bench2Drive闭环驾驶基准评估协议中的缺陷，包括有问题的舒适度指标和导航信号不一致，并提出了修正指标和分析，表明舒适度与驾驶速度而非驾驶质量相权衡。

title: Uni-PNP: Unified Prehensile and Non-prehensile Policy Learning for Generalizable Object Pose Reaching
summary: Object manipulation often requires combining non-prehensile actions with grasping. However, existing approaches typically develop these capabilities separately and integrate them by sequencing distinct primitives through prescribed intermediate objectives, limiting the coordination of contact motions and grasping. Their integration also remains sensitive to object and gripper geometry and depends on particular environmental supports, complicating real-world deployment. We present Uni-PNP, a unified policy that jointly learns prehensile and non-prehensile manipulation for object pose reaching across diverse objects and grippers. To achieve this, we first pretrain a geometry encoder to predict contact-induced object motion using a contact-dynamics dataset constructed from simulated interactions between diverse objects and grippers. We then train the policy in a two-stage reinforcement learning curriculum from graspable objects to ungraspable peers, encouraging the discovery of non-prehensile interactions and their integration with grasping. Experiments show 76.39% success on hundreds of seen objects with grippers, and 57.91% on unseen peers, outperforming the strongest pose-reaching baseline by 20.52 and 17.79 percentage points, respectively. We also analyze emergent behaviors, including nonprehensile and prehensile repositioning, grasp acquisition that requires grasping after tipping, and table-assisted reorientation while grasping, and transfer to the real-world scenario. Project page available at lgswdn.github.io/Uni-PNP.
summary_zh: 操作物体往往需要将非抓取动作与抓取相结合。然而，现有方法通常分别开发这些能力，并通过预设的中间目标将不同的原始动作串联起来进行整合，这限制了接触运动与抓取之间的协调性。此外，其整合方式对物体和夹爪的几何形状较为敏感，并且依赖于特定的环境支撑条件，从而增加了实际部署的复杂性。我们提出了Uni-PNP，一种统一策略，可联合学习抓取性和非抓取性操作，以实现跨多种物体和夹爪的物体位姿到达。为实现这一目标，我们首先利用由多种物体与夹爪之间的模拟交互构建的接触动力学数据集，预训练一个几何编码器，用于预测接触引发的物体运动。随后，我们在两阶段强化学习课程中训练策略，从可抓取物体逐步过渡至不可抓取物体，以促进非抓取交互的发现及其与抓取动作的整合。实验表明，在数百个已见物体与夹爪上，成功率达76.39%，在未见物体上达57.91%，分别比最强的位姿到达基线高出20.52和17.79个百分点。我们还分析了涌现行为，包括非抓取性和抓取性的位置调整、需在倾斜后抓取的抓取获取，以及抓取过程中借助桌面辅助的重新定向，并将上述能力迁移至真实世界场景。项目页面见lgswdn.github.io/Uni-PNP。
tldr: Uni-PNP is a unified policy that jointly learns prehensile and non-prehensile manipulation for object pose reaching, using a geometry encoder pretrained on contact dynamics and a two-stage curriculum RL, achieving strong performance on unseen objects and real-world transfer.
tldr_zh: Uni-PNP 是一个统一策略，联合学习抓取和非抓取操作以实现物体位姿到达，通过基于接触动力学的几何编码器预训练和两阶段课程强化学习，在未见物体和真实世界迁移中表现出色。

title: MAIA: Anticipating Interaction Anomalies in Contact-Rich Manipulation via Multimodal World Models
summary: Reliable contact-rich manipulation requires detecting execution deviations early enough for corrective action. Yet most monitoring methods are reactive, identifying anomalies only after they become observable. Anticipating such anomalies is challenging because visual observations only partially reveal physical interaction, while planned actions describe intended motion rather than their actual physical consequences. We address this problem with MAIA, a multimodal framework for anomaly anticipation. Its vision-action-force world model learns nominal interaction dynamics and predicts the visual and force responses of planned actions, while a lightweight anomaly head predicts impending interaction anomalies. To enable systematic evaluation, we introduce CRIA, a real-world multimodal dataset of 2,852 trajectories spanning 18 contact-rich manipulation tasks, with frame-level annotations of anomaly onset and evolution. Experiments on both seen and novel tasks show that MAIA achieves more accurate anomaly discrimination than representative baselines while providing earlier warnings, with bACC scores of 0.765 and 0.710 and median anticipation lead times of 28.0 and 25.1 steps, respectively. Moreover, using these predictions for anomaly-aware action selection improves end-to-end task success from 52.6% to 61.5% without retraining the underlying manipulation policy. These results highlight the value of modeling future physical consequences for proactive anomaly anticipation.
summary_zh: 可靠的高接触操作要求足够早地检测到执行偏差，以便及时采取纠正措施。然而，大多数监测方法都是反应式的，只有在异常变得可观察之后才能识别它们。预测此类异常具有挑战性，因为视觉观察只能部分揭示物理交互，而规划的动作描述的是预期运动，而非其实际物理后果。我们提出MAIA，一个用于异常预测的多模态框架，来解决这一问题。其视觉-动作-力世界模型学习标称交互动力学，并预测规划动作的视觉和力响应，同时一个轻量级异常头预测即将发生的交互异常。为支持系统性评估，我们引入CRIA，一个包含2，852条轨迹的真实世界多模态数据集，涵盖18项高接触操作任务，并具有异常发生和演化的帧级标注。在已知和新颖任务上的实验表明，MAIA在异常判别上比代表性基线更为准确，同时提供更早的预警，其bACC分数分别为0.765和0.710，中位预测提前量分别为28.0步和25.1步。此外，利用这些预测进行异常感知的动作选择，可将端到端任务成功率从52.6%提升至61.5%，而无需重新训练底层操作策略。这些结果凸显了对未来物理后果进行建模对主动异常预测的价值。
tldr: MAIA introduces a multimodal vision-action-force world model that predicts future visual and force responses to planned actions, enabling early anticipation of interaction anomalies in contact-rich manipulation and improving task success via anomaly-aware action selection.
tldr_zh: MAIA 提出一种多模态视觉-动作-力世界模型，通过预测规划动作的未来视觉和力响应，在接触丰富的操作中提前预测交互异常，并利用异常感知动作选择提升任务成功率。

title: SPEAR: Selective Preference Elicitation with Adaptive Rewards for VLM-Guided Robotic Manipulation
summary: Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable automated preference labeling for robotic manipulation, yet their deployment remains impractical since each query incurs substantial inference cost, while VLMs frequently abstain on visually challenging comparisons. We propose SPEAR, a framework that transforms VLMs into efficient preference oracles via two synergistic mechanisms. First, we design distinguishability-aware query selection to reduce abstention rates by targeting only informative and distinguishable comparisons. Second, we deploy an adaptive reward transition that bootstraps exploration with VLM-synthesized guidance before preference-based refinement. Experiments on the manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that SPEAR achieves 88.9% average success, outperforming baselines by 23.3 percentage points, while significantly reducing abstention and wall-clock training time on contact-rich tasks. SPEAR learns three Mobile ALOHA manipulation tasks fully online on real hardware, demonstrating end-to-end real-world applicability. By addressing query efficiency and exploration challenges, SPEAR establishes VLMs as practical preference oracles for scalable robot learning without manual reward engineering.
summary_zh: 最近的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）使得机器人操作中的自动化偏好标注成为可能，然而其实际部署仍面临挑战，因为每次查询都会产生大量的推理成本，同时VLMs在面对视觉上具有挑战性的比较时常常选择弃权。我们提出SPEAR框架，通过两种协同机制将VLMs转化为高效的偏好预言机。首先，我们设计了基于可区分性感知的查询选择机制，通过仅针对信息丰富且可区分的比较来降低弃权率。其次，我们部署了自适应奖励转换机制，在基于偏好的细化之前，利用VLM合成的指导进行探索引导。在操作基准上的实验表明，SPEAR实现了88.9%的平均成功率，比基线方法高出23.3个百分点，同时在接触密集型任务中显著减少了弃权率和挂钟训练时间。SPEAR在真实硬件上完全在线学习了三个Mobile ALOHA操作任务，展示了端到端的实际应用能力。通过解决查询效率和探索挑战，SPEAR将VLMs确立为可扩展机器人学习的实用偏好预言机，无需手动奖励工程。
tldr: SPEAR improves VLM-based preference learning for robotic manipulation by selecting informative comparisons to reduce abstention and using adaptive reward transitions to bootstrap exploration, achieving higher success rates and faster real-world training.
tldr_zh: SPEAR通过区分性查询选择和自适应奖励过渡，解决了VLM偏好标注成本高和弃权率高的问题，在真实机器人操作任务上显著提升了学习效率和成功率。

title: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Specialized vision-language-action (VLA) policies acquire strong domain-specific skills, yet consolidating these skills into one shared policy remains challenging. On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher knowledge on inputs induced by the student, addressing the distribution mismatch encountered during deployment. For flow-based VLAs, this mismatch arises at two levels: environment observations and intermediate action-generation states. We propose a two-level on-policy distillation framework that couples student-driven environment interaction with teacher velocity supervision along student-generated action flow trajectories. Frozen domain specialists jointly supervise one student. After each update, the student collects new environment experience and generates fresh action-flow trajectories. Starting from a joint supervised fine-tuning (SFT) initialization, Velocity Loss OPD yields absolute success-rate gains of 22.55% on LIBERO-40, 33.4% on CALVIN five-instruction sequences, and 22.6% on Meta-World MT50. Compared with Action Loss OPD and Teacher-rollout SFT, it achieves absolute success-rate gains of 6.4-9.5% on LIBERO-40, 9.7-18.3% on CALVIN, and 3.2-4.2% on Meta-World MT50. Analysis by sequence length further shows larger success-rate gains on longer CALVIN sequences. These results demonstrate effective multi-domain capability consolidation through two-level on-policy supervision, with a single student deployed across domains.
summary_zh: 专业化的视觉-语言-行动（VLA）策略具备较强的领域专属技能，但将这些技能整合至单一共享策略仍具挑战性。在线策略蒸馏（OPD）可利用学生模型所引发的输入来迁移教师知识，从而解决部署过程中遇到的分布不匹配问题。对于基于流的VLA模型，这种不匹配出现在两个层面：环境观测和中间动作生成状态。我们提出了一种双层在线策略蒸馏框架，将学生驱动的环境互动与教师速度监督相结合，沿着学生生成的动作流轨迹进行监督。多个冻结的领域专家共同监督一个学生模型。每次更新后，学生模型会收集新的环境经验，并生成新的动作流轨迹。从联合监督微调（SFT）初始化出发，速度损失OPD在LIBERO-40上实现了22.55%的绝对成功率提升，在CALVIN五指令序列上提升了33.4%，在Meta-World MT50上提升了22.6%。与动作损失OPD和教师回放SFT相比，该方法在LIBERO-40上实现了6.4%至9.5%的绝对成功率提升，在CALVIN上实现了9.7%至18.3%的提升，在Meta-World MT50上实现了3.2%至4.2%的提升。按序列长度的分析进一步表明，在较长的CALVIN序列上成功率增益更大。这些结果证明了通过双层在线策略监督能够有效整合多领域能力，并由单一学生模型跨领域部署。
tldr: This paper introduces a two-level on-policy distillation framework for flow-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, enabling a single student policy to consolidate skills from multiple frozen domain-specialist teachers through student-driven environment interaction and velocity supervision along student-generated action flow trajectories, achieving significant success-rate gains on LIBERO, CALVIN, and Meta-World benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于基于流的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的两级在线蒸馏框架，通过学生驱动的环境交互和沿学生生成的动作流轨迹的速度监督，将多个冻结的领域专家教师的技能整合到单一学生策略中，在LIBERO、CALVIN和Meta-World基准上取得了显著的成功率提升。

title: TRACE: Typed Reference-Aware Conversational Editing for Humanoid Motion Diffusion
summary: Language-conditioned humanoid motion generation enables users to create and refine robot movements through natural language. The central challenge is to connect an underspecified request to concrete motion structure that can subsequently be revised relative to an accepted reference. We present TRACE, a generation and editing framework for the Unitree G1 humanoid robot built around typed, measurable kinematic quantities. Our insight is to ground generation conditions in paired training motions and editing goals in the current motion. A language model learns to predict support, root, and hand events from motion-derived supervision; their time-aligned encodings complement the original text in a diffusion generator. Gravity-referenced states and trajectory--contact objectives improve kinematic consistency. For editing, typed requests define body--time scopes and source-relative goals. A separate reference-conditioned diffusion editor uses these goals and revised events to realize changes, while sampling-time projection preserves protected state coordinates. Quantitative evaluation and human assessment show improved semantic alignment and motion quality over the compared methods. Controlled ablations support the value of motion-grounded conditioning and kinematic consistency, while multi-turn editing evaluations demonstrate more reliable execution of successive relative requests under shared preservation constraints. Together, these results support typed kinematic structure as a common basis for motion generation and reference-aware revision.
summary_zh: 语言条件的人形运动生成技术使用户能够通过自然语言创建和优化机器人动作。核心挑战在于将模糊的需求描述与具体的运动结构相连接，并使其能够根据已接受的参考标准进行后续修正。我们提出了TRACE，一个面向Unitree G1人形机器人的生成与编辑框架，其核心基于类型化的、可测量的运动学量。我们的关键洞察在于：将生成条件锚定于成对训练动作，将编辑目标锚定于当前动作。语言模型从动作派生的监督信号中学习预测支撑、根部和手部事件；这些时间对齐的编码在扩散生成器中补充了原始文本信息。基于重力参考的状态以及轨迹-接触目标函数提升了运动学一致性。在编辑方面，类型化请求定义了身体-时间范围及源相对目标。一个独立的、参考条件化的扩散编辑器利用这些目标和修正后的事件来实现变化，同时采样时间投影保护了受约束的状态坐标。定量评估和人工评估表明，与对比方法相比，本文方法在语义对齐和动作质量上均有提升。受控消融实验验证了运动锚定条件和运动学一致性的价值，而多轮编辑评估则证明了在共享保持约束下，对连续相对请求的执行更为可靠。综合来看，这些结果支持类型化运动学结构作为动作生成与参考感知修正的共同基础。
tldr: TRACE introduces a typed, reference-aware conversational editing framework for humanoid motion generation and editing on the Unitree G1 robot, grounding language conditions in motion-derived events and using a reference-conditioned diffusion editor for multi-turn revisions.
tldr_zh: TRACE 为 Unitree G1 人形机器人提出了一种基于类型化、参考感知的对话式运动生成与编辑框架，通过运动派生事件和参考条件扩散编辑器实现多轮运动修订。

title: CarryOn: A Dual-Loop Harness for Personalized and Reliable Robot Assistance
summary: While generalist vision-language-action (VLA) models have enabled diverse open-world manipulation, real-world robotic assistance requires two critical capabilities they currently lack: personalization and reliable execution. First, executing an instruction like "make me a sandwich" requires grounding subtask decomposition in persistent user preferences rather than relying on a single generic solution. Second, reliable deployment demands explainable safety assurance that proactively prevents hazards and gracefully recovers from occasional physical failures. To address these gaps, we present CarryOn, a dual-loop harness designed to augment a frozen VLA policy. The planning loop maintains persistent user-level and scene-level context that is continually grounded against new observations and revised through interaction, enabling personalized task selection and execution grounding across conversations and changing scenes. The execution loop actively supervises policy rollouts, shielding actions from predicted hazardous contact. When execution fails, the system invokes reusable control-based recovery skills that restore task progress and are refined through reflection on earlier failures. On a real robot and in simulation, CarryOn dispatches preference-consistent subtasks across users and scenes, reduces the violation rate of an already safety-finetuned VLA from 52.6% to 6.1%, and increases recovery success from 13% to 80% when refined skills are reused.
summary_zh: 虽然通用型视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已能够支持多样化的开放世界操作，但现实世界中的机器人辅助还需要两项它们目前尚不具备的关键能力：个性化和可靠执行。首先，执行“给我做个三明治”这类指令时，需要将子任务的分解建立在持续的用户偏好之上，而非依赖单一的通用方案。其次，可靠的部署要求具备可解释的安全保障，能够主动预防危险并在偶尔发生的物理故障中优雅恢复。为填补这些空白，我们提出了CarryOn——一种旨在增强冻结VLA策略的双循环框架。规划循环维护持续的用户级和场景级上下文，这些上下文不断根据新的观测进行校准，并通过交互进行修订，从而跨对话和场景变化实现个性化任务选择和执行落地。执行循环主动监督策略的展开，屏蔽可能导致危险接触的动作。当执行失败时，系统会调用基于控制的可复用恢复技能，以恢复任务进度，并通过对先前失败的反思不断优化这些技能。在真实机器人和仿真环境中，CarryOn能在不同用户和场景间分派符合偏好的子任务，将已经过安全微调的VLA模型的违规率从52.6%降至6.1%，并在技能优化复用后将恢复成功率从13%提升至80%。
tldr: The paper proposes CarryOn, a dual-loop harness that augments frozen VLA policies with a planning loop for personalization and an execution loop for safety and recovery, demonstrating reduced violations and improved recovery success in real-world and simulated robot evaluations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出CarryOn，一种双循环框架，通过规划循环实现个性化，执行循环提供安全保证和故障恢复，在真实机器人和仿真中验证了降低违规率和提高恢复成功率的效果。

title: X-Fly: Learning to Reach and Stop in Full-Chunk Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Aerial vision-language navigation (VLN) agents built on large vision-language models are expensive to query. Executing a complete predicted action chunk before replanning amortizes this cost, reducing model inference from 195 to 42 ms per executed waypoint for our policy. It also moves the states at which the policy is queried away from expert demonstrations, which supervise neither recovery from these states nor termination at the learner's own arrival. On OpenFly test-seen, no-stop failures account for 47.78% of full-chunk behavior cloning (BC) outcomes. We present X-Fly, a staged training framework for full-chunk aerial VLN. Recovery DAgger labels learner-visited decision states with smooth chunks that reconnect to future expert segments and with STOP at the first in-region state. Flow-GRPO then jointly refines the chunked flow controller and a Bernoulli STOP policy from same-task closed-loop outcomes, supplemented by outcome-verified stopping supervision. With eight controls per decision, X-Fly reaches 74.18% SR on test-seen and 51.73% on test-unseen, compared with 16.45% and 18.43% for full-chunk BC and 32.04% and 29.46% for DreamFly.
summary_zh: 基于大型视觉语言模型的航空视觉语言导航（VLN）智能体在查询时成本高昂。在重新规划之前执行完整的预测动作块可摊销这一成本，使我们的策略在每执行一个航点时的模型推理时间从195毫秒降至42毫秒。同时，这也使策略被查询的状态偏离专家示范——专家示范既不监督从这些状态的恢复，也不监督学习者在自身到达时的终止行为。在OpenFly测试已知场景中，无停止失败占完整动作块行为克隆（BC）结果的47.78%。我们提出X-Fly，一种面向完整动作块航空VLN的分阶段训练框架。Recovery DAgger为学习者访问的决策状态标注平滑动作块，使其重新连接至未来的专家片段，并在首个区域内状态处标注STOP。随后，Flow-GRPO基于同任务闭环结果联合优化块状流控制器和伯努利停止策略，并辅以结果验证的停止监督。在每决策八个控制动作的设置下，X-Fly在测试已知场景中达到74.18%的成功率（SR），在测试未知场景中达到51.73%，而完整动作块BC分别为16.45%和18.43%，DreamFly分别为32.04%和29.46%。
tldr: X-Fly introduces a staged training framework (Recovery DAgger and Flow-GRPO) to address no-stop failures and distribution shift in full-chunk aerial vision-language navigation, achieving significant success-rate improvements on OpenFly.
tldr_zh: X-Fly 提出了一种分阶段训练框架（Recovery DAgger 和 Flow-GRPO），以解决全块空中视觉语言导航中的不停车失败和分布偏移问题，在 OpenFly 上显著提高了成功率。

title: Policy-Aligned Predictive Verification for Adaptive VLA Action-Chunk Execution
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies generate action sequences that reduce repeated inference, but deciding how much of each sequence to execute is critical to task success. Existing adaptive methods make this decision using generation stability or prediction agreement, yet these signals do not establish whether executing a candidate prefix preserves the ability to complete the task. We introduce a policy-aligned predictive verifier (PAV) that anticipates the consequences of candidate action prefixes and evaluates their compatibility with successful continuation before execution. Rather than using future prediction to generate actions, our method evaluates existing proposals in the VLA's internal task-conditioned representation space. To learn local judgments from terminal task outcomes, we combine trajectory-level survival supervision with a localization prior that preserves useful behavior within failed rollouts. The resulting validity scores guide execution-horizon selection. Evaluations with pi_0 and pi_0.5 across LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world manipulation show improved success-query trade-offs. These findings point toward a different role for future prediction in robotics, using it to assess how far to trust a policy's proposed actions rather than to generate new ones.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略生成的动作序列减少了重复推理，但决定每个序列执行多少对于任务成功至关重要。现有的自适应方法利用生成稳定性或预测一致性来做出这一决策，然而这些信号无法确定执行候选前缀是否保留了完成任务的能力。我们提出了一种策略对齐的预测验证器（PAV），它在执行前预测候选动作前缀的后果，并评估其与成功延续的兼容性。我们的方法不是利用未来预测来生成动作，而是在VLA内部的任务条件表示空间中评估已有的候选方案。为了从最终任务结果中学习局部判断，我们将轨迹级别的生存监督与局部化先验相结合，从而在失败轨迹中保留有用行为。由此产生的有效性分数指导执行视界的选择。在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0和真实世界操作任务上使用pi_0和pi_0.5进行的评估显示，成功查询权衡得到了改善。这些发现指向了未来预测在机器人技术中的不同作用，即利用未来预测来评估策略提议动作的可信程度，而非生成新动作。
tldr: This paper introduces a policy-aligned predictive verifier (PAV) that scores candidate action prefixes in a VLA model's internal representation space using trajectory-level survival supervision, enabling adaptive execution-horizon selection and improving success-query trade-offs across multiple benchmarks and real-world manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种策略对齐的预测验证器（PAV），在VLA模型的内部表示空间中利用轨迹级生存监督对候选动作前缀进行评分，从而实现自适应的执行长度选择，并在多个基准和真实世界操作中改善了成功率-查询次数的权衡。

title: MuSTMM: Learning Sound-Triggered Mobile Manipulation across Multiple Scenes
summary: Sound-Triggered Mobile Manipulation (STMM) requires robots to respond to sound events by navigating to the associated objects and performing appropriate physical interactions. Existing STMM evaluations primarily vary object layouts within limited architectural structures, leaving challenges to unseen scenes insufficiently explored. We introduce Multi-scene Sound-Triggered Mobile Manipulation (MuSTMM), a dataset that combines spatial audio rendering and physical interaction across 31 scenes with diverse architectures and object layouts. MuSTMM contains 14.36 million precomputed binaural Room Impulse Responses (RIRs) and a scene-disjoint split for evaluating single-event and multi-event settings in unseen scenes. We further augment the Navigation Policy Model with explicit spatial memory that complements acoustic cues with observed geometry. Specifically, we accumulate pose-aligned depth observations in a shared coordinate frame and project this memory into an egocentric Bird's-Eye View (BEV) occupancy map. Fusing map features with sound context produces a goal descriptor that provides both target-location and scene-structure priors, guiding navigation to the target region required for subsequent physical interaction. This policy achieves a 2.60% success rate boost over existing methods, while component ablations further support the effectiveness of spatial memory. MuSTMM and the navigation policy provide a testbed for the new challenge of studying sound-triggered mobile manipulation in unseen scenes. The code and dataset will be released upon acceptance.
summary_zh: 声音触发的移动操纵（STMM）要求机器人通过导航至相关物体并执行适当的物理交互来响应声音事件。现有的STMM评估主要在有限的建筑结构内变化物体布局，对未见场景的挑战探索不足。我们引入了多场景声音触发移动操纵（MuSTMM）数据集，该数据集结合了空间音频渲染和物理交互，涵盖31个具有不同建筑结构和物体布局的场景。MuSTMM包含1436万个预计算的双耳房间脉冲响应（RIR），并提供场景不相交的划分，用于评估未见场景中的单事件和多事件设置。我们进一步为导航策略模型增加了显式空间记忆，以观测到的几何信息补充声学线索。具体而言，我们在共享坐标系中累积与姿态对齐的深度观测，并将该记忆投影到以自我为中心的鸟瞰图（BEV）占用网格中。将地图特征与声音上下文融合，生成目标描述符，该描述符同时提供目标位置和场景结构先验，引导导航到达后续物理交互所需的目标区域。该策略相较于现有方法实现了2.60%的成功率提升，而组件消融实验进一步验证了空间记忆的有效性。MuSTMM和导航策略为研究未见场景中声音触发移动操纵这一新挑战提供了测试平台。代码和数据集将在录用后发布。
tldr: The paper introduces MuSTMM, a multi-scene sound-triggered mobile manipulation dataset with 31 scenes and 14.36 million binaural RIRs, and a navigation policy augmented with explicit spatial memory (BEV occupancy) that fuses acoustic cues with observed geometry, achieving a 2.60% success rate boost over existing methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了MuSTMM，一个包含31个场景和1436万个双耳房间脉冲响应的多场景声音触发移动操作数据集，并提出了一个利用显式空间记忆（BEV占据图）融合声音线索和观测几何信息的导航策略，相比现有方法成功率提升了2.60%。

title: From Optical Flow to Safety: Visual Safety Certification via Scale-Free Relative Motion
summary: Safe autonomous navigation using monocular vision remains challenging because explicit obstacle states are not directly observable. This letter introduces a visual safety-certification paradigm that uses scale-free, depth-normalized relative motion encoded by monocular optical flow as the representation for collision-risk certification, without reconstructing obstacle position, velocity, geometry, or a metric world model. Unlike conventional optical-flow-based navigation approaches that rely on image motion to shape avoidance behavior, the proposed framework directly encodes collision-cone geometry and safety constraints in this relative-motion representation. An online Concurrent Learning observer estimates the normalized relative velocity and provides a computable estimation-error bound. This uncertainty is propagated into the collision cone through angular inflation and a monocular robot-footprint margin, yielding a Robust Vision-Based Collision Cone Control Barrier Function (RV-C$^3$BF). An optimal-decay CBF quadratic program minimally modifies the nominal control input to enforce the resulting robust safety constraint under the stated assumptions. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments on a TurtleBot3 in cluttered environments with static and dynamic obstacles demonstrate collision avoidance using only monocular vision and onboard proprioception, with the estimation-error bound containing the measured error in $98.3\%$ of simulation samples and the robot achieving collision-free navigation in $93$ of $100$ real-world trials.
summary_zh: 安全自主导航利用单目视觉仍具挑战性，因为障碍物的显式状态无法直接观测。本文提出一种视觉安全认证范式，利用单目光流编码的无尺度、深度归一化相对运动作为碰撞风险认证的表示，而无需重建障碍物位置、速度、几何形状或度量世界模型。与依赖图像运动来塑造避障行为的传统光流导航方法不同，所提框架直接在该相对运动表示中编码碰撞锥几何和安全约束。一种在线并发学习观测器估计归一化相对速度并提供可计算的估计误差界。该不确定性通过角度膨胀和单目机器人足迹裕度传播至碰撞锥中，从而生成鲁棒基于视觉的碰撞锥控制障碍函数（RV-C$^3$BF）。一个最优衰减CBF二次规划在最小程度上修改标称控制输入，以在所述假设下强制执行所得鲁棒安全约束。在静态和动态障碍物杂乱环境中对TurtleBot3进行的大量仿真和真实世界实验表明，仅利用单目视觉和机载本体感觉即可实现避障，其中估计误差界在$98.3\%$的仿真样本中包含实测误差，机器人在$100$次真实世界试验中有$93$次实现无碰撞导航。
tldr: This paper presents a visual safety-certification framework for monocular autonomous navigation that uses scale-free relative motion from optical flow to construct a robust vision-based collision cone control barrier function, enabling collision-free navigation on a TurtleBot3 without metric world models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于单目光流的视觉安全认证框架，利用无尺度的相对运动编码碰撞锥几何与安全约束，通过鲁棒控制障碍函数实现无需度量世界模型的自主导航，并在TurtleBot3上验证了避障效果。

title: CQDC-Warp: GPU-Accelerated Differentiable Quasi-Dynamic Simulation for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Efficient synthesis of contact-rich manipulation trajectories is essential for downstream robot learning. Gradient-based planning offers a promising approach, but jointly optimizing motion and contact decisions remains challenging. Meanwhile, many existing planners run on CPUs with limited throughput. We present CQDC-Warp, a GPU-accelerated differentiable quasi-dynamic simulator for batched model predictive control (MPC). We use it to study contact-guided trajectory optimization, in which intended robot--object contacts are specified before planning and encouraged through soft costs, while the simulated dynamics determine contact geometry and frictional response without a prescribed contact-mode schedule. Across $17{,}408$ trials on the $17$-object Allegro in-hand rotation benchmark, our framework achieves $79.8\%$ success, compared with $73.7\%$ for CFree and $65.2\%$ for IMPACT, and reduces mean trajectory-generation time by factors of $27.0$ and $50.2$, respectively. On a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 with $2{,}048$ parallel worlds, forward and backward throughput reach $2.06\times10^5$ and $2.25\times10^5$ world-steps per second, respectively. Further experiments cover manipulation with LEAP and Shadow hands, environmental contact exploitation, bimanual manipulation, whole-body control, and real-world trajectory replay on a Sharpa hand.
summary_zh: 高效合成富含接触的操控轨迹对于下游机器人学习至关重要。基于梯度的规划提供了一种有前景的方法，但联合优化运动与接触决策仍具挑战性。同时，许多现有规划器在CPU上运行，吞吐量有限。我们提出了CQDC-Warp，一个用于批量模型预测控制（MPC）的GPU加速可微准动态仿真器。我们利用它研究接触引导的轨迹优化，在该优化中，预期的机器人-物体接触在规划之前被指定，并通过软成本进行激励，而模拟动力学则确定接触几何和摩擦响应，无需预设接触模式调度。在包含$17{,}408$次试验的$17$物体Allegro手内旋转基准测试中，我们的框架实现了$79.8\%$的成功率，相比之下，CFree为$73.7\%$，IMPACT为$65.2\%$，并将平均轨迹生成时间分别缩短了$27.0$倍和$50.2$倍。在单块NVIDIA RTX 4090上，配备$2{,}048$个并行环境，前向和后向吞吐量分别达到每秒$2.06\times10^5$和$2.25\times10^5$个世界步。进一步的实验涵盖了LEAP和Shadow手的操控、环境接触利用、双臂操控、全身控制，以及在Sharpa手上的真实世界轨迹回放。
tldr: This paper introduces CQDC-Warp, a GPU-accelerated differentiable quasi-dynamic simulator that enables batched model predictive control for contact-rich manipulation, achieving higher success rates and significantly faster trajectory generation compared to prior methods.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了CQDC-Warp，一种GPU加速的可微准动态仿真器，用于接触丰富操作的批量模型预测控制，在成功率和轨迹生成速度上优于现有方法。

title: Do VLAs Really Follow Instructions? Diagnosing How-Level Instruction Following in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are expected to follow instructions like their language backbones, yet prior work has focused on What-level instructions that specify the task rather than How-level instructions that specify how to carry it out. Through our diagnoses, we find that How-level instructions do not help current VLAs and lower task success. We hypothesize that pairing each training episode with a single instruction limits How-level instruction following, and show that training with segment-level enriched instructions makes actions respond to such instructions without consistently raising task success. To measure How-level instruction following beyond standard benchmarks, we introduce SIMPLER-IN, where success requires conditions given only in the instruction. It shows that the gained responsiveness does not extend to demanding or out-of-distribution How-level instructions. How-level instruction following thus remains an open challenge.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型理应像其语言骨干一样遵循指令，然而先前的研究主要聚焦于“做什么”层面的指令，即指定任务目标，而非“怎么做”层面的指令，即指定执行方式。通过诊断，我们发现“怎么做”层面的指令无法有效帮助当前的VLA模型，反而会降低任务成功率。我们假设，将每个训练片段仅与单一指令配对会限制模型对“怎么做”层面指令的遵循能力，并证明使用片段级别丰富的指令进行训练可使动作响应此类指令，但并未持续提升任务成功率。为了在标准基准之外衡量对“怎么做”层面指令的遵循程度，我们引入了SIMPLER-IN，其成功判定要求仅由指令中给出的条件决定。结果表明，所获得的响应能力无法推广至要求严苛或分布外的“怎么做”层面指令。因此，“怎么做”层面的指令遵循仍是一个有待攻克的挑战。
tldr: This paper diagnoses how-level instruction following in VLA models, finding that such instructions do not improve and often hurt task success, and introduces SIMPLER-IN to measure this ability.
tldr_zh: 本文诊断了视觉-语言-动作模型中“如何级”指令跟随能力，发现此类指令并未提升甚至会降低任务成功率，并引入SIMPLER-IN来评估该能力。

title: An Agentic Framework for Proactive Robots with Procedural Assistance Memory
summary: Proactive robots should anticipate user needs and provide assistance before being explicitly asked. A straightforward approach is to infer human intentions from commonsense knowledge, but the same observed behavior can imply different needs across users, potentially leading to unwanted assistance. We observe that everyday routines in the real world exhibit recurring patterns, so learning these patterns can reduce ambiguity in proactive decisions. Based on this, we propose a memory-based agentic framework in which a VLM task predictor reads a Procedural Assistance Memory (PAM) alongside the current observation to decide when to assist and what task to perform, and a VLA executor performs the predicted task. PAM is structured as a finite-state machine over activity phases, per-state assistance rules, and event-driven transitions; a reflection VLM revises PAM from each day's interaction trace without weight updates or retraining. In our 5-day desk-assistance evaluation, memory-free baselines remain conservative, with limited recall on proactive tasks. Our system improves consistently with accumulated experience, achieving the highest precision, recall, and F1 and reducing first-fire delay from approximately 5 seconds on Day 1 to 1 second by Day 5. Our approach also adapts to changes in the user's routine through continued memory reflection, recovering from memory--routine misalignment after a single memory update. The project page is available at https://davian-robotics.github.io/PAM/
summary_zh: 主动式机器人应在用户明确请求之前预测其需求并提供帮助。一种直接的方法是从常识知识中推断人类意图，但相同的观察行为在不同用户身上可能意味着不同的需求，从而导致不必要的帮助。我们观察到，现实世界中的日常活动呈现出重复性模式，因此学习这些模式可以减少主动决策中的歧义。基于此，我们提出了一种基于记忆的智能体框架，其中VLM任务预测器结合当前观察读取程序性辅助记忆（PAM），以决定何时提供帮助以及执行什么任务，而VLA执行器则执行预测的任务。PAM被构建为一个基于活动阶段、各阶段辅助规则和事件驱动转换的有限状态机；反思VLM从每天的交互轨迹中修订PAM，无需权重更新或重新训练。在我们为期5天的桌面辅助评估中，无记忆基线保持保守态度，在主动任务上的召回率有限。我们的系统随着经验积累持续改进，达到了最高的精确率、召回率和F1分数，并将首次触发延迟从第1天的约5秒缩短至第5天的1秒。我们的方法还通过持续的记忆反思适应用户日常习惯的变化，在单次记忆更新后即可从记忆与日常习惯的不匹配中恢复。项目页面可在 https://davian-robotics.github.io/PAM/ 查看。
tldr: This paper introduces a memory-based agentic framework for proactive robots, combining a VLM task predictor with a Procedural Assistance Memory (PAM) and a VLA executor, enabling robots to anticipate user needs and adapt to routine changes through memory reflection without retraining.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于记忆的智能体框架，用于主动机器人，结合了VLM任务预测器、程序性辅助记忆（PAM）和VLA执行器，使机器人能够预见用户需求并通过记忆反思适应日常变化，无需重新训练。

title: When to Ask for Help: A Decision-Theoretic Account and Measurement Standard for Slow-Module Scheduling in Dual-System Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Dual-system vision-language-action (VLA) models pair a high-frequency fast policy with a slow, expensive module, and published trigger mechanisms for invoking it lack a shared objective, measured costs, and any standard separating schedule quality from module quality. We provide the missing account: invocation is formalized as a calibrated decision problem whose fixed-ratio, fixed-budget, and history-gated schedules are degenerate cases of one quantity, the Value of Intervention (VoI); a renewal baseline proves the optimal schedule periodic under state-independent collapse, with adaptive gains governed by the cost ratio $ρ$ and the dispersion of collapse. Measured systems span three orders of magnitude in $ρ$ (FiS-VLA $0.95$; RoboICL about $10^3$), and a direct test confirms the low-$ρ$ prediction: calibrated gains vanish under homogeneous collapse and grow with heterogeneity. Fourteen closed-loop arms on LIBERO test the contested middle of the continuum ($ρ=1.53$): the adaptive trigger allocates its queries exactly as the threshold rule predicts, yet the language-rewrite channel cannot convert them into success on either suite, and a revert actuator that undoes a failed rewrite is the only intervention with zero net downside on both LIBERO-Spatial and LIBERO-Goal, where the rewrite deficit deepens from thirteen to forty-two points. A four-measure leak-free protocol cuts apparent early-warning AUC from $0.93$ to $0.62$ on $929$ deployment traces, a detection-limited frontier theorem converts detection quality into a schedulability statement, and a compilation loop turns measured value functions into per-task refresh periods within $2.4\%$ of the closed-loop oracle. Together these results turn slow-module invocation from a design opinion into a measured decision.
summary_zh: 双系统视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将高频快速策略与一个缓慢且昂贵的模块配对，而已发表的触发机制缺乏统一目标、可测量的成本，以及任何将调度质量与模块质量分离的标准。我们提供了缺失的理论框架：调用被形式化为一个校准决策问题，其固定比率、固定预算和历史门控调度均归结为同一量——干预价值（VoI）——的退化情形；一个更新基准则证明，在状态无关崩溃下最优调度是周期性的，自适应增益由成本比$ρ$和崩溃的离散度控制。实测系统在$ρ$上跨越三个数量级（FiS-VLA为$0.95$；RoboICL约为$10^3$），直接测试验证了低$ρ$预测：在校齐性崩溃下校准增益消失，并随异质性增长而增大。在LIBERO上的十四个闭环臂测试了该连续体中有争议的中间区域（$ρ=1.53$）：自适应触发器分配查询的方式与阈值规则预测完全一致，但语言重写通道无法将查询转化为任一测试套件上的成功率提升；而一种撤销失败重写的回退执行器，是唯一在LIBERO-Spatial和LIBERO-Goal上均具有零净负面的干预措施，其中重写缺陷从十三个百分点加深至四十二个百分点。一种四指标无泄漏协议将$929$条部署轨迹上的表观早期预警AUC从$0.93$降至$0.62$；一个检测受限前沿定理将检测质量转化为可调度性陈述；一个编译循环将实测价值函数转化为每任务刷新周期，与闭环预言机的误差在$2.4\%$以内。综合这些结果，慢速模块调用从一种设计观点转变为一项可测量的决策。
tldr: This paper formalizes slow-module scheduling in dual-system VLA models as a decision problem via Value of Intervention (VoI), provides a calibration baseline and measurement protocol, and validates the theory on LIBERO with closed-loop robot arms, showing adaptive triggers match predictions and revert actuation is the only zero-downside intervention.
tldr_zh: 本文通过干预价值（VoI）将双系统VLA模型中的慢模块调度形式化为决策问题，提供了校准基线和测量协议，并在LIBERO闭环机器人臂上验证理论，表明自适应触发器符合预测，而回退执行器是唯一零副作用的干预。

title: KODA: Kinematics--Observation Data Alignment for Humanoid Learning from Human Egocentric Demonstration
summary: Training humanoid whole-body vision-language-action (VLA) policies requires costly robot demonstrations with aligned robot-view observations and controller-compatible whole-body state-action labels. Egocentric human demonstrations offer scalable supervision but have misaligned views and sparse motion cues. Existing approaches either pretrain policies that still require robot data for adaptation or generate controller-specific commands that limit reuse. Conversion also requires robot-view observations aligned with the generated whole-body motion. We present KODA (Kinematics-Observation Data Alignment), which converts egocentric RGB demonstrations into whole-body VLA training data using a reusable canonical trajectory to guide robot-view synthesis and generate controller-specific whole-body state-action supervision. KODA first generates a simulator-checked whole-body trajectory using a sparse tracker with sampling-based command optimization. This generated trajectory directly determines the onboard camera poses used to synthesize corresponding robot-view observations. The motion, observations, and task instruction form a canonical record. For each deployment controller, KODA optimizes commands to track the stored motion and records the corresponding action labels and proprioceptive states. When switching controllers, KODA retains this canonical record and regenerates whole-body state-action supervision for co-training with matching robot demonstrations. We evaluate KODA on four Unitree G1 loco-manipulation tasks using two whole-body controllers, SONIC and HEFT. With robot data held fixed, macro-average success on conditions covered by human demonstrations but absent from robot data improves by 45.0 and 46.25 percentage points, respectively. Under both controllers, this metric shows an upward trend across the evaluated human-data budgets, suggesting potential for further scaling.
summary_zh: 训练人形全身视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略需要昂贵的机器人示范数据，这些数据须具备对齐的机器人视角观测以及与控制器兼容的全身状态-动作标签。以自我为中心的人类示范提供了可扩展的监督信号，但存在视角错位和运动线索稀疏的问题。现有方法要么预训练策略但仍需机器人数据进行适配，要么生成受限于特定控制器的指令而限制了复用性。此外，转换过程还需要与生成的全身运动对齐的机器人视角观测。我们提出KODA（运动学-观测数据对齐）方法，利用可复用的规范轨迹引导机器人视角合成，并生成特定控制器的全身状态-动作监督，从而将自我为中心的RGB示范转换为全身VLA训练数据。KODA首先利用基于采样的命令优化和稀疏追踪器生成经仿真器验证的全身轨迹。该生成轨迹直接决定用于合成相应机器人视角观测的机载相机位姿。运动、观测和任务指令共同构成一条规范记录。对于每个部署控制器，KODA优化命令以跟踪存储的运动，并记录相应的动作标签和本体感觉状态。切换控制器时，KODA保留该规范记录，并重新生成全身状态-动作监督，用于与匹配的机器人示范进行协同训练。我们在四个宇树G1移动操控任务上，使用两个全身控制器SONIC和HEFT对KODA进行评估。在机器人数据保持固定的情况下，对于人类示范覆盖但机器人数据缺失的条件，宏观平均成功率分别提升了45.0和46.25个百分点。在两种控制器下，该指标在评估的人类数据预算范围内均呈上升趋势，表明进一步扩展具有潜力。
tldr: KODA converts egocentric human RGB demonstrations into whole-body VLA training data by generating a canonical, simulator-checked whole-body trajectory that guides robot-view synthesis and controller-specific state-action supervision, improving humanoid loco-manipulation success on conditions unseen in robot data.
tldr_zh: KODA 将人类第一视角 RGB 演示转换为全身 VLA 训练数据，通过生成模拟器验证的规范全身轨迹来合成机器人视角观测并生成控制器特定的状态-动作监督，提高了人形机器人在未见条件下的操作成功率。

title: MoCaP: Mobile Code-as-Policies for Zero-Shot Mobile Manipulation from Passive Human Videos
summary: Passive human videos of everyday activity offer robots access to a massive amount of human experience without requiring a demonstration for each task. However, using this experience requires recovering knowledge from unstructured video recordings and adapting it to a different body (i.e., the robot). To overcome these challenges, we present mobile code-as-policy (MoCaP), an agentic framework that turns passive human video recordings into guidance for an end-to-end mobile manipulation policy. MoCaP extracts spatial memory and cues of how people prepare to interact with objects, which inform navigation and the search for a manipulation-ready configuration. Guided by passive human experience and current observations, MoCaP uses a closed-loop code-as-policy to coordinate planning and tool use primitives to solve motions under the robot's geometry and kinematic constraints. On a real mobile manipulator, MoCaP achieves 80% success on each of two mobile manipulation tasks in an indoor environment whereas existing approaches cannot succeed at the task. Video-derived spatial memory improves object-navigation success from 70% to 100%, and human approach prior raises the rate of finding a reachable base pose from 0% to 100% at an unfavorable start location. Videos and code are available on the project website: https://mocap-7.github.io/MoCAP-page/.
summary_zh: 被动的人类日常活动视频使机器人能够获得大量的人类经验，而无需为每项任务进行示范。然而，利用这些经验需要从非结构化的视频记录中恢复知识，并将其适配到不同的主体（即机器人）上。为克服这些挑战，我们提出了移动端代码即策略（MoCaP），这是一个智能体框架，能够将被动的人类视频记录转化为端到端移动操作策略的指导。MoCaP提取空间记忆以及人类如何准备与物体交互的线索，这些信息用于指导导航和寻找适合操作配置的搜索。在被动人类经验和当前观测的引导下，MoCaP利用闭环代码即策略来协调规划和使用工具原语，以在机器人的几何和运动学约束下解决动作问题。在真实移动操作机器人上，MoCaP在室内环境中的两项移动操作任务上均实现了80%的成功率，而现有方法无法成功完成这些任务。视频衍生的空间记忆将物体导航成功率从70%提升至100%，人类接近先验在不利起始位置将找到可达基座姿态的成功率从0%提升至100%。视频和代码可在项目网站上获取：https://mocap-7.github.io/MoCAP-page/。
tldr: MoCaP is an agentic framework that extracts spatial memory and human interaction cues from passive human videos to guide a real mobile manipulator, achieving 80% success on two mobile manipulation tasks and significantly improving navigation and base-pose reachability.
tldr_zh: MoCaP 是一个智能体框架，从被动人类视频中提取空间记忆和交互线索，引导真实移动机械臂，在两个移动操作任务上达到 80% 成功率，并显著提升导航和基座可达性。

title: LEAP: Gradient Flow Augmented Lagrangian Trajectory Optimization for Contact Constrained Robots
summary: Generating dynamically feasible motions for legged and manipulating robots requires solving a large, nonlinear, non-convex optimal control problem (OCP) in which contact wrenches must satisfy friction-cone constraints throughout the motion, not only at isolated instants. Existing solvers are sensitive to the initial guess and scale poorly with the number of joints. This paper introduces LEAP, which transcribes the OCP with pseudospectral collocation and, instead of a Newton or SQP solve, integrates a primal--dual gradient flow of a Powell--Hestenes--Rockafellar augmented Lagrangian to compute a solution. Because the flow is stiff, this paper designs a linearly implicit integrator with a Gauss--Newton metric, momentum, and a merit-based step controller that keeps the augmented Lagrangian monotone. Across locomotion benchmarks on five robot platforms, from planar hoppers to 32-joint humanoids, LEAP is the only method to solve every tested problem, achieves substantial speedups over Crocoddyl and Aligator on several benchmarks, and reaches trackable references at smaller compute budgets. The resulting trajectories are validated by tracking them in a high-fidelity simulator and on hardware. We will make the code public upon final acceptance of this paper.
summary_zh: 生成腿式机器人和操作机器人的动态可行运动，需要解决一个大规模、非线性、非凸的最优控制问题（OCP），其中接触力必须在整个运动过程中满足摩擦锥约束，而不仅仅是在孤立时刻。现有求解器对初始猜测较为敏感，且随着关节数量的增加，其扩展性较差。本文提出了LEAP方法，该方法采用伪谱配点法对OCP进行离散化，并利用Powell–Hestenes–Rockafellar增广拉格朗日函数的原始-对偶梯度流来计算解，而非使用牛顿法或SQP求解。由于该梯度流是刚性的，本文设计了一种线性隐式积分器，结合Gauss–Newton度量、动量项以及基于性能指标的步长控制器，以保持增广拉格朗日函数的单调性。在从平面跳跃机器人到32关节类人机器人的五个机器人平台的运动基准测试中，LEAP是唯一能解决所有测试问题的方法，在多个基准上相较Crocoddyl和Aligator实现了显著加速，并且在更小的计算预算下即可达到可跟踪的参考轨迹。所得轨迹通过高保真仿真器及硬件上的跟踪实验得到了验证。论文最终录用后，我们将公开代码。
tldr: LEAP introduces a primal-dual gradient flow method with an augmented Lagrangian for solving contact-constrained optimal control problems in legged and manipulating robots, demonstrating robustness and speedups across benchmarks and hardware validation.
tldr_zh: LEAP 提出了一种基于增广拉格朗日的原始-对偶梯度流方法，用于求解腿式机器人和操作机器人的接触约束最优控制问题，在基准测试和硬件验证中表现出鲁棒性和加速效果。

title: EgoJEPA: Beyond Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Videos
summary: Egocentric human videos offer a scalable alternative to costly robot demonstra- tions, yet transferring their manipulation priors to robot control remains chal- lenging. The commonly adopted retargeting-based approaches convert human wrist and finger poses into embodiment-specific action commands through hand- crafted geometric mappings. However, such mappings require meticulous recal- ibration across different embodiments and risk propagating hand-tracking errors into downstream robot control pipelines. To this end, we propose EgoJEPA, a three-stage framework that learns embodiment-agnostic representations from ego- centric human videos without rule-based human-to-robot retargeting: 1) Human- action pre-training learns effect-aware latent actions through JEPA-style visual prediction conditioned on hand-motion differences; 2) Latent-action-based world modeling jointly predicts future visual dynamics and latent actions, which decou- ples human prior pre-training from robot-specific control parameterizations; 3) Embodiment-specific tuning adapts the pretrained model to diverse robots through lightweight action adapters. Experiments on five real-world manipulation tasks across three robot embodiments demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of EgoJEPA. It achieves a 74% average success rate under the out-of-domain evalu- ation, compared with 65% for the retargeting baseline, while reducing cumulative cross-embodiment wall-clock cost by 47.2%, from 743.2 to 392.7 hours.
summary_zh: 以自我为中心的人类视频为成本高昂的机器人演示提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，但将其操作先验迁移至机器人控制仍具挑战性。常用的基于重定向的方法通过手工设计的几何映射将人类手腕和手指姿态转换为特定具身对应的动作指令。然而，此类映射在不同具身之间需要精细的重新校准，并存在将手部跟踪误差传播至下游机器人控制流程的风险。为此，我们提出EgoJEPA，一个三阶段框架，无需基于规则的“人-机器人”重定向，即可从以自我为中心的人类视频中学习与具身无关的表征：1）人类动作预训练通过基于手部运动差异的JEPA式视觉预测学习效果感知的潜在动作；2）基于潜在动作的世界模型联合预测未来视觉动态与潜在动作，从而将人类先验预训练与机器人特定的控制参数化解耦；3）具身特定微调通过轻量级动作适配器将预训练模型适应于多种机器人。在三个机器人具身上的五项真实世界操作任务实验验证了EgoJEPA的有效性与效率。在域外评估中，其平均成功率达到74%，而重定向基线为65%，同时跨具身累计墙钟时间成本从743.2小时降至392.7小时，减少了47.2%。
tldr: EgoJEPA learns embodiment-agnostic manipulation priors from egocentric human videos via JEPA-based latent action prediction and world modeling, avoiding hand-crafted retargeting. It achieves higher success rates across five real-world tasks and three robot embodiments while reducing cross-embodiment training cost.
tldr_zh: EgoJEPA通过基于JEPA的潜在动作预测和世界建模，从第一人称人类视频中学习与具体机器人无关的操作先验，避免了手工重定向。在三个机器人平台上的五个真实世界任务中取得了更高的成功率，并显著降低了跨平台训练成本。

title: TGrasp6D: Task-Informed Vision-Language Priors and Pose Refinement enable Zero-Shot Task-Oriented 6DoF Grasping
summary: Task-Oriented Grasping (TOG) has emerged as an important skill for purposeful robotic manipulation. Given the task of using a knife to "slice bread," a robot must choose to grasp from the handle, whereas for "hand[ing] the knife over," it is preferable for the handle to remain unobstructed for safe handoff. Current approaches for TOG either focus on 2D planar grasping, remain limited by their reliance on task-agnostic grasp generators, or are constrained by reliance on finite, manually-annotated, task-specific grasp datasets that cannot cover all possible grasp-task pairs. To that end, we present TGrasp6D, a vision-language based approach for generating task-oriented 6DoF grasps in a zero-shot manner. Given a task and a single RGB-D image of an associated object, TGrasp6D reasons about the appropriate semantic affordance for the given task and object geometry to produce an initial task- informed prior. This generated prior is further refined via 6DoF pose optimization for collision avoidance while preserving task consistency. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art success rate of 94% on the TaskGrasp dataset, with the best baseline at 74%. We also deploy our approach on a Franka Research 3 robot to demonstrate zero-shot generalization to real world objects
summary_zh: 面向任务抓取（TOG）已成为实现目的性机器人操作的一项重要技能。给定“用刀切面包”的任务，机器人必须选择从刀柄处抓取；而在“递刀”场景中，则更希望刀柄保持无障碍状态，以便安全交接。当前TOG方法要么聚焦于二维平面抓取，要么因依赖与任务无关的抓取生成器而受限，要么受限于依赖有限、人工标注、特定于任务的抓取数据集，无法覆盖所有可能的抓取-任务组合。为此，我们提出了TGrasp6D，一种基于视觉语言的方法，能够以零样本方式生成面向任务的六自由度抓取。给定一个任务及与该任务相关联物体的单张RGB-D图像，TGrasp6D针对给定任务和物体几何结构推理恰当的语义可供性，以生成初始的任务引导先验。该生成先验进一步通过六自由度位姿优化进行精炼，以避免碰撞，同时保持任务一致性。我们的方法在TaskGrasp数据集上达到了94%的最先进成功率，而最优基线为74%。我们还将该方法部署在Franka Research 3机器人上，展示了其对真实世界物体的零样本泛化能力。
tldr: TGrasp6D is a zero-shot task-oriented 6DoF grasping method that uses vision-language priors and pose refinement, achieving state-of-the-art success on the TaskGrasp dataset and demonstrating real-robot generalization.
tldr_zh: TGrasp6D 是一种零样本任务导向的六自由度抓取方法，利用视觉语言先验和位姿优化，在 TaskGrasp 数据集上取得了最优成功率，并在真实机器人上验证了泛化能力。

title: Race to Recovery: Designing Advanced Safety Systems for Autonomous Driving via Learning Autonomous Racing
summary: Vehicles that lose control at the handling limit through icing, hydroplaning, or an abrupt evasive maneuver fall outside the operating envelope of production safety systems such as electronic stability control, which focus on preventing instability rather than recovering from it. Expert drivers regain authority in these conditions by drifting. Existing autonomous recovery approaches are validated on idealized scenarios, define "recovered" states empirically and inconsistently, or rely on offline-planned trajectories rather than acting online. We address these gaps by first training a racing policy with reinforcement learning that learns drifting as a time-optimal maneuver, then adapting it to recovery through continued training with a minimum-time reward. We define recovery relative to a phase-plane-grounded stable equilibrium and introduce Gym-Khana for controller training and evaluation. Across 294 initial loss-of-control states, the transferred policy improves recovery by 186.8% over a Stanley path tracker and outperforms both a nonlinear model predictive controller and a recovery-only policy trained from scratch, while also recovering faster on states the baseline can already handle. An ablation shows that racing pretraining, rather than broader initial-state exposure alone, drives this gain. Deployed on a physical 1:10-scale F1TENTH vehicle using system identification, actuator-lag modelling, and domain randomization, the transferred policy outperforms Stanley on every tested loss-of-control state, including recovering 50% of the time from a hard state the baseline never recovers from.
summary_zh:
摘要：
在操控极限状态下，因结冰、水滑或突发避险 maneuver 而失去控制的车辆，超出了电子稳定控制等生产级安全系统的运行包线——这些系统侧重于防止失稳，而非从失稳中恢复。专业驾驶员在这种条件下通过漂移重新获得车辆控制权。现有的自主恢复方法通常基于理想化场景进行验证，对“已恢复”状态的界定依赖经验且标准不一，或依赖离线规划轨迹而非在线实时决策。为弥补这些不足，我们首先通过强化学习训练一个将漂移视为时间最优操作的赛车策略，再通过持续训练并采用最短时间奖励，将其适配为恢复策略。我们将恢复状态相对于基于相平面稳定平衡点的定义进行了界定，并引入了用于控制器训练与评估的 Gym-Khana 平台。在294种初始失控状态中，迁移策略相较于 Stanley 路径跟踪器恢复成功率提升186.8%，同时优于非线性模型预测控制器和从零训练的纯恢复策略，并且基线方法已能应对的状态下也能实现更快恢复。消融实验表明，赛车预训练（而非单纯扩大初始状态覆盖范围）是性能提升的关键驱动因素。在采用系统辨识、执行器延迟建模和域随机化的物理1:10比例 F1TENTH 车辆上部署后，迁移策略在所有测试的失控状态中均优于 Stanley，包括从基线方法完全无法恢复的高难度状态中实现50%的恢复成功率。
tldr: This paper proposes learning autonomous recovery from loss-of-control states by first training a drifting racing policy with RL and adapting it with a minimum-time reward, introducing Gym-Khana for training/evaluation, and demonstrating improved recovery over baselines on simulated and real F1TENTH vehicles.
tldr_zh: 本文提出通过学习自主赛车中的漂移策略并适应最小时间奖励来应对失控状态，引入 Gym-Khana 进行训练和评估，并在仿真和真实 F1TENTH 车辆上验证了相对于基线的恢复性能提升。

title: SHRED: Self-Play for Heterogeneous Road-Users without Expert Demonstrations
summary: Realistic traffic simulation and autonomous planning both depend on modeling interactions among heterogeneous road users whose dynamics, constraints, and behaviors differ fundamentally. Existing approaches predominantly learn realistic interaction behavior from large-scale human driving demonstrations. In this work, we ask whether such behavior can instead emerge purely through self-play. We present SHRED, a framework that jointly trains vehicles, pedestrians, and cyclists through large-scale heterogeneous self-play from random initialization, without demonstrations or logged-trajectory replay. SHRED combines type-specific dynamics and objectives with procedural scenario generation and per-agent randomization, allowing diverse behaviors to emerge through closed-loop interaction. On the Waymo Open Sim Agents Challenge (WOSAC), SHRED jointly controls all three road-user types and outperforms both the closest demonstration-free self-play baseline and prior self-play methods that use demonstration-trained reference policies. Policies trained only on nuPlan map geometry retain comparable realism under zero-shot evaluation on Waymo. For planning, SHRED outperforms all compared planners on the interaction-heavy InterPlan benchmark. Controlled ablations show that heterogeneity in self-play improves both traffic realism and planning performance, with particularly large planning gains in interaction-heavy scenarios. Together, these results establish heterogeneous procedural self-play as a scalable, demonstration-free paradigm for learning realistic and interactive traffic behavior.
summary_zh: 现实的交通模拟与自主规划都依赖于对异构道路使用者之间交互行为的建模，这些道路使用者的动力学特性、约束条件及行为模式存在根本性差异。现有方法主要从大规模人类驾驶示范中学习逼真的交互行为。在本研究中，我们探讨是否可以通过纯自我博弈的方式使此类行为自发涌现。我们提出了SHRED框架，该框架通过大规模异构自我博弈，从随机初始化出发联合训练车辆、行人及骑车人，无需示范数据或轨迹回放。SHRED将类型特定的动力学与目标函数、程序化场景生成及智能体级随机化相结合，使得多样化行为能够在闭环交互中涌现。在Waymo开放模拟智能体挑战赛（WOSAC）中，SHRED联合控制全部三类道路使用者，其表现优于最接近的无示范自我博弈基线方法，以及使用示范训练参考策略的既有自我博弈方法。仅在nuPlan地图几何上训练的策略，在Waymo数据集上进行零样本评估时仍保持相当的逼真度。在规划方面，SHRED在交互密集型的InterPlan基准测试中优于所有对比规划器。受控消融实验表明，自我博弈中的异构性既能提升交通仿真逼真度，也能改善规划性能，在交互密集场景中规划性能提升尤为显著。综合而言，这些结果确立了异构程序化自我博弈作为一种可扩展、无示范的学习范式，可用于学习逼真且具交互性的交通行为。
tldr: SHRED proposes a demonstration-free framework that generates realistic interactions among heterogeneous road users (vehicles, pedestrians, cyclists) purely through large-scale self-play, outperforming existing baselines in traffic simulation and planning benchmarks.
tldr_zh: SHRED提出了一种无需专家演示的框架，仅通过大规模异构自博弈生成车辆、行人和自行车之间的逼真交互行为，在交通模拟和规划基准上超越了现有基线。

title: A Phenomenology of Neural Geometry in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Robotic manipulation is inherently geometric, but what shape does the world take inside the policy that performs it? Prior work on vision-language-action (VLA) policies establishes that task-relevant variables are linearly readable from activations, yet readability certifies only that a variable is present and says nothing about the shape its values trace, which may be curved and multi-dimensional. Using controlled sweeps, natural rollouts, linear probes, and activation interventions, we build a taxonomy of seven task-relevant concepts in VLA models. We find that realized geometry is predominantly multi-dimensional and is shaped by the constraints under which the policy acts. Physical joint limits, for example, leave wrist orientation an open arc rather than a circle, and distance to the target, a single scalar, is realized in two orthogonal subspaces, a coarse ruler for the approach and a fine ruler for the grasp. The same geometries reappear in two further VLA models on real-world robot data, indicating that they are neither model-specific nor artifacts of simulation. We demonstrate how the findings are actionable by steering along the geometry a concept realizes. Overall, this work lays out an initial phenomenology of realized geometry in VLA policies and demonstrates that a concept's shape carries as much importance as its readability.
summary_zh: 机器人操作本质上是一个几何问题，但在执行该操作策略的内部，世界呈现出怎样的形状？先前关于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的研究表明，任务相关变量可从激活中线性读取，但可读性仅证明该变量存在，并未说明其取值所构成的形状，而该形状可能是弯曲且多维的。通过受控扫描、自然轨迹展开、线性探针和激活干预，我们构建了VLA模型中七类任务相关概念的分类体系。我们发现，实际实现的几何结构主要是多维的，并且受到策略执行时所处约束条件的塑造。例如，物理关节限位使得手腕姿态呈现为开放弧线而非完整圆环；而到目标的距离，这一单一标量，则在两个正交子空间中被实现——一个用于接近的粗略尺度，一个用于抓取的精细尺度。相同的几何结构在另外两个基于真实机器人数据的VLA模型中也重复出现，表明它们既非模型特有，也非仿真伪影。我们展示了这些发现的可操作性，即通过沿概念所实现的几何方向进行引导干预。总体而言，本研究为VLA策略中已实现几何结构建立了初步的现象学框架，并证明概念的形状与其可读性同等重要。
tldr: This paper presents a phenomenology of neural geometry in vision-language-action (VLA) models, identifying a taxonomy of task-relevant concept shapes and demonstrating that these geometries are consistent across models and actionable for steering policy behavior.
tldr_zh: 本文对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中的神经几何进行了现象学研究，建立了任务相关概念形状的分类法，并展示了这些几何形状在不同模型中的一致性及其在策略引导中的可操作性。

title: Multi-Dimensional Featurizers Yield Fine-Grained Steering and Data Shaping in Robot Foundation Models
summary: Can better feature discovery improve control over robot behavior through internal interventions and training data? Recent work in vision and language models reveals multidimensional features, motivating block-sparse featurizers (BSFs), which represent each feature in a low-dimensional subspace. We investigate whether recovering this structure provides an interpretable interface for steering vision-language-action models and shaping the data from which they learn. We show that BSFs recover several multi-dimensional task-relevant features underlying the model's computation (e.g., perception, language, proprioceptive state, episode phase, and control variables). We causally validate these features through fine-grained steering: targeted changes in visual perception, semantic representation, and spatial localization produce predictable changes in downstream action prediction. Finally, we use feature-based data attribution to isolate where a specific behavior (failure recovery) arises in the training dataset, identifying fewer than $1.4\%$ of training tokens whose masking is sufficient to remove the targeted behavior. Overall, our results show how matching featurizers to representation geometry can provide more effective tools for understanding and changing robot behavior.
summary_zh: 更优的特征发现能否通过内部干预和训练数据来提升对机器人行为的控制？近期在视觉和语言模型领域的研究揭示了多维特征的存在，进而推动了块稀疏特征器（BSFs）的发展，该特征器将每个特征表示在低维子空间中。我们探讨了恢复这种结构是否能提供一个可解释的接口，用于引导视觉-语言-行动模型，并塑造它们学习所依据的数据。我们证明，BSFs能够恢复模型计算中若干多维任务相关特征（如感知、语言、本体感觉状态、情节阶段及控制变量）。我们通过细粒度引导对这些特征进行因果验证：对视觉感知、语义表示和空间定位的定向修改会导致下游动作预测产生可预测的变化。最后，我们利用基于特征的数据归因来定位特定行为（故障恢复）在训练数据中的来源，发现仅需掩蔽少于1.4%的训练令牌即可消除该目标行为。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，将特征提取器与表示几何结构相匹配，可以为理解和改变机器人行为提供更有效的工具。
tldr: This paper investigates whether block-sparse featurizers can recover multi-dimensional, interpretable features in vision-language-action models, enabling fine-grained steering of robot behavior and feature-based data attribution to identify minimal training data subsets that control specific behaviors.
tldr_zh: 本文研究块稀疏特征化器能否在视觉-语言-动作模型中恢复多维可解释特征，从而实现对机器人行为的细粒度引导，并通过基于特征的数据归属识别控制特定行为所需的最少训练数据子集。

title: Learning Intrinsic Dynamics in Latent World Models
summary: Learning intrinsic dynamics---the relationship between actions and their consequences---is essential for world models. However, visual variations unrelated to the underlying control process can obscure this relationship in learned representations. We investigate the connection between action predictability, defined as the ability to reconstruct an action from consecutive latent states, and the preservation of intrinsic dynamics. Our central hypothesis is that encouraging action predictability discourages representations from discarding the distinctions between different actions and their consequences. We provide two complementary forms of evidence for this connection. Theoretically, we derive a positive lower bound on squared inverse prediction error when the encoder merges distinguishable outcomes of different actions from the same state and appearance, and show that forward prediction can still be exact on those transitions. Empirically, controlled appearance-diversity comparisons, supervision interventions, and latent probes support the role of action prediction in preserving control-relevant transition information. We instantiate action predictability with Concat IDM, which predicts actions from concatenated latent states and updates the shared encoder using action labels already available in offline trajectories, without changing the test-time planner. Across three independent training runs on Push-T with 24 appearances, Concat IDM increases planning success from 9.1% to 77.2%; its paired improvement is 52.9 percentage points larger than that observed with a single appearance. Together, these findings support action predictability as an inductive bias toward intrinsic dynamics and demonstrate the practical benefits of Concat IDM for latent planning under visual diversity.
summary_zh: 学习内在动力学——即动作与其后果之间的关系——对于世界模型至关重要。然而，与底层控制过程无关的视觉变化可能会在学习到的表征中模糊这一关系。我们研究了动作可预测性（定义为从连续的潜在状态中重建动作的能力）与内在动力学保留之间的联系。我们的核心假设是，鼓励动作可预测性会阻止表征丢弃不同动作及其后果之间的区分。我们为这一联系提供了两种互补形式的证据。理论上，当编码器合并来自相同状态和外观的不同动作的可区分结果时，我们推导出平方逆预测误差的正下界，并表明前向预测在这些转换上仍然可以是精确的。实证上，受控的外观多样性比较、监督干预和潜在探针支持了动作预测在保留与控制相关的转换信息方面的作用。我们使用Concat IDM实例化动作可预测性，该方法从拼接的潜在状态中预测动作，并利用离线轨迹中已有的动作标签更新共享编码器，而不改变测试时的规划器。在具有24种外观的Push-T上进行的三个独立训练运行中，Concat IDM将规划成功率从9.1%提高到77.2%；其配对改进比单一外观下观察到的改进高出52.9个百分点。综上所述，这些发现支持动作可预测性作为朝向内在动力学的归纳偏置，并展示了Concat IDM在视觉多样性下潜在规划中的实际益处。
tldr: This paper proposes Concat IDM, a method that improves latent world models by learning intrinsic dynamics via action predictability, leading to significantly better planning performance in visual diversity settings.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Concat IDM，通过动作可预测性学习内在动态，从而改进潜在世界模型，在视觉多样性设置下显著提升规划性能。

title: FutureLift: Lifting Trajectory Proposals into Bidirectional Future Graphs for Motion Forecasting
summary: Accurate motion prediction is critical for safe autonomous driving, yet even strong forecasters leave residual errors in their multimodal proposals. Existing refiners compress complete proposals or update their segments sequentially, preventing the full proposed future from serving as explicit relational context for correction. We introduce FutureLift, a backbone-agnostic refiner that represents each multimodal proposal as a heterogeneous future graph, with spatially grounded temporal nodes connected to agent histories, map elements, alternative modes, and, for joint prediction, other agents future trajectories. Bidirectional temporal edges allow later evidence to revise earlier segments in a single pass, and the updated nodes predict residual coordinate and confidence corrections. Requiring only proposals, scores, and scene context, FutureLift provides a common refinement interface for structurally different forecasting backbones. On Argoverse2 and the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, it consistently improves frozen proposals and outperforms native and specialized refiners across marginal and joint forecasting. On the WOMD motion-prediction leaderboard, FutureLift ranks first in minADE (0.5049m) and minFDE (0.9942m) among the compared standard-input methods, without LiDAR or ensembling, while achieving a competitive 0.4874 Soft mAP.
summary_zh: 准确的运动预测对于安全自动驾驶至关重要，然而即使强大的预测器在其多模态提议中仍会残留误差。现有的精化器要么压缩完整提议，要么按顺序更新其片段，这使得完整的未来提议无法作为显式的关系上下文用于修正。我们提出FutureLift，一种与主干网络无关的精化器，它将每个多模态提议表示为异质未来图，空间锚定的时间节点与智能体历史、地图元素、备选模式以及（在联合预测中）其他智能体的未来轨迹相连接。双向时间边允许后续证据在单次前向传播中修正较早的片段，更新后的节点预测残差坐标和置信度修正。仅需提议、得分和场景上下文，FutureLift为结构不同的预测主干网络提供了通用的精化接口。在Argoverse2和Waymo开放运动数据集上，它持续改进冻结的提议，并在边缘和联合预测中优于原生及专用精化器。在WOMD运动预测排行榜上，FutureLift在比较的标准输入方法中，minADE（0.5049米）和minFDE（0.9942米）排名第一，无需LiDAR或集成方法，同时实现了具有竞争力的0.4874 Soft mAP。
tldr: FutureLift is a backbone-agnostic refiner that lifts trajectory proposals into bidirectional future graphs, using relational context to correct multimodal motion forecasts for autonomous driving. It achieves state-of-the-art results on Argoverse2 and the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, ranking first on the WOMD leaderboard for minADE and minFDE among standard-input methods.
tldr_zh: FutureLift 是一种与主干网络无关的细化器，将轨迹提议提升为双向未来图，利用关系上下文来修正自动驾驶中的多模态运动预测。它在 Argoverse2 和 Waymo 开放运动数据集上取得了最先进的结果，在 WOMD 排行榜的标准输入方法中，minADE 和 minFDE 均排名第一。

title: Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning for Path-Safe Target Reaching in Robotic Harvesting of Hydroponic Lettuce
summary: Robotic harvesting requires precise manipulation to ensure accurate positioning of the end-effector, especially in a constraint workspace. This study introduces the Path-Safe Approach Proximal Policy Optimization (PSA-PPO), a target-conditioned local reaching framework designed for robotic harvesting of nutrient film technique (NFT)-hydroponic lettuce in greenhouses. The proposed PSA-PPO preserves the standard clipped PPO objective while introducing a harvesting-oriented policy formulation that integrates target-conditioned observations, corridor-aware spatial constraints, trajectory-history-based safety encoding, and task-specific success criteria for constrained robotic manipulation. PSAPPO was trained entirely in Isaac Lab and successfully transferred to a physical UR10e robotic arm without any real-world policy fine-tuning. In a controlled physical benchmark against 150 scheduled targets, PSA-PPO achieved the highest reaching rate of 94.7%, outperforming Cartesian+TOTG (86.0%), RRTConnect (88.0%), and RRT* (80.0%), while reducing median RMS jerk by 39.8 to 73.0% relative to the classical planners during the final approach segment. A formulation ablation evaluated over 200 simulation targets demonstrates that path-safety and side-corridor shaping are the principal drivers of harvesting-compatible performance: removing either term substantially degrades strict success even when terminal endpoint accuracy is preserved or improved, confirming that optimization toward the endpoint alone is an insufficient objective for constrained crop-proximal manipulation. Finally, PSA-PPO was integrated with an RGB-D vision module and an end-effector and evaluated as a complete greenhouse harvesting system across 144 lettuce harvesting attempts, achieving 94.4% vision-guided target reaching and 86.1% complete harvesting success.
summary_zh: 机器人采摘要求精确的操作控制，以确保末端执行器在受限工作空间内精准定位。本研究提出了一种路径安全近端策略优化算法（PSA-PPO），这是一种面向目标的局部到达框架，专为温室中营养液膜技术（NFT）水培生菜的机器人采摘设计。所提出的PSA-PPO保留了标准裁剪式PPO目标函数，同时引入了一种面向采摘的策略制定方式，该方式整合了目标条件观测、通道感知空间约束、基于轨迹历史的安全编码以及针对受限机器人操作的任务特定成功标准。PSA-PPO完全在Isaac Lab中训练，并成功迁移至实体UR10e机械臂，无需任何真实环境策略微调。在针对150个预设目标的受控物理基准测试中，PSA-PPO取得了94.7%的最高到达率，优于Cartesian+TOTG（86.0%）、RRTConnect（88.0%）和RRT*（80.0%），同时在最终接近阶段，其中位RMS加加速度较经典规划器降低了39.8%至73.0%。在200个仿真目标上进行的消融研究表明，路径安全与侧通道塑形是影响采摘兼容性能的主要驱动因素：移除其中任一要素都会显著降低严格成功率，即使终端端点精度得到保持或提升，这证实了仅以端点优化为目标不足以应对作物邻近区域的受限操作。最后，PSA-PPO与RGB-D视觉模块及末端执行器集成，作为完整的温室采摘系统在144次生菜采摘尝试中进行了评估，实现了94.4%的视觉引导目标到达率和86.1%的完整采摘成功率。
tldr: This paper introduces PSA-PPO, a target-conditioned reinforcement learning framework with path-safety constraints, for robotic harvesting of hydroponic lettuce. It achieves high success rates on a real UR10e arm, outperforming classical planners and integrating with vision for complete greenhouse harvesting.
tldr_zh: 本文提出PSA-PPO，一种带有路径安全约束的目标条件强化学习框架，用于水培生菜机器人采摘。在真实UR10e机械臂上取得了高成功率，优于经典规划器，并与视觉集成实现完整温室采摘。

title: Onboard Lightweight LLM Reasoning for Human-Aware Safe UAV Navigation
summary: Aerial robots operating near people must treat a pedestrian, a parked car, and a wall differently, yet conventional perception--planning stacks reduce all of them to occupied geometry---a \emph{human-aware safety gap} in which category-specific clearance is unavailable to the planner and temporary occlusions remove pedestrian-specific constraints from its map. We present a modular, fully onboard pipeline that closes this gap by turning visual observations into context-dependent safety constraints for real-time UAV navigation. A shared BLIP encoder drives scene captioning and text-conditioned segmentation, which is fused with depth to localize obstacles in 3D. Obstacle-specific risk is inferred by a lightweight LLM (Qwen-2.5-0.5B) stabilized with retrieval-augmented generation and grammar-constrained decoding that restricts its output to a planner-compatible JSON schema. The LLM reasons once per object category rather than per frame: its verdicts are cached per class, so previously seen categories are resolved without inference and new ones trigger a fresh retrieval-grounded query; detections are additionally given persistent identities and held in the map across occlusions. The perception pipeline runs at 10\,Hz on a Jetson Orin NX, while fallback LLM queries take approximately 0.8\,s and remain off the control-critical path. In Gazebo, low-altitude urban navigation among pedestrians and vehicles shows a roughly $3\times$ reduction in collision events over a geometric planner, and semantics-aware landing among moving actors raises success from 34\% to 96\%. The 224-pixel encoder input limits reliable small-object perception at range; conservative pedestrian margins and short-term persistence mitigate this limitation during navigation.
summary_zh: 在人类附近运行的空中机器人必须区别对待行人、停放车辆和墙壁，然而传统的感知—规划架构将所有障碍物一律简化为占据几何体——这构成了一个“人类感知安全鸿沟”，即规划器无法获取针对特定类别的安全间距，而临时遮挡会从其地图中移除行人专属约束。我们提出了一种模块化的全机载处理流程，通过将视觉观测转化为适用于实时无人机导航的上下文相关安全约束，弥补了这一鸿沟。共享的BLIP编码器驱动场景描述与文本条件分割，并与深度信息融合，在三维空间中定位障碍物。针对特定障碍物的风险由轻量级大语言模型（Qwen-2.5-0.5B）推断，该模型通过检索增强生成和语法约束解码加以稳定，后者将其输出限制为规划器兼容的JSON模式。大语言模型按物体类别而非逐帧进行推理：其判定结果按类别缓存，因此已见过的类别无需再次推理即可解决，而新类别则会触发一次新的检索基础查询；此外，检测结果会赋予持久身份，并在遮挡期间持续保留在地图中。感知流程在Jetson Orin NX上以10赫兹运行，而备用大语言模型查询约需0.8秒，且不位于控制关键路径上。在Gazebo中，行人及车辆间的低空城市导航实验表明，与几何规划器相比碰撞事件减少了约3倍；而在移动参与者之间进行的语义感知着陆将成功率从34%提升至96%。224像素的编码器输入限制了远距离小物体感知的可靠性；保守的行人安全余量及短期持久性在导航过程中缓解了这一局限性。
tldr: The paper presents a modular onboard UAV navigation pipeline that uses a lightweight LLM with RAG and grammar-constrained decoding to generate human-aware safety constraints, significantly reducing collisions and improving landing success in simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种模块化的机载无人机导航流程，利用轻量级LLM与RAG和语法约束解码生成人类感知的安全约束，在仿真中显著减少碰撞并提高着陆成功率。

title: Plans Are Not Executions: Adapting Frozen World-Model Planners to Controller-Induced Execution Shift
summary:
World-model planners evaluate candidate trajectories by predicting their future consequences, implicitly relying on the plan-to-motion relationship learned during training. At deployment, a different downstream controller may execute the same planned trajectory differently, creating a planning-execution gap between the frozen model's imagined future and actual execution. A natural remedy is to replace the planned trajectory with its predicted or observed execution. However, we find that better execution fidelity does not necessarily yield better decisions: directly substituting predicted execution trajectories yields only a 0.048 PDMS improvement across 10 unseen controller configurations, far smaller than the gain from our proposed adaptation. This suggests a semantic mismatch between a planned trajectory, which serves as a reference for downstream control, and an executed trajectory, which already describes the resulting post-controller motion.
  We introduce ExecutionBridge, which infers controller-specific execution characteristics from planned-executed trajectory pairs and uses them to adapt the native ego latent rollout while keeping the original planned trajectory unchanged. The planner, world model, and reward head remain frozen. On NAVSIM, ExecutionBridge consistently improves planning across unseen controller configurations and multiple frozen world-model planners, with substantially larger gains in challenging driving scenes where execution mismatch more strongly affects candidate evaluation.
summary_zh:
世界模型规划器通过预测候选轨迹的未来后果来评估其优劣，这隐式地依赖于训练期间学到的“规划-运动”关系。在部署阶段，不同的下游控制器可能以不同方式执行相同的规划轨迹，从而在冻结模型的想象未来与实际执行之间产生规划-执行差距。一种自然的补救方法是用预测或观测到的执行轨迹替代规划轨迹。然而，我们发现更高的执行保真度并不一定能带来更好的决策：直接替换预测的执行轨迹，在10种未见过的控制器配置下仅带来0.048的PDMS提升，远小于我们提出的自适应方法所带来的增益。这表明规划轨迹（作为下游控制的参考）与执行轨迹（已描述控制器后的实际运动）之间存在语义不匹配。

为此，我们提出ExecutionBridge方法，从规划-执行轨迹对中推断控制器特定的执行特性，并利用这些特性调整原生自我潜在轨迹展开，同时保持原始规划轨迹不变。规划器、世界模型和奖励头均保持冻结状态。在NAVSIM基准上，ExecutionBridge在多种未见过的控制器配置和多个冻结的世界模型规划器上持续提升规划性能，且在执行不匹配对候选评估影响更大的挑战性驾驶场景中，其增益尤为显著。
tldr: This paper introduces ExecutionBridge, a method to adapt frozen world-model planners to controller-induced execution shifts by inferring controller-specific characteristics from planned-executed trajectory pairs, improving planning performance on NAVSIM without retraining the planner or world model.
tldr_zh: 本文提出ExecutionBridge，通过从计划-执行轨迹对中推断控制器特定特征，使冻结的世界模型规划器适应控制器引起的执行偏移，在NAVSIM上提升了规划性能且无需重新训练规划器或世界模型。

title: DemoStream: Batched Task-and-Motion-Plan Optimization for Automated Learning from Demonstration
summary: Learning from demonstration is an effective strategy for endowing robots with manipulation capabilities but requires training on datasets comprised of massive amounts of demonstrations. Existing demonstration collection approaches either require constant human involvement, for example, via teleoperation or are specialized for a single task. Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) systems are able to autonomously solve and therefore generate demonstrations for general-purpose tasks; however, learning from their demonstrations has proven difficult due to multi-modality in their solutions. In this work, we build on recent work leveraging GPU acceleration for TAMP and propose DemoStream, a TAMP system that optimizes demonstration quality in order to improve behavior cloning success rates. First, we introduce batched TAMP sampling operations along with a new TAMP algorithm that correspondingly performs batched constraint satisfaction in order to explore many solutions in parallel. We conduct simulation experiments ablating different action spaces, cost functions, and batch sizes to analyze the effect of these choices on downstream policy success rates. Finally, we show that we can leverage the safety guarantees of TAMP to directly collect real-world demonstrations at an average rate of 66 demos per hour. See our website for policy rollout videos: demostream.github.io.
