tldr_zh: PACT-VLA 是一个无需训练的框架，通过从过时观测生成多个动作块，并利用推理延迟作为决策时间，根据提交前观测选择最佳候选块，提高了 VLA 策略的延迟鲁棒性，无需单独验证器且不增加控制步延迟。

title: LocoPilot: Single-Operator Bilateral Teleoperation for Loco-Manipulation Policy Learning
summary: Learning loco-manipulation policies requires demonstrations that capture coordinated base and arm motion on the target embodiment. Robot-free interfaces allow demonstrations to be collected independently of the target robot, increasing flexibility but without directly capturing platform-specific commands, proprioception, and body-mounted observations. On-robot teleoperation allows to capture these signals directly, but requires an interface capable of commanding the complete system concurrently. This paper presents LocoPilot, a single-operator bilateral teleoperation and data-collection framework implemented on a 12-DoF Unitree Go2 quadruped equipped with a 6-DoF AgileX Piper L manipulator, an Intel RealSense D435 wrist camera, and an Intel RealSense D405 head camera. A second 6-DoF Piper L arm, used as the leader and two handheld controllers provide simultaneous control of the base, body posture, manipulator, and gripper. The follower arm interaction forces are estimated without a dedicated force/torque sensor and rendered to the operator through a passivity-constrained haptic channel. A ROS~2 pipeline records synchronized multimodal observations together with a unified 11D action shared by teleoperation and policy deployment. Compared to prior work, LocoPilot uniquely unifies robot-in-the-loop legged data collection, force feedback without motion-capture instrumentation, and the same action interface at deployment. We evaluate the interface across multiple loco-manipulation tasks and validate the complete collection-to-deployment pipeline by fine-tuning MolmoAct2 \cite{MOLMO} on pick-and-place demonstrations and deploying on the physical robot without action retargeting or additional inverse kinematics. Code available at: https://github.com/iit-DLSLab/LocoPilot
summary_zh: 学习移动操控策略需要包含目标本体上基座与手臂协调运动的演示数据。无机器人交互界面允许独立于目标机器人采集演示数据，提高了灵活性，但无法直接捕获平台特定的指令、本体感觉及机体搭载的观测信息。机器人上的遥操作可以直接捕获这些信号，但需要一个能够同时控制完整系统的交互界面。本文提出了LocoPilot，一种单操作员双向遥操作与数据采集框架，实现于配备6自由度AgileX Piper L机械臂、Intel RealSense D435腕部相机和Intel RealSense D405头部相机的12自由度Unitree Go2四足机器人上。第二个6自由度Piper L机械臂作为主臂，配合两个手持控制器，实现对基座、机体姿态、机械臂和夹爪的同步控制。从臂的交互力无需专用力/力矩传感器即可估算，并通过无源性约束的触觉通道反馈给操作员。ROS 2管道记录同步的多模态观测数据，以及遥操作与策略部署共用的统一11维动作表示。与先前工作相比，LocoPilot独特地将机器人参与的回环腿式数据采集、无需动作捕捉设备的力反馈，以及部署时相同的动作接口统一于一体。我们跨多个移动操控任务评估了该交互界面，并通过在拾取放置演示数据上微调MolmoAct2 \cite{MOLMO}，在物理机器人上无需动作重定向或额外逆运动学即可部署，验证了完整的采集到部署管道。代码见：https://github.com/iit-DLSLab/LocoPilot
tldr: LocoPilot presents a single-operator bilateral teleoperation framework for legged loco-manipulation data collection, enabling direct capture of platform-specific commands and proprioception, and validates it by fine-tuning a VLA policy for real-world pick-and-place.
tldr_zh: LocoPilot 提出了一种用于腿式移动操控数据采集的单操作员双边遥操作框架，可直接捕获平台特定的指令和本体感觉，并通过微调 VLA 策略在真实机器人上完成抓取放置任务验证。

title: Learning Tactile-Aware Hand Representations from Human Hand-Object Interaction Data
summary: Tactile representation learning for dexterous manipulation often requires substantial robot-side data collection, limiting its scalability across different hands and sensors. We explore whether large-scale human hand-object interaction (HOI) data can provide a useful prior for robotic tactile learning. To this end, we propose HuTact, a framework that pretrains tactile-aware hand representations from human HOI data without requiring real tactile signals during pretraining. HuTact transfers the interaction structure learned from human hand motions to robotic tactile observations and can be further adapted with a small amount of unlabeled robot interaction data. We evaluate HuTact on tactile perception and manipulation tasks, including grasp prediction, slip detection, object classification, and tactile-conditioned policy learning. Across these tasks, human HOI pretraining improves data efficiency and provides a strong initialization for downstream learning. Notably, with HOI pretraining followed by midtraining on unlabeled robot play data, HuTact achieves 88.26% Macro-F1 on grasp prediction using only 25\% of the labeled downstream data, comparable to training from scratch on the full labeled dataset (88.23%). These results suggest that human interaction data can serve as a scalable complementary source for robotic tactile representation learning.
summary_zh: 灵巧操作中的触觉表征学习通常需要大量的机器人侧数据收集，这限制了其在不同机械手和传感器之间的可扩展性。我们探索大规模人类手-物交互数据能否为机器人触觉学习提供有效的先验知识。为此，我们提出HuTact框架，该框架从人类手-物交互数据中预训练触觉感知的手部表征，且预训练阶段无需真实的触觉信号。HuTact将人类手部运动中习得的交互结构迁移至机器人触觉观测，并可通过少量无标注的机器人交互数据进行进一步适配。我们在触觉感知和操作任务上评估HuTact，包括抓取预测、滑移检测、物体分类以及触觉条件策略学习。在这些任务中，人类手-物交互预训练显著提升了数据效率，并为下游学习提供了强初始化。值得注意的是，通过人类手-物交互预训练并结合在无标注机器人播放数据上的中训练，HuTact在仅使用25%标注下游数据的情况下，抓取预测的Macro-F1达到88.26%，与在完整标注数据集上从头训练的88.23%相当。这些结果表明，人类交互数据可作为机器人触觉表征学习中可扩展的补充数据来源。
tldr: HuTact pretrains tactile-aware hand representations from large-scale human hand-object interaction data without real tactile signals, enabling efficient adaptation to robotic tactile perception and manipulation tasks with limited labeled data.
tldr_zh: HuTact 从大规模人手-物体交互数据中预训练触觉感知的手部表征，无需真实触觉信号，从而在少量标注数据下有效适应机器人触觉感知与操作任务。

title: EventSync: Event-Driven Memory Updates for History-Dependent Manipulation
summary: History-dependent robotic manipulation requires task context and interaction history, as the current observation alone is insufficient to determine the next action. Hierarchical frameworks use task memory for high-level subgoal reasoning and low-level policies for execution. However, memory updates require accurate completion assessment: similar observations may correspond to different execution phases, and prematurely recording completion can mislead subsequent subgoal reasoning. We present EventSync, a hierarchical framework that coordinates task reasoning and action execution through event-driven memory updates. A vision-language model generates subgoals from task plans and interaction history, while a vision-language-action model executes them. A lightweight Event Monitor combines visual observations with end-effector trajectories to determine whether the current subgoal is complete. The framework records the current subgoal in its completed-subgoal history and triggers subsequent reasoning only after obtaining completion evidence. With visual history in the executor, EventSync achieves 64.5% overall success on RoboMME, exceeding the best baseline reported in the benchmark by 20.0 percentage points. Further analysis shows that this update mechanism helps build a reliable completed-subgoal history. Experiments on four real-robot tasks with different memory requirements validate the framework's effectiveness in real-world robotic manipulation.
summary_zh: 历史依赖的机器人操作需要任务上下文和交互历史，因为仅凭当前观察不足以确定下一步动作。分层框架利用任务记忆进行高层子目标推理，并借助低层策略执行动作。然而，记忆更新需要准确的完成度评估：相似的观察可能对应不同的执行阶段，过早记录完成状态可能误导后续的子目标推理。我们提出了EventSync，一种通过事件驱动的记忆更新来协调任务推理与动作执行的分层框架。视觉-语言模型从任务计划和交互历史中生成子目标，而视觉-语言-动作模型负责执行这些子目标。轻量级事件监控器结合视觉观察与末端执行器轨迹，判断当前子目标是否已完成。框架仅在获得完成证据后，才将当前子目标记录到已完成子目标历史中，并触发后续推理。在执行器中引入视觉历史后，EventSync在RoboMME上取得了64.5%的总体成功率，比基准测试中报告的最佳基线高出20.0个百分点。进一步分析表明，这一更新机制有助于构建可靠的已完成子目标历史。在四种具有不同记忆需求的实际机器人任务上的实验验证了该框架在真实机器人操作中的有效性。
tldr: EventSync introduces a hierarchical framework with event-driven memory updates for history-dependent robot manipulation, using a lightweight event monitor to trigger subgoal reasoning only upon completion evidence, achieving significant success rate improvements over baselines.
tldr_zh: EventSync 提出了一种具有事件驱动内存更新的分层框架，用于历史相关的机器人操作，通过轻量级事件监视器在完成证据出现时才触发子目标推理，显著提高了任务成功率。

title: What Novice Operators See Changes What the Policy Learns: A User Study of Keypoint Hand Visual Representation for Teleoperated Demonstration
summary: Imitation learning increasingly relies on novice operators, whose demonstrations fall short of experts' in number and inter-trial consistency. Operators act on what they are shown, yet how the rendering of the robot affects their demonstrations, and the policies trained on them, has not been examined. We study this question with PointHand, a teleoperation interface that renders a multi-fingered robot hand as sparse keypoints at its fingertips and joints, the same keypoints a policy can observe. In a simulated mug-in-box task, 18 novices and 4 experts collected 2,200 trials under three renderings: the real shape of the hand, all keypoints emphasized, or the thumb and index finger alone emphasized. The novices shown the thumb and index finger emphasized collected 441 successful demonstrations from 600 trials, against 320 for those shown the real shape. We then trained diffusion policies on these demonstrations, replacing the scene point cloud and proprioceptive state they observe with the hand keypoints and two object keypoints. Within 400 steps these demonstrations went from the weakest of the three novice conditions under the point-cloud policy (46.3%) to the strongest under the keypoint policy (57.3%), a gain of +11.0 percentage points in all five seeds. Those collected with all keypoints emphasized changed by at most +0.7 percentage points, and in no more than three seeds. The value of a demonstration therefore depends on the rendering shown during collection and on what the policy observes together. A shared representation can pay off on both sides, in the number of successful demonstrations and in the success rate of the policy trained on them. Project page: https://omron-sinicx.github.io/point-hand/
summary_zh: 模仿学习日益依赖于新手操作员，而他们的示范在数量上和试验间一致性上均不及专家。操作员依据所见进行操作，然而机器人渲染方式如何影响他们的示范以及基于这些示范训练的策略，尚未得到研究。我们通过PointHand这一遥操作界面来探究此问题，该界面将多指机器人手渲染为指尖和关节处的稀疏关键点，即策略可观察到的同一组关键点。在模拟的杯子放入盒子任务中，18名新手和4名专家在三种渲染条件下收集了2,200次试验：手的真实形状、全部关键点突出显示、或仅突出显示拇指和食指。看到拇指和食指突出显示的新手在600次试验中收集了441次成功示范，而看到真实形状的新手则收集了320次成功示范。随后我们基于这些示范训练扩散策略，将策略观察的场景点云和本体感觉状态替换为手部关键点和两个物体关键点。在400步训练内，这些示范在点云策略下从三种新手条件中最弱（46.3%）转变为关键点策略下最强（57.3%），在所有五个随机种子中均获得+11.0个百分点的提升。全部关键点突出显示条件下收集的示范变化最多不超过+0.7个百分点，且仅在不超过三个种子中有所提升。因此，示范的价值既取决于收集过程中展示的渲染方式，也取决于策略共同观察的内容。共享表示可在两方面带来收益：成功示范的数量以及基于这些示范训练的策略的成功率。项目页面：https://omron-sinicx.github.io/point-hand/
tldr: This paper studies how the visual rendering of a robot hand during teleoperated demonstration collection affects both the quality of demonstrations from novice operators and the performance of policies trained on them, finding that a shared keypoint representation improves both demonstration success rates and downstream policy success.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了遥操作示范采集中机器人手部视觉渲染方式如何影响新手操作者的示范质量以及后续策略的性能，发现共享关键点表示能同时提高示范成功率和下游策略成功率。

title: Frontier LLMs Enter the World of Robotics: A Cross-Model Evaluation on RoboColiseum
summary: Recent studies have explored the potential of multimodal large language models for robot control, yet the models' embodied capabilities remain insufficiently characterized across models, tasks, and execution settings. We conduct a multidimensional comparative evaluation on RoboColiseum across four tracks: Instruction Following, Spatial Reasoning, General Manipulation, and Robustness. We implement Agent2Act, a control harness that integrates GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, Claude Opus 5.5, and Gemini 4 Argon into the evaluation environment through shared observation, action execution, and feedback interfaces. Under common task settings and scoring criteria, all four models exhibit a consistent capability profile: high instruction-following scores, with three approaching perfect performance; strong spatial reasoning; and general manipulation scores below those of the other three tracks. Within the evaluated configurations, Astra leads instruction following and robustness, while Opus leads spatial reasoning, general manipulation, and overall performance. These results reveal complementary strengths across models and a persistent gap between task understanding and reliable physical execution. Component comparisons on selected tasks further show that harness design affects task success, planning cost, and execution time. Additionally, case studies with Astra examine whole-body coordination, manipulation across robot embodiments, precision manipulation, dexterous-hand manipulation, and real-robot tasks, providing further insight into the model's capabilities and limitations across embodied tasks.
summary_zh: 近期研究已探索多模态大语言模型在机器人控制中的潜力，然而，这些模型的具身能力在不同模型、任务及执行场景中的表征仍不充分。我们在RoboColiseum平台上开展了涵盖四个轨道的多维比较评估：指令遵循、空间推理、通用操作及鲁棒性。我们实现了Agent2Act，一个控制框架，通过共享观测、动作执行及反馈接口，将GPT-6 Astra、GPT-6.1 Sol、Claude Opus 5.5和Gemini 4 Argon集成到评估环境中。在统一的任务设置和评分标准下，四个模型展现出一致的能力特征：指令遵循得分高，其中三个模型接近完美表现；空间推理能力强；而通用操作得分低于其他三个轨道。在所评估的配置中，Astra在指令遵循和鲁棒性方面领先，而Opus在空间推理、通用操作及整体性能上居首。这些结果揭示了模型之间互补的优势，以及任务理解与可靠物理执行之间持续存在的差距。在选定任务上的组件比较进一步表明，框架设计会影响任务成功率、规划成本及执行时间。此外，针对Astra的案例研究考察了全身协调、跨机器人形态的操作、精细操作、灵巧手操作及真实机器人任务，从而更深入地揭示了该模型在各类具身任务中的能力与局限。
tldr: This paper evaluates frontier multimodal LLMs on robot control tasks within the RoboColiseum benchmark, using a unified control harness across instruction following, spatial reasoning, manipulation, and robustness, revealing complementary strengths and persistent gaps between task understanding and physical execution.
tldr_zh: 本文在RoboColiseum基准上评估了前沿多模态大模型的机器人控制能力，使用统一的控制框架覆盖指令跟随、空间推理、操作和鲁棒性等任务，揭示了各模型的互补优势以及任务理解与物理执行之间的持续差距。

title: RoboCasa-Shift: Stage-Aware Robustness Evaluation of Vision-Language-Action Policies in Long-Horizon Household Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) robustness is commonly summarized by aggregate task success, which obscures how individual executions change under distribution shifts and where failures emerge in long-horizon tasks. We introduce \textbf{RoboCasa-Shift}, a diagnostic robustness benchmark built on RoboCasa365 that combines controlled single-factor shifts, matched clean-perturbed rollouts in which each pair shares the same underlying settings and differs only in the target shift, and simulator-grounded stage-aware diagnostics. We evaluate GR00T N1.5 on four long-horizon tasks that pass a predefined clean-performance gate under four perturbation factors and three calibrated severity levels, including conditions that drive the evaluated policy to complete task failure, totaling 1,040 formal rollouts. Robustness responses vary substantially across factors and tasks, and increasing severity does not always produce monotonic degradation. For example, one camera condition yields $Δ\mathrm{SR}=0$ despite 8 of 80 matched episodes changing outcome. Stage-aware analysis further shows that the same end-to-end degradation can correspond to different execution-depth profiles. Camera $L_2$ and Gaussian blur $L_1$ both yield $Δ\mathrm{SR}=0.188$, yet their first-stage failure rates are 19.0\% and 36.4\%, respectively. Our findings suggest that VLA robustness should be viewed as a multi-dimensional property of execution rather than a single end-to-end performance measure, motivating evaluation protocols that jointly capture outcome degradation, paired outcome sensitivity, and failure progression. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/HaochengWang23/RoboCasa-Shift.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的鲁棒性通常以总体任务成功率来概括，但这种做法掩盖了在分布偏移下各次执行结果的变化，以及长时程任务中失败究竟在何处出现。我们提出 \textbf{RoboCasa-Shift}，一个基于 RoboCasa365 构建的诊断性鲁棒性基准，它结合了受控的单因素偏移、匹配的干净-扰动 rollout（每对 rollout 共享相同的底层设置，仅目标偏移不同），以及基于仿真器的分阶段诊断。我们在四项通过预定义干净性能门槛的长时程任务上评估 GR00T N1.5，涵盖四种扰动因素和三个校准严重级别，包括使被评估策略完全任务失败的条件，总共有 1,040 次正式 rollout。鲁棒性响应在不同因素和任务间差异显著，且严重程度的增加并不总是带来单调的性能退化。例如，在某种相机条件下，尽管 80 个匹配回合中有 8 个结果发生变化，$\Delta\mathrm{SR}$ 仍为 0。分阶段分析进一步表明，相同的端到端性能退化可能对应不同的执行深度分布。相机 $L_2$ 扰动与高斯模糊 $L_1$ 扰动均产生 $\Delta\mathrm{SR}=0.188$，但二者的第一阶段失败率分别为 19.0\% 和 36.4\%。我们的研究结果表明，VLA 鲁棒性应被视为执行过程的多维属性，而非单一的端到端性能指标，因此需要同时捕捉结果退化、配对结果敏感性以及失败进展的联合评估协议。代码已公开于 https://github.com/HaochengWang23/RoboCasa-Shift。
tldr: This paper introduces RoboCasa-Shift, a diagnostic robustness benchmark for evaluating VLA policies under controlled distribution shifts in long-horizon household manipulation, revealing that robustness is multi-dimensional and not captured by aggregate success rates alone.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 RoboCasa-Shift，一个用于在长时程家庭操作任务中评估 VLA 策略在受控分布偏移下鲁棒性的诊断基准，揭示了鲁棒性是多维度的，不能仅由总体成功率衡量。

title: Multi-View Latent Action Pretraining for Cross-Embodiment Robot Learning from Videos
summary: Action-free videos are an appealing substitute for costly teleoperated data. Latent action models (LAMs) turn videos into a supervision signal by inferring abstract actions between frames. Existing LAMs observe a single camera view, which resolves 6D robot actions only ambiguously missing out-of-plane movements and potential occlusions. We propose a LAM that ingests synchronized multi-camera views using cross-attention to resolve depth and occlusions before compressing them into latent actions. The latent actions are fed into a policy in which a latent expert and an action expert are coupled by sequential flow matching around a frozen VLM backbone. We further evaluate in strict cross-embodiment settings where task-specific demonstrations come from other embodiments. We show that dual-view LAM pretraining improves the decodability of ground-truth 6D actions by 17% compared to single-view, while scaling single-view data by two orders of magnitude is not sufficient to fully recover out-of-plane motions. The downstream policy improves success rate by +13.5% compared to +6.2% for single-view LAM. A single cross-embodiment is sufficient for skill transfer, and adding a second viewpoint outperforms adding up to four further embodiments. The results transfer to hardware where demonstrations come from a human hand improving success rate by +20% over action-only policies in 850 rollouts. We show that video and robot data are complementary, and that benefits of learning from video are task-dependent. Website: https://learnsyslab.github.io/multiview_latent_action_pretraining/
summary_zh: 无动作视频是昂贵遥操作数据的一种有吸引力的替代品。潜在动作模型（LAMs）通过推断帧之间的抽象动作，将视频转化为监督信号。现有的LAMs仅观察单一摄像头视角，这使得6D机器人动作的解析存在模糊性，无法捕捉平面外运动及潜在的遮挡问题。我们提出了一种LAM模型，该模型利用交叉注意力机制融合多摄像头同步视角，在将其压缩为潜在动作之前解决深度和遮挡问题。潜在动作被输入到一个策略中，在该策略中，潜在专家和动作专家通过围绕冻结的VLM主干网络的序列流匹配进行耦合。我们进一步在严格的跨具身设置中进行了评估，其中任务特定的演示来自其他具身。我们证明，与单视角相比，双视角LAM预训练将真实6D动作的可解码性提高了17%，而将单视角数据扩展两个数量级仍不足以完全恢复平面外运动。下游策略的成功率提升至+13.5%，而单视角LAM仅为+6.2%。单个跨具身数据足以实现技能迁移，且增加第二个视角优于增加多达四个额外具身。这些结果也迁移到了硬件实验中，在850次实际部署中，使用人类手部演示的策略相比仅基于动作的策略成功率提高了+20%。我们表明视频和机器人数据是互补的，且从视频中学习的收益取决于具体任务。网站：https://learnsyslab.github.io/multiview_latent_action_pretraining/
tldr: This paper proposes a multi-view latent action model that uses cross-attention to fuse synchronized camera views, improving 6D action decodability and cross-embodiment policy learning from action-free videos, with gains demonstrated in simulation and real-robot rollouts.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种多视角隐动作模型，通过交叉注意力融合同步多相机视图，提高从无动作视频中解码6D动作的能力，并在跨本体策略学习中取得显著提升，仿真和真实机器人实验均验证了有效性。

title: RoboJudge: Multimodal Language Models as Judges for Embodied Video Generation
summary: Video generation models are promising foundations for embodied world models, but only if their generated rollouts are physically valid and faithful to task instructions. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to judge these properties, yet their agreement with human judgments on embodied videos has not been systematically evaluated. To address this gap, we introduce RoboJudge-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs as judges of embodied video generation. The benchmark measures two fundamental dimensions, Physical Adherence and Instruction Alignment, across 800 human-annotated videos from 8 source corpora and 10 video generators, spanning grippers, human hands, and dexterous hands. Experiments reveal uneven alignment between existing judges and human ratings: general-purpose MLLMs show lower agreement on physical adherence, while specialized video judges designed for general-domain physical reasoning do not consistently transfer to embodied scenarios. Motivated by these findings, we construct RoboJudge-Train, comprising 12K videos annotated with 25K human-verified scores and model-assisted rationales for Physical Adherence and Instruction Alignment. We fine-tune a 9B MLLM on this dataset with supervised learning followed by reinforcement learning, yielding RoboJudge-9B. Among the model judges evaluated on RoboJudge-Bench, RoboJudge-9B achieves the highest overall agreement, reaching a Pearson correlation of 0.719 with a statistically significant 0.089 gain over Gemini-3.7-Flash, the best-performing proprietary baseline in our evaluation. Training on RoboJudge-Train also yields gains on external benchmarks, including VideoPhy2 and Physion-Eval. We further use RoboJudge-9B as a downstream evaluator to benchmark video generation models according to Physical Adherence and Instruction Alignment.
summary_zh: 视频生成模型是具身世界模型的有力基础，但前提是其生成的推演序列在物理上有效且忠实于任务指令。多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）正越来越多地被用于评判这些属性，然而它们与人类在具身视频评判上的一致性尚未得到系统评估。为填补这一空白，我们提出了RoboJudge-Bench，一个用于评估MLLMs作为具身视频生成评判者的基准。该基准从8个源语料库和10个视频生成器中，对800个经过人工标注的视频，衡量两个基本维度：物理遵从性和指令对齐性。实验揭示了现有评判者与人类评分之间的不一致性：通用型MLLMs在物理遵从性上的一致性较低，而为通用领域物理推理设计的专用视频评判者，在迁移到具身场景时并不能持续保持其性能。基于这些发现，我们构建了RoboJudge-Train，包含12K个视频，配有25K个人工验证的评分以及用于物理遵从性和指令对齐性的模型辅助推理依据。我们通过监督学习结合强化学习，在该数据集上微调了一个9B参数的MLLM，得到RoboJudge-9B。在RoboJudge-Bench上评估的所有模型评判者中，RoboJudge-9B取得了最高的总体一致性，皮尔逊相关系数达到0.719，相较于我们评估中表现最佳的商业基线Gemini-3.7-Flash，统计上显著提升了0.089。在RoboJudge-Train上的训练还为外部基准带来了增益，包括VideoPhy2和Physion-Eval。我们进一步将RoboJudge-9B作为下游评估器，根据物理遵从性和指令对齐性对视频生成模型进行基准测试。
tldr: This paper introduces RoboJudge-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs as judges of embodied video generation, and RoboJudge-9B, a fine-tuned MLLM that achieves the highest agreement with human judgments on physical adherence and instruction alignment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了RoboJudge-Bench基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型作为具身视频生成评判者的能力，并训练了RoboJudge-9B模型，在物理一致性和指令对齐方面与人类判断的一致性最高。

title: AWLS: Advantage-Weighted Latent Steering for One-Step Generative Robotic Manipulation Policies
summary: Human-collected real-world robotic manipulation demonstrations often contain mixed-quality trajectories, including hesitant, indirect, or inefficient action segments. While diffusion- and flow-based policies can model such multimodal data, standard behavior cloning (BC) assigns equal likelihood to all demonstrated actions and may therefore reproduce suboptimal modes. Offline RL value estimates offer a natural signal for biasing policies toward higher-value behavioral modes, but directly fine-tuning the generative policy or using critic gradients for policy steering can amplify critic errors and induce prior drift. We propose Advantage-Weighted Latent Steering (AWLS), an offline post-training method for improving frozen one-step generative manipulation policies without updating their decoders. AWLS learns a residual noise shaper, an observation-conditioned residual correction to the policy's latent noise, and trains it with an advantage-weighted action reconstruction objective. The advantages are detached, scale-normalized, and used only as supervised weights on demonstrated actions, avoiding critic-gradient policy updates while preserving fast single-step inference. We further introduce a rollout-free decoder-sensitivity criterion for selecting pretrained checkpoints that remain responsive to latent-noise perturbations. Experiments on simulated and real-world robotic manipulation tasks with clean and mixed-quality demonstrations show that AWLS improves over the frozen base policy while limiting drift from the pretrained behavior prior. Project page: https://awls-corl2026.github.io/
summary_zh: 人工采集的真实世界机器人操作演示数据常包含质量参差不齐的轨迹，其中不乏犹豫、迂回或低效的动作片段。虽然基于扩散和流匹配的策略能够建模此类多模态数据，但标准行为克隆（BC）对所有演示动作赋予相同似然，因此可能复现次优模态。离线强化学习的价值估计为引导策略偏向高价值行为模态提供了天然信号，但直接微调生成式策略或利用评论家梯度进行策略导向可能放大评论家误差并引发先验漂移。我们提出优势加权潜在引导（AWLS）——一种离线后训练方法，用于在不更新解码器的情况下改进冻结的单步生成式操作策略。AWLS学习一个残差噪声整形器，即对策略潜在噪声的观测条件残差修正，并通过优势加权动作重建目标进行训练。优势值被分离处理、尺度归一化，且仅作为演示动作上的监督权重，从而避免评论家梯度策略更新，同时保持快速单步推理。我们进一步提出一种无需 rollout 的解码器敏感性准则，用于筛选对潜在噪声扰动保持响应的预训练检查点。在仿真和真实机器人操作任务上，使用干净与混合质量演示的实验表明，AWLS在冻结基策略基础上取得改进，同时限制了对预训练行为先验的漂移。项目页面：https://awls-corl2026.github.io/
tldr: AWLS is a post-training method that improves frozen one-step generative robotic manipulation policies by shaping latent noise with advantage-weighted reconstruction, avoiding critic-gradient updates and preserving inference speed.
tldr_zh: AWLS 是一种后训练方法，通过优势加权重建来调整冻结的单步生成式机器人操作策略的潜噪声，避免了评论家梯度更新并保持了推理速度。

title: CovNav: Conformal Prediction-Guided Adaptive Inference for Object Goal Navigation
summary: In object goal navigation (ObjectNav), an embodied agent must find a target object (e.g., "find a bed") in a previously unseen environment, relying on spatial commonsense such as object co-occurrence. Large Language Models (LLMs) encode this commonsense, but deploying them on robots exposes a trade-off between reasoning quality and efficiency: cloud-based models incur latency and privacy risks, whereas small on-device LLMs are fast but prone to hallucinated spatial judgments. Hybrid reasoning LLMs offer both a fast non-thinking mode and a slow thinking mode, which raises a key question for embodied agents: when is slow thinking worth its cost? We propose CovNav, a training-free framework that answers this question with Conformal Prediction (CP), turning dual-process (System 1 / System 2) inference into an uncertainty-aware decision. Much like recent decision models such as Jev, CovNav casts each spatial query as a structured binary decision rather than free-form generation: a local LLM in fast mode judges whether the target is likely near an observed object, CP converts its token probabilities into a prediction set, and only ambiguous queries are escalated to slow chain-of-thought reasoning. The object-pair formulation keeps calibration tractable and supports open-set objects through off-the-shelf detectors. Experiments on Gibson and HM3D show that CovNav surpasses the strongest zero-shot baseline by 0.8 and 1.7 percentage points in success rate on HM3D v1 and v2, while invoking slow reasoning for only 12.4% of queries and retaining most of the gain of always-on thinking at a fraction of its latency. Real-robot experiments on a TurtleBot 4 further validate the approach. CovNav shows how calibrated uncertainty can decide when an embodied agent should think slowly, offering a principled form of adaptive test-time reasoning for LLM-based robots.
summary_zh: 在目标目标导航（ObjectNav）任务中，具身智能体必须在未见过的环境中找到目标物体（例如“找到一张床”），这依赖于物体共现等空间常识。大语言模型（LLMs）编码了这类常识，但在机器人上部署它们时，需要在推理质量与效率之间做出权衡：基于云的模型会带来延迟和隐私风险，而设备端的小型LLM虽然速度快，却容易产生幻觉式的空间判断。混合推理LLM同时提供快速非思考模式和缓慢思考模式，这给具身智能体带来了一个关键问题：何时值得为缓慢思考付出代价？我们提出CovNav，一个无需训练且利用共形预测（CP）回答该问题的框架，将双过程（系统1/系统2）推理转化为不确定性感知的决策。与Jev等近期决策模型类似，CovNav将每个空间查询视为结构化二元决策而非自由形式生成：本地LLM在快速模式下判断目标是否可能靠近某个已观察物体，CP将其词元概率转换为预测集，仅将模糊查询升级为缓慢的链式思维推理。物体配对公式保证了校准的可操作性，并可通过现成检测器支持开放集物体。在Gibson和HM3D上的实验表明，CovNav在HM3D v1和v2上的成功率分别超过最强零样本基线0.8和1.7个百分点，同时仅对12.4%的查询调用缓慢推理，并以极低的延迟保留了常开思维的大部分收益。TurtleBot 4上的真实机器人实验进一步验证了该方法。CovNav展示了校准后的不确定性如何决定具身智能体何时应进行缓慢思考，为基于LLM的机器人提供了一种原则性的自适应测试时推理形式。
tldr: CovNav introduces a conformal prediction-guided framework that adaptively decides when an embodied agent should use slow chain-of-thought reasoning from a hybrid LLM during object goal navigation, improving success on Gibson and HM3D with low reasoning overhead and validating on a real TurtleBot 4.
tldr_zh: CovNav 提出一种基于保形预测的框架，在物体目标导航中自适应决定何时使用混合 LLM 的慢速推理模式，在 Gibson 和 HM3D 上提升成功率并以较低开销在真实 TurtleBot 4 上验证。

title: PLaCA: Learning Patch-Level Future Latent Change for Action Generation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions, but effective manipulation also requires anticipating how the environment will change. Existing world-action models explore future image prediction and latent dynamics modeling. However, generating complete future images can be computationally expensive, while highly compressed latent representations may obscure local changes. To address these challenges, we propose PLaCA, a world-to-action framework built around future latent change. PLaCA directly predicts spatially structured patch-level future latent change from the current multimodal input, preserving local information about expected environmental changes. We introduce patch-level change-aware supervision to emphasize regions undergoing larger changes and a future-to-action interface that explicitly incorporates predicted future latent change into action generation. Experiments on LIBERO-Long show that PLaCA achieves a 79.0% success rate, improving upon the Action-only baseline by 5.0 percentage points. On CALVIN, PLaCA improves the average sequence length from 2.784 to 3.564. These improvements are achieved while updating only 2.95% of the model parameters during the second training stage, demonstrating the effectiveness of future latent change modeling for downstream robotic manipulation.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型根据视觉观测和语言指令生成机器人动作，但有效的操作还需要预测环境将如何变化。现有世界-动作模型探索了未来图像预测和潜在动态建模。然而，生成完整的未来图像在计算上可能成本高昂，而高度压缩的潜在表示又可能掩盖局部变化。为应对这些挑战，我们提出PLaCA，一种以未来潜在变化为核心的“世界到动作”框架。PLaCA直接从当前多模态输入预测具有空间结构的块级未来潜在变化，保留预期环境变化的局部信息。我们引入了块级变化感知监督，以强调发生较大变化的区域，并设计了一个“未来到动作”接口，将预测的未来潜在变化显式融入动作生成中。在LIBERO-Long上的实验表明，PLaCA实现了79.0%的成功率，较仅基于动作的基线提升了5.0个百分点。在CALVIN上，PLaCA将平均序列长度从2.784提升至3.564。这些提升仅通过在第二阶段训练中更新2.95%的模型参数即可实现，充分证明了未来潜在变化建模对下游机器人操作的有效性。
tldr: PLaCA predicts patch-level future latent changes to enhance VLA manipulation policies, achieving significant improvements on LIBERO-Long and CALVIN with minimal parameter updates.
tldr_zh: PLaCA通过预测补丁级别的未来潜在变化来增强VLA操作策略，在LIBERO-Long和CALVIN上以极少的参数更新取得了显著提升。

title: A Head Camera Is (Almost) All You Need: An Electronics-Free UMI Glove Labelled and Observed by One Moving Camera
summary: Handheld demonstration devices decouple data collection from the robot, but conventional designs burden the hand with a wrist camera, cables and a pose tracker (SLAM, an IMU, a VR controller, or a fixed external camera that the collector's body occludes), and burden the pipeline with as many data streams to timestamp, synchronise and cross-calibrate. We show that a single egocentric camera (USD 122) worn on the collector's head replaces the wrist camera, the pose tracker and their separate streams with one. It reads printed fiducials on an electronics-free glove (USD 22) against paper tiles taped around the workspace, giving the 6-DoF gripper pose and the jaw width from the same frames the policy will see; at deployment the same camera rides a low-cost (USD 120) arm beside the robot that mimics the collector's head from the robot's joint state. Against the robot's encoders the labels are accurate to 6.5 mm and 1.6 degrees median with 93-100% frame coverage, and a policy trained on them instead of encoders pays 3% in validation loss. Adding 194 glove demonstrations to 48 teleoperated episodes lifts rollout success from 10/25 to 17/25, level with 172 teleoperated episodes alone (18/25), and the full co-trained head-camera policy succeeds in 20/25 against 15/25 for the wrist-camera recipe, whose policies drop the object when the goal leaves their view, and 12/25 for a fixed camera.
summary_zh: 手持式演示设备将数据采集与机器人解耦，但传统设计给手部带来了腕部相机、线缆和位姿追踪器（SLAM、IMU、VR控制器，或容易被采集者身体遮挡的固定外部相机）的负担，同时给数据管线带来了需要时间戳同步和交叉标定的多路数据流负担。我们证明，一个佩戴在采集者头上的单目第一视角相机（122美元）即可取代腕部相机、位姿追踪器及其各自独立的数据流，将其统一为一路。该相机读取无电子元件手套（22美元）上的印刷基准标记，并参照贴在工作区周围纸面上的标记贴片，从策略将看到的同一帧图像中获取6自由度夹爪位姿及爪口宽度；部署时，同一相机安装在机器人旁的低成本（120美元）机械臂上，该机械臂根据机器人关节状态模拟采集者的头部位置。与机器人编码器相比，标签的中位精度达到6.5毫米和1.6度，帧覆盖率达93-100%，而基于这些标签而非编码器训练的策略仅产生3%的验证损失。在48集遥操作数据基础上增加194集手套演示数据，将 rollout 成功率从10/25提升至17/25，与仅使用172集遥操作数据的效果持平（18/25）；完整联合训练的头戴相机策略在20/25次试验中成功，而腕部相机方案仅为15/25——该方案下策略在目标离开视野时会丢落物体——固定相机方案则为12/25。
tldr: This paper presents a low-cost data collection system for robot manipulation that uses a single head-mounted camera to observe fiducial markers on a glove and paper tiles, replacing wrist cameras and pose trackers, and demonstrates improved policy performance in real-robot experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种低成本机器人操作数据采集系统，利用头戴式单摄像头读取手套上的标记和纸片，替代腕部相机和位姿追踪器，并通过真实机器人实验证明策略性能提升。

title: JARVIS: From Visual Manuals to Autonomous Robotic Assembly
summary: Visual manuals communicate procedural knowledge through stepwise diagrams, but translating these instructions into reliable long-horizon robotic execution remains challenging. We introduce JARVIS, a method-agnostic benchmark for autonomous visual-manual-guided execution without additional language instructions. JARVIS comprises 236,679 LEGO assembly tasks across 8,987 scenes, with a carefully curated JARVIS-v1 suite of 50 tasks for interactive robotic evaluation. Tasks span varying initial structural complexities and assembly horizons, requiring agents to interpret manuals, ground actions in an evolving workspace, and execute the intended procedure. A structure-aware evaluation protocol captures geometric accuracy, structural relations, construction order, partial progress, and completion. We further introduce JARVIS-agentic, a tool-grounded embodied agent that composes robot primitives into executable programs and uses execution feedback for verification and recovery, without task-specific action trajectories or model parameter updates. Across nine multimodal and reasoning models, task-oriented primitives increase the average assembly score. Performance nevertheless declines sharply with assembly horizon, and execution errors remain difficult to correct. Prior-task experience improves initial performance, while repeated reflection provides inconsistent benefits, highlighting persistent limitations in connecting visual procedural reasoning with reliable physical execution.
summary_zh: 视觉手册通过分步图示传达程序性知识，但将这些说明转化为可靠的长时程机器人执行仍具挑战性。我们提出JARVIS，一个无需额外语言指令即可实现自主视觉手册引导执行的方法无关基准。JARVIS包含覆盖8，987个场景的236，679项LEGO装配任务，并精心构建了包含50项任务的JARVIS-v1套件，用于交互式机器人评估。任务涵盖不同的初始结构复杂性和装配时域，要求智能体解读手册、在动态变化的工作空间中落实动作，并执行预期流程。一种结构感知的评估协议可量化几何精度、结构关系、构建顺序、部分进展及完成度。我们进一步提出JARVIS-agentic，一个基于工具具身化的智能体，其将机器人原语组合为可执行程序，并利用执行反馈进行验证与恢复，而无需任务特定的动作轨迹或模型参数更新。在九种多模态及推理模型中，任务导向的原语平均提高了装配得分。然而，随着装配时域延长，性能急剧下降，且执行错误仍难以纠正。先前任务经验可改善初始表现，而重复反思带来的收益不一致，凸显了连接视觉程序推理与可靠物理执行之间的持续局限。
tldr: JARVIS is a benchmark and an agentic system for autonomous robotic assembly guided by visual manuals, evaluating the ability of multimodal models to translate procedural diagrams into executable robot actions without language instructions.
tldr_zh: JARVIS是一个用于视觉手册引导的自主机器人装配的基准和智能体系统，评估多模态模型将程序性图表转化为可执行机器人动作的能力，无需语言指令。

title: Embodied Task Agents Can Perform Fine Manipulation through Tactile In-Context Learning
summary: Can embodied task agents use tactile experience to perform fine manipulation without task-specific model training? We investigate this capability through Tactile-ETA, a system that incorporates tactile experience into an embodied task agent through in-context learning. Successful expert demonstrations show how contact changes during manipulation. We pair each recorded robot movement with its camera views and bilateral tactile observations. We keep tactile observations at the start and end of each movement and add two neighboring time points when the tactile images change markedly in between. The agent combines these demonstrations with current vision, tactile observations, and proprioception to select actions through general-purpose robot tools, without updating model parameters. Across four simulated manipulation tasks, adding tactile observations to the same two expert demonstrations increases average success from 15.75% to 24.00%, with current sensing and execution interfaces held fixed. Further experiments show that performance depends on the sensory content and representation of demonstrations, while comparing agent models on Lift Bottle reveals substantial differences under the same system configuration. On the real-robot tasks, demonstrations with aligned visual and tactile observations increase the task success rate from 0% to 60%. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of using tactile experience in context for fine manipulation and suggest a path toward extending embodied task agents to additional sensory inputs.
summary_zh: 具身任务智能体能否在不进行任务特定模型训练的情况下，利用触觉经验完成精细操作？我们通过Tactile-ETA系统对此能力进行研究，该系统通过上下文学习将触觉经验融入具身任务智能体。成功的专家演示展示了操作过程中接触变化的情况。我们将每次记录的机器人运动与其相机视角及双侧触觉观测配对。我们在每次运动的开始和结束时刻保留触觉观测，并在触觉图像在中间发生显著变化时增加两个相邻时间点。智能体将这些演示与当前的视觉、触觉观测及本体感觉相结合，通过通用机器人工具选择动作，无需更新模型参数。在四个模拟操作任务中，将触觉观测添加到相同的两个专家演示中，平均成功率从15.75%提升至24.00%，同时保持当前感知和执行接口不变。进一步实验表明，性能取决于演示的感知内容和表示方式，而在Lift Bottle任务上比较智能体模型时，在相同系统配置下显示出显著差异。在实际机器人任务中，具有对齐视觉和触觉观测的演示将任务成功率从0%提升至60%。这些发现证明了在上下文中使用触觉经验进行精细操作的可行性，并提示了将具身任务智能体扩展到更多感官输入的路径。
tldr: This paper introduces Tactile-ETA, a system that enables embodied task agents to perform fine manipulation by incorporating tactile observations into in-context learning, improving success rates on simulated and real-robot tasks without task-specific training.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Tactile-ETA系统，通过上下文学习将触觉观察融入具身任务代理，无需任务特定训练即可提升精细操作的成功率，并在仿真和真实机器人任务中得到验证。

title: Training Controllable World Models via Action Influence Maximization
summary: Action-conditioned video generative models trained on successful, goal-directed demonstrations tend to ignore the commanded action, rendering a plausible expert-like future regardless of what is asked of them. We trace this failure to training data that lack sufficient action influence. We analyze this metric and prove that it upper bounds the action influence that any model trained on that data can express. Expert demonstrations, whose narrow action distributions let next states be predicted without attending to the action, set a low ceiling that no amount of model capacity alone can raise. Raising it requires collecting different data. We introduce Action Influence Maximization (AIM), an algorithm for actively collecting training data for improving dataset action influence. We compare the performance and data-efficiency of AIM against exploration heuristics and intrinsic-motivation methods on simulated navigation and manipulation tasks. In pixel-based manipulation, AIM is the only method that consistently improves controllability: 500 actively collected episodes added to 3k demonstrations match a world model trained on 300k expert episodes on end-effector controllability, an $85\times$ reduction in data.
summary_zh: 基于动作条件的视频生成模型在由成功且目标导向的演示数据训练时，往往会忽略所施加的动作，无论要求其执行何种操作，都会生成看似合理的专家式未来。我们将这一失败归因于训练数据缺乏足够的动作影响。我们对该指标进行了分析，并证明了它界定了任何在该数据上训练的模型所能表达的动作影响的上限。专家演示中的动作分布狭窄，使得在无需关注动作的情况下即可预测下一状态，这设定的上限过低，仅靠增加模型容量无法提高。要提升这一上限，需要收集不同的数据。我们提出了动作影响最大化（AIM）算法，这是一种主动收集训练数据以提高数据集动作影响的算法。我们在模拟导航和操作任务中，将AIM与探索启发式方法及内在动机方法在性能和数据效率上进行了比较。在基于像素的操作任务中，AIM是唯一能持续提升可控性的方法：主动收集的500条经验片段加上3k条演示，在末端执行器可控性方面达到了与在300k条专家片段上训练的世界模型相当的性能，数据量减少了85倍。
tldr: This paper analyzes why action-conditioned video world models trained on expert demonstrations fail to follow commanded actions due to low action influence in the training data, and proposes Action Influence Maximization (AIM), an active data collection algorithm, to improve controllability, achieving an 85x reduction in data for pixel-based manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了在专家演示数据上训练的动作条件视频世界模型因数据中动作影响不足而无法遵循指令动作的问题，并提出动作影响最大化（AIM）主动数据收集算法以提升可控性，在像素级操作任务上实现了85倍的数据缩减。

title: What Would Removing This Corruption Change? Failure Attribution for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are sensitive to visual corruptions, but knowing that a corruption is typically harmful does not establish whether removing it would benefit the current episode. Furthermore, when several corruptions co-occur, deciding what to correct requires understanding which ones contribute to failure risk and how much their removal would help. We define this problem as failure attribution. Detecting corruption presence alone cannot answer this question, as corruptions can be present but relatively harmless, while directly measuring removal benefits requires costly paired policy rollouts with and without the corruption present. To address this, we introduce a factorized risk model that learns separate representations of the scene and corruptions, allowing us to estimate removal benefits through latent intervention from the current image and task instruction, without paired clean images or additional counterfactual rollouts. We evaluate our approach on OpenVLA and $π_{0.5}$ in simulation and $π_{0.5}$-DROID on a Franka robot. Our method outperforms monolithic and vision-language-model (VLM) baselines, including achieving approximately 3x lower attribution error than frontier VLMs. We also demonstrate our method adapts to execution context and corruption intensity, and can be used for online failure monitoring on hardware.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型对视觉扰动较为敏感，但知道某种扰动通常有害，并不能确定在当前回合中消除该扰动是否有利。此外，当多种扰动同时出现时，决定应修正哪些扰动需要理解哪些因素导致了失败风险，以及消除它们能带来多大程度的改善。我们将这一问题定义为失败归因。仅检测扰动的存在无法回答该问题，因为扰动可能存在但相对无害，而直接衡量消除扰动带来的收益则需要在有扰动和无扰动条件下进行代价高昂的成对策略 rollout。为解决这一问题，我们引入了一种因子化风险模型，该模型分别学习场景和扰动的表征，从而能够通过当前图像和任务指令的潜在干预来估计消除扰动带来的收益，无需成对的干净图像或额外的反事实 rollout。我们在 OpenVLA 和 $π_{0.5}$ 上进行了仿真评估，并在 Franka 机器人上对 $π_{0.5}$-DROID 进行了评估。我们的方法优于单体模型和视觉-语言模型（VLM）基线，包括相较于前沿 VLM 实现了约 3 倍更低的归因误差。我们还证明了该方法能够适应执行上下文和扰动强度，并可用于硬件上的在线失败监控。
tldr: The paper introduces a failure attribution method for VLA models that estimates how much removing specific visual corruptions would improve task success, using a factorized risk model with latent interventions rather than costly counterfactual rollouts. It is evaluated on OpenVLA, π0.5, and real robot hardware, showing significantly lower attribution error than VLM baselines.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的失败归因方法，通过分解风险模型和潜在干预，无需额外对应对照轨迹即可估计移除特定视觉扰动对任务成功率的提升，并在OpenVLA、π0.5及真实机器人上验证，相比VLM基线大幅降低归因误差。

title: EmbodyHOI: Embodiment-Aware Generation of Hand-Object Interactions for Humanoid Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Humanoid dexterous manipulation needs reference motions that are both semantically rich and kinematically feasible for the target robot. Text-conditioned hand-object interaction (HOI) generators supply diverse, language-specified demonstrations, but they synthesize motion in human (MANO) space. The embodiment gap is therefore deferred to post-hoc retargeting, where trajectories deployed on the robot can fail to maintain contact with objects and also degrade policy learning. Our key idea is that robot reachability should constrain the interaction trajectories while they are being generated. We present EmbodyHOI, which runs a differentiable inverse-kinematics (IK) solver for a specific humanoid embodiment inside the sampling loop of a frozen flow-matching HOI trajectory generator. We feed back gradients from the embodiment-aware IK solver into the HOI sampler and jointly optimize the position of the humanoid with respect to the object. Because guidance acts only at inference, one HOI trajectory generator trained on human hand poses transfers across humanoid embodiments without retraining. On ARCTIC trajectories with two contrasting humanoids (Unitree G1 and H1-2), our proposed guidance-based method cuts the retargeted wrist error from 8.9 cm to 0.6 cm while leaving text-to-HOI generation quality intact, and raises task success from 68% to 79% on 50 random G1 tasks and from 62% to 76% on a four-task H1-2 suite. Critically, cheaper alternatives for bridging the embodiment gap fail to beat EmbodyHOI. Post-hoc wrist refinement and compute-matched best-of-N selection both reach lower IK energy than our guidance yet train worse policies. For simulation results, see our website: https://embodyhoi.github.io/
summary_zh: 拟人灵巧操作需要既在语义上丰富、又在运动学上对目标机器人可行的参考动作。基于文本条件的手-物交互（HOI）生成器能够提供多样化的、由语言指定的演示，但它们在人体（MANO）空间中合成运动。因此，具身差异被推迟到事后重定向阶段处理，此时部署在机器人上的轨迹可能无法保持与物体的接触，同时还会降低策略学习的质量。我们的核心思想是：在生成交互轨迹的过程中，就应让机器人的可达性对轨迹产生约束。我们提出了EmbodyHOI，该方法在冻结的流匹配HOI轨迹生成器的采样循环内部，为特定拟人具身运行可微逆运动学（IK）求解器。我们将来自具身感知IK求解器的梯度反馈到HOI采样器中，并联合优化拟人机器人相对于物体的位置。由于引导仅在推理阶段起作用，一个在人类手部姿态上训练的HOI轨迹生成器无需重新训练即可跨拟人具身迁移。在采用两个对比鲜明的拟人机器人（Unitree G1和H1-2）的ARCTIC轨迹上，我们提出的基于引导的方法将重定向后的手腕误差从8.9厘米降至0.6厘米，同时保持文本到HOI的生成质量不受影响，并将50个随机G1任务的成功率从68%提升至79%，将四个任务的H1-2测试套件的成功率从62%提升至76%。关键在于，用于弥合具身差异的较廉价替代方案未能超越EmbodyHOI。事后手腕优化和计算量匹配的N选最优策略虽然都能达到比我们的引导方法更低的IK能量，但训练出的策略表现更差。模拟结果详见我们的网站：https://embodyhoi.github.io/
tldr: EmbodyHOI integrates a differentiable IK solver for a target humanoid into the sampling loop of a frozen flow-matching HOI trajectory generator, using embodiment-aware gradients to produce kinematically feasible and semantically rich hand-object interaction demonstrations without retraining, improving retargeting accuracy and task success on two humanoid platforms.
tldr_zh: EmbodyHOI将目标人形机器人的可微逆运动学求解器集成到冻结的流匹配手物交互轨迹生成器的采样循环中，利用具身感知梯度生成既语义丰富又运动学可行的演示，无需重新训练即可提高重定向精度和任务成功率。

title: VLA-Retain: Benchmarking Cross-Dimension Effects of Vision Tuning in VLAs
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models transfer knowledge from large-scale pretraining into robot control, but their manipulation performance remains sensitive to changes in observation conditions, which recent work addresses by fine-tuning the visual module on target-domain data. However, it remains unclear how such adaptation affects robustness beyond the target condition, as existing robustness benchmarks only evaluate models without fine-tuning and adaptation studies only report the target gain. Measuring this cross-dimension effect requires separating target gains from off-target changes, isolating adaptation effects from architectural differences, ruling out generic forgetting, and comparing tuning choices. Therefore, we introduce VLA-Retain, a benchmark that compares five open VLA models, tuned on Camera-view or Sensor-noise data, with their own base checkpoints on LIBERO-Plus dataset spanning seven perturbation dimensions. Our study reveals four findings. First, targeted vision tuning is not local, and its target gain does not predict retention. Mean off-target gain is negative in 8 of 10 model--domain configurations. Under Camera-view tuning, X-VLA gains $69.4$ percentage points on the target but loses $4.6$ points on average elsewhere, whereas OpenVLA-OFT gains $39.3$ and $1.4$ points, respectively. Second, these regressions are not explained only by performance loss on the same tasks without perturbations. Third, broader training coverage raises overall gain over target-specific training but does not eliminate dimension-level regressions. Fourth, tuning strategies are model-dependent, as DELTA-style feature preservation raises X-VLA's mean off-target gain to $+1.2$ points but lowers OpenVLA-OFT's to $-23.1$. Overall, these findings show that target-domain success alone is insufficient and highlight cross-dimensional retention as a key criterion for targeted VLA adaptation.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将大规模预训练的知识迁移到机器人控制中，但其操作性能对观测条件的变化仍然敏感，近期研究通过在目标域数据上微调视觉模块来解决这一问题。然而，这种适配在目标条件之外的鲁棒性影响尚不明确，因为现有的鲁棒性基准仅评估未微调的模型，而适配研究仅报告目标增益。衡量这种跨维度效应需要将目标增益与脱靶变化分离、将适配效应与架构差异隔离、排除泛化遗忘，并比较不同的调优选择。为此，我们提出了VLA-Retain基准，该基准在LIBERO-Plus数据集上对五个开放VLA模型进行比较，这些模型在相机视角或传感器噪声数据上进行调优，并以各自的基座检查点为参照，覆盖七个扰动维度。本研究揭示了四个发现。第一，目标导向的视觉调优并非局部性的，其目标增益不能预测保留效果。在10个模型-领域配置中，有8个的平均脱靶增益为负。在相机视角调优下，X-VLA在目标上获得69.4个百分点的增益，但在其他维度平均损失4.6个百分点，而OpenVLA-OFT分别获得39.3和1.4个百分点。第二，这些退化并不仅仅由同一任务在无扰动情况下的性能损失来解释。第三，更广泛的训练覆盖相比目标特定训练提高了整体增益，但并未消除维度层面的退化。第四，调优策略依赖于具体模型，因为DELTA风格的特征保留使X-VLA的平均脱靶增益提升至+1.2个百分点，却使OpenVLA-OFT降至-23.1个百分点。总体而言，这些发现表明仅靠目标域的成功是不够的，并强调跨维度保留是目标导向VLA适配的关键准则。
tldr: This paper introduces VLA-Retain, a benchmark for evaluating how fine-tuning vision modules of VLA models on target domain data affects their performance on other perturbation dimensions, revealing that targeted tuning often causes off-target regressions and that target gain alone is insufficient for assessing adaptation.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了VLA-Retain基准，用于评估VLA模型在目标域数据上微调视觉模块后对其他扰动维度性能的影响，揭示了针对性调优常导致非目标性能下降，仅凭目标增益不足以评估适应性。

title: Learning the 4D World through Point Trajectory Forecasting
summary: Reliable multi-view forecasting requires videos from different cameras to describe the same evolving 3D scene. To this end, we introduce Video-Point Model (VPM), a world model that conditions on multi-view video histories and a language instruction to jointly forecast future videos from arbitrary viewpoints and the 3D trajectories of persistent scene points. We extend a pretrained world model with camera-conditioned multi-view processing that integrates complementary observations across cameras, and add a trajectory head that predicts how physical points move through time. Each trajectory tracks a single point across all views, and supervising these trajectories alongside video generation therefore anchors appearance changes in every camera to a shared description of 3D motion. To support training and evaluation, we build VPM-Data, a simulation corpus pairing synchronized multi-view videos with persistent point trajectories, and VP-WorldBench, a forecasting benchmark spanning simulated and real environments. We further extend VPM to robot control by adding robot actions as a token modality in the generator. Action tokens share the point-supervised backbone and are denoised jointly with future videos, thereby grounding the policy in the same 3D-aware representation. On VP-WorldBench and existing 4D generation benchmarks, point supervision improves both video fidelity and 3D motion accuracy over a video-only counterpart, and in simulated and real-robot experiments, it also raises the manipulation success of the action-enabled model.
summary_zh: 可靠的多样本视角预测要求来自不同摄像头的视频能够描述同一正在演化的三维场景。为此，我们提出了视频点模型（Video-Point Model, VPM），这是一种以多视角视频历史和语言指令为条件的世界模型，能够联合预测任意视角的未来视频以及持久场景点的三维轨迹。我们扩展了一个预训练的世界模型，加入了基于相机条件的多视角处理机制，以整合不同摄像头之间的互补观测信息，并增加了一个轨迹头，用于预测物理点随时间移动的方式。每条轨迹跨所有视角追踪单个点，因此，在视频生成的同时对这些轨迹进行监督，能够将每个摄像头中的外观变化锚定到共享的三维运动描述上。为支持训练与评估，我们构建了VPM-Data，一个将同步多视角视频与持久点轨迹配对模拟数据集，以及VP-WorldBench，一个涵盖模拟和真实环境的预测基准。我们进一步将VPM扩展到机器人控制领域，在生成器中加入了机器人动作作为标记模态。动作标记与点监督骨干网络共享，并与未来视频联合去噪，从而将策略扎根于同一具备三维感知能力的表示中。在VP-WorldBench以及现有4D生成基准上，相较于仅依赖视频的对应模型，点监督同时提升了视频保真度和三维运动精度；在模拟和真实机器人实验中，它同样提高了具备动作能力模型的操作成功率。
tldr: The paper introduces Video-Point Model (VPM), a world model that forecasts multi-view videos and 3D point trajectories from multi-view inputs and language instructions, and extends it to robot control by adding action tokens, demonstrating improved video fidelity, 3D motion accuracy, and manipulation success.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了视频点模型（VPM），一种从多视角输入和语言指令预测多视角视频及3D点轨迹的世界模型，并通过添加动作令牌将其扩展到机器人控制，展示了在视频保真度、3D运动准确性和操作成功率方面的提升。

title: Industrial ReMEmbR: Scaling Spatiotemporal Memory to Robot Fleets
summary: Warehouse robot fleets continuously observe operational conditions, but preserving these observations as reusable semantic memory incurs substantial computation, communication, and storage costs. For example, explaining recurring aisle blockages can require reviewing video from multiple robots across several shifts. We present IndustrialRemembr, a shared spatiotemporal memory system that extends NVIDIA ReMEmbR to robot fleets and reduces server-side computation by generating scene descriptions only on demand. On each robot, an NVIDIA Jetson encodes video clips into retrieval embeddings with Cosmos-Embed1, vision tokens with Cosmos3-Edge, and reconstruction latents with the Wan2.2 VAE, without uploading raw camera frames. The encoding models are re-used to detect people in image patches, zeroing them out to support PII abstraction for GDPR-compliant deployments. We split Cosmos3-Edge at its vision-language boundary, placing the vision encoder on the robot and the language decoder on an on-premises server. A Nemotron agent retrieves memories by content, position, and time and queries the decoder using cached vision tokens. This design eliminates caption generation at write time, while cached-token decoding reproduces the unsplit model's output in all 450 tested decodes.
summary_zh: 仓库机器人车队持续观测运行条件，但将这些观测结果保存为可复用的语义记忆会带来大量的计算、通信和存储开销。例如，解释反复出现的通道堵塞问题可能需要审阅多台机器人在多个班次期间拍摄的视频。我们提出了IndustrialRemembr，一种共享的时空记忆系统，它将NVIDIA ReMEmbR扩展至机器人车队，并仅按需生成场景描述，从而减少服务器端计算。在每台机器人上，NVIDIA Jetson利用Cosmos-Embed1将视频片段编码为检索嵌入，利用Cosmos3-Edge编码视觉令牌，利用Wan2.2 VAE编码重建潜变量，且不上传原始摄像头帧。编码模型被复用检测图像补丁中的人员，并将其置零以支持PII抽象，从而满足GDPR合规部署要求。我们将Cosmos3-Edge在其视觉-语言边界处拆分，将视觉编码器置于机器人端，语言解码器置于本地服务器端。一个Nemotron智能体按内容、位置和时间检索记忆，并使用缓存的视觉令牌查询解码器。该设计消除了写入时生成描述的需要，而缓存的令牌解码在所有450次测试解码中均能复现未拆分模型的输出。
tldr: This paper presents Industrial ReMEmbR, a shared spatiotemporal memory system for warehouse robot fleets that reduces computation by generating scene descriptions on demand, using on-robot encoding and a split vision-language model for efficient, privacy-preserving semantic memory retrieval.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了工业ReMEmbR，一种用于仓库机器人车队的共享时空记忆系统，通过在机器人上编码并拆分视觉-语言模型，按需生成场景描述，以降低计算成本并支持隐私保护。

title: Warping the Workspace: Expanding Visual Access with Adjustable Reach Mapping for Humanoid Teleoperation
summary: First-person humanoid teleoperation ties access to side and rear targets to operator rotation. We present coupled visual--motor remapping, pairing a panoramic azimuth warp with its inverse upper-limb yaw transform. A working prototype implements Global Zoom (GZ) and Focus+Context (F+C). In a within-subject study (N=8); 72 trials), GZ had the largest completion count (23/24; Fixed: 20/24; F+C: 21/24), whereas F+C was preferred by 6/8 participants. Therefore, completion and preference favored different mappings in this sample.
summary_zh: 第一人称人形机器人遥操作将侧方和后方的目标访问与操作员旋转联系起来。我们提出了一种视觉-运动耦合重映射方法，将全景方位角扭曲与其逆上肢偏航变换配对。一个工作原型实现了全局缩放（GZ）和焦点+上下文（F+C）两种模式。在一项受试者内研究（N=8；72次试验）中，GZ模式的完成次数最多（23/24；固定模式：20/24；F+C模式：21/24），而6/8的参与者更偏好F+C模式。因此，在本样本中，完成率和偏好倾向于不同的映射方式。
tldr: This paper explores coupled visual-motor remapping for humanoid teleoperation, introducing panoramic azimuth warp and inverse upper-limb yaw transforms to expand visual access. A user study compared Global Zoom and Focus+Context mappings, finding trade-offs between completion rate and user preference.
tldr_zh: 本文通过将全景方位角扭曲与上肢偏航变换相结合，提出视觉-运动重映射以扩展人形遥操作的视野。用户研究表明全局缩放和焦点+上下文模式在完成率和用户偏好间存在权衡。

title: SceneRig: An Agentic System for Simulation-Ready 3D Scene Reconstruction from Single Images
summary: Simulation is a powerful tool for robotics, but building diverse, simulation-ready scenes at scale remains difficult. Reconstructing scenes from single images is a promising alternative, but visual similarity alone is insufficient: objects must also be recovered, accurately placed, and physically grounded. Existing methods that rely on post-hoc physics settling often misplace objects, producing scenes that look correct but behave poorly under manipulation. We present SceneRig, an agentic system that turns a single image into an editable, simulation-ready scene. SceneRig combines geometric, visual, and physical tools to reconstruct a faithful 3D scene. An agent then performs edit-and-validate loops inside a physics simulator to achieve physical stability. Across diverse inputs, SceneRig improves instance segmentation, object-centric appearance, and 3D placement while keeping the reconstructed scenes physically stable. Furthermore, SceneRig is effective for downstream robotics: its scenes predict real-robot policy outcomes more accurately than the baseline method and more reliably support replay of recorded manipulations without trajectory adaptation.
summary_zh: 摘要：仿真为机器人学提供了强大的工具，但大规模构建多样且可直接用于仿真的场景仍然颇具挑战。从单张图像重建场景是一种颇具前景的替代方案，但仅凭视觉相似性并不足够：物体还必须被准确恢复、精确放置并具备物理接地性。现有方法依赖事后物理稳定化处理，往往导致物体位置错乱，生成看似正确但在操控下表现不佳的场景。我们提出了SceneRig，一个智能体系统，能够将单张图像转化为可编辑、可直接用于仿真的场景。SceneRig结合了几何、视觉和物理工具，以忠实地重建3D场景。随后，一个智能体在物理仿真器内执行编辑-验证循环，以实现物理稳定性。在多种输入场景下，SceneRig提升了实例分割、以物体为中心的外观表现以及3D放置精度，同时保持重建场景的物理稳定性。此外，SceneRig对下游机器人任务同样有效：其重建场景在预测真实机器人策略结果方面优于基线方法，且无需轨迹适配即可更可靠地支持记录操作的复现。
tldr: SceneRig is an agentic system that reconstructs a single image into a simulation-ready 3D scene by combining geometric, visual, and physical tools with edit-and-validate loops in a physics simulator, improving physical stability and downstream robotics applicability.
tldr_zh: SceneRig是一个智能体系统，通过结合几何、视觉和物理工具，并在物理模拟器中进行编辑-验证循环，将单张图像重建为可用于模拟的3D场景，提升了物理稳定性和下游机器人应用的适用性。

title: MARE: An Open-Source Lunar Rover Simulator with Shadow Ground Truth for Perception and Autonomy
summary: Lunar surface exploration increasingly relies on autonomous rovers that must perceive and traverse unstructured terrain under extreme illumination conditions. Near the lunar poles, low sun elevations produce long, high-contrast shadows that challenge stereo vision, terrain segmentation, and localization. Developing perception and navigation algorithms for these conditions requires large amounts of sensor data with accurate ground truth, which field campaigns and analog facilities can only provide at high cost and with limited variety. This paper presents MARE (Modular Autonomy and Rendering Environment), an open-source simulation suite for lunar rover perception and autonomy built on Unreal Engine 5 and ROS 2. MARE consists of three integrated components. Terrain Studio generates cratered and rocky lunar Digital Elevation Maps (DEMs) to build simulation scenes. A dedicated Unreal Engine project hosts two physics-based rovers with plugins for stereo, lidar, event, and Single-Photon Avalanche Diode (SPAD) cameras, streaming time-stamped sensor data and pixel-accurate ground truth. Lastly, a Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) stack provides web-based mission control. Validation shows a mean Intersection over Union (IoU) of 0.79 between predicted and rendered shadows at low sun elevations, and stereo depth analysis verifies decreased pixel coverage in shadowed regions relative to sunlit terrain.
summary_zh: 月球表面探测日益依赖自主巡视器，这些巡视器必须在极端光照条件下感知并穿越非结构化地形。在月球极区附近，低太阳高度角会产生长而高对比度的阴影，给立体视觉、地形分割和定位带来挑战。为这些条件开发感知与导航算法需要大量带有精确真值数据的传感器数据，而野外试验和模拟设施仅能以高成本且有限的变化性提供这些数据。本文介绍了MARE（模块化自主与渲染环境），一个基于虚幻引擎5和ROS 2构建的开源月球巡视器感知与自主仿真套件。MARE由三个集成组件构成。Terrain Studio生成带有陨石坑和岩石的月球数字高程模型（DEM）以构建仿真场景。一个专用的虚幻引擎项目承载两辆基于物理的巡视器，并配备立体相机、激光雷达、事件相机和单光子雪崩二极管（SPAD）相机插件，输出带时间戳的传感器数据和像素级精确的真值数据。最后，制导、导航与控制（GNC）软件栈提供基于网络的任务控制。验证结果显示，在低太阳高度角下，预测阴影与渲染阴影之间的平均交并比（IoU）为0.79，立体深度分析证实阴影区域相较于受阳光照射地形的像素覆盖率有所下降。
tldr: MARE is an open-source Unreal Engine 5 and ROS 2-based simulation suite for lunar rover perception and autonomy, providing terrain generation, physics-based rovers with multiple sensors, pixel-accurate shadow ground truth, and a GNC stack with web-based mission control.
tldr_zh: MARE 是一个基于 Unreal Engine 5 和 ROS 2 的开源月球车感知与自主仿真套件，提供地形生成、带多种传感器的物理月球车、像素级阴影真值以及基于网络的任务控制 GNC 栈。

title: Physical AI for Intralogistics: Benchmarking the NVIDIA Sim-to-Real Ecosystem for Cosmos-Enhanced COMPASS Navigation on Industrial Mobile Robots
summary: Classical robot navigation stacks are reliable but often require re-engineering for each new robot type and site. Learning-based navigation shifts this effort from hand-tuned parameters to data generation and training, where a policy adapts to each new embodiment or facility by fine-tuning in simulation. Whether policies adapted this way stay reliable on real industrial robots has seen little systematic testing. We study this for NVIDIA's X-Mobility and COMPASS workflow for training learned navigation policies on Idealworks robots. In simulation, we extend the COMPASS benchmark with two embodiments, the differential-drive iw$\mkern-1.5mu.\mkern-1.5mu$hub and an omnidirectional Humanoid Mobile Platform (HMP), and with a digital twin of the Idealworks R&D center. For the real world, we fine-tune X-Mobility on data from this digital twin, with and without sim-to-real variants generated by NVIDIA Cosmos, train COMPASS on top of it from scratch in the digital twin, deploy the resulting policies on the iw$\mkern-1.5mu.\mkern-1.5mu$hub's onboard Jetson AGX Xavier, and benchmark them in the Idealworks R&D center against COMPASS trained only on NVIDIA's environments and the existing Idealworks navigation stack on task success, efficiency, safety, smoothness and onboard compute. Running every static scenario both in a digital-twin replica and in the real facility measures the sim-to-real gap and how far Cosmos-augmented data closes it. Training in the digital twin with Cosmos sim-to-real augmentation raises the real-world success rate of learned navigation from 65.3% to 91.7% across four scenarios and nearly halves its weighted travel time compared with simulation-only training, bringing it within 8.3 points of the production navigation stack, fully onboard; with an integrated global planner, it also reaches far, occluded goals in every trial.
summary_zh: 经典机器人导航技术栈可靠性高，但往往需要针对每种新型机器人和新场地进行重新工程设计。基于学习的导航则将这一工作从手工调参转向数据生成与训练，即通过在仿真环境中进行微调，使策略适应每种新载体或新设施。然而，以这种方式适配的策略在真实工业机器人上是否能保持可靠性，尚缺乏系统性测试。本研究针对NVIDIA的X-Mobility与COMPASS工作流，在Idealworks机器人上对学习型导航策略的训练进行了考察。在仿真方面，我们为COMPASS基准扩展了两种载体——差速驱动的iw$\mkern-1.5mu.\mkern-1.5mu$hub和全向人形移动平台（HMP），并加入了Idealworks研发中心的数字孪生模型。在真实环境方面，我们利用该数字孪生模型产生的数据对X-Mobility进行微调，部分数据经过NVIDIA Cosmos生成的仿真到现实（sim-to-real）变体增强，随后在数字孪生中从头训练COMPASS，将所得策略部署到iw$\mkern-1.5mu.\mkern-1.5mu$hub机载的Jetson AGX Xavier上，并在Idealworks研发中心将其与仅在NVIDIA环境中训练的COMPASS以及现有Idealworks导航栈进行对比，评估指标包括任务成功率、效率、安全性、平滑性和机载计算开销。在数字孪生副本和真实设施中分别运行所有静态场景，可衡量仿真到现实的差距，以及Cosmos增强数据在多大程度上缩小了这一差距。在数字孪生中结合Cosmos仿真到现实增强进行训练，使学习型导航在四个场景中的真实世界成功率从65.3%提升至91.7%，加权行驶时间相比仅仿真训练几乎减半，且完全在机载运行，与生产级导航栈的差距缩小至8.3个百分点；在集成全局规划器后，该方案还能在每次试验中到达远距离、遮挡的目标点。
tldr: This paper benchmarks the NVIDIA X-Mobility and COMPASS workflows for training learned navigation policies on real industrial mobile robots, using a digital twin and Cosmos-generated sim-to-real data. The authors show that Cosmos augmentation significantly improves real-world success rates from 65.3% to 91.7%, nearly matching a production stack, and demonstrate deployment on an onboard Jetson AGX Xavier.
tldr_zh: 本文在真实工业移动机器人上基准测试了NVIDIA X-Mobility和COMPASS用于训练学习导航策略的流程，采用数字孪生和Cosmos生成的仿真到现实数据。结果显示，Cosmos增强使真实世界成功率从65.3%提升到91.7%，接近生产级导航栈，并展示了在车载Jetson AGX Xavier上的部署。

title: Reinforced Iterative Learning Control for elastic joint arms: Guaranteed cross-trajectory generalization under model uncertainties
summary: Trajectory tracking for compliant robots is challenging due to nonlinear dynamics and modeling uncertainties, often requiring learning-based methods to avoid explicit parameter identification. Iterative Learning Control (ILC) ensures theoretically high precision and preserves the passive compliance of the robot. However, traditional ILC requires a separate learning phase for each new trajectory. Conversely, Reinforcement Learning (RL) generalizes to new trajectories, but practically suffers from high sample complexity and limited tracking precision. This work proposes Reinforced Iterative Learning Control (RILC) that combines the strengths of both approaches to achieve fast adaptation and guaranteed tracking convergence across diverse trajectories. By establishing a concurrent coupling between the two controllers, RILC overcomes the high initial errors and slow adaptation of traditional ILC, enabling high-performance tracking from the very first trials. In this architecture, ILC provides high-quality samples, while RL contributes as a generalizing best-effort policy across iterations. Additionally, a theoretical proof is presented to show that the RL component preserves ILC stability and, under specific conditions, can also reduce the error bound asymptotically. The efficacy of this framework is demonstrated through simulation and experiments on an underactuated 4-degree-of-freedom serial elastic robot using different trajectories and modeling mismatches.
summary_zh: 柔顺机器人的轨迹跟踪因非线性动力学和建模不确定性而具有挑战性，通常需要基于学习的方法来避免显式参数辨识。迭代学习控制（ILC）在理论上能够确保高精度，同时保持机器人的被动柔顺性。然而，传统ILC要求对每条新轨迹都进行单独的学习阶段。相比之下，强化学习（RL）能够泛化到新轨迹，但在实际应用中存在样本复杂度高和跟踪精度有限的问题。本文提出了一种强化迭代学习控制（RILC）方法，结合了两者的优势，以实现跨多样轨迹的快速适应和有保证的跟踪收敛。通过在这两种控制器之间建立并发耦合，RILC克服了传统ILC初始误差大、适应速度慢的缺点，从首次试验起即可实现高性能跟踪。在该架构中，ILC提供高质量样本，而RL则充当跨迭代的泛化性尽力策略。此外，本文给出了理论证明，表明RL分量能够保持ILC的稳定性，并在特定条件下还能渐近地降低误差界。该框架的有效性通过在一个欠驱动四自由度串联弹性机器人上使用不同轨迹和建模失配进行的仿真与实验得到了验证。
tldr: This paper proposes Reinforced Iterative Learning Control (RILC), which combines ILC and RL to achieve fast, high-precision trajectory tracking for elastic joint robots with guaranteed convergence and generalization across trajectories, validated in simulation and real experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了强化迭代学习控制（RILC），结合ILC和RL，在模型不确定下实现弹性关节机器人快速高精度轨迹跟踪，保证跨轨迹泛化，并在仿真和真实实验中验证。

title: Distributed Platoon Control for Safe and Smooth Crossing at an Unsignalized Intersection-Part I: Stability Analysis
summary: We propose a distributed platoon controller that guarantees safe and smooth crossing of multi-vehicle systems at an unsignalized intersection. To support the stability analysis, we consider a multi-vehicle platoon maneuvering along a closed path with a single unsignalized intersection. Unlike traditional bi-level decoupled designs on open paths, which primarily focus on intersection control while neglecting its coupling with platoon convergence, and thus hindering rigorous convergence analysis, the closed-path setting allows us to analyze the asymptotic behavior of the platoon. The local exponential convergence analysis of the switched closed-loop system, induced by repeated vehicle switching at the intersection, is presented. Under some mild conditions on the controller gains, we show that safe intersection crossing is ensured during the transient phase and smooth crossing is achieved in steady state, where all vehicles travel at a common constant speed while avoiding collisions at the intersection. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed distributed controller is demonstrated in a high-fidelity CARLA simulator using multiple commercial vehicle models.
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种分布式队列控制器，用于确保多车辆系统在无信号交叉口安全且平稳地通行。为了支持稳定性分析，我们考虑一个多车辆队列沿包含单个无信号交叉口的封闭路径行驶。与传统的在开放路径上采用的双层解耦设计不同，这类设计主要关注交叉口控制，而忽略了其与队列收敛之间的耦合，从而阻碍了严格的收敛性分析；封闭路径的设定使我们能够分析队列的渐近行为。针对交叉口处车辆重复切换所引发的切换闭环系统，我们给出了其局部指数收敛性分析。在关于控制器增益的若干温和条件下，我们证明了在暂态阶段能够确保安全的交叉口通行，在稳态阶段实现平稳通行，此时所有车辆以共同恒定的速度行驶，并在交叉口处避免碰撞。最后，我们在高保真度的CARLA仿真器中，使用多种商用车辆模型验证了所提出的分布式控制器的有效性。
tldr: This paper proposes a distributed platoon controller for safe and smooth crossing at unsignalized intersections, with stability analysis in a closed-path setting and validation in CARLA simulations using commercial vehicle models.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种分布式队列控制器，用于无信号交叉口的安全和平滑通行，在闭环路径设置下进行稳定性分析，并在CARLA模拟器中用多种商用车辆模型验证。

title: Temporal Difference Learning of Probabilistic Reach-Avoid Value Functions
summary:
Reach-avoid sets, defining the states from which a task can be completed while avoiding unsafe regions, are fundamental tools for deploying robots in environments subject to disturbances and uncertainty, as well as for runtime task-feasibility monitoring, allowing prediction of whether a state is safe and will lead to successful task completion. Classical Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability (HJR) and its recent neural extensions (e.g., Lipschitz Continuous Reachability Learning, DeepReach) treat disturbances adversarially, computing the reach-avoid set under worst-case disturbances from a bounded set. This guarantees safety but can yield overly conservative sets when disturbances are stochastic rather than adversarial, and additionally requires the disturbance set to be known or specified in advance.
  We propose Probabilistic reach-avoid Value Function (PVF), a self-supervised method, applicable to black-box systems, for computing reach-avoid sets as the states with a certain reach-avoid probability under stochastic, potentially unbounded disturbances. We evaluate our approach against HJR-based baselines on systems of increasing complexity, up to a Hopper locomotion task, and show that our probabilistic sets are less conservative and more accurate than adversarial HJR sets when disturbances are non-adversarial.
summary_zh:
可达-避碰集合（Reach-avoid sets）定义了在避开不安全区域的同时能够完成任务的初始状态集合，是在存在扰动和不确定性的环境中部署机器人的基础工具，同时也用于运行时任务可行性监测，以预测某个状态是否安全并能导致任务成功完成。经典的哈密顿-雅可比可达性分析（HJR）及其近年来的神经扩展方法（如Lipschitz连续可达性学习、DeepReach）将扰动视为对抗性的，在有限集合的最坏情况扰动下计算可达-避碰集合。这保证了安全性，但当扰动是随机而非对抗性时，可能会产生过于保守的集合，并且还需要预先已知或指定扰动集合。

我们提出了概率可达-避碰价值函数（PVF），一种适用于黑箱系统的自监督方法，用于在随机且可能无界的扰动下，将可达-避碰集合计算为具有特定可达-避碰概率的状态集合。我们在复杂度逐渐增加的系统上（直至Hopper运动任务）将我们的方法与基于HJR的基线方法进行了评估，结果表明在非对抗性扰动条件下，我们的概率集合比对抗性HJR集合更不保守且更准确。
tldr: This paper proposes a self-supervised method to compute probabilistic reach-avoid value functions for black-box systems under stochastic disturbances, producing less conservative and more accurate reach-avoid sets than adversarial Hamilton-Jacobi reachability, demonstrated up to a Hopper locomotion task.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种自监督方法，用于在随机扰动下为黑盒系统计算概率可达-避免值函数，生成比对抗式汉密尔顿-雅可比可达性更不保守且更准确的集合，并已在 Hopper 运动任务上验证。

title: Knowing When to Stop Thinking: A Dissection of Expected Free Energy as a Test-Time Compute Controller for Latent World-Model Planning
summary: A planner using a learned world model can improve its predicted outcome while choosing a worse action. We study when expected free energy (EFE) can help decide how much computation to spend on a plan. An EFE-inspired objective combines goal distance with disagreement among stochastic predictions. We test candidate scoring, stopping, and online predictor updates separately. Stopping when elite cost stalls reduces refinement on tasks whose success plateaus with depth, with mean success close to fixed-depth references. At the larger tested weights, rewarding disagreement lowers success with a frozen model. Penalizing it helps at some task and weight settings but harms others. When training data omit a region needed to reach the goal, online updates recover part of the resulting loss. The tested cost-stall rule can fail when further optimization exploits model errors, because predicted cost keeps falling after task success peaks. Cost progress can guide computation on a plateau, but protecting performance after a peak requires information about the consequences of the chosen actions.
summary_zh: 基于学习的世界模型进行规划时，智能体可能因选出一个更差的动作而获得更优的预测结果。本文研究预期自由能（EFE）能否用于决定在规划上投入多少计算量。受EFE启发的目标函数将目标距离与随机预测之间的分歧相结合。我们分别测试了候选评分、停止准则和在线预测器更新。当精英成本陷入停滞时提前停止，会减少在成功随深度趋于平台期的任务上的细化程度，其平均成功率接近固定深度的参照结果。在测试的较大权重下，奖励分歧在冻结模型时降低了成功率；而惩罚分歧在部分任务和权重设置下有助于提升性能，但在其他情况下则有害。当训练数据缺失通向目标所需的部分区域时，在线更新能够部分恢复由此导致的性能损失。所测试的成本停滞准则在进一步优化利用模型误差时可能失效，因为预测成本在任务成功率达到峰值后仍持续下降。成本进展可在平台期指导计算分配，但在峰值之后保护性能则需要有关所选动作后果的信息。
tldr: This paper analyzes expected free energy as a test-time compute controller for latent world-model planning, studying when stopping or refining planning is beneficial. It finds simple cost-stall stopping can fail when model errors are exploited, and online updates recover some loss when training data is incomplete.
tldr_zh: 本文分析了期望自由能作为潜在世界模型规划中测试时计算控制器的作用，研究了何时停止或细化规划是有益的。发现简单的成本停滞停止在模型错误被利用时会失败，而在线更新可以部分恢复因训练数据不完整造成的损失。

title: PCLA-Bridge: A Framework for Cross-Domain Deployment of CARLA Agents
summary: Most high-performing end-to-end autonomous driving agents (ADAs) are developed for the CARLA Leaderboard, tightly coupling them to CARLA's APIs, sensor layouts, coordinate systems, and internal clock. Reusing these models on real datasets, alternative simulators, or physical platforms necessitates substantial manual re-engineering. We present PCLA-Bridge, a deployable tool that runs unmodified CARLA Leaderboard agents from any sensor source to any control destination without an active CARLA server. With PCLA-Bridge handling dependency isolation, tensor marshalling, routing, and synthetic timing, integrators only need to provide a minimal interface. We validate the tool across two operational paradigms: offline replay on in-domain CARLA recordings and real-world nuScenes logs, and live closed-loop control across three diverse simulation engines: MetaDrive, AWSIM, and AlpaSim. We analyze the lightweight integration requirements for each platform, highlighting output translation (such as converting agent actions into target trajectory formats) and coordinate-frame transformations, showing that integration requires minimal glue code rather than structural changes. All eight evaluated agents execute across all three simulators without modification, confirming the reliability of PCLA-Bridge and establishing a foundation for systematic sim-to-real, cross-sim, and security testing.
summary_zh: 大多数高性能端到端自动驾驶智能体（ADAs）是为CARLA排行榜开发的，因此紧密依赖于CARLA的API、传感器布局、坐标系和内部时钟。若要在真实数据集、其他模拟器或物理平台上复用这些模型，需要进行大量手工重新工程。我们提出了PCLA-Bridge，一种可直接部署的工具，能够在无需激活CARLA服务器的情况下，将未经修改的CARLA排行榜智能体从任意传感器源运行到任意控制目标端。通过PCLA-Bridge处理依赖隔离、张量编组、路由和合成时序，集成者只需提供最小化接口。我们在两种运行范式下对该工具进行了验证：一是对域内CARLA录像和真实世界nuScenes日志进行离线回放；二是在三种不同模拟引擎（MetaDrive、AWSIM和AlpaSim）中进行实时闭环控制。我们分析了各平台的轻量级集成需求，重点说明了输出转换（例如将智能体动作转换为目标轨迹格式）和坐标系变换，表明集成仅需极少的胶水代码，而无需结构性改动。所有八个评估智能体在未作任何修改的情况下均能在三种模拟器中运行，这验证了PCLA-Bridge的可靠性，并为系统的仿真到现实迁移、跨模拟器测试及安全测试奠定了基础。
tldr: PCLA-Bridge is a deployable tool that enables unmodified CARLA Leaderboard agents to run across diverse simulators and real datasets without a CARLA server, validated in offline replay and live closed-loop control across three simulation engines and nuScenes.
tldr_zh: PCLA-Bridge 是一个可部署的工具，能够让未经修改的 CARLA 排行榜智能体在无需 CARLA 服务器的情况下，跨多种模拟器和真实数据集运行，并在三个模拟引擎和 nuScenes 数据上进行了验证。

title: High-Precision RCM Motion for Ophthalmic Robotics via Hierarchical QP Control and Authority-Guided Recovery Planning
summary: General-purpose manipulators can position ophthalmic instruments under a software Remote Centre of Motion (RCM). However, at some reachable configurations that are nonsingular for the tip task alone, the RCM and tip-tracking objectives conflict and the servo oscillates. We formalise this failure as a constraint-induced task singularity: the RCM-projected tip Jacobian loses rank while the unprojected tip Jacobian stays well conditioned. Thus, the effective tip authority collapses although the target remains reachable. We present a high-precision RCM servo architecture with built-in singularity recovery: for each commanded target, an authority-guided planner selects a well-conditioned arm configuration that reaches it and plans an RCM-consistent route, executed by a fixed hierarchical-QP controller. On a 200-scenario kinematic benchmark, the complete nominal-and-recovery protocol reaches 128/128 near-singular targets and 71/72 near-joint-limit targets (100% and 99%, respectively), with the software-RCM residual below 0.142 mm. On a physical 6-DOF arm it executes across four RCM entry points, with a worst-case kinematically reconstructed RCM residual of 178 μm and a median tip-regulation error of 32μm, within the 200μm control requirement adopted for the ophthalmic task.
summary_zh: 通用机械臂可以在软件远程运动中心（RCM）约束下定位眼科手术器械。然而，在某些仅针对末端任务而言非奇异的可达构型下，RCM约束与末端跟踪目标相互冲突，导致伺服系统振荡。我们将这种失效形式化为一种由约束引发的任务奇异性：RCM投影后的末端雅可比矩阵秩亏，而未投影的末端雅可比矩阵条件数保持良好。因此，尽管目标仍然可达，有效末端控制能力却发生崩溃。我们提出了一种内置奇异性恢复能力的高精度RCM伺服架构：针对每个指令目标，基于控制能力引导的规划器选取一个条件数良好的机械臂构型以到达目标，并规划一条满足RCM约束的路径，由固定层级二次规划（QP）控制器执行。在包含200个场景的运动学基准测试中，完整的标称与恢复协议成功到达128/128个近奇异目标（100%）和71/72个近关节极限目标（99%），软件RCM残差低于0.142 mm。在物理6自由度机械臂上，该方法在四个RCM入口点均能顺利执行，最坏情况下运动学重建的RCM残差为178 μm，末端调节误差中位数为32 μm，满足眼外科任务所采用的200 μm控制要求。
tldr: This paper addresses a constraint-induced task singularity in software RCM ophthalmic robotics, presenting a hierarchical QP control architecture with authority-guided recovery planning that achieves high precision on both simulated and physical 6-DOF arms, with residuals well within clinical requirements.
tldr_zh: 本文针对眼科手术机器人软件RCM中约束引起的任务奇异性，提出了一种分层QP控制与权威导向恢复规划架构，在仿真和物理6自由度机械臂上实现了高精度，残余误差满足临床要求。

title: Enumeration-Guided Training of Neural Hamilton-Jacobi Safety Certificates
summary: Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability analysis offers formal safety guarantees for control systems, but training accurate neural certificates remains difficult, particularly when unsafe regions are hard to characterize. We propose a verification-guided training framework that addresses this by using probabilistic enumeration of safety constraints to detect forward-invariance violations, i.e., states where the learned certificate incorrectly classifies unsafe behavior. This produces a compact, targeted set of counterexamples that more precisely captures the failure boundary than inputs generated by standard adversarial attack methods. Crucially, using this representation to fine-tune a pretrained HJ value function yields larger certified regions and reduces certification time across all tested benchmarks. We further introduce a shielding mechanism based on the refined certificates to enforce safety constraints at deployment time. We evaluate the proposed safety filter in a realistic, physics-based Isaac Sim environment and through real-world autonomous racing experiments, achieving zero safety constraint violations compared to a nominal controller and a backup policy based on Linear Quadratic Regulation (LQR). These results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed shielding mechanism in ensuring safe operation under high-speed, safety-critical conditions.
summary_zh: Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) 可达性分析为控制系统提供了形式化的安全保证，但在不安全区域难以刻画的情况下，训练精确的神经证书仍然十分困难。我们提出了一种基于验证引导的训练框架，通过概率枚举安全约束来检测前向不变性违反，即学习到的证书错误分类不安全行为的状态。与标准对抗攻击方法生成的输入相比，该方法生成了一组紧凑且具有针对性的反例，能够更精确地捕捉失败边界。关键在于，利用这一表示对预训练的 HJ 值函数进行微调，可以在所有测试基准上获得更大的认证区域，并减少认证时间。我们进一步引入了一种基于精化证书的屏蔽机制，以在部署时强制执行安全约束。我们在基于物理的 Isaac Sim 环境中以及真实自动驾驶赛车实验中评估了所提出的安全滤波器，与标称控制器和基于线性二次调节（LQR）的备份策略相比，实现了零安全约束违反。这些结果证明了所提出的屏蔽机制在高速、安全关键条件下确保安全运行的有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces a verification-guided training framework for neural Hamilton-Jacobi safety certificates, using probabilistic enumeration of safety constraints to generate targeted counterexamples for fine-tuning, and demonstrates a shielding mechanism that achieves zero safety violations in real-world autonomous racing and Isaac Sim experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种验证引导的神经Hamilton-Jacobi安全证书训练框架，通过概率枚举安全约束生成针对性反例进行微调，并在真实自动驾驶赛车及Isaac Sim实验中展示了屏蔽机制实现零安全违规。

title: Agentic discovery of interpretable car-following laws from multi-source trajectory data
summary: Car-following (CF) models is a fundamental component of microscopic traffic simulation and underpin the analysis of collective traffic dynamics, while its modeling becomes more challenging due to diverse human driving behaviors and the increasing presence of automated vehicle. Analytical CF models offer interpretable representations of longitudinal vehicle interactions, but their prescribed functional structures may limit the representation of heterogeneous driving behavior. This study proposes an agent-centered, physics-aware framework for the empirical discovery of CF laws from multi-source trajectory data. The framework iteratively combines agent-guided hypothesis generation, informed by traffic flow knowledge and state-dependent reconstruction errors, with evolutionary symbolic search and physics-aware multi-objective evaluation. Using NGSIM US-101, highD, and exiD, the framework discovers the Adaptive Equilibrium Response Model (AERM), which couples state-dependent relative-speed response with spacing-dependent equilibrium-speed restoration. AERM admits analytical equilibrium speed-spacing and flow-density relationships; its stability conditions are derived for the zero-delay formulation, and platoon simulations examine disturbance propagation. Evaluated against seven classical CF models on Shanghai naturalistic driving data, NGSIM I-80, and Waymo trajectories, AERM attains the lowest spacing and speed reconstruction errors under trajectory-specific calibration, reducing spacing RMSE by 9.11%, 7.59%, and 21.73% relative to the strongest baselines, and remains competitive under dataset-level shared parameters. These results demonstrate the fitting flexibility and analytical tractability of the discovered CF law, providing an interpretable basis for microscopic traffic simulation.
summary_zh: 跟驰模型是微观交通仿真的基本组成部分，也是分析交通宏观动态行为的基础。然而，由于人类驾驶行为的多样性以及自动驾驶汽车的日益普及，跟驰建模面临更大挑战。解析型跟驰模型能够提供纵向车辆交互的可解释表征，但其预设的函数结构可能限制对异质驾驶行为的表达能力。本研究提出了一种以智能体为中心、物理感知的框架，用于从多源轨迹数据中经验性地发现跟驰规律。该框架将基于智能体的假设生成——结合交通流知识与状态依赖的重构误差——与进化符号搜索及物理感知多目标评估迭代结合。利用NGSIM US-101、highD和exiD数据集，该框架发现了自适应平衡响应模型（AERM），该模型将状态依赖的相对速度响应与间距依赖的平衡速度恢复机制耦合在一起。AERM具有解析的平衡速度-间距关系和流量-密度关系；推导了零延迟公式下的稳定性条件，并通过队列仿真检验了扰动传播特性。在上海自然驾驶数据、NGSIM I-80和Waymo轨迹数据上，与七个经典跟驰模型进行对比评估，AERM在轨迹特定标定下取得了最低的间距和速度重构误差，相较于最强基线模型，间距均方根误差分别降低了9.11%、7.59%和21.73%，并在数据集级共享参数设置下仍保持竞争力。上述结果表明，所发现的跟驰规律兼具拟合灵活性与解析可操作性，为微观交通仿真提供了可解释的基础。
