Across four conversation datasets, we find that curiosity-oriented questions remain rare (17-28% of all questions), but are associated with more exploratory and epistemically rich subsequent user responses, with varying patterns across datasets. We further conduct a human study to evaluate the usefulness of model curiosity, finding that curiosity can encourage exploration, especially in advice, creative, and research contexts. These findings have implications for building LLMs that ask more selectively to support deeper exploration and human-AI collaboration.

title: What Sketches Tell Us about LVLMs: Conventions, Grounding, and Localisation
summary: LVLM benchmarks tell us whether a model answers correctly, but not which visual conventions it has retained, nor where those conventions live. Sketches expose this hidden structure. A sketch removes texture, lighting, and photographic context while preserving the strokes humans judged sufficient for recognition. If an LVLM can operate on that abstraction, the surviving signal is structural rather than merely photometric. We introduce a training-free sketch probe with three readouts: temporal part-construction order, spatial attention-based grounding, and the mechanistic layer/head locus of grounding. We evaluate nine LVLMs on part order and five on the attention readouts, over two part-annotated sketch datasets. Three findings emerge. First, LVLM part order tracks human convention: models reproduce canonical orderings where human drawings converge, and become correspondingly variable where human orderings vary. Controls that blank, withhold, and mismatch the sketch locate this convention in the language model. Second, part-level grounding survives the abstraction: attention heads selected from the frozen model with an existing recipe recover part and object regions on object and scene sketches, with no grounding supervision. Third, the grounding signal concentrates in a narrow mid-network band whose location follows the base language model rather than parameter count in the two families we compare, and remains stable across object and scene sketches. The result is a practical diagnostic for sketch-driven LVLMs: no fine-tuning, no auxiliary segmenter, and a layer band that doubles as a head-selection prior, matching or improving grounding mAcc@0.1 in every model and dataset we tested.

title: When is early stopping beneficial under label noise? A phase diagram for kernel gradient flow
summary: Early stopping is commonly used to prevent fitting label noise from degrading generalization. Does this mean that, when a positive fraction of the training labels is intrinsically unpredictable, the best test error must occur before interpolation? Experiments on a CIFAR10 classification task with randomly labeled examples motivate the opposite possibility: although fixed-feature and shallow models exhibit late-time deterioration of the test error, the need for early stopping essentially disappears in larger, deeper convolutional networks even after the random labels have all been classified correctly. We determine when late-time deterioration disappears entirely in a solvable setting. For kernel gradient flow on a synthetic noisy classification task, we derive sharp high-dimensional learning curves and obtain a phase diagram controlled by the balance between the linear kernel component that learns the shared relation between inputs and labels and the higher-order components that enable fitting the label noise. In one regime, generalization is optimized at finite time and early stopping is necessary. In another, generalization improves until interpolation, but the endpoint is suboptimal across kernels. At the boundary, the interpolating endpoint attains the lowest generalization error across the considered kernel family and all training times. Thus, even with extensive irreducible label noise, interpolation can outperform early stopping. The neural-network experiments leave open how learned representations acquire an analogous favorable geometry.

title: Whether or Where? Tail Calibration Signals Finite-Budget Reward Hacking in Best-of-N Selection
summary: Best-of-N (BoN) inference returns the candidate with the highest proxy reward, so a larger $N$ tests the proxy's extreme tail more than its average ranking quality. We show that the exact BoN value is a Beta-weighted integral of conditional true reward over within-prompt score quantiles. It follows that BoN depends on scores only through their ranks. It also follows that BoN can decline only if the calibration curve in the tail turns downward, and the budget where the decline appears depends on where that turn lies. Under a bounded additive model, the error tail sets the limit: Gaussian errors keep improving, Laplace errors reach a plateau, and heavy-tailed errors return to the prior mean. When error variance is largest at low true reward, even Gaussian noise can push BoN below random selection. Synthetic phase maps agree with this taxonomy. On real candidate pools spanning several verifiable domains, base policies, and learned reward models, tail failures are rare and all occur in code generation. A held-out tail calibration statistic reliably predicts where a cross-fitted budget cap helps. It does about as well as rank accuracy, and the cap is competitive with a Soft-BoN baseline. Tail calibration therefore does not replace ranking metrics. It is an audit that is unchanged by any monotone rescaling of the reward scores and shows which budgets are at risk.

title: Why Does Structured Output Fail? An Empirical Study of Prompt-Enforced Pydantic Schemas Across Nine LLMs
summary: Pipelines that require structured outputs from hosted language models often specify a Pydantic schema in the prompt, validate the response, and retry when validation fails. Although native structured-output modes provide an alternative, application-side validation remains important for enforcing custom constraints. Yet pipeline reliability is often summarized by a single validity rate, which obscures why outputs fail and which interventions may help. We introduce a fine-grained taxonomy of schema-conformance failures and a deterministic classifier that assigns failure categories from model responses and Pydantic validation errors. We apply this framework to 3,997 generation attempts across nine OpenAI and Anthropic model/API configurations, using questions from HotpotQA and FinanceBench. Our results show that similar validity rates can mask different failure patterns, and that dominant failure categories vary with schema constraints and task. Markdown-fenced JSON is the most common failure: among 681 fenced failures, only 48.0% pass validation after fence removal, while the remainder conceal additional violations, predominantly field-length violations. In an exploratory prompt ablation, variants that suppress fences appear to shift failures toward length violations, but the shift is consistent with exposing violations that were already present, illustrating how aggregate validity rates can obscure changes in failure composition. We derive four engineering practices for validator, schema, retry and evaluation design, three supported by our data and one, on retry feedback, proposed but not tested, and release the classifier, completions, and annotations.

title: Write What Matters: Disentangling Token Selection from Slot Allocation in Recurrent Memory
summary: Long-sequence models must retain earlier information. Full attention keeps all past tokens but grows expensive, and recurrent-memory models compress history into fixed slots for linear-time processing. Limited capacity makes writes consequential: distractors can interfere with useful content, while skipped evidence cannot be recalled. Existing multi-slot memories write every token to the same number of slots, merging whether to store it with how many slots to update. We introduce Factorized Write Routing (FWR), which first keeps or skips each token and then chooses a fixed or token-adaptive number of slots. Queries still read all slots. Across ten seeds on two synthetic tasks that query facts after long contexts, we observe a density-dependent reversal. With four slots per write, long-context accuracy favors always writing on dense Feature Recall (0.472 vs 0.337), but learned selective writing on sparse-fact Passkey (0.222 vs 0.048). The tested adaptive rule underperforms fixed allocation under the learned gate on both tasks. A diagnostic oracle given fact labels unavailable at deployment reaches 0.372 on Passkey, showing headroom in filtering distractors. The results suggest avoiding missed writes in information-dense contexts and filtering distractors when they dominate.

title: Xing USP: A Cross-Family Semantic Contract for Information Extraction and Intent-Slot Parsing
summary: Structured semantic parsing is typically judged by whether the correct category is assigned, which leaves value recovery and instance-level associations unexamined: a system may recognize an event yet bind an argument to the wrong instance, or identify an intent yet supply an incorrect slot value. We present USP, a cross-family semantic contract that represents categories, fields, values, and instance associations through a common interface for named-entity recognition, relation extraction, event extraction, and intent-slot parsing. The contract is paired with five diagnostic matching views---category agreement, field recognition, field-value pairing, instance-bound assignment, and complete-instance recovery---that ask distinct questions about the same output. Using this contract, we normalize 61 datasets into a unified corpus with shared schemas, prompts, and matching rules, and compare six models on a fixed test subset. Our fine-tuned Xing4.0-29B-Intent attains 57.70 task-balanced Field-Value Micro-F1 (equally weighted across the four task families) and ranks first in every family and on all five views; its margin over the strongest alternative widens from 2.93 points for category matching to 20.73 points for complete-instance matching. This widening gap shows that category agreement alone understates structural deficits. USP thus offers the community a shared representation, a normalized 61-dataset corpus, and a diagnostic evaluation protocol that make structural agreement measurable and comparable across extraction and intent-slot tasks.

title: OSWAM: An Effective World Action Model with One-Step Action Generation
summary: Direct-policy World Action Models (WAM) have demonstrated the benefits of decoupling action generation from explicit future visual prediction for efficient inference in autonomous driving and embodied control. However, they still require tens of denoising steps to achieve competitive action quality, incurring substantial latency and hindering real-time deployment. Simply reducing the number of denoising steps will collapse the nonlinear multi-step denoising trajectory into coarse updates, substantially degrading action quality. To reduce the denoising steps while enabling real-time action generation, we present an effective world action model with one-step action generation, namely OSWAM, for autonomous driving and embodied control. We argue that it is the absence of structured action priors in random noise initialization that forces direct-policy WAMs to recover coherent action sequences through iterative denoising. Hence, we construct imagination tokens to initialize the diffusion process, providing physical priors and action-conditioned representations. We further introduce privileged information distillation with future conditioning to enhance future-aware action generation. As a result, OSWAM can efficiently and effectively generate high quality actions in just one diffusion step. Our experiments demonstrate that OSWAM achieves comparable or even better results in both autonomous driving and embodied control than direct-policy WAM and Joint-WAM that require tens of steps. It obtains approximately $3\times$ speedup over direct-policy WAM baselines and supports real-time compiled inference with latency as low as 40ms on an NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU. The project page is available at https://gwenzhang.github.io/OSWAM/
summary_zh: 直接策略世界动作模型（WAM）已证明，在自动驾驶和具身控制中，将动作生成与显式未来视觉预测解耦能够实现高效推理。然而，这类模型仍需数十步去噪才能达到具有竞争力的动作质量，由此带来显著延迟并阻碍实时部署。单纯减少去噪步数会将非线性多步去噪轨迹退化为粗糙更新，从而大幅降低动作质量。为在减少去噪步数的同时实现实时动作生成，我们提出了一种高效的世界动作模型——OSWAM，支持单步动作生成，适用于自动驾驶和具身控制场景。我们认为，正是随机噪声初始化中缺乏结构化动作先验，迫使直接策略WAM通过迭代去噪来恢复连贯的动作序列。为此，我们构建了想象令牌（imagination tokens）来初始化扩散过程，提供物理先验和动作条件化表示。我们进一步引入带未来条件化的特权信息蒸馏，以增强对未来感知的动作生成能力。由此，OSWAM仅需一步扩散即可高效、高质量地生成动作。实验表明，在自动驾驶和具身控制任务中，OSWAM达到了与需要数十步去噪的直接策略WAM及联合WAM相当甚至更优的性能。相较直接策略WAM基线，OSWAM实现了约3倍加速，并在NVIDIA RTX 5090 GPU上支持低至40ms延迟的实时编译推理。项目主页见 https://gwenzhang.github.io/OSWAM/
tldr: OSWAM introduces imagination tokens and privileged information distillation to enable one-step diffusion-based action generation in world action models, achieving comparable performance to multi-step baselines in autonomous driving and embodied control with significantly lower latency.
tldr_zh: OSWAM通过引入想象令牌和特权信息蒸馏，实现了世界动作模型中的单步扩散动作生成，在自动驾驶和具身控制中达到了与多步基线相当的性能，同时显著降低了延迟。

title: Learning Force-Reactive Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Many everyday tasks require controlling contact force as well as motion. On a humanoid, this force must often be coordinated across both hands and the whole body, and cannot be specified by kinematic trajectories alone. Therefore, we present FLORE, a framework for learning force-reactive humanoid loco-manipulation. We collect robot-free demonstrations using two force-sensing UMI-style handheld grippers for hand motion and contact wrenches, and wearable trackers for body motion. A force-reactive diffusion policy takes vision, proprioception, and measured wrenches as input, then predicts actions and per-hand force commands. A hybrid compliance whole-body controller with force tracking executes these commands while maintaining balance: an integral of the force error measured by real force/torque (F/T) sensors lets each hand track force accurately along the commanded direction and remain compliant along the others. In simulation, the controller tracks per-hand force commands of varied magnitude and direction, with little loss in whole-body motion accuracy. Across three contact-rich tasks on the robot, the force-reactive policy succeeds in 80% of rollouts, compared with 26.7% for a position-only policy trained on the same demonstrations and executed by the same controller. For more details, please visit our website: https://louis-leee.github.io/FLoRe/.
summary_zh: 许多日常任务同时要求控制接触力与运动。在类人机器人上，这种力通常需要双手与全身协调配合，而无法仅通过运动学轨迹来指定。为此，我们提出了FLORE，一个用于学习力反应式类人机器人操作与移动的框架。我们使用两个力传感UMI式手持夹持器采集无机器人参与的演示，记录手部运动与接触力旋量，并利用可穿戴追踪器捕捉身体运动。一种力反应式扩散策略以视觉、本体感觉及实测力旋量为输入，预测动作及每只手的力指令。一个带力跟踪的混合柔顺全身控制器执行这些指令并保持平衡：由实际力/力矩（F/T）传感器测得的力误差积分，使每只手能够沿指令方向精确跟踪力，同时在其余方向上保持柔顺。在仿真中，该控制器能够跟踪大小和方向各异的每手力指令，且全身运动精度损失较小。在机器人的三项接触密集任务中，力反应式策略在80%的试验中取得成功，而仅基于相同演示训练并采用同一控制器执行的位置型策略成功率仅为26.7%。更多详情，请访问我们的网站：https://louis-leee.github.io/FLoRe/。
tldr: FLORE is a framework for learning force-reactive humanoid loco-manipulation, using force-sensing demonstrations and a force-reactive diffusion policy with a hybrid whole-body controller to achieve reliable contact-rich manipulation on a real humanoid robot.
tldr_zh: FLORE是一个学习力反应人形移动操作框架，通过力感应演示和力反应扩散策略，结合混合全身控制器，在真实人形机器人上实现了可靠的接触丰富操作。

title: Differentiable Contact Dynamics for Legged Locomotion: Policy Learning and Contact-Implicit Trajectory Optimization
summary: This paper proposes a smooth analytic gradient for frictional contact and applies it to policy learning and contact-implicit trajectory optimization for legged locomotion. The exact contact sensitivity is available in closed form but describes changes within the current contact mode, providing no first-order information toward neighboring contact modes. The proposed gradient replaces this sensitivity only in the backward pass, leaving the hard-contact forward solve unchanged and the realized rollout feasible. A central-path relaxation of the de Saxcé-corrected second-order-cone complementarity problem for Coulomb friction smooths the conditions defining the separating, clamping, and sliding modes. The relaxed sensitivity is evaluated at a point on the central path obtained by a Newton iteration initialized from the hard-contact solution. The sensitivity remains continuous through contact-mode transitions and converges to the exact sensitivity as the relaxation vanishes. Using 100,000 samples and less than 2 min of training on a desktop PC, policy learning with the proposed gradient produces a policy that transfers to hardware without fine-tuning. On hardware, the robot under a trotting policy withstands pushes and traverses debris and slippery ground. In trajectory optimization, the proposed gradient reaches contact-rich solutions missed by exact and Signorini-relaxed gradients. Project page: https://diffcontact.github.io
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于摩擦接触的光滑解析梯度，并将其应用于策略学习以及腿式运动中的接触隐式轨迹优化。精确的接触灵敏度可以以闭式形式获得，但仅描述当前接触模式内的变化，无法提供朝向相邻接触模式的一阶信息。所提出的梯度仅在反向传播中替代该灵敏度，保持硬接触前向求解不变，并确保实际推出的轨迹可行。针对库仑摩擦的de Saxcé修正二阶锥互补问题，采用中心路径松弛方法，对分离、夹紧和滑动模式的定义条件进行光滑化处理。松弛后的灵敏度在由硬接触解初始化并通过牛顿迭代获得的中心路径点处进行评估。该灵敏度在接触模式转换过程中保持连续，并随着松弛的消失收敛至精确灵敏度。利用100，000个样本且在台式电脑上训练时间不超过2分钟，采用所提梯度的策略学习能够生成无需微调即可迁移至硬件的策略。在硬件实验中，执行小跑步态的机器人能够抵御推挤，并穿越碎屑和湿滑地面。在轨迹优化中，所提梯度能够找到精确梯度和Signorini松弛梯度所遗漏的接触丰富解。项目页面：https://diffcontact.github.io
tldr: This paper proposes a smooth analytic gradient for frictional contact, applied to policy learning and contact-implicit trajectory optimization for legged locomotion, demonstrating hardware transfer without fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于摩擦接触的光滑解析梯度，并将其应用于腿式运动的策略学习和接触隐式轨迹优化，展示了无需微调的硬件迁移能力。

title: Profiling a Frontier Agent with EBench: From Direct Control to Harness with Policy
summary: Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can control robots without robot-specific training, but how their capabilities compare and interact with post-trained vision-language-action (VLA) and world action model (WAM) policies across manipulation demands remains to be thoroughly evaluated. In this report, we evaluate GPT-6-Astra on EBench as the core of an agent that controls a robot through an agent harness under the same visual and proprioceptive observation protocol as post-trained policies. We study two agent configurations: direct control, in which the agent generates waypoint commands directly, and harness with policy, in which it can also invoke a post-trained VLA or WAM policy for action execution. Under direct control, the agent achieves competitive overall performance relative to post-trained policies. It leads on short-horizon tasks and exhibits the least performance variation across generalization dimensions, whereas it underperforms post-trained policies on long-horizon tasks, tabletop manipulation, and high-precision contact-rich tasks. In the harness with policy, invoking a post-trained VLA or WAM combines the complementary strengths of both components, raising overall task success to the level of the strongest compared post-trained policies while substantially reducing token cost. However, performance remains below the per-task upper bound of the standalone components due to suboptimal policy invocation, fixed-instruction execution without subgoals, and grasp disruption when the agent resumes control. Overall, our study characterizes the capability boundary of a frontier MLLM agent and suggests directions for improving future agent harness design. Project page: https://internrobotics.github.io/EBench-Astra-Tech-Report/
summary_zh: 前沿多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）无需机器人专用训练即可控制机器人，但其能力与经过后训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）及世界动作模型（WAM）策略在各类操作需求上的比较与交互方式，尚有待全面评估。本报告中，我们在EBench上以GPT-6-Astra为核心，通过智能体框架控制机器人，并采用与后训练策略相同的视觉和本体感觉观测协议。我们研究了两种智能体配置：直接控制模式，即智能体直接生成路点指令；以及策略协同模式，即智能体还可调用后训练的VLA或WAM策略来执行动作。在直接控制模式下，智能体的整体表现与后训练策略相当，在短时程任务上表现领先，且在各泛化维度上的性能波动最小；但在长时程任务、桌面操作及高精度接触密集任务上，其表现不及后训练策略。在策略协同模式下，调用后训练的VLA或WAM策略可结合两者的互补优势，将整体任务成功率提升至所比较的最强后训练策略水平，同时大幅降低词元成本。然而，由于策略调用次优、缺乏子目标的固定指令执行，以及智能体恢复控制时的抓取中断，整体性能仍低于各独立组件的任务级上限。总体而言，本研究刻画了前沿MLLM智能体的能力边界，并为未来智能体框架设计的改进提供了方向。项目页面：https://internrobotics.github.io/EBench-Astra-Tech-Report/
tldr: This report evaluates GPT-6-Astra, a frontier MLLM, on EBench as a robot agent under direct control and harness-with-policy configurations, comparing its performance against post-trained VLA and WAM policies for manipulation. The agent performs competitively under direct control but benefits from combining with post-trained policies in the harness setup, though limitations in policy invocation and task execution remain.
tldr_zh: 本报告评估了前沿多模态大语言模型 GPT-6-Astra 在 EBench 上作为机器人智能体的表现，比较了直接控制和经策略的 harness 两种配置下与后训练 VLA 和 WAM 策略的差异。结果表明，直接控制下性能有竞争力，但结合后训练策略可提升整体成功率，同时存在策略调用和任务执行方面的局限。

title: Pretraining Knows What, Simulation Teaches How: Compositional Generalization in a Sim-Trained Robot Agent
summary: A robot policy needs to understand what a task is asking for in a scene, and how to move the robot to accomplish that task. To achieve these two skills, we introduce Zero-real Agent Policy (ZAP), a recipe that teaches a small off-the-shelf vision-language model to control a robot via a simple tool harness. We use a pretrained 27B parameter model to bootstrap world understanding and reasoning, followed by supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on simple simulated tasks to teach it how to move the robot. Without observing real-world robot data during training, ZAP reaches 96.7% success on real-world tasks, matching GPT-6 Astra in our harness and outperforming the MolmoAct2 VLA (33.3%), while running 3x faster and 17x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra. Furthermore, ZAP also generalizes to an unseen embodiment as well as new objects, goals and strategies never seen during training. On a single-arm Franka, ZAP reaches 55.9% on RoboLab-120, 4.9 percentage points ahead of the leading VLA/WAM baseline.
summary_zh: 机器人策略需要理解场景中任务的要求，以及如何移动机器人以完成该任务。为同时实现这两项技能，我们引入了零样本真实智能体策略（ZAP），这是一种通过简单工具框架教会小型现成视觉语言模型控制机器人的方法。我们利用一个预训练的270亿参数模型来建立对世界的理解与推理能力，随后在简单模拟任务上进行监督微调和GRPO训练，以教会模型如何移动机器人。在训练过程中未观察任何真实机器人数据的情况下，ZAP在真实世界任务中达到了96.7%的成功率，在我们的框架中与GPT-6 Astra表现相当，并优于MolmoAct2 VLA（33.3%），同时运行速度比GPT-6 Astra快3倍，成本低17倍。此外，ZAP还能泛化到未见过的机器人形态以及训练中从未出现过的新物体、新目标和新策略。在单臂Franka上，ZAP在RoboLab-120基准上达到55.9%的成功率，比领先的VLA/WAM基线高出4.9个百分点。
tldr: ZAP is a recipe that trains a small vision-language model to control a robot using a tool harness, bootstrapped by a large pretrained model for world understanding and fine-tuned on simulated tasks, achieving high real-world success without real robot data.
tldr_zh: ZAP 是一种配方，通过工具框架训练小型视觉语言模型来控制机器人，利用大型预训练模型引导世界理解并在模拟任务上进行微调，无需真实机器人数据即可实现高真实世界成功率。

title: E0.5: From Reconstructive to Future-Predictive 3D Foundations for Robotic World-Action Modeling
summary: World-action models (WAMs) offer a promising framework for embodied intelligence, yet mainstream approaches remain centered on video foundation models or vision-language models. Even when geometric features extracted by 3D models such as VGGT are incorporated, they are typically passed into a video model or VLM that serves as the primary backbone, leaving 3D geometry as an auxiliary input or prediction target rather than the native foundation for world modeling. We present E0.5, a geometry-native world-action model built directly on 3D foundation models. E0.5 introduces two key innovations. First, it adopts a 3D foundation model as the primary backbone, making 3D geometry the native representation for both world modeling and action prediction. Second, it explicitly predicts future 3D states together with actions, enabling the model to capture geometric world dynamics beyond action-only modeling or future video prediction. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 first demonstrate the effectiveness of E0.5 without embodied-data pretraining, achieving success rates of 89.90\% and 50.09\% under clean and randomized settings, respectively. Building on these results, we further pretrain E0.5 on more than 160k robot trajectories from AgiBotWorld-Beta, jointly learning robot actions and future geometry within the pretrained 3D foundation. This embodied pretraining improves mean real-world manipulation success rates by approximately 15 and 7 percentage points on AgileX Piper and Zerith H1, respectively. Together, these results demonstrate the potential of geometry-native foundations to acquire robot interaction knowledge and transfer it to physical manipulation. E0.5 embodies this geometry-native approach as a member of the VWA family of world-action models.
summary_zh: 世界-动作模型（WAMs）为具身智能提供了一种有前景的框架，但主流方法仍以视频基础模型或视觉-语言模型为核心。即使引入了由VGGT等3D模型提取的几何特征，这些特征通常也被输入到作为主干的视频模型或VLM中，使得3D几何仅作为辅助输入或预测目标，而非世界建模的原生基础。我们提出了E0.5，一种直接构建于3D基础模型之上的几何原生世界-动作模型。E0.5引入了两项关键创新。首先，它采用3D基础模型作为主干网络，使3D几何成为世界建模和动作预测的原生表示。其次，它显式地预测未来的3D状态以及动作，使模型能够捕捉超出仅动作建模或未来视频预测范围的几何世界动态。在RoboTwin 2.0上的实验首先证明了E0.5在无需具身数据预训练的情况下的有效性，在干净和随机化设置下分别达到了89.90%和50.09%的成功率。基于这些结果，我们进一步在来自AgiBotWorld-Beta的超过16万条机器人轨迹上对E0.5进行预训练，在预训练的3D基础之上联合学习机器人动作和未来几何结构。这种具身预训练在AgileX Piper和Zerith H1上分别将真实世界操作的平均成功率提升了约15个百分点和7个百分点。综合来看，这些结果证明了几何原生基础在获取机器人交互知识并将其迁移到物理操作中的潜力。E0.5作为VWA世界-动作模型家族的一员，体现了这种几何原生的方法。
tldr: E0.5 is a geometry-native world-action model that uses a 3D foundation model as the primary backbone to jointly predict future 3D states and robot actions, demonstrating improved manipulation success in both simulation and real-world settings.
tldr_zh: E0.5是一种以几何为本体的世界动作模型，直接以3D基础模型为主干，联合预测未来3D状态与机器人动作，在仿真和真实操控中均提升了成功率。

title: Continuous-Time Safe Planning and Control for Agile Quadrupeds
summary: Agile quadruped navigation in dynamic environments demands trajectories that are both dynamically feasible and provably collision-free. Most real-time planners achieve tractability through a convex reduction that requires simplified kinematic models, discarding motion that the robot can readily execute, and certify safety only at discretization points, leaving open possible inter-sample collisions with moving obstacles. We present a real-time motion planning framework that retains the fully-actuated $SE(2)$ model of a quadruped, with its anisotropic, heading-coupled velocity bounds, and accepts the resulting nonconvexity. By parameterizing trajectories as composite Bernstein polynomials, we exploit the convex hull property to certify collision avoidance and the input bounds over the entirety of each planning horizon. Solved at online replanning rates, the optimization runs in closed loop, commanding body velocities to the locomotion controller. We validate the approach in simulation against ablations and external baselines, and in hardware experiments on a quadruped navigating among unknown moving obstacles, recovering both lateral and heading-coupled motion that simplified models exclude.
summary_zh: 在动态环境中，四足机器人的敏捷导航要求其运动轨迹既具有动力学可行性，又能被证明无碰撞。大多数实时规划器通过凸化简化来获得可解性，这需要简化的运动学模型，从而丢弃了机器人本可执行的运动，并且仅在离散点上验证安全性，这可能导致与移动障碍物在采样点之间发生碰撞的情况未被检测。我们提出了一种实时运动规划框架，该框架保留了四足机器人全驱动的 $SE(2)$ 模型，包括其各向异性、与航向相关的速度约束，并接受由此产生的非凸性。通过将轨迹参数化为复合伯恩斯坦多项式，我们利用凸包特性来验证整个规划周期内每个时刻的避碰性和输入约束。该优化以在线重规划速率运行，在闭环中工作，将机体速度指令发送给运动控制器。我们在仿真中通过消融实验和外部基线验证了该方法的有效性，并在未知移动障碍物环境下的四足机器人硬件实验中进行了验证，成功实现了简化模型所排除的横向运动与航向耦合运动。
tldr: This paper presents a real-time motion planning framework for agile quadrupeds that retains the full SE(2) model with anisotropic, heading-coupled velocity bounds, using composite Bernstein polynomials and their convex hull property to certify collision avoidance and input bounds continuously over the planning horizon, validated in simulation and hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于敏捷四足机器人的实时运动规划框架，保留了完整的SE(2)模型及各向异性、与航向耦合的速度约束，利用复合伯恩斯坦多项式的凸包性质在整个规划周期内连续验证碰撞避免和输入约束，并在仿真和硬件上进行了验证。

title: Revisiting Direct Control: A Field Evaluation of Sensor Fusion Efficacy in Teleoperating Full-Scale Autonomous Vehicles via Bird's Eye View
summary: In autonomous driving, robot teleoperation serves as a critical safety fallback mechanism, requiring operators to assume direct control in the event of system failure. While recent research has pivoted toward high-level supervisory control or simulation-based studies, these approaches often fail to capture the physical dynamics and sensory demands of driving a full-scale vehicle. To address this gap, we evaluated the impact of spatial data representation on operator performance using a real car-sized vehicle in a field experiment with $N = 18$ participants. We compared three visualization interfaces: (i) a standard camera feed baseline, with two bird's-eye views (BEV) from (ii) a raw LiDAR point cloud, and (iii) a sensor fusion of LiDAR and camera data streams. Contrary to prior passive observation studies suggesting that sensor-fusion BEV may hinder awareness, our active-control results demonstrate that such representation significantly outperforms the standard LiDAR BEV in perceived usability ($p \leq 0.0001$) and cognitive task load ($p = 0.01$, NASA-TLX score: 34.58/100) while also being significantly better than the Camera-only view ($p = 0.043$). The fused interface also led to statistically significant reductions in task completion time ($p = 0.0461$) and superior usability (SUS: 77.9/100) compared to those of the Camera-only and LiDAR-only views. By synthesizing objective performance data with comprehensive subjective assessments, we demonstrate that BEV fusion maximizes safety margins while minimizing the operator's mental demand. These findings challenge existing teleoperation conventions and provide an empirically validated approach for designing robust remote piloting systems.
summary_zh: 在自动驾驶领域，机器人远程操作作为关键的安全备用机制，要求操作人员在系统故障时接管直接控制权。尽管近期研究已转向高层监督控制或基于仿真的研究，这些方法往往难以捕捉全尺寸车辆驾驶的物理动力学特性和感官需求。为弥补这一空白，我们通过一项包含18名参与者的实地实验，评估了空间数据表示方式对操作员绩效的影响。研究中比较了三种可视化界面：(i) 标准摄像头画面作为基线，以及基于(ii)原始LiDAR点云和(iii)LiDAR与摄像头数据流融合的两种鸟瞰视图（BEV）。与先前被动观察研究认为传感器融合BEV可能阻碍态势感知的结论相反，我们的主动控制结果表明，该融合表示在感知可用性（p ≤ 0.0001）和认知任务负荷（p = 0.01，NASA-TLX得分：34.58/100）方面显著优于标准LiDAR BEV，同时也显著优于仅摄像头视图（p = 0.043）。融合界面在任务完成时间（p = 0.0461）上也实现了统计显著的缩减，并展现出更优的可用性（SUS：77.9/100），优于仅摄像头和仅LiDAR视图。通过综合客观绩效数据与全面的主观评估，我们证明BEV融合在最大化安全裕度的同时，最小化了操作员的认知需求。这些发现挑战了现有远程操作惯例，为设计稳健的远程驾驶系统提供了经验验证的方法。
tldr: This paper presents a field experiment with 18 participants teleoperating a full-scale autonomous vehicle, comparing camera-only, LiDAR BEV, and sensor-fusion BEV interfaces, finding that the fused BEV significantly improves usability, workload, and task completion time.
tldr_zh: 本文通过18名参与者在全尺寸自动驾驶车辆上的实地实验，比较了纯摄像头、激光雷达BEV和传感器融合BEV界面，发现融合BEV在可用性、工作负荷和任务完成时间上显著更优。

title: Robot-Aligned 3D Gaussian Splatting for Precise Reaching with Wrist-Camera VLA Policies
summary: Efficient robotic data collection remains a major bottleneck for vision-language-action (VLA) policy learning, especially for tasks requiring accurate end-effector positioning and camera-action alignment. This challenge is particularly severe in electronic-waste disassembly, where robots operate in cluttered assemblies of densely packed, visually similar components. Full digital-twin simulation is difficult because many parts are thin, reflective, or mechanically complex, making accurate object-level meshes and contact models difficult to obtain. In this work, we focus on pre-contact reaching and propose a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based data generation pipeline for wrist-camera VLA adaptation. Our method reconstructs the real workspace with 3DGS and renders diverse wrist-camera observations from robot-aligned poses. These observations are paired with smooth, structured reaching trajectories to provide robot-aligned visual-action supervision for VLA fine-tuning. We further augment the VLA policy with an instruction-conditioned reach verifier that estimates target proximity and provides reliable termination before physical interaction. Experiments in motherboard disassembly demonstrate precise VLA-based reaching using wrist-camera observations alone, without an external side-view camera. With $π$0.5, 1,500 generated trajectories achieve 80.0\% precise-reaching success across three targets, compared with 58.7\% using 150 teleoperated demonstrations, while requiring less than 10 minutes of active human capture. Project website: https://001-wang.github.io/PrecisionReach-GS/
summary_zh: 高效机器人数据采集仍然是视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略学习的主要瓶颈，尤其是在需要精确末端执行器定位和相机-动作对齐的任务中。这一挑战在电子废弃物拆解场景中尤为突出，因为机器人需要在由密集排列、视觉上高度相似的部件组成的杂乱装配体中作业。由于许多部件薄、反光或机械结构复杂，难以构建精确的物体级网格和接触模型，因此完整的数字孪生仿真较为困难。在本工作中，我们聚焦于接触前到达阶段，并提出了一种基于三维高斯溅射（3DGS）的数据生成流程，用于腕部相机VLA适配。我们的方法利用3DGS重建真实工作空间，并从机器人对齐的位姿渲染多样化的腕部相机观测图像。这些观测图像与平滑、结构化的到达轨迹配对，为VLA微调提供机器人对齐的视觉-动作监督。我们进一步为VLA策略增补了一个指令条件化的到达验证器，该验证器可估计目标接近程度，并在物理交互之前提供可靠的终止信号。在主板拆解实验中，仅使用腕部相机观测即可实现精确的基于VLA的到达操作，无需外部侧视相机。使用π0.5模型，1，500条生成轨迹在三个目标上实现了80.0%的精确到达成功率，而使用150条遥操作演示仅达到58.7%，且生成过程所需的主动人工采集时间不到10分钟。项目网站：https://001-wang.github.io/PrecisionReach-GS/
tldr: This paper introduces a 3D Gaussian Splatting-based data generation pipeline that creates robot-aligned wrist-camera observations and structured reaching trajectories to fine-tune VLA policies for precise pre-contact reaching in cluttered electronic-waste disassembly, achieving higher success than teleoperated demonstrations with less human effort.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于3D高斯泼溅的数据生成流程，为腕部相机VLA策略生成机器人对齐的观察和结构化的到达轨迹，在电子废弃物拆解中实现精确的到达操作，相比遥操作演示成功率更高且人力消耗更少。

title: RoboDoctor: Training-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Robot Policies
summary: Generalist robot policies and language-model agents provide complementary capabilities, but completing a task also requires adapting their use to the consequences of physical interaction. We study execution as a locus of adaptation: feedback guides the current action and supplies evidence for revising subsequent decisions under fixed model weights. We introduce RoboDoctor, a training-free framework that connects diagnosis, grounded action, and persistent experience across three revision targets. The harness allocates control between policy and agent; intervention determines when to assist while preserving useful policy behavior; and operation refines physical methods through observed effects. Linked experience records retain the reason for a decision, the attempted method, its outcome, and conditions for reuse. On a curated archive of 54 RoboDojo-Sim task entries, RoboDoctor achieves a five-dimension mean score of 57.10, with a native success rate of 49.44%. Recorded interactions illustrate strategy changes, selective correction, and grasp revision. These findings characterize execution-time adaptation in the evaluated system; controlled trials remain necessary to isolate the contribution of cross-episode experience.
summary_zh: 通用机器人策略与语言模型代理各自具备互补的能力，但完成一项任务还需要根据物理交互的结果对其使用方式进行调整。我们研究将执行过程作为适应的关键环节：反馈不仅引导当前动作，还为在固定模型权重下修订后续决策提供依据。我们提出RoboDoctor，一个无需训练的框架，将诊断、基于实体的行动以及跨三个修订目标的持续经验相连接。该框架在策略与代理之间实现控制分配；干预机制决定何时提供辅助，同时保留策略的有效行为；操作模块则通过观察到的效果精细化物理方法。关联的经验记录保留了决策缘由、尝试方法、其结果以及再使用条件。在包含54个RoboDojo-Sim任务条目的精选档案中，RoboDoctor实现了五维平均得分57.10，原生成功率为49.44%。记录到的交互展示了策略变更、选择性修正以及抓取调整。这些发现特征化了对所评估系统中执行时适应的表现；仍需通过受控试验来隔离跨回合经验的具体贡献。
tldr: RoboDoctor is a training-free framework that improves robot policies at execution time by connecting diagnosis, grounded action, and persistent experience across three revision targets, achieving a native success rate of 49.44% on RoboDojo-Sim tasks.
tldr_zh: RoboDoctor 是一个无需训练的框架，通过在执行阶段连接诊断、落地动作和持久经验，在 RoboDojo-Sim 任务上实现了49.44%的原生成功率。

title: Model-Aware Generation of Safety-Critical Scenes for Robust End-to-End Driving via Distilled Planner Surrogates
summary: End-to-end driving models perform well on standard benchmarks but collide frequently in safety-critical scenarios. We present a failure-mode analysis on NeuroNCAP which shows that 95.9% of DiffusionDrive's collisions are planning failures despite reliable detection, pinpointing the bottleneck in planning rather than perception. We attribute this to a fundamental data imbalance, as safety-critical interactions are rare in real driving logs, so planners are hardly ever trained on them. We close this gap with a novel model-aware framework that generates safety-critical training scenes against a specific planner. Each planner is attacked at the bird's-eye-view (BEV) level through a differentiable surrogate distilled from its own planning head. This keeps the expensive video renderer out of the attack loop. We extract 50 scenes per planner, each pairing an attack with a safe escape trajectory that serves as the fine-tuning label. A fully automated quality-diversity search generates both the attacks and the escapes, so that their variety is not specified by hand. Only these scenes are rendered to fine-tune the planner, which reduces the computational cost significantly. Fine-tuning on these scenes roughly halves the closed-loop collision rate of two planners on NeuroNCAP (SparseDrive 28.0% to 12.2%, DiffusionDrive 37.5% to 19.2%) while largely preserving normal driving. A cross-planner transfer experiment shows that the gain comes from targeting the specific planner. Each planner improves most on the scenes generated against itself, and DiffusionDrive fine-tuned on SparseDrive's scenes retains only 6.7 of its 18.3-point collision-rate reduction.
summary_zh: 端到端驾驶模型在标准基准测试中表现良好，但在安全关键场景中频繁发生碰撞。我们对NeuroNCAP进行了失效模式分析，结果显示DiffusionDrive的碰撞中95.9%是在检测可靠的情况下发生的规划失败，这指明了瓶颈在于规划而非感知。我们将此归因于根本性的数据不平衡——安全关键交互在真实驾驶日志中极为罕见，因此规划器很少能基于此类数据进行训练。我们提出了一种新颖的模型感知框架，针对特定规划器生成安全关键训练场景，从而弥合这一差距。每个规划器都在鸟瞰图（BEV）层面受到攻击，攻击通过从其自身规划头蒸馏出的可微代理模型进行。这使昂贵的视频渲染器保持在攻击循环之外。我们为每个规划器提取50个场景，每个场景将一次攻击与一条安全的逃逸轨迹配对，该轨迹作为微调标签。全自动的质量-多样性搜索同时生成攻击和逃逸，因此它们的多样性无需人工指定。仅这些场景会被渲染用于微调规划器，从而显著降低计算成本。在这些场景上微调使两个规划器在NeuroNCAP上的闭环碰撞率大约减半（SparseDrive从28.0%降至12.2%，DiffusionDrive从37.5%降至19.2%），同时很大程度上保留了正常驾驶性能。跨规划器迁移实验表明，性能提升来源于针对特定规划器的攻击策略。每个规划器在针对自身生成的场景上提升最大，而使用SparseDrive的场景微调的DiffusionDrive仅保留了其18.3个百分点碰撞率降低中的6.7个百分点。
tldr: This paper introduces a model-aware framework that generates safety-critical training scenes against specific end-to-end driving planners via distilled BEV-level surrogates, fine-tuning on which halves closed-loop collision rates on NeuroNCAP while preserving normal driving performance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种模型感知框架，通过蒸馏的BEV级替代模型针对特定端到端驾驶规划器生成安全关键训练场景，在NeuroNCAP上微调后闭环碰撞率减半，同时保持正常驾驶性能。

title: RetroNav: Scene-Grounded Retrospection and Retry for Self-Evolving Lifelong Navigation
summary: Existing robot navigation methods primarily focus on isolated tasks, overlooking the need to accumulate knowledge and experience across repeated navigation episodes. Although recent lifelong navigation methods have explored cross-task knowledge accumulation, they mainly focus on scene knowledge while neglecting historical navigation experience and its connection to scene evidence, limiting the ability to reflect on past mistakes and improve future decisions. To address this limitation, this paper presents RetroNav, a training-free self-evolving navigation framework that integrates navigation, memory accumulation, and failure reflection. Specifically, we develop a unified memory system that connects geometric and semantic scene knowledge with historical navigation experience, distinguishing objective observations from task-dependent interpretations. After each navigation attempt, an independent evaluator determines whether a retry is necessary. If so, a Retrospection Agent revisits historical decisions using accumulated scene knowledge and navigation records, generating an evidence-grounded retry brief to guide the next attempt. RetroNav achieves state-of-the-art performance across five navigation benchmarks. Our method will be open-sourced at https://github.com/3dv-casia/RetroNav .
summary_zh: 现有的机器人导航方法主要聚焦于孤立任务，忽视了在多次导航过程中积累知识与经验的需求。尽管近期的一些终身导航方法已探索跨任务的知识积累，但它们主要关注场景知识，而忽略了历史导航经验及其与场景证据之间的联系，从而限制了反思过往错误并优化未来决策的能力。为解决这一局限，本文提出了RetroNav——一种无需训练的自进化导航框架，将导航、记忆积累与失败反思融为一体。具体而言，我们构建了一个统一记忆系统，将几何与语义场景知识与历史导航经验相连接，并区分客观观察与任务相关解读。每次导航尝试后，一个独立评估器判断是否需要进行重试。若需要，一个反思代理（Retrospection Agent）将借助累积的场景知识与导航记录回顾历史决策，生成一份基于证据的重试简报，以指导下一次尝试。RetroNav在五个导航基准上均取得了最先进的性能。我们的方法将开源，地址为https://github.com/3dv-casia/RetroNav。
tldr: RetroNav is a training-free lifelong navigation framework that uses a unified memory system and a retrospection agent to reflect on past navigation failures and generate evidence-grounded retry briefs, achieving state-of-the-art performance on five navigation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: RetroNav 是一个无需训练的终身导航框架，通过统一记忆系统和反思代理回顾历史导航失败并生成基于证据的重试简报，在五个导航基准上达到了最先进的性能。

title: Zero-HLM: Generalizable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation without Real Robot Data
summary: Learning generalizable humanoid loco-manipulation remains bottlenecked by costly real-world demonstrations. Simulation provides a scalable alternative, but requires visually faithful, physics-ready scenes and executable whole-body motions. We present Zero-HLM, a real-to-sim-to-real framework that transforms smartphone captures and simulated source demonstrations into scalable training data for humanoid loco-manipulation. Gaussian-guided agentic real-to-sim reconstruction aligns visual and physical scenes; motion-environment co-adaptation uses rollout feedback to correct whole-body references and interaction geometry. We generate 4,800 physically validated demonstrations for zero-shot transfer across three Unitree G1 tasks. Simulation-trained GR00T N1.7 achieves 66.7% mean full-task success, versus 46.7% with real-data training. On generalized configurations, expanded simulation training raises pooled success from 23% for base-trained real-data policies to 69%, without additional real demonstrations. Project page: https://young-bit.github.io/zero-hlm/
summary_zh: 学习通用的人形机器人 locomotion-manipulation（移动操控）能力仍受制于成本高昂的真实世界示范数据。仿真提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，但需要视觉保真、物理就绪的场景以及可执行的全身体运动。我们提出了 Zero-HLM，一个真实到仿真再到真实的框架，将智能手机拍摄和仿真源示范转化为可扩展的人形机器人移动操控训练数据。基于高斯引导的智能体式真实到仿真重建，实现了视觉与物理场景的对齐；运动与环境协同自适应利用回滚反馈修正全身参考轨迹和交互几何。我们生成了 4,800 个经过物理验证的示范，用于 Unitree G1 上三项任务的零样本迁移。经过仿真训练的 GR00T N1.7 实现了 66.7% 的平均全任务成功率，而使用真实数据训练仅为 46.7%。在泛化配置下，扩展的仿真训练将基于基础训练真实数据策略的合并成功率从 23% 提升至 69%，且无需额外真实示范。项目页面：https://young-bit.github.io/zero-hlm/
tldr: Zero-HLM is a real-to-sim-to-real framework that uses smartphone captures and simulated demonstrations to train humanoid loco-manipulation policies without real robot data, achieving zero-shot transfer to a Unitree G1 robot and outperforming real-data training.
tldr_zh: Zero-HLM 是一个真实到仿真再到真实的框架，利用智能手机采集和仿真演示来训练人形机器人全身操控策略，无需真实机器人数据，即可零样本迁移到 Unitree G1 机器人，并优于真实数据训练的效果。

title: PushAround: Collaborative Path Clearing via Physics-Informed Hybrid Search
summary: Large vehicles in cluttered environments are often blocked by movable obstacles, motivating mobile robot teams to clear traversable corridors. Navigation Among Movable Obstacles (NAMO) approaches often abstract obstacle displacements while neglecting robot dimensions, obstacle mass, contact geometry and forces, yielding physically infeasible plans. PushAround is a physics-informed hybrid search that couples geometric connectivity reasoning with short-horizon simulation to construct executable clearing plans. Repeated W-clearance connectivity graph (WCCG) queries expose frontier gaps requiring widening and rank them by estimated downstream costs. The search generates direct or recursive pushing candidates, selecting obstacles, directions, contacts and forces, and admits physics-evaluated candidates. Numerical experiments validate WCCG against standard connectivity checks and demonstrate scaling to denser clutter and teams of up to four robots, with robustness to simulated execution-side physical-parameter mismatch.
summary_zh: 大型车辆在杂乱环境中常常受到可移动障碍物的阻挡，这促使移动机器人团队清理可通行的走廊。在可移动障碍物中导航（NAMO）方法通常对障碍物位移进行抽象，而忽略了机器人尺寸、障碍物质量、接触几何形状及作用力，从而生成物理上不可行的规划方案。PushAround是一种基于物理信息的混合搜索方法，将几何连通性推理与短时程仿真相结合，以构建可执行的清理计划。通过重复的W-清除连通图（WCCG）查询，可识别需加宽的边界缺口，并根据预估的下游成本对其进行排序。该搜索生成直接或递归的推移候选方案，选择障碍物、方向、接触点及作用力，并接受经物理评估的候选方案。数值实验验证了WCCG相对于标准连通性检查的有效性，并展示了其在更密集杂乱环境及最多四台机器人团队中的可扩展性，同时验证了对模拟执行侧物理参数失配的鲁棒性。
tldr: PushAround introduces a physics-informed hybrid search algorithm that couples connectivity graph reasoning with short-horizon simulation to enable mobile robot teams to clear traversable corridors for large vehicles among movable obstacles, producing physically executable plans.
tldr_zh: PushAround提出了一种物理信息混合搜索算法，将连接图推理与短时仿真相结合，使移动机器人团队能够清除大型车辆在可移动障碍物中的可行走廊，生成物理上可执行的计划。

title: DriveUniTok: A Unified Multimodal Tokenizer for Driving World-Action Models
summary: World models are emerging as a fundamental component of policy learning for real-world agents, enabling agents to predict future world states and plan actions within a learned representation of the dynamic environment. Existing approaches, however, often model appearance, metric geometry represented by projected LiDAR depth, and ego motion either partially or independently, overlooking the fact that these modalities are different projections of a shared underlying world state. This separation can lead to information loss and cross-modal inconsistency, ultimately limiting downstream performance. Motivated by this unified view of the world, we propose DriveUniTok, a unified multimodal tokenizer for driving world-action models (WAMs) that encodes these modalities in a single decodable continuous latent. We freeze DriveUniTok and adapt a pretrained diffusion model, DriveUniWAM, to predict future unified latents; the tokenizer then decodes them into future appearance, projected LiDAR depth, and ego trajectories. Experiments on NAVSIM demonstrate that our unified design achieves better future prediction and planning performance at lower downstream computational cost than separate-stream alternatives. With reinforcement learning post-training, DriveUniWAM achieves a PDMS of 91.54, reaching state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated WAM-based planners.
summary_zh: 世界模型正逐步成为真实世界智能体策略学习的基础组件，使智能体能够在动态环境的学习表示中预测未来世界状态并规划动作。然而，现有方法往往部分或独立地对表观、由投影LiDAR深度表示的度量几何以及自车运动进行建模，忽视了这些模态本质上是同一底层世界状态的不同投影这一事实。这种分离可能导致信息丢失和跨模态不一致性，最终限制下游任务的性能。受这一统一世界观的启发，我们提出了DriveUniTok，一种面向驾驶世界-动作模型（WAMs）的统一多模态分词器，能够在单一可解码的连续潜空间中编码这些模态。我们冻结DriveUniTok，并适配一个预训练的扩散模型DriveUniWAM，用于预测未来的统一潜表示；随后分词器将其解码为未来的表观、投影LiDAR深度和自车轨迹。在NAVSIM上的实验表明，与分离流方案相比，我们的统一设计在更低的下游计算成本下实现了更优的未来预测和规划性能。经过强化学习后训练，DriveUniWAM的PDMS达到91.54，在所评估的基于WAM的规划器中达到了最先进的性能水平。
tldr: DriveUniTok proposes a unified multimodal tokenizer that encodes appearance, projected LiDAR depth, and ego motion into a single continuous latent, which is then fed into a diffusion-based driving world-action model for future prediction and planning, achieving state-of-the-art PDMS on NAVSIM.
tldr_zh: DriveUniTok 提出了一种统一的多模态分词器，将外观、投影激光雷达深度和自车运动编码为单个连续潜变量，并输入扩散式驾驶世界动作模型进行未来预测和规划，在 NAVSIM 上取得了最先进的 PDMS 分数。

title: JevVLA: Jev-Inspired Energy-Based Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies can select among discrete candidates for pick-and-place manipulation or generate continuous action chunks for motion control. Improving both forms of decision making through a common mechanism while retaining the capabilities of a pretrained policy is an important adaptation problem. Inspired by Jev's structured, probabilistic decision interface, we propose JevVLA, a lightweight energy-based adaptation framework for VLA policies. JevVLA instantiates this inspiration by modeling the relative quality of action proposals: with the base policy frozen, it learns a differentiable scalar energy conditioned on observations, task context, and actions, using execution feedback, expert corrections, or demonstration-derived preferences. JevVLA uses this single learned action preference function in two ways: its values compare discrete candidates, while its action gradients correct continuous actions or guide their generation. Candidate selection and continuous control thus share one trainable decision core. Each benchmark uses independently trained weights and fixed input/output encodings, while retaining the same core network with approximately 80,000 trainable parameters. On the held-out test sets, JevVLA improves task success over the respective matched base-policy controls by 1.28, 2.31, 1.60, 1.52, and 1.28 percentage points on MetaWorld MT50, VIMA, LanguageTable, LIBERO Plus, and CLIPort, respectively. These results support the feasibility of a lightweight, Jev-inspired energy model for adapting both discrete action selection and continuous action guidance. The JevVLA implementation will be open-sourced at https://github.com/ZJU4EmbodiedAI/JevVLA.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略既可以在抓取放置操作中从离散候选中进行选择，也可以生成连续动作块用于运动控制。通过一种通用机制同时提升这两种决策形式，同时保持预训练策略的能力，是一个重要的适配问题。受Jev的结构化概率决策接口启发，我们提出JevVLA，一种面向VLA策略的轻量级基于能量的适配框架。JevVLA通过建模动作提议的相对质量来实现这一思想：在冻结基础策略的条件下，学习一个以观测、任务上下文和动作为条件的可微标量能量函数，利用执行反馈、专家修正或演示-derived偏好进行训练。JevVLA以两种方式使用这一学习到的动作偏好函数：其数值用于比较离散候选，而其动作梯度则用于修正连续动作或引导其生成。因此，候选选择与连续控制共享一个可训练决策核心。每个基准测试使用独立训练的权重和固定的输入/输出编码，同时保留相同的核心网络，其可训练参数约为80,000个。在留出测试集上，JevVLA相较于各自匹配的基础策略控制，在MetaWorld MT50、VIMA、LanguageTable、LIBERO Plus和CLIPort上的任务成功率分别提升了1.28、2.31、1.60、1.52和1.28个百分点。这些结果支持了一种受Jev启发的轻量级能量模型在适配离散动作选择与连续动作引导两方面的可行性。JevVLA的实现将开源至https://github.com/ZJU4EmbodiedAI/JevVLA。
tldr: JevVLA introduces a lightweight energy-based adaptation framework for VLA policies, using a single learned action preference function to improve both discrete action selection and continuous action generation across multiple benchmarks.
tldr_zh: JevVLA 提出了一种轻量级基于能量的适配框架，用于视觉-语言-动作策略，通过单一学习到的动作偏好函数在多个基准上改进离散动作选择和连续动作生成。

title: VLA-HWBench: Where the Time Goes When VLA Models Run on Edge Hardware
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly run on edge devices aboard robots, where inference latency constrains closed-loop robot control. However, it remains unclear how to design VLA models, their inference software and edge hardware so that robots can run VLA inference in real time. Most VLA models report only task success, while prior studies cover limited action-generation strategies, divide inference into at most three stages, and lack comparisons of inference optimizations on the same models. Therefore, we introduce VLA-HWBench, a benchmark that measures 18 open VLA models on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor and AMD Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 395, with a seven-stage inference breakdown. Our study reveals three insights. First, action-generation strategy matters more than model size. It dominates 14 of 19 Jetson configurations, latency varies by $82\times$ on Jetson and $157\times$ on AMD, and parameter count explains at most 15% of latency variance. Models that generate long action chunks in a few flow-matching steps keep up with control, whereas token-by-token decoding does not. Second, kernel fusion with 4-bit weights helps most, running $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.7 2.6-2.9$\times$ faster than PyTorch with torch.compile, but it exists for only these two models and only on the Jetson. Optimization also moves the time to the stages it shortens least, as CPU preprocessing grows from 12% to 39% of the GR00T N1.7 call. Third, after optimization, memory bandwidth limits only the stages that process few tokens on the Jetson, such as the denoising steps, whereas software limits all other stages, from unfused kernels to serial preprocessing on the host CPU. Overall, low-latency edge VLAs should use few action-generation iterations, inference software should extend kernel fusion and low-bit weights to more models and platforms, and edge hardware needs high memory bandwidth and a fast host CPU.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型日益部署于机器人端侧设备上，推理延迟制约着闭环机器人控制。然而，目前尚不清楚应如何设计VLA模型、其推理软件及端侧硬件，以使机器人能够实时运行VLA推理。大多数VLA模型仅报告任务成功率，而先前研究仅覆盖有限的动作生成策略，将推理过程最多划分为三个阶段，且缺乏在相同模型上对推理优化的比较。为此，我们提出VLA-HWBench基准，在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor和AMD Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 395上评测18个开源VLA模型，并采用七阶段推理分解。本研究揭示了三点洞见。首先，动作生成策略比模型规模更为关键。该策略在19种Jetson配置中的14种中占主导地位，延迟在Jetson上相差82倍，在AMD上相差157倍，而参数量最多仅能解释15%的延迟差异。通过少数几步流匹配生成大块动作的模型能够跟上控制节奏，而逐token解码则无法满足要求。其次，结合4比特权重的核融合优化效果最为显著，使π₀.₅和GR00T N1.7的运行速度比采用torch.compile的PyTorch快2.6–2.9倍，但该优化仅适用于这两个模型且仅限Jetson平台。优化还使时间转移到其缩短最少的阶段，CPU预处理在GR00T N1.7调用中的占比从12%上升至39%。第三，优化后，内存带宽仅限制Jetson上处理少量token的阶段（如去噪步骤），而软件限制则影响所有其他阶段，从未融合核到主机CPU上的串行预处理均不例外。总体而言，低延迟端侧VLA应采用较少的动作生成迭代次数，推理软件应将核融合和低位宽权重扩展到更多模型与平台，端侧硬件则需要高内存带宽和快速主机CPU。
tldr: This paper introduces VLA-HWBench, a benchmark for profiling 18 open VLA models on edge hardware with a seven-stage inference breakdown, revealing that action-generation strategy and kernel fusion with low-bit weights are more critical than model size for achieving real-time closed-loop control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了VLA-HWBench基准，该基准在边缘硬件上对18个开源VLA模型进行七阶段推理剖析，揭示了动作生成策略和内核融合与低比特权重比模型大小更能实现实时闭环控制。

title: Benchmarking Obstacle-Conditioned Safety in Household Robot Navigation
summary: Safe household navigation requires robots to regulate clearance and speed according to what an obstacle is and how close it is, without unnecessary conservatism. Yet existing evaluations do not test whether semantic safety distinctions are reflected in continuous motion. To that end, we introduce OSMA-Bench, an Obstacle-Conditioned Safe Motion Adaptation Benchmark built on spatially matched scenario sets that differ only in obstacle type. We also propose the \emph{Semantic Sensitivity Index} (SSI), which measures whether clearance and distance-dependent speed and smoothness follow the caution ordering of obstacles. Evaluating VLM-based and vision-language-action (VLA) policies on the benchmark, we find that neither consistently adapts its motion to obstacle safety, even with explicit safety prompts. Our analysis shows that the policies can correctly distinguish obstacles by safety relevance but fail to reflect this distinction in the motion parameters or actions they produce. For VLM-based policies, which recognize the obstacle and then generate a navigation program, adding an explicit parameter-inference step between these two stages improves adaptation. These findings expose a gap in \emph{semantic-to-motion grounding}, highlighting the need to translate semantic caution into appropriately safe motion.
summary_zh: 安全家庭导航要求机器人能够根据障碍物的类型及其距离来调节间距和速度，同时避免不必要的保守行为。然而，现有评估并未检验语义安全区分是否反映在连续运动之中。为此，我们提出了OSMA-Bench，一个基于仅在障碍物类型上有所不同的空间匹配场景集的障碍物条件化安全运动适配基准。我们还提出了语义敏感度指数，用于衡量间距、随距离变化的速度及平滑度是否遵循障碍物的谨慎程度排序。在该基准上评估基于视觉语言模型的策略和视觉-语言-动作策略后，我们发现，即使有明确的安全提示，两者均未能持续地根据障碍物安全性调整其运动。我们的分析表明，这些策略能够正确地区分障碍物的安全相关性，却未能在其生成的运动参数或动作中反映这种区分。对于基于视觉语言模型的策略——即先识别障碍物，再生成导航程序——在这两个阶段之间增加一个显式的参数推断步骤能够改善适配效果。这些发现揭示了语义到运动落地方面的空白，凸显了将语义谨慎转化为适当安全运动的必要性。
tldr: OSMA-Bench is a benchmark for obstacle-conditioned safe household robot navigation, with the Semantic Sensitivity Index (SSI) to measure whether VLM/VLA policies adapt motion to obstacle type. Findings show these policies fail to ground semantic caution into motion parameters, but an explicit parameter-inference step helps.
tldr_zh: OSMA-Bench 是一个用于家庭机器人导航中障碍物条件安全性的基准，并提出了语义敏感性指数（SSI）来衡量视觉语言模型/视觉语言行动模型策略是否根据障碍物类型调整运动。结果表明这些策略未能将语义谨慎落实到运动参数中，而显式参数推断步骤有所改善。

title: Video World Models Need Predictable Latents
summary: Video world models trained on large-scale robot data promise a safe and scalable approach for learning and evaluating policies that act in the physical world. However, they still struggle with long-horizon rollouts and out-of-distribution generalization, and they remain computationally demanding at inference time. Typically, video world models make predictions in the latent space of a reconstruction-trained autoencoder, which however is not directly optimized for dynamics modeling. On the other hand, world models designed for latent planning usually optimize latents to be predictable, but they forgo accurate prediction of observations in pixel space. In this paper, we show that it is possible to achieve the best of both worlds: a latent geometry optimized to make future prediction as simple as possible without sacrificing accurate prediction of future observations. More precisely, we find that temporal objectives for representation learning, paired with a past-conditioned decoder architecture, lead to consistent improvements in generative video world models at the same training budget. The gains include up to 5x cheaper inference, over 7x faster training, and 15-24% lower pixel and perceptual errors out of distribution and over long horizons. Our world models also agree more closely with real-world policy evaluation when using a vision-language model to judge task success from their pixel-space predictions. Overall, our study indicates that temporal predictability is an important design criterion for the latent space of video world models, and provides concrete guidance on how to incorporate it into the training of autoencoders.
summary_zh: 视频世界模型在大型机器人数据上进行训练，为学习和评估在物理世界中行动的策略提供了一种安全且可扩展的方法。然而，这些模型在长时间跨度的推演和分布外泛化方面仍存在困难，并且在推理时计算需求较高。通常，视频世界模型在基于重建训练的自编码器的潜空间中进行预测，但该潜空间并未直接针对动态建模进行优化。另一方面，为潜在规划而设计的世界模型通常优化潜变量以实现可预测性，但它们牺牲了对像素空间中观测值的准确预测。在本文中，我们展示了实现两全其美的可能性：一种潜几何结构，在使未来预测尽可能简单的同时，不牺牲对未来观测值的准确预测。更具体地，我们发现，表征学习的时间目标与基于过去条件的解码器架构相结合，能够在相同训练预算下带来生成式视频世界模型的一致性改进。这些改进包括推理成本降低多达5倍，训练速度提升超过7倍，以及在分布外和长时间跨度场景下像素误差和感知误差降低15-24%。当使用视觉-语言模型从其像素空间预测中判断任务成功与否时，我们的世界模型也与真实世界的策略评估更为一致。总体而言，我们的研究表明，时间可预测性是视频世界模型潜空间的一个重要设计准则，并为如何将其纳入自编码器训练提供了具体指导。
tldr: This paper improves video world models for robot data by optimizing the latent space for temporal predictability, achieving faster training/inference and better long-horizon, out-of-distribution predictions while maintaining pixel-space accuracy.
tldr_zh: 本文通过优化潜在空间的时间可预测性来改进机器人数据的视频世界模型，在保持像素空间精度的同时，实现了更快的训练/推理和更好的长时程、分布外预测。

title: Dream to Assist: Intent-Conditioned World Models for Shared Vehicle Control
summary: Assistive agents in shared-control settings face a dual challenge: acting proactively to align with the human's intentions while remaining legible enough for the human to comprehend and fluently respond in real time. We present Dream2Assist, a model-based reinforcement learning framework for tightly-coupled shared decision making that addresses both sides of this challenge. Our approach extends a recurrent state-space world model with intent inference, enabling an assistive policy trained via fictitious co-play to anticipate and support discrete human objectives without overriding human agency. Beyond the computational framework, we describe the full deployment pipeline needed to translate a world-model-based policy into a safe, human-centered system in a resource-efficient way. Crucially, we address the sim-to-real-human gap via policy down-selection and reward restructuring within an iterative human-machine interface design. We validate the framework through three human-subjects studies and a preliminary on-vehicle deployment spanning two qualitatively distinct domains: high-speed racing (N=30) and urban driving with richer intent structure (N=10). Our results demonstrate that intent conditioning yields measurable improvements in torque alignment and collision rate. We surface key design insights and practices for deploying learning-based assistive agents in safety-critical, real-time human-robot teaming.
summary_zh: 共享控制场景中的辅助智能体面临双重挑战：既要主动行动以契合人类的意图，又要保持足够的可读性，使人类能够理解并实时流畅地作出反应。我们提出了Dream2Assist，一种基于模型的强化学习框架，用于紧耦合的共享决策，同时应对这一挑战的两个方面。我们的方法将意图推断扩展至循环状态空间世界模型，使得通过虚拟共玩训练的辅助策略能够预测并支持离散的人类目标，而不会剥夺人类的主体性。在计算框架之外，我们还描述了将基于世界模型的策略转化为安全、以人为本系统所需的完整部署流程，并以资源高效的方式实现。关键在于，我们通过策略筛选和奖励重构，在迭代式人机界面设计中弥合了仿真与真实人类之间的差距。我们通过三项人类受试者研究和一项初步的实车部署验证了该框架，涵盖两个性质不同的领域：高速竞速（N=30）和意图结构更丰富的城市驾驶（N=10）。结果表明，意图条件化在扭矩对齐和碰撞率方面带来了可量化的改进。我们总结了在安全关键、实时人机协作中部署基于学习的辅助智能体的关键设计洞见与实践经验。
tldr: Dream2Assist introduces an intent-conditioned world model and model-based RL framework for shared vehicle control, validated in human-subject studies and on-vehicle deployment in racing and urban driving.
tldr_zh: Dream2Assist 提出了一种意图条件世界模型和基于模型的强化学习框架，用于共享车辆控制，并通过人类受试者研究和实车部署在赛车和城市驾驶中得到验证。

title: RobotAgentBench: Towards Open-world Robot Autonomy
summary: Recent advances in vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) have significantly improved robotic manipulation, yet deploying robots in the open world demands a higher level of autonomy beyond executing predefined tasks. Robot agents offer a promising paradigm for this transition, integrating task discovery, contextual reasoning, physical execution, and adaptive recovery into a closed interaction loop. However, existing benchmarks largely evaluate isolated capabilities, failing to capture the complexity of open-world robot autonomy. We introduce RobotAgentBench (RAB), a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating robot agents in realistic, open-world household environments. Through an agent-assisted, human-in-the-loop real-to-sim pipeline, RAB constructs 50 diverse household layouts with interactive objects and physically grounded tasks, encompassing 90 atomic tasks, 18 short-horizon tasks, 8 long-horizon tasks, and 4 open-ended scenarios. RAB provides a multi-level evaluation of robot agent capabilities: (1) task-level assessments systematically examine five complementary dimensions: task discovery, context reasoning, manipulation, failure recovery, and robustness; (2) scenario-level evaluation assesses how agents integrate these capabilities to autonomously fulfill high-level user needs. Furthermore, RAB enables systematic comparisons of standalone VLA/WAM models and diverse robot agent architectures under a unified planning-execution-verification framework. Extensive experiments reveal substantial gaps between manipulation and autonomy, demonstrate the advantages of agentic architectures and recursive self-improvement, and highlight the remaining challenges toward open-world robot autonomy.
summary_zh: 近期，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型及世界-动作模型（WAMs）的进展显著提升了机器人操作能力，然而在开放世界中部署机器人，要求其具备超越既定任务执行层面的更高自主性。机器人智能体为此转变提供了一种富有前景的范式，它将任务发现、情境推理、物理执行与自适应恢复整合为一个闭环交互流程。但现有基准大多仅评估孤立能力，未能捕捉开放世界机器人自主性的复杂性。为此，我们提出了RobotAgentBench（RAB），一个用于在逼真的开放世界家庭环境中评估机器人智能体的综合基准。通过一种智能体辅助、人在回路的“真实到仿真”流水线，RAB构建了50个多样化的家庭布局，包含可交互物体及物理可行的任务，涵盖90个原子任务、18个短时程任务、8个长时程任务及4个开放式场景。RAB提供对机器人智能体能力的多层级评估：（1）任务级评估系统性地考察五个互补维度：任务发现、情境推理、操作、故障恢复与鲁棒性；（2）场景级评估则考察智能体如何整合这些能力，自主满足高层用户需求。此外，RAB支持在统一的“规划-执行-验证”框架下，对独立的VLA/WAM模型及多种机器人智能体架构进行系统性比较。大量实验揭示出操作能力与自主性之间的显著差距，验证了智能体架构及递归式自我改进的优势，并凸显了实现开放世界机器人自主性所面临的剩余挑战。
tldr: RobotAgentBench introduces a benchmark for evaluating robot agents in open-world household environments, assessing capabilities like task discovery, reasoning, manipulation, and recovery beyond isolated task performance.
tldr_zh: RobotAgentBench 提出了一个用于评估开放世界家庭环境中机器人智能体的基准，超越了孤立任务性能，综合评估任务发现、推理、操作和恢复等能力。

title: How High Can GPT-6 Astra Climb in Contact-Rich Manipulation? PhysLadder: A Hierarchical, Matched Sim-Real Benchmark for Physical Interaction
summary: We introduce PhysLadder, a hierarchical Sim-Real benchmark for evaluating physical interaction capabilities in contact-rich manipulation. Its 16 household tasks span three cumulative levels: contact selection and geometric alignment (L1), force regulation within sustained contact (L2), and coordinated contact reconfiguration and force regulation (L3). Each task is instantiated in physically and visually matched simulated and real-world environments, with shared task definitions and success criteria. We evaluate GPT-6 Astra zero-shot with three trials per task in each environment. Real-world success rates decline from 80.0% at L1 to 47.6% at L2 and 0.0% at L3, with corresponding simulation rates of 66.7%, 47.6%, and 0.0%. Ten of the 16 tasks have identical success counts across environments; the remaining six differ by one success out of three trials. Across both environments, recurring difficulties in spatial reasoning, contact selection, force regulation, and coordination often prevent local physical progress from accumulating into task completion. These findings characterize Astra's observed capability boundary across increasing interaction demands and, for this model, support matched simulation as a repeatable, scalable testbed for studying the sustained, coordinated physical interactions that limit reliable manipulation.
summary_zh: 我们提出了PhysLadder，一个用于评估接触丰富操作中物理交互能力的分层模拟-真实基准。其包含的16项家务任务跨越三个递进层级：接触选择与几何对齐（L1）、持续接触中的力调节（L2），以及协调的接触重构与力调节（L3）。每项任务均在物理和视觉上匹配的模拟环境与真实世界环境中实例化，并共享相同的任务定义和成功标准。我们在每个环境中对GPT-6 Astra进行零样本评估，每项任务执行三次试验。真实世界成功率从L1的80.0%下降至L2的47.6%，再到L3的0.0%；对应的模拟环境成功率分别为66.7%、47.6%和0.0%。16项任务中，有10项在两种环境下的成功次数完全一致；其余6项在三次试验中仅相差一次成功。在两种环境中，空间推理、接触选择、力调节和协调方面的反复出现的困难，常常阻碍局部物理进展累积为任务完成。这些发现刻画了Astra在不断增加交互需求下的可观察能力边界，并且对于该模型而言，支持了匹配模拟作为可重复、可扩展的测试平台，用于研究限制可靠操作能力的持续、协调物理交互。
tldr: PhysLadder introduces a hierarchical sim-real benchmark with 16 contact-rich manipulation tasks to evaluate GPT-6 Astra's physical interaction capabilities, finding that performance degrades sharply with task complexity (from 80% to 0% on real robots) and that matched simulation is a reliable predictor.
tldr_zh: PhysLadder 提出了一个包含 16 个接触丰富操作任务的分层 sim-real 基准，评估 GPT-6 Astra 的物理交互能力，发现其性能随任务复杂度急剧下降（从真实机器人上的 80% 降至 0%），并证明匹配仿真可作为可靠的预测工具。

title: TRIAGE: Efficient Vision-Language-Action Inference Needs Both Reuse and Pruning
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are increasingly used for robot manipulation because they map camera images and a language instruction directly to actions. Robots that cannot be tethered to a workstation, such as mobile manipulators and humanoids, must run them on onboard embedded boards, where the prefill latency of the language backbone grows with the hundreds of visual tokens processed at every control step. To meet real-time limits, training-free accelerators recompute only a subset of the visual tokens and skip the rest, either by pruning them or by reusing their cached key-value (KV) states. The two options save nearly the same computation, yet existing methods apply only one of them to every skipped token. Through a token-level diagnostic, we show that which option keeps the action closer to full recomputation depends on the token's drift, the change in its shallow-layer value since its cache was computed. On both backbones tested, reusing tokens below a drift threshold was no worse than pruning them, whereas beyond it, reuse yields up to 4.4x the action error of pruning; the same diagnostic calibrates this threshold per backbone. Building on this finding, we propose TRIAGE, which deems a cache valid when its drift is below this threshold and it is not too old. TRIAGE recomputes a fixed budget of tokens, prioritizing important tokens with invalid caches, reuses every other token with a valid cache, and prunes the rest; prune-only and reuse-only methods are the two extremes of this partition. Because the budget fixes the number of recomputed tokens, it directly sets the prefill latency. On LIBERO and SimplerEnv, TRIAGE stays within 3 pp of full recomputation in average success rate while cutting prefill latency on a Jetson AGX Orin by up to 48%, and with only 7% of visual tokens recomputed, it beats the strongest baseline by 24.4 pp on LIBERO-Object.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型日益广泛地应用于机器人操作任务，因为它们能够直接将摄像头图像和语言指令映射为动作。对于无法连接至工作站的机器人，如移动操作平台和人形机器人，这些模型必须在板载嵌入式设备上运行，而语言骨干网络的预填充延迟会随着每个控制步骤中处理的数百个视觉令牌数量增长而增加。为满足实时性要求，无训练加速方法仅重新计算部分视觉令牌并跳过其余令牌，具体方式要么是剪枝，要么是复用其缓存的键值（KV）状态。这两种方式节省的计算量几乎相同，但现有方法对每个被跳过的令牌仅采用其中一种策略。通过令牌级诊断，我们发现哪种方式能使动作更接近完全重计算，取决于令牌的漂移量，即自其缓存计算以来浅层值的变化程度。在测试的两个骨干网络上，对于低于漂移阈值的令牌，复用并不逊色于剪枝；而超过该阈值时，复用产生的动作误差最高可达剪枝的4.4倍；该诊断可为每个骨干网络校准此阈值。基于这一发现，我们提出TRIAGE方法，该方法在缓存的漂移低于阈值且缓存不过于陈旧时，判定该缓存有效。TRIAGE重新计算固定预算的令牌，优先处理缓存无效且重要的令牌，复用所有缓存有效的其余令牌，并剪枝剩余令牌；仅剪枝和仅复用方法分别是该划分的两个极端。由于预算固定了重新计算的令牌数量，因此直接确定了预填充延迟。在LIBERO和SimplerEnv基准上，TRIAGE的平均成功率与完全重计算相差在3个百分点以内，同时在Jetson AGX Orin上将预填充延迟降低高达48%；仅重新计算7%的视觉令牌时，TRIAGE在LIBERO-Object上比最强基线高出24.4个百分点。
tldr: TRIAGE is a training-free inference accelerator for VLA models that selectively recomputes, reuses, or prunes visual tokens based on a drift threshold, reducing prefill latency on edge devices while maintaining task success.
tldr_zh: TRIAGE 是一种无需训练的VLA模型推理加速方法，通过基于漂移阈值选择性重算、复用或剪枝视觉令牌，在边缘设备上降低预填充延迟并保持任务成功率。

title: Beyond Behaviour: A Stimulus-Response Safety Evaluation of Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Humans exhibit biological sensitivity to safety-critical stimuli that can trigger defensive action. Across three models and two video benchmarks, we investigate whether similar responses emerge in vision-language-action models by examining their internal representations and action tendencies in response to visible hazards and harmful consequences. Our findings suggest that task execution may remain the default response even when danger is internally registered.
summary_zh: 人类对可能触发防御性动作的安全关键刺激表现出生物敏感性。通过三个模型和两个视频基准，我们考察了视觉-语言-动作模型在面临可见危险及有害后果时，其内部表征和动作倾向是否会出现类似反应。研究结果表明，即便危险已在内部被识别，任务执行仍可能是模型的默认响应。
tldr: This paper evaluates whether vision-language-action models exhibit defensive responses to safety-critical stimuli in their internal representations and action tendencies across three models and two video benchmarks, finding that task execution remains the default response even when danger is internally registered.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了视觉-语言-动作模型在内部表征和动作倾向中是否对安全关键刺激产生防御性反应，在三个模型和两个视频基准上发现即使内部注册到危险，任务执行仍是默认反应。

title: OmniBrain-0: A Unified Agentic Model for Embodied Intelligence
summary: General-purpose embodied intelligence requires robots to coordinate diverse skills over long horizons, track task progress, and recover from failures. Specialist policies alone do not ensure task-level reliability, while powerful multimodal agents rely on costly reasoning and external experience that compact models struggle to reproduce. We introduce OmniBrain-0, a lightweight unified embodied agent that coordinates manipulation and navigation through a shared high-level decision model, integrating task understanding, planning, progress tracking, and feedback-driven recovery. Our progressive training framework combines embodied pretraining, domain-specialized agent distillation, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). It distills powerful teachers' interaction experience into manipulation and navigation experts, then consolidates their decision capabilities into OmniBrain-0. Unification therefore occurs within the learned decision model rather than only at the tool interface. We further introduce Rubric-Guided Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI), a data flywheel in which a Meta-Agent turns execution evidence into refined rubrics, step-level reminders, and verified trajectories for domain-expert updates before their reconsolidation into OmniBrain-0 through MOPD. We evaluate OmniBrain-0 on LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-Plus, RoboCasa365, RoboTwin 2.0, and R2R-CE Val-Unseen, as well as multiple real-world manipulation tasks. OmniBrain-0 combines strong cross-domain task performance with substantially lower inference and execution overhead than its closed-source teacher, demonstrating efficient transfer and consolidation of embodied capabilities into a compact unified agent.
summary_zh: 通用具身智能要求机器人在长时间跨度内协调多种技能、跟踪任务进度并实现故障恢复。单一专用策略无法确保任务层面的可靠性，而强大的多模态智能体则依赖于高昂的推理成本和外部经验，紧凑模型难以复现这些能力。我们提出OmniBrain-0，一种轻量级统一具身智能体，通过共享的高层决策模型协调操作与导航，并整合任务理解、规划、进度跟踪和基于反馈的恢复机制。我们的渐进式训练框架结合了具身预训练、领域专用智能体蒸馏以及多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）。该框架将强大教师模型的交互经验蒸馏至操作与导航专家模型中，随后将其决策能力整合进OmniBrain-0。因此，统一性体现在学习到的决策模型内部，而非仅仅停留在工具接口层面。我们进一步提出基于评分准则的递归自改进方法（RSI），这是一种数据飞轮机制，元智能体将执行证据转化为精细化评分准则、逐步提示和经过验证的轨迹，用于领域专家模型的更新，随后通过MOPD将其重新整合进OmniBrain-0。我们在LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-Plus、RoboCasa365、RoboTwin 2.0和R2R-CE Val-Unseen以及多项真实世界操作任务上对OmniBrain-0进行了评估。OmniBrain-0在实现强跨领域任务性能的同时，推理和执行开销较闭源教师模型显著降低，展示了将具身能力高效迁移和整合至紧凑统一智能体的有效性。
tldr: OmniBrain-0 is a lightweight unified embodied agent that integrates manipulation and navigation through a shared decision model, trained via progressive distillation and a rubric-guided self-improvement loop, achieving strong cross-domain performance with low overhead.
tldr_zh: OmniBrain-0 是一种轻量级统一具身智能体，通过共享决策模型整合操作与导航，利用渐进式蒸馏和规则引导的自我改进循环，以低开销实现跨域高性能。

title: WorldPager: Zero-Stall Tiered Memory for Long-Horizon World Models on a Single Consumer GPU
summary: Interactive world models keep the KV of past chunks as retrieval memory so that revisited places stay consistent. On a single consumer machine (one RTX 4090, 32 GiB of host memory, one NVMe SSD), long sessions with such memory hit two walls. The first is capacity: the KV of Matrix-Game 2.0 exhausts host memory after 45 seconds of video in bf16 and after 2.8 minutes in int4. The second is the model's positional horizon of 4.3 minutes. We show that this memory is capacity-bound rather than bandwidth-bound and that its access set is known before compute, because the camera pose is an input. An analytical model built on these observations predicts spill points to within one chunk and classifies zero versus non-zero stalls correctly on held-out configurations. Guided by it, WorldPager stores int4 KV in a GPU/DRAM/NVMe hierarchy instead of recomputing it, prefetches each chunk's memory from the extrapolated pose, never waits on a miss, and writes back in the background; to our knowledge, it is the first to place the KV memory of an interactive world model on an NVMe tier with zero-stall prefetching. With training-free position handling, it generates 37.5 minutes of video continuously with zero stalls and constant host memory, at about 9.5 frames per second. On a sealed test set, int4 storage shows no measurable quality loss; on long-gap revisits it lowers image quality by about one MUSIQ point.
summary_zh: 交互式世界模型将过去数据块的关键值（KV）作为检索记忆保存，从而使重访场景保持一致。在单台消费级机器（一块RTX 4090、32 GiB主机内存、一块NVMe固态硬盘）上，使用此类记忆的长时间会话会遭遇两大瓶颈。第一是容量问题：在bf16精度下，Matrix-Game 2.0的KV数据在45秒视频后即耗尽主机内存，而在int4精度下为2.8分钟。第二是模型的时间视野限制，仅为4.3分钟。我们表明，该记忆受容量限制而非带宽限制，且其访问集合在计算之前即可预知，因为相机位姿是输入项。基于这些观察构建的分析模型能够将一个数据块内的溢出点预测误差控制在一个块以内，并在保留配置上正确区分零停顿与非零停顿。在该模型的指导下，WorldPager将int4 KV存储于GPU/DRAM/NVMe分层结构中而非重新计算，根据外推位姿预取每个数据块的记忆，从不因未命中而等待，并在后台写回；据我们所知，这是首个将交互式世界模型的KV记忆置于NVMe层级并实现零停顿预取的方案。凭借无需训练的位置处理，它能够以约每秒9.5帧的速度持续生成37.5分钟的视频，全程零停顿且主机内存占用恒定。在封闭测试集上，int4存储未显示可测量的质量损失；在长间隔重访场景中，图像质量下降约一个MUSIQ评分点。
tldr: The paper presents WorldPager, a tiered GPU/DRAM/NVMe memory management system with pose-based prefetching that enables zero-stall long-horizon interactive world model generation on a single consumer GPU, demonstrating 37.5 minutes of continuous video at 9.5 FPS without stalls.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了WorldPager，一种基于GPU/DRAM/NVMe分层内存管理及位姿预取的系统，可在单张消费级GPU上实现无卡顿的长时间交互世界模型生成，连续生成37.5分钟视频。

title: MemVLN: Streaming Episodic Memory for Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-language navigation (VLN) requires an embodied agent to follow language instructions through 3D environments. Maintaining persistent episodic memory remains a challenge for VLM-based streaming agents in long-horizon navigation. We present MEMVLN, a streaming episodic memory framework that maintains a bounded bank of compressed perceptual features annotated with timesteps and action-derived relative poses, and produces compact memory tokens via cross-attention. We pair the proposed memory with a frozen pretrained geometry encoder. To learn the memory module, we design a masking-based trajectory summarization task with multi-granularity sub-trajectory decomposition, encouraging route reconstruction exclusively from episodic memory. Under navigation training restricted to the official R2R/RxR trajectories, MEMVLN achieves state-of-the-art performance on most reported metrics on standard VLN-CE benchmarks. Long-horizon analyses further characterize when episodic memory is useful. For physical evaluation, we collect 30 instruction-conditioned episodes in one physical scene, use 24 as demonstrations for post-training, and hold out six for testing. On the held-out episodes, MEMVLN improves success over the VLM baseline from 17% to 40%, and post-training further raises it to 47%.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言导航（VLN）要求具身智能体通过三维环境遵循语言指令。在长时程导航中，基于VLM的流式智能体维持持久的 episodic 记忆仍是一项挑战。我们提出 MEMVLN，一种流式 episodic 记忆框架，该框架维护一个有界的压缩感知特征库，并标注时间步及由动作推导的相对位姿，通过交叉注意力生成紧凑的记忆令牌。我们将所提出的记忆模块与冻结的预训练几何编码器配对。为学习该记忆模块，我们设计了一种基于掩码的轨迹摘要任务，并采用多粒度子轨迹分解，从而仅依赖 episodic 记忆鼓励路径重建。在仅使用官方 R2R/RxR 轨迹进行导航训练的条件下，MEMVLN 在标准 VLN-CE 基准的大多数报告指标上取得了最优性能。长时程分析进一步刻画了 episodic 记忆在何种情况下发挥作用。为进行物理环境评估，我们在一个物理场景中收集了30个指令条件下的 episode，其中24个用于后训练演示，6个用于测试。在保留的测试 episode 上，MEMVLN 将成功率从 VLM 基线的17%提升至40%，后训练进一步将其提升至47%。
tldr: MemVLN introduces a streaming episodic memory module for VLM-based vision-language navigation agents, enabling state-of-the-art performance on VLN-CE benchmarks and improved real-world success rates through post-training on physical episodes.
tldr_zh: MemVLN 为基于 VLM 的视觉语言导航代理引入了流式情节记忆模块，在 VLN-CE 基准上实现了最先进的性能，并通过物理场景的后训练提高了实际成功率。

title: Nonprehensile Robotic Catching Using Virtual Constraints
summary: The problem of nonprehensile robotic catching is addressed using virtual nonholonomic constraints (VNHCs); the motion of the robot end-effector is designed and controlled directly in terms of the states of the object before it is caught on the surface of the end-effector. In contrast to contemporary approaches, our approach avoids the need for object trajectory prediction, and consequent time-varying robot trajectory generation. With a focus on the planar case, we demonstrate that our VNHC approach can be used to catch an object on an end-effector at a desired height, with minimal relative normal velocity at the contact instant. Moreover, the VNHC function depends only on the desired catching height, and the same VNHC can be used for a range of initial conditions. We use model predictive control (MPC) to bring the object and end-effector to rest at a desired location after contact is made. The approach is validated in simulation.
summary_zh: 针对非抓取式机器人捕获问题，本文采用虚拟非完整约束（VNHCs）方法加以解决；在物体尚未接触末端执行器表面之前，机器人末端执行器的运动被直接设计并控制为以物体状态为变量的函数。与现有方法相比，本文方法无需对物体轨迹进行预测，亦无需随之生成时变的机器人轨迹。本文聚焦平面情形，证明所提出的VNHC方法能够在期望高度处实现物体在末端执行器上的捕获，并在接触瞬间使相对法向速度最小化。此外，VNHC函数仅依赖于期望捕获高度，同一VNHC可用于多种初始条件。本文采用模型预测控制（MPC）在接触建立后使物体与末端执行器在期望位置处静止。所提方法已在仿真中得到验证。
tldr: This paper presents a virtual nonholonomic constraints (VNHC) approach for nonprehensile robotic catching, avoiding object trajectory prediction by controlling the end-effector directly in terms of object states, with MPC to bring the system to rest, validated in simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于虚拟非完整约束（VNHC）的非抓取式机器人接物方法，通过直接基于物体状态控制末端执行器，避免物体轨迹预测，并利用MPC使系统静止，仿真验证。

title: Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Using Routed Ensembles and Trajectory Attribution
summary: Multi-objective reinforcement learning is a fundamental problem for modern AI, with applications spanning post-training, reasoning models, and robotic control. A central challenge is to learn policies that balance competing objectives, such as helpfulness versus honesty in safety and alignment, or speed versus energy in robotics. The optimal policy can vary sharply with objective-weighting combinations, and the extent of this variation depends crucially on the degree of conflict among objectives, making per-preference policy learning sample-inefficient. In this paper, we introduce objective-conflict coefficients and derive near-optimal regret bounds for online settings using this measure, thereby quantifying the impact of misalignment on learning efficiency. Then, we design routed ensemble policy learning, an algorithm that maintains a small set of basis policies and dynamically routes trajectories to the policy with the highest potential reward. Finally, we consider trajectory selection as another approach to mitigate objective conflict, and design a kernel surrogate trajectory attribution algorithm that estimates how feedback signals from a set of trajectories influence policy learning on other trajectories. The kernel can capture nonlinear interactions such as synergy and antagonism between trajectories. We evaluate our approach across diverse environments and benchmarks: routed ensembles improve average performance by 4.3% over baselines for online environments from Meta-World and MO-Gymnasium, and kernel surrogate attribution improves correlation with leave-one-out analysis over existing baselines by 50%. When applied to trajectory selection, kernel-based attribution yields a 27% improvement in reward over baseline attribution methods.
