summary_zh: 多目标强化学习是现代人工智能中的一个基本问题，其应用涵盖后训练、推理模型和机器人控制等多个领域。核心挑战在于学习能够平衡相互竞争目标的策略，例如安全与对齐中的有用性与诚实性之间的权衡，或机器人领域中速度与能耗之间的权衡。最优策略会随着目标权重组合的变化而显著改变，而这种变化的程度主要取决于目标之间的冲突程度，这使得针对特定偏好的策略学习在样本效率上表现不佳。在本文中，我们引入了目标冲突系数，并利用该度量推导了在线设置下的近最优遗憾界，从而量化了目标失调对学习效率的影响。随后，我们设计了路由集成策略学习方法，该算法维护一组少量基策略，并动态地将轨迹路由至具有最高潜在奖励的策略。最后，我们将轨迹选择视为缓解目标冲突的另一种途径，并设计了一种核替代轨迹归因算法，用于估计一组轨迹的反馈信号如何影响其他轨迹上的策略学习。该核能够捕获轨迹之间的非线性交互作用，如协同效应和拮抗效应。我们在多种环境和基准上评估了所提方法：在来自Meta-World和MO-Gymnasium的在线环境中，路由集成相比基线方法平均性能提升了4.3%；核替代归因在留一法分析中的相关性相比现有基线提升了50%。当应用于轨迹选择时，基于核的归因方法相比基线归因方法在奖励上实现了27%的提升。
tldr: This paper introduces objective-conflict coefficients and routed ensemble policy learning for multi-objective RL, which maintains basis policies and dynamically routes trajectories, plus a kernel surrogate trajectory attribution method for trajectory selection. It demonstrates improved rewards across Meta-World and MO-Gymnasium benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出目标冲突系数和基于路由集成策略学习的多目标强化学习方法，通过维护一组基础策略并动态分配轨迹，以及基于核函数的轨迹归因方法进行轨迹选择，在Meta-World和MO-Gymnasium基准上取得了奖励提升。

title: SPECOLA: A Tool for Specification Driven Robot Evaluation
summary: Simulation benchmarks are a useful way to measure progress in robotics; typically they provide success rate as the dominant measure of performance. However, success rate reports only whether a rollout completed the task, hiding by what margin it succeeded, how sensitive the success is to goal parameter changes, requirements it may have violated, and whether success persisted. Signal Temporal Logic (STL) provides a formal language for capturing specifications; it can be used to define requirements, and measure how close a robot behavior is to satisfying or violating them. Using STL monitors in a simulator, however, requires exposing simulator state and mapping it to specification-relevant signals. We present Specola, a tool for evaluating robot behaviors in simulation with respect to STL specifications. Specola provides an interface for writing specifications over simulator signals, and creates and manages the relevant monitors while a policy executes. We provide a Python API and command-line interface for integrating monitoring into existing policy execution loops. We provide an adapter interface for connecting new simulators, and provide adapters for nine simulation environments and benchmarks, including LIBERO, RoboCasa, Isaac Lab, and RoboDojo. We provide case studies that illustrate the nuanced evaluation that Specola enables. Code and adapters are available at https://github.com/specola-eval/specola.
summary_zh: 模拟基准测试是衡量机器人技术进展的有效方式；通常，它们将成功率作为性能的主要衡量指标。然而，成功率仅报告了 rollout 是否完成了任务，而隐藏了其成功的余量、成功对目标参数变化的敏感度、可能违反的要求以及成功是否持续。信号时序逻辑（STL）提供了一种用于捕获规格的形式化语言；它可用于定义要求，并衡量机器人行为在多大程度上满足或违反这些要求。然而，在模拟器中使用 STL 监视器需要暴露模拟器状态并将其映射到与规格相关的信号。我们提出了 Specola，一种在模拟中根据 STL 规格评估机器人行为的工具。Specola 提供了一种在模拟器信号上编写规格的接口，并在策略执行期间创建和管理相关监视器。我们提供了 Python API 和命令行界面，用于将监控集成到现有的策略执行循环中。我们提供了一个适配器接口用于连接新的模拟器，并为九个模拟环境和基准测试提供了适配器，包括 LIBERO、RoboCasa、Isaac Lab 和 RoboDojo。我们提供的案例研究展示了 Specola 所实现的细致评估。代码和适配器可在 https://github.com/specola-eval/specola 获取。
tldr: Specola is a tool that enables specification-driven evaluation of robot behaviors in simulation using Signal Temporal Logic (STL), providing interfaces for writing specifications, managing monitors, and adapting multiple simulation environments.
tldr_zh: Specola 是一个工具，利用信号时序逻辑 (STL) 在仿真中实现基于规范的机器人行为评估，提供编写规范、管理监视器以及适配多种仿真环境的接口。

title: TrySee: Modular Perception-Enhanced VLM Grounding for Closed-Loop Robot Task Planning in Specialized Domains
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown impressive capabilities in high-level reasoning and task planning for robots. However, specialized domains remain a challenge for VLMs' image interpretation and grounding abilities. We introduce TrySee, a modular closed-loop robot task planning pipeline integrating general-purpose VLM reasoning with domain-specific perception and established robotics components. The system consists of an inherently reactive cyclic planning pipeline, augmented with domain-specific modular vision preprocessing, to provide online grounding. Finally, a dynamic preprocessing selection mechanism contributes to the scalability of the pipeline. The system requires neither VLM fine-tuning nor end-to-end demonstrations and adapts through replaceable perception modules and motion planning. The approach is evaluated on planning tasks across 5 widely different domains, including a real-world robot disassembly task. The field tests in a brownfield environment demonstrate the approach's practicality in integrating VLM planning into specialized robotic systems with limited domain-specific training data.
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在高层次推理和机器人任务规划方面展现出了显著能力。然而，在专业领域，VLMs的图像解读和基础定位能力仍面临挑战。我们提出了TrySee，一种模块化闭环机器人任务规划流水线，将通用VLM推理与领域特定感知及成熟机器人组件相结合。该系统包含一个固有响应式的循环规划流水线，并辅以领域特定的模块化视觉预处理，以提供在线基础定位支持。最后，动态预处理选择机制增强了流水线的可扩展性。该系统无需VLM微调或端到端演示，可通过可替换的感知模块和运动规划进行适配。该方法在5个差异显著的领域中的规划任务上进行了评估，包括一项真实世界的机器人拆解任务。在棕地环境中的现场测试证明，该方法在将VLM规划集成到专业机器人系统且领域特定训练数据有限的情况下具有实用性。
tldr: TrySee presents a modular closed-loop robot task planning pipeline that enhances general-purpose VLMs with domain-specific perception modules and dynamic preprocessing selection, enabling grounding for specialized robotic tasks without fine-tuning, validated across 5 domains including real-world disassembly.
tldr_zh: TrySee 提出了一种模块化的闭环机器人任务规划流水线，通过领域专用感知模块和动态预处理选择增强通用 VLM 的接地能力，无需微调即可适应专业领域任务，并在 5 个领域包括真实拆解任务中进行了验证。

title: FISRF: Flexible Instructional Scaffolding Reflection Framework for Robotics Task Planning with Large Language Model
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely adopted for reflective error correction in task planning; however, existing approaches primarily rely on autonomous exploration, rendering them prone to accumulating erroneous experiences during early interactions with new environments. To address this limitation, we propose the Flexible Instructional Scaffolding Reflection Framework (FISRF), an agent--mentor architecture that estimates the robot's Zone of Proximal Development (ZPD) in task planning and adaptively selects reflection strategies and mentor guidance, thereby facilitating the accumulation of effective error-correction experience. Experiments in ALFWorld and on real-world robotic platforms demonstrate that FISRF reduces the average number of error-correction rounds by 37% and redundant reasoning by 25.1%, while improving the overall task success rate by 8%. Project webpage : https://fisrfplanning.github.io/
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）被广泛用于任务规划中的反思性错误修正；然而，现有方法主要依赖自主探索，导致在与新环境交互的早期阶段容易积累错误的经验。为解决这一局限，我们提出了灵活教学支架反思框架（FISRF），这是一种智能体-导师架构，能够评估机器人在任务规划中的最近发展区（ZPD），并自适应地选择反思策略与导师引导，从而促进有效错误修正经验的积累。在ALFWorld及真实机器人平台上的实验表明，FISRF将平均错误修正轮次减少了37%，冗余推理减少了25.1%，同时将整体任务成功率提升了8%。项目网页：https://fisrfplanning.github.io/
tldr: FISRF proposes an agent-mentor framework for LLM-based robot task planning that adaptively selects reflection strategies based on Zone of Proximal Development, reducing error-correction rounds and improving success rates in ALFWorld and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: FISRF提出了一种基于大型语言模型的机器人任务规划的智能体-导师框架，根据最近发展区自适应选择反思策略，在ALFWorld和真实机器人任务中减少了错误修正轮次并提高了成功率。

title: Environment Edits as a Corrective Signal for Reward Learning
summary: Robot corrections allow people to adjust a robot's behavior, but a single correction changes many features. Also, preferences about object attributes and relationships between objects cannot be expressed by moving the robot. We propose environment edits as a complementary form of feedback. The robot's motion is held constant as the human edits the scene, so the only explanation for the edit is the moved object. We introduce Feature Learning from Environmental and Robot-Relational Edit Traces (FERRET), which learns preferences from both robot and environment corrections. We show that environment edits are able to disambiguate features and learn preferences that robot corrections alone cannot.
summary_zh: 机器人纠错允许人们调整机器人的行为，但一次单一的纠错会改变多个特征。此外，关于物体属性的偏好以及物体之间的关系无法通过移动机器人来表达。我们提出环境编辑作为一种补充的反馈形式。在人类编辑场景时，机器人的运动保持不变，因此编辑的唯一解释就是被移动的物体。我们引入了从环境和机器人关系编辑痕迹中学习特征的方法（FERRET），该方法能从机器人修正和环境编辑中学习偏好。我们证明了环境编辑能够消除特征歧义，并学习到仅靠机器人纠错无法获得的偏好。
tldr: This paper proposes environment edits as a complementary human feedback signal for reward learning, showing that editing objects in the scene (while robot motion is constant) can disambiguate feature preferences that robot corrections alone cannot. The method learns from both robot and environment corrections to improve preference learning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出将环境编辑作为人类反馈的补充信号用于奖励学习，通过在固定机器人运动时编辑场景物体来消除特征歧义，并学习仅靠机器人纠正无法表达的偏好。

title: VPR-Space: A Benchmark for Visual Place Recognition in Space Analog Domains
summary: Visual Place Recognition (VPR) is an important means for loop closure detection in visual Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM). While state-of-the-art VPR and SLAM approaches excel in urban and feature-rich natural environments, the vast and feature-poor environments of extraterrestrial surfaces like on the Moon or Mars pose severe challenges for existing approaches. This paper presents a novel benchmark, VPR-Space, to evaluate VPR capabilities on extraterrestrial surfaces. There are three contributions: (1) We collected sixteen VPR database-query datasets based on existing data from Space Analog Domains (SAD), terrestrial environments that resemble properties of the Moon or Mars. The collection includes a range of challenges regarding environment, viewpoint change, and illumination conditions. (2) To address the ill-posed nature of VPR, we propose a novel approach to generate the ground-truth information in VPR benchmarks. Instead of defining that a query and datbase image show the same place if and only if their camera poses are within fixed position and viewing direction thresholds, we propose to make the decision dependent on whether the match would be valuable in the downstream SLAM task. To avoid the overhead and restrictions of evaluating VPR in-the-loop within SLAM systems, we provide VPR ground-truth (GT) matrices based on the performance of an ensemble of state-of-the-art Relative Pose Estimators (RPE). Under this GT we require a VPR method to identify exactly those image pairs for which a subsequently applied RPE is expected to provide a valuable pose estimate in a SLAM context. (3) We evaluated nine state-of-the-art VPR approaches. The results show considerable room for improvement and indicate directions for future research. We provide a pre-release version of the dataset on github: $\texttt{https://github.com/rfechner/VPR-Space}$
summary_zh: 视觉地点识别（VPR）是视觉同步定位与建图（SLAM）中回环检测的重要手段。尽管最先进的VPR和SLAM方法在城市及特征丰富的自然环境中表现出色，但月球或火星等地外天体表面广阔且特征匮乏的环境对现有方法构成了严峻挑战。本文提出了一种新的基准数据集VPR-Space，用于评估地外天体表面上的VPR能力。本文的贡献有三点：（1）我们基于空间模拟域（SAD）的现有数据，收集了十六个VPR查询-数据库数据集，这些模拟域是性质上类似月球或火星的陆地环境。该数据集涵盖了环境、视角变化和光照条件等方面的多种挑战。（2）为解决VPR问题的不适定性，我们提出了一种在VPR基准中生成真值信息的新方法。我们不再简单地定义“当且仅当查询图像与数据库图像的相机位姿处于固定的位置和视角阈值内时，它们显示同一地点”，而是提出根据该匹配在下游SLAM任务中是否具有价值来决定其匹配关系。为避免在SLAM系统中进行循环内VPR评估带来的开销和限制，我们基于一组最先进的相对位姿估计器（RPE）的集成性能，提供VPR真值（GT）矩阵。在此真值标准下，我们要求VPR方法准确识别出那些后续应用RPE有望在SLAM情境下提供有价值位姿估计的图像对。（3）我们评估了九种最先进的VPR方法。结果表明仍有相当大的改进空间，并为未来研究指明了方向。我们已在GitHub上提供数据集预发布版本：$\texttt{https://github.com/rfechner/VPR-Space}$
tldr: This paper introduces VPR-Space, a benchmark for Visual Place Recognition in space analog environments, using a novel SLAM-oriented ground-truth generation method and evaluating nine VPR approaches to highlight performance gaps.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 VPR-Space，一个用于太空模拟环境中视觉地点识别（VPR）的基准，采用新颖的基于SLAM价值的地面真值生成方法，并评估了九种VPR方法的性能差距。

title: Adapt for Planning, Not just Prediction: Optimistic Test-Time World Model Adaptation
summary: Latent world models are typically pre-trained offline and kept frozen at test time, so planning with them can degrade under distribution shift. Test-time adaptation (TTA) can mitigate this degradation by updating the model during deployment. Unlike pre-training on fixed data, TTA for planning is closed-loop: the planner uses model rollouts to select actions, and the resulting transitions drive the next update. This raises the question: which objective should guide TTA for planning? Under a prediction-only objective, the model is fit only to the outcomes of its own actions, so it can remain wrong about the actions that would reach the goal, and low prediction error need not translate into better planning. Inspired by reward-biased maximum likelihood from adaptive control, we introduce Optimistic Test-Time Adaptation (OpTTA). Its objective has two terms, the prediction loss on observed transitions and the planner's goal-reaching cost on its candidate rollouts, both minimized over the model parameters. The planning term biases adaptation toward models that are optimistic about reaching the goal, without any additional environment interaction. Across visual and environment shifts on manipulation, reaching and navigation tasks, OpTTA raises final planning success over the frozen model by 13.5 percentage points on average, compared with 6.9 for the prediction-only objective (AdaJEPA), when only the predictor is adapted. When the encoder is adapted as well, the gains are 13.5 and 7.5 points. These experiments span three JEPA world models with different encoders and training objectives and, for temporal straightening, both CEM and gradient-based planners. Our results suggest that test-time adaptation of world models for planning benefits from an optimistic, task-aware term in addition to the prediction loss.
summary_zh: 潜在世界模型通常在离线状态下进行预训练，并在测试时保持冻结，因此在分布偏移下，基于它们的规划性能可能会下降。测试时自适应（TTA）可以通过在部署过程中更新模型来缓解这种性能下降。与在固定数据上进行预训练不同，用于规划的TTA是闭环的：规划器利用模型推演来选择动作，而产生的状态转移则驱动下一轮更新。这引出了一个问题：在规划任务中，应该用什么样的目标函数来指导TTA？在仅基于预测的目标下，模型只针对自身动作的结果进行拟合，因此它可能对能够到达目标的动作仍然存在偏差，且较低的预测误差并不一定意味着更好的规划效果。受自适应控制中奖励偏向最大似然方法的启发，我们提出了乐观测试时自适应（OpTTA）。其目标函数包含两项：一是对观测到的状态转移的预测损失，二是规划器对其候选推演轨迹的目标到达成本，两者均在模型参数上最小化。规划项使自适应偏向于那些对到达目标持乐观态度的模型，而无需额外的环境交互。在操作、到达和导航任务中，面对视觉和环境偏移，当仅自适应预测器时，OpTTA相较于冻结模型将最终规划成功率平均提升了13.5个百分点，而仅使用预测目标（AdaJEPA）的提升为6.9个百分点。当编码器也进行自适应时，相应提升分别为13.5和7.5个百分点。这些实验涵盖了三个具有不同编码器和训练目标的JEPA世界模型，以及在时间直线化方面，同时包括CEM和基于梯度的规划器。我们的结果表明，用于规划的世界模型的测试时自适应，除了预测损失外，还应引入一个乐观的、任务感知的项，从而获得更好的性能。
tldr: This paper introduces Optimistic Test-Time Adaptation (OpTTA), a test-time adaptation objective for latent world models that includes a planner's goal-reaching cost on candidate rollouts in addition to prediction loss, improving planning success under distribution shift across manipulation, reaching, and navigation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于潜在世界模型的乐观测试时自适应(OpTTA)目标，在预测损失之外增加了规划器在候选轨迹上的目标达成代价，从而在分布偏移下提高规划成功率。

title: Context-Aware Generation and Modulation of Expressive Motion Behavior using Multimodal Foundation Models
summary: Expressive robot motion positively impacts human-robot interaction by improving user engagement, likability, or task performance. We present a novel approach to automatically generate and modulate complex, expressive full-body gesture sequences from a multimodal (text, audio, video) context description. Based on a unified mathematical implementation of the Principles of Animation using Dynamic Movement Primitives, we use multimodal foundation models to generate such sequences along with parametric motion variations that are highly context-aware. This method extends the state of the art in terms of flexibility and generality by being interpretable, composable, and working across different robot morphologies. Moreover, we integrate the system into a continuous control framework and leverage knowledge distillation to learn a much smaller model, significantly improving token efficiency and system latency. Results from a user study with a human-like platform indicate that participants judged our system's motions to be better aligned with the interaction context than motions produced under a non-modulated or API-level condition. We also demonstrate how the system generates expressive motion for robots with different kinematics, showcasing its versatility. Paper webpage: https://gen-mod-expressive-motion-behavior.github.io/.
summary_zh: 表情丰富的机器人运动通过提升用户参与度、喜好度或任务表现，对人与机器人交互产生积极影响。我们提出了一种新颖的方法，能够从多模态（文本、音频、视频）情境描述中自动生成并调制复杂、富有表现力的全身姿态序列。基于动态运动基元对动画原理的统一数学实现，我们利用多模态基础模型生成这些序列以及高度情境感知的参数化运动变体。该方法在灵活性和通用性方面拓展了现有技术水平，具有可解释性、可组合性，并适用于不同机器人形态。此外，我们将该系统集成到连续控制框架中，并利用知识蒸馏技术学习一个更小的模型，显著提升了词元效率和系统延迟。一项基于类人平台的用户研究表明，与在非调制或API级别条件下生成的运动相比，参与者认为我们系统生成的运动与交互情境的契合度更高。我们还展示了该系统如何为具有不同运动学特性的机器人生成富有表现力的运动，体现了其多功能性。论文网页：https://gen-mod-expressive-motion-behavior.github.io/。
tldr: This paper presents a system that uses multimodal foundation models to generate and modulate expressive full-body robot gestures from context descriptions, grounded in animation principles and dynamic movement primitives, with a user study validating better context alignment and demonstrated versatility across robot morphologies.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种利用多模态基础模型，基于动画原理和动态运动原语，从上下文描述中生成和调制富有表现力的全身机器人姿态的系统，并通过用户研究验证了其上下文对齐效果和跨形态的通用性。

title: Preemptive Instruction Following with Resumption
summary: Long-horizon embodied navigation may be interrupted by a higher-priority instruction before the current task sequence is complete. The agent must finish its current atomic task, execute the inserted task, and resume the remaining sequence from the updated environment state, where its viewpoint and available navigation candidates may have changed. To evaluate this capability, we introduce PIFR benchmark, a novel task for runtime task preemption and resumption in embodied navigation. PIFR includes single, repeated, and nested interruption settings,with stage-specific metrics for inserted-task completion, resumption of the original task, and completion of the full sequence. Evaluations show that recovery performance varies across interruption conditions, while aggregate success can obscure differences in interruption handling and resumption. We further propose a lightweight candidate-ranking baseline to improve target re-grounding after interruption. Together, PIFR and the baseline provide a systematic framework for studying interruption handling and task recovery in long-horizon embodied navigation.
summary_zh: 长程具身导航可能在当前任务序列完成之前被更高优先级的指令打断。智能体必须完成当前的原子任务，执行插入的任务，并在更新后的环境状态中从剩余序列处恢复执行，此时其视角和可用的导航候选点可能已发生变化。为评估这一能力，我们引入了PIFR基准，这是具身导航中运行时任务抢占与恢复的新任务。PIFR包含单次、重复和嵌套三种中断设置，并针对插入任务完成、原任务恢复及完整序列完成分别设置了分阶段评估指标。评估结果表明，恢复性能在不同中断条件下存在差异，而总体成功率可能掩盖中断处理与恢复过程中的差异。我们进一步提出了一种轻量级候选点排序基线方法，以改善中断后的目标重新定位能力。PIFR与基线方法共同为长程具身导航中的中断处理与任务恢复研究提供了系统化框架。
tldr: This paper introduces the PIFR benchmark for evaluating embodied navigation agents on preemptive instruction following with resumption, including single, repeated, and nested interruptions, and proposes a candidate-ranking baseline for improved target re-grounding after interruptions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了PIFR基准，用于评估具身导航代理在执行长时程任务时被更高优先级指令打断后的恢复能力，并设计了一个轻量级候选排序基线以提升打断后的目标重新定位。

title: High-resolution tactile observation makes hidden racket-control mechanisms learnable
summary: Experts can master fine hand-object manipulation skills, yet limited conscious perception of rapid tactile interactions hinders their ability to articulate the underlying control mechanisms. Badminton racket control requires rapid, fine hand-force coordination, providing a demanding testbed for uncovering these mechanisms. An 864-node tactile-inertial glove with synchronized 100-Hz acquisition recorded over 14,000 strokes from more than 70 participants across five skills. Inspired by sensorimotor control, our mechanics-grounded two-layer framework inferred object-driving and grip-stabilizing control from tactile history, while resolving their spatiotemporal force realization. We found that higher proficiency was associated with selective rather than extensive control: greater skill specificity, anticipatory regulation, focal distal modulation and lower geometric torque cancellation, while spatiotemporal coordination showed a non-monotonic acquire-refine pattern. We translated these mechanisms into personalized guidance targeting force control and force-motion coordination. In a randomized cohort, mechanism-guided learners gained 0.72 expert-rated skill levels versus 0.05 with level-only feedback, making control mechanisms actionable.
summary_zh: 专家能够掌握精细的手-物操控技能，然而对快速触觉交互的有意识感知有限，这阻碍了他们阐明潜在控制机制的能力。羽毛球拍控制需要快速、精细的手部力量协调，为揭示这些机制提供了一个高要求的试验平台。一套包含864个节点的触觉-惯性手套，以100赫兹的同步采集频率，记录了来自70多名参与者、涵盖五种技能、超过14000次挥拍的数据。受感觉运动控制的启发，我们提出的基于力学的两层框架从触觉历史中推断出物体驱动和握拍稳定的控制，同时解析了它们在时空上的力的实现。我们发现，更高的熟练度与选择性控制而非广泛性控制相关：表现为更高的技能特异性、预期性调节、局灶性远端调控以及更低的几何力矩抵消，而时空协调则呈现出非单调的“获取-精炼”模式。我们将这些机制转化为针对力量控制及力-运动协调的个性化指导。在一项随机队列中，接受机制引导的学习者获得了0.72分的专家评定技能提升，而仅接受水平反馈的学习者仅提升0.05分，从而使控制机制具备了可操作性。
tldr: This paper introduces a high-resolution tactile-inertial glove dataset of badminton racket control and a mechanics-grounded two-layer framework to infer hidden control mechanisms, showing that mechanism-guided feedback significantly improves learning.
tldr_zh: 本文通过高分辨率触觉惯性手套数据集和力学基础的两层框架，揭示了羽毛球拍控制中的隐藏机制，并证明基于机制的反馈显著提升学习效果。

title: Enhancing Deep Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Motion Planning via Task Decomposition
summary: Training robotic manipulation policies in simulation is widely adopted due to safety and cost efficiency; however, tasks involving obstacles remain under-performing and often converge slowly under Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL). To address this challenge, we propose a task decomposition framework for DRL that integrates Transfer Learning (TL) with Reward Redesign (RR) to improve learning efficiency and robustness in obstacle environments. The TL strategy selectively transfers only the first-layer critic parameters across structurally related tasks, since that layer captures general state--action representations while deeper layers encode reward- and obstacle-specific value geometry; RR decomposes tasks into staged sub-objectives to provide denser optimization signals. Experiments on the PyBullet Panda platform show consistent gains in obstacle settings. On Push with obstacle, our method achieves $0.83 \pm 0.05$, outperforming the strongest baseline (Truncated Quantile Critics (TQC), $0.77 \pm 0.06$) by approximately $7.8\%$. On Slide with obstacle, performance reaches $0.95 \pm 0.02$, exceeding Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) ($0.84 \pm 0.06$) by about $11\%$ success rates. In addition to higher final performance, forward transfer reduces convergence time by up to $70\%$ in obstacle tasks, and RR shortens sparse-reward Pick-and-Place training from roughly $0.75$M to $0.20$M steps ($\approx73\%$ reduction). The best policy is deployed on a real Franka Emika FR3 robot as a qualitative feasibility demonstration.
summary_zh: 在仿真环境中训练机器人操作策略因其安全性和成本效益而被广泛采用；然而，涉及障碍物的任务在深度强化学习（DRL）下仍然表现欠佳，且往往收敛缓慢。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了一种面向DRL的任务分解框架，该框架将迁移学习（TL）与奖励重塑（RR）相结合，以提升障碍环境下的学习效率和鲁棒性。TL策略仅在结构相关的任务之间选择性迁移第一层评论家网络参数，因为该层捕获通用的状态-动作表征，而深层网络则编码与奖励和障碍物相关的价值几何结构；RR将任务分解为分阶段的子目标，以提供更密集的优化信号。在PyBullet Panda平台上的实验表明，该方法在障碍环境中具有一致的性能提升。在带障碍物的Push任务中，我们的方法达到了$0.83 \pm 0.05$的成功率，相较于最强基线（截断分位数评论家（TQC），$0.77 \pm 0.06$）提升了约$7.8\%$。在带障碍物的Slide任务中，性能达到$0.95 \pm 0.02$，相较于软演员-评论家（SAC）（$0.84 \pm 0.06$）成功率提升了约$11\%$。除了更高的最终性能外，前向迁移使障碍任务的收敛时间最多减少了$70\%$，而RR将稀疏奖励的抓取-放置训练从约$0.75$M步缩短至$0.20$M步（约减少$73\%$）。最优策略已部署在实际的Franka Emika FR3机器人上，作为定性可行性验证。
tldr: This paper proposes a task decomposition framework for Deep Reinforcement Learning that integrates transfer learning and reward redesign to improve robotic manipulation learning in obstacle environments, demonstrating gains in simulation and on a real Franka robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于深度强化学习的任务分解框架，结合迁移学习和奖励重新设计，以提高在障碍环境中机器人操作学习的效果，并在仿真和真实Franka机器人上验证了其优势。

title: DEX-PHD: A Dexterous Portable Handheld Device for Multimodal Data Collection
summary: Existing manipulation data collection methods typically offer either accurate robot-state acquisition through kinematic-chain-based teleoperation or convenient, portable operation through vision-based approaches. We present DEX-PHD, a portable handheld device that combines these advantages for dexterous manipulation by integrating a dexterous robot hand, continuous per-finger control, and multimodal logging. The system records proprioceptive information, fingertip contact data, and wrist-camera video, while the operator directly controls the robot hand through joint-level mapping. Its untethered design enables data collection across diverse environments. We demonstrate DEX-PHD on contact-rich tasks requiring coordinated multi-finger manipulation and deploy the collected demonstrations through open-loop replay on a physical humanoid robot. The results show that open-loop replay preserves the main temporal patterns of finger motion and task-relevant contact. Therefore, DEX-PHD provides a practical platform for portable, multimodal dexterous manipulation data collection.
summary_zh: 现有的操作数据收集方法通常通过基于运动学链的遥操作提供精确的机器人状态获取，或通过基于视觉的方法提供便捷、便携的操作方式。我们提出了DEX-PHD，一种便携式手持设备，通过集成灵巧机器人手、连续逐指控制和多模态记录，结合了上述两种方法的优势，用于灵巧操作。该系统记录本体感觉信息、指尖接触数据以及手腕摄像头视频，同时操作员通过关节级映射直接控制机器人手。其无束缚设计使得数据收集能够在多种环境中进行。我们在需要协调多指操作的接触密集型任务上展示了DEX-PHD，并将收集到的示范通过物理人形机器人上的开环回放进行部署。结果表明，开环回放保留了手指运动的主要时间模式及与任务相关的接触特征。因此，DEX-PHD为便携式、多模态灵巧操作数据收集提供了一个实用平台。
tldr: DEX-PHD is a portable handheld device for collecting multimodal dexterous manipulation data, integrating a dexterous robot hand, per-finger control, and multimodal logging, with demonstrations validated via open-loop replay on a physical humanoid robot.
tldr_zh: DEX-PHD 是一种便携式手持设备，用于收集多模态灵巧操作数据，集成了灵巧机器人手、逐指控制和多模态记录，并通过在实体人形机器人上的开环回放验证了演示效果。

title: RoKON: Efficient and Adaptive Data-Enabled Predictive Control for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Data-enabled predictive control has recently emerged as a promising control paradigm, enabling a transparent optimal-control formulation without the need to learn an explicit dynamics model. This paper presents a number of extensions paving the path towards its use in real-time robotics tasks. Following recent work, we utilize a nonlinear predictor based on Gaussian kernels to represent the relationship between input and output data. We propose a damped Gauss-Newton method that enables real-time control by efficiently exploiting the least-squares structure of the control problem. In addition, we introduce a hybrid buffer management strategy that incorporates informative online data while retaining relevant offline data, allowing the predictor to account for changes in the dynamics. We demonstrate the tracking performance and computational suitability of the proposed method in MuJoCo using a Franka Research 3 arm pushing a block across surface, without prior knowledge of its changing friction values.
summary_zh: 数据驱动的预测控制近年来已成为一种前景广阔的控 制范式，能够在无需学习显式动力学模型的情况下实现透明的最优控制问题构建。本文提出了若干扩展方法，为其在实时机器人任务中的应用铺平道路。在近期研究的基础上，我们利用基于高斯核的非线性预测器来表示输入与输出数据之间的关系。我们提出了一种阻尼高斯-牛顿方法，通过高效利用控制问题的最小二乘结构，实现实时控制。此外，我们引入了一种混合缓冲区管理策略，在保留相关离线数据的同时纳入有信息量的在线数据，使预测器能够适应动力学变化。我们使用Franka Research 3机械臂在MuJoCo环境中将方块推过表面的实验，验证了所提方法的跟踪性能与计算适用性，且无需预先了解摩擦系数变化。
tldr: This paper enhances data-enabled predictive control for real-time robotic manipulation by proposing a damped Gauss-Newton method for efficient least-squares optimization and a hybrid buffer management strategy to adapt to changing dynamics, demonstrated on a Franka arm pushing a block in MuJoCo.
tldr_zh: 本文通过提出阻尼高斯-牛顿方法以高效利用最小二乘结构，以及混合缓冲区管理策略以适应动态变化，增强了数据驱动的预测控制在实时机器人操作中的应用，并在MuJoCo中Franka机械臂推块任务上进行了验证。

title: MATE-BT: A Behavior-Tree-Based Framework for Hierarchically Decentralized Mission Autonomy in Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Teams
summary: Multi-robot teams executing predefined missions must adapt to runtime changes and sustain mission management despite robot failures. This paper proposes MATE-BT (Mission, Allocation, and Task Execution with Behavior Trees), a hierarchically decentralized framework that separates mission execution, allocation, and task execution. An active onboard leader manages mission progression and team-level task assignment, with authority transferable to another leader-capable robot after failure. Interchangeable decentralized methods resolve target assignments, while each robot adapts its local behavior through planning and acting with behavior trees. Webots simulations and real-robot experiments demonstrate mission continuity despite new targets and robot failures, including active-leader failure. In the physical experiments, all MATE-BT computation runs onboard. Hardware-in-the-loop resource measurements further support onboard execution on Jetson Orin Nano and Raspberry Pi 5. By updating only the affected layers without full-plan regeneration, MATE-BT maintained a response time of approximately 130 ms with 30 robots and 120 targets. Comparisons of four target-assignment plugins reveal scenario-dependent trade-offs between mission completion time and total travel distance.
summary_zh: 多机器人团队在执行预定任务时，必须适应运行时变化，并在机器人发生故障的情况下维持任务管理。本文提出了MATE-BT（任务、分配与行为树执行），一种分层去中心化框架，将任务执行、任务分配和具体任务执行相分离。一个活跃的机载领导者负责管理任务推进和团队级任务分配，且该权限可在领导者机器人发生故障后转移给另一个具备领导者能力的机器人。可互换的去中心化方法用于解决目标分配问题，同时每个机器人通过行为树进行规划与行动，以调整其局部行为。Webots仿真和真实机器人实验表明，即使在出现新目标、机器人故障（包括活跃领导者故障）的情况下，任务连续性仍得以维持。在物理实验中，所有MATE-BT计算均在机载完成。硬件在环资源测量进一步支持在Jetson Orin Nano和Raspberry Pi 5上进行机载执行。通过仅更新受影响层而无需重新生成完整规划，MATE-BT在30个机器人和120个目标的情况下保持了约130毫秒的响应时间。四种目标分配插件的比较揭示了任务完成时间与总行驶距离之间因场景不同而存在的权衡关系。
tldr: MATE-BT is a hierarchically decentralized framework using behavior trees for multi-robot mission management, enabling runtime adaptation, leader-failure recovery, and onboard execution with low response times.
tldr_zh: MATE-BT 是一个基于行为树的分层去中心化框架，用于多机器人任务管理，支持运行时调整、领导者故障恢复及机载执行，并保持低响应时间。

title: EmbodiedLab: Benchmarking Embodied Agents That Act to Know
summary: Embodied agents are expected to accomplish real-world goals by deciding for themselves how and when to interact with their surroundings. For many such goals, changing the physical state of the world is the means rather than the end: the agent changes the state of a system through interaction, observes the feedback, and explores until it either achieves the goal itself (e.g., discovering physical laws) or learns what the goal requires; it acts to know. Manipulation benchmarks stop at acting to change, with the target state given; scientific discovery benchmarks evaluate knowing but replace physical experimentation with symbolic actions or numerical queries. We introduce EmbodiedLab, a benchmark in which a robot must act to know. Quantitative science experiments make this setting controllable: the parameters of the system are resampled for every instance, so the result cannot be known in advance, yet it can be scored exactly. Across 30 experiments in five disciplines on 14 apparatus platforms, the agent receives an objective and the apparatus, chooses its own procedure, and operates a physics-based simulated laboratory, reading the instruments through its cameras. Evaluation checks what the agent came to know, grounded in readings recorded during the episode, as well as the physical state the task requires; every experiment is verified to be solvable. We evaluate six frontier models in their developers' coding agents with native observation and control, with added perception and motion planning, and with manipulation skills distilled from the strongest agents. With native control, even the strongest agent succeeds less than half the time; for every agent, most failures arise in interacting with the apparatus, and manipulation skills help weaker agents more than perception and planning. The benchmark and its evaluation code are available at https://github.com/HexaFuture/EmbodiedLab.
summary_zh: 具身智能体预期通过自主决定如何以及与周围环境交互的时机，来实现现实世界中的目标。对于许多此类目标而言，改变世界的物理状态是手段而非目的：智能体通过交互改变系统状态，观察反馈，并持续探索，直到其要么自身实现目标（例如，发现物理规律），要么获悉目标所需的条件；它通过行动来认知。操控基准测试止步于“行动以改变”，且目标状态是预设给定的；科学发现基准测试评估“认知”，但以符号操作或数值查询替代了物理实验。我们引入EmbodiedLab，这是一个要求机器人“以行动求认知”的基准测试。定量科学实验使该设定具有可控性：系统参数在每个实例中重新采样，因此结果无法预先获知，却能被精确评分。在涵盖五个学科、分布于14个装置平台上的30项实验中，智能体接收目标和装置，自行选择操作流程，并在基于物理的模拟实验室中运行，通过摄像头读取仪器读数。评估核查的是智能体最终知晓的内容——这基于情节过程中记录的读数，以及任务所要求的物理状态；每项实验均经验证是可解的。我们评估了六个前沿模型在其开发者编码智能体中的表现，分别采用原生观测与控制、额外加入感知与运动规划，以及从最强智能体中蒸馏出的操控技能等配置。在原生控制下，即便最强的智能体成功率也不及一半；对每个智能体而言，大多数失败源于与装置的交互环节，且操控技能对较弱智能体的帮助大于感知与规划。基准测试及其评估代码可在 https://github.com/HexaFuture/EmbodiedLab 获取。
tldr: EmbodiedLab is a benchmark for embodied agents that must interact with a simulated physics laboratory to discover experimental outcomes, evaluating frontier models' abilities to act-to-know across 30 physics experiments.
tldr_zh: EmbodiedLab 是一个基准测试，用于评估具身智能体在模拟物理实验室中通过交互来发现实验结果的能力，涵盖30个物理实验。

title: Labference: Benchmarking the Reasoning-Action Connection in Robotic Laboratories
summary: Realizing Embodied AI for Science requires robots to translate experimental goals into reliable physical procedures, reducing hazardous and repetitive human work while generating evidence for scientific discovery. Although language-based planning and learned manipulation provide complementary capabilities, their integration requires robots to adapt subsequent operations to actual execution outcomes. For example, an unsuccessful placement changes what must be done next, even when the experimental goal remains unchanged. Existing benchmarks assess planning, manipulation, and laboratory workflows through task completion and reasoning or execution metrics; however, aggregate performance leaves the connection between outcome-dependent choices and physical execution unresolved. To address this evaluation gap, we introduce Labference, a benchmark for evaluating how observed physical outcomes guide subsequent choices and how those choices translate into robotic laboratory actions. Its evaluation protocol is designed to test outcome-dependent behavioral adaptation through controlled evidence variations, while independently measuring operation selection, physical execution, and task completion. Matched Oracle-assisted continuations from shared checkpoints then assess which forms of support improve subsequent choices and task completion. Initial weighing evaluations reveal target-selection errors in the tested VLA policies despite successful object transfers, whereas GPT-driven control achieves correct selection but encounters execution failures and substantial computation costs. Together, these findings highlight the need to connect task-appropriate reasoning with reliable, timely action. By making this connection measurable and diagnosable, Labference supports targeted improvements toward autonomous experimentation for Embodied AI for Science.
summary_zh:
摘要：
实现科学领域的具身人工智能，要求机器人将实验目标转化为可靠的物理操作流程，从而减少危险且重复的人力工作，同时为科学发现提供证据。尽管基于语言的规划与习得性操作提供了互补能力，但二者的整合要求机器人能够根据实际执行结果调整后续操作。例如，一次失败的放置操作会改变接下来必须执行的步骤，即使实验目标保持不变。现有基准通过任务完成度、推理或执行指标来评估规划、操作及实验室工作流程；然而，总体性能指标未能揭示结果依赖型选择与物理执行之间的联系。为弥补这一评估空白，我们提出了Labference基准，用于评估观察到的物理结果如何引导后续选择，以及这些选择如何转化为机器人实验室操作。其评估协议旨在通过受控的证据变化来测试结果依赖型行为适应能力，同时独立衡量操作选择、物理执行和任务完成度。从共享检查点出发的匹配式Oracle辅助延续，可用于评估何种支持形式能够改善后续选择及任务完成效果。初步称量评估显示，尽管被测VLA策略能够成功完成物体转移，但存在目标选择错误；而GPT驱动的控制虽能实现正确选择，却遭遇执行失败并产生可观的算力开销。综上，这些发现凸显了将任务适配的推理与可靠、及时的物理行动相结合的必要性。通过使这种连接变得可测量、可诊断，Labference为具身智能科学领域的自主实验提供了有针对性的改进支持。
tldr: This paper introduces Labference, a benchmark that evaluates the connection between reasoning and action in robotic laboratory settings, specifically testing how observed physical outcomes guide subsequent choices and the execution of those choices into physical actions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 Labference，一个用于评估机器人实验室环境中推理与行动之间联系的基准，具体测试观察到的物理结果如何指导后续选择以及这些选择如何转化为物理动作。

title: The Language of Deformation: Semantic Failure Analysis as a Prerequisite for Dexterous Manipulation of Deformable Objects
summary: Dexterous manipulation of rigid objects has reached a level of maturity where grasp stability, control, and planning strategies are successfully applied in industry and logistics. In contrast, manipulating deformable objects (cables, plastic pieces, cloth) remains far more challenging, as rigid-object methods do not account for their additional complexity. This paper identifies semantic failure analysis as a key step toward mature deformable-object manipulation and supports this claim with proof-of-concept experiments. Unlike rigid-object manipulation, where goals are well-defined in terms of criteria such as force balance and slippage, deformable-object manipulation involves a broader variety of failure modes arising from differences in materials, geometry, and behaviour. Typical failures include buckling, plastic deformation, pressure variations, and tearing. These diverse and often hard-to-detect events require distinct corrective strategies, making semantic failure analysis necessary. We define its key components and challenges and present experimental results supporting its potential as a research direction.
summary_zh: 灵巧操作刚性物体已达到一定成熟度，抓取稳定性、控制与规划策略已成功应用于工业与物流领域。相比之下，操作可变形物体（如线缆、塑料件、布料）仍面临更大挑战，因为面向刚性物体的方法无法应对其额外复杂性。本文指出语义失效分析是实现可变形物体操作成熟化的关键步骤，并通过概念验证实验支持这一论断。与刚性物体操作中目标明确（如力平衡与滑移准则）不同，可变形物体操作涉及更多样化的失效模式，这些模式源于材料、几何形状和行为特性的差异。典型失效包括屈曲、塑性变形、压力变化及撕裂等。这些多样且往往难以检测的事件需要针对性的纠正策略，从而使语义失效分析成为必要。我们定义了其关键组成部分与挑战，并展示了支持其作为研究方向潜力的实验结果。
tldr: This paper argues that semantic failure analysis is a crucial, largely missing step for enabling robust dexterous manipulation of deformable objects, and provides proof-of-concept experiments to support this research direction. It defines the key components and challenges of this analysis, focusing on failure modes like buckling, plastic deformation, tearing, and pressure variations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出语义故障分析是实现在柔软物体灵巧操作的关键且常被忽视的步骤，并通过概念验证实验支持这一研究方向。文章定义了该分析的关键组成部分和挑战，重点关注屈曲、塑性变形、撕裂和压力变化等故障模式。

title: Uncertainty Evaluation to Support Safety of the Intended Functionality Analysis for Determining the Applicability of Performance Targets Across Triggering Conditions in ML-Based LiDAR Object Detection
summary: For safety of the intended functionality (SOTIF) analysis according to ISO 21448, a machine learning object detector for light detection and ranging (LiDAR) point clouds can meet a performance target, a limit on the mean per-frame share of wrong detections among accepted detections, by rejecting detections above an uncertainty threshold. A threshold selected on data of one condition carries a statistical guarantee only for data distributed like its selection data, whereas SOTIF analysis covers every triggering condition. This paper presents an uncertainty evaluation in which the threshold is transferred into a triggering condition, a test decides at a stated error probability whether the target is applicable there, not applicable or not determined, and a lower bound counts the independent units an applicable outcome requires. For PointPillars ensembles on KITTI and nuScenes, counted in recorded sequences, as the dependence between frames requires, neither dataset held enough independent units for any target limit, and no transfer had a not applicable outcome. Counted in frames, the same data gave not applicable outcomes at limits fixed in advance after transfers into far distance, into rain and between two separately trained detectors, thresholds that met the target limit after a transfer rejected most correct detections, and in rain the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve did not decrease. A performance target met under one condition therefore counts as evidence under a triggering condition only after a test there, reported with its share of accepted correct detections and its number of independent recorded sequences.
summary_zh: 摘要：针对ISO 21448所规定的预期功能安全性（SOTIF）分析，基于光检测与测距（LiDAR）点云的机器学习目标检测器可通过拒绝超过不确定性阈值的检测结果，达到性能目标——即对已接受检测中每帧错误检测平均占比的限制。在某一条件下基于数据选定的阈值，其统计保证仅适用于与该选择数据分布一致的数据，而SOTIF分析需覆盖所有触发条件。本文提出一种不确定性评估方法，其中阈值被转化为触发条件，测试以规定的错误概率判定目标在该条件下是否适用、不适用或无法确定，并给出下限以统计适用结果所需的独立单元数量。针对KITTI和nuScenes数据集上的PointPillars集成模型，按记录序列计数（因帧间存在依赖关系），两个数据集均未达到任何目标限值所需的独立单元数量，且所有迁移场景均无不适用结果。按帧计数时，相同数据在预先设定的限值下，经迁移至远距离、雨天及两个独立训练检测器之间后，均出现不适用结果；满足目标限值的阈值在迁移后拒绝了绝大多数正确检测；且在雨天条件下，接收者操作特征曲线下面积并未下降。因此，在某一条件下满足的性能目标，仅在相应触发条件下经测试后方可作为证据，并需同时报告其已接受正确检测占比及独立记录序列数量。
tldr: This paper evaluates the transferability of performance targets for ML-based LiDAR object detection across triggering conditions in SOTIF analysis, proposing a statistical test that determines whether a target applies to a new condition and highlighting that thresholds meeting targets under one condition may not generalize.
tldr_zh: 本文针对ISO 21448 SOTIF分析中基于ML的LiDAR目标检测性能目标在不同触发条件下的可转移性进行评估，提出一种统计检验来判断目标是否适用于新条件，并强调在一种条件下满足目标的阈值可能无法泛化到其他条件。

title: 3D-Force Estimation for Dual-arm Manipulation of Deformable Linear Objects via Factor Graphs
summary: Estimating forces acting on Deformable Linear Objects (DLOs) is challenging due to their underactuated nature. However, reliable contact estimation is crucial to precisely control them and enable safe manipulation tasks. Differently from the various approaches presented in the literature, this work adopts a probabilistic formulation where the DLO state and sensor data are related through conditional distributions. In particular, factor graphs are used to determine the magnitude, direction, and location of a 3D force acting on a DLO, while simultaneously reconstructing its shape. Since DLOs are not actuated and are typically thin, like cables and wires, strain gauges and actuation readings are usually impractical. Therefore, to overcome this issue, this work is tested using one type of sensing information only, thus developing a generic technique suited for a wider variety of tasks. Realistic tests are performed by introducing noise into the measurements while the DLO follows a prescribed path in the presence of external forces that are accurately estimated.
summary_zh: 估计作用于可变形线性物体上的力因其欠驱动特性而颇具挑战性。然而，可靠的接触估计对于精确控制这些物体并实现安全操作任务至关重要。与文献中提出的多种方法不同，本研究采用了一种概率公式，通过条件分布将可变形线性物体的状态与传感器数据相关联。具体而言，利用因子图来确定作用于可变形线性物体上的三维力的大小、方向及位置，同时重构其形状。由于可变形线性物体通常不被驱动且较为纤细，例如电缆和导线，应变计和驱动读数往往不切实际。因此，为克服这一问题，本研究仅使用一种类型的传感信息进行测试，从而开发出一种适用于更广泛任务的通用技术。通过在测量中引入噪声并进行逼真测试，同时使可变形线性物体在存在外部力的情况下沿着预定路径运动，这些外部力得以被精确估计。
tldr: This paper proposes a probabilistic factor graph-based method to estimate 3D forces acting on deformable linear objects (e.g., cables) during dual-arm manipulation while simultaneously reconstructing the object's shape, using only one type of sensing data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于因子图的概率方法，用于在双臂操作柔性线性物体（如线缆）时估计其受到的3D力，并同时重建物体形状，且仅使用单一类型的传感数据。

title: VISTA: Active Exploration for Self-Improvement in Embodied Agents
summary: Agentic embodied intelligence plays a foundational role in open-ended, dynamic physical environments. Rather than treating policy learning as an end-to-end mapping from instructions to actions, recent studies reveal that embodied systems depend not only on pre-trained foundation models, but also on harness. Prior approaches largely treat rollouts as static logs for post-hoc reflection, producing harness updates without autonomously testing and refining them through subsequent embodied interaction. To address this challenge, we propose VISTA, a meta-agent framework that transforms post-hoc rollout reflection into active self-exploration for embodied harness improvement. Specifically, VISTA maintains a harness graph that records the lineage of proposed harnesses, which enables the meta-agent to retrieve prior hypotheses, build on effective mechanisms, and avoid repeatedly exploring failed directions. Each iteration begins from a retained harness version and its execution evidence. Rather than directly committing an update from these historical trajectories, the meta-agent actively explores in the environment. It autonomously generates new rollouts, probes execution failures and recovery behaviors, and iteratively modifies the harness based on the resulting evidence. The refined harness is then evaluated afresh and added to the harness graph. We evaluate VISTA on the LIBERO-Pro, RoboCasa, and RoboTwin benchmarks. Experimental results demonstrate that VISTA progressively improves task success and is more rollout-efficient than static reflection, achieving higher success rates with fewer simulator rollouts.
summary_zh: 具身智能体在开放、动态的物理环境中发挥着基础性作用。近期的研究表明，具身系统并非将策略学习视为从指令到动作的端到端映射，而是不仅依赖于预训练的基础模型，还依赖于“驾驭框架”（harness）。以往的方法大多将交互轨迹视为事后反思的静态日志，从而在更新驾驭框架时，未能通过后续的具身交互对其进行自主测试和优化。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了VISTA，一个元智能体框架，将事后轨迹反思转化为主动的自我探索，以改进具身驾驭框架。具体而言，VISTA维护一个驾驭框架图，记录所提出框架的谱系，使元智能体能够检索先前的假设、基于有效机制进行构建，并避免重复探索失败的路径。每次迭代从保留的框架版本及其执行证据出发，元智能体并非直接依据这些历史轨迹进行更新，而是主动在环境中探索。它自主生成新的交互轨迹，探测执行失败与恢复行为，并基于所得证据迭代修改驾驭框架。随后，对改进后的框架进行重新评估，并将其加入驾驭框架图。我们在LIBERO-Pro、RoboCasa和RoboTwin基准上对VISTA进行了评估。实验结果表明，VISTA能够逐步提升任务成功率，并且相比静态反思方法具有更高的交互效率，在更少的模拟器交互次数下实现了更高的成功率。
tldr: VISTA is a meta-agent framework that turns post-hoc rollout reflection into active self-exploration for embodied agents, iteratively improving harness policies on LIBERO-Pro, RoboCasa, and RoboTwin benchmarks.
tldr_zh: VISTA 是一个元代理框架，将事后轨迹反思转化为主动自探索，以在 LIBERO-Pro、RoboCasa 和 RoboTwin 基准上迭代改进具身智能体的策略。

title: Learning Direct Control from Optimization for Dynamic Target Tracking
summary: Dynamic target tracking requires a mobile robot to maintain target visibility while navigating obstacles with smooth, feasible controls. Online trajectory optimization explicitly encodes these objectives but requires repeated numerical solving, whereas waypoint-based neural policies separate geometric prediction from control execution. We introduce LECO, a framework that transfers tracking optimization into offline learning of a direct-control policy. LECO predicts control sequences and maps them to trajectories through a differentiable kinematic model, allowing trajectory-level objectives to directly guide control learning. A decaying expert-guidance curriculum initializes effective tracking behavior and progressively shifts learning toward these task objectives. At deployment, a predictive safety lock checks short-horizon obstacle clearance and invokes a classical planning and control fallback when the predicted motion is unsafe or the target prediction is invalid. Across three simulated obstacle densities, LECO reduces root-mean-square linear jerk by 14.1--31.2\% relative to the best competing method for this metric and achieves the highest tracking success rate, with per-cycle computation times of 4.25--5.63\,ms. Experiments on two robot platforms further demonstrate tracking through indoor narrow passages and outdoor forest environments. These results demonstrate that learning direct control from optimization enables smooth and robust dynamic target tracking.
summary_zh: 动态目标追踪要求移动机器人在通过平滑且可行的控制策略避开障碍物的同时，保持对目标的可见性。在线轨迹优化明确地将这些目标编码为优化问题，但需要重复进行数值求解，而基于路径点的神经策略则将几何预测与控制执行分离开来。我们提出了LECO框架，该框架将追踪优化转化为直接控制策略的离线学习。LECO预测控制序列，并通过可微分的运动学模型将其映射为轨迹，从而使轨迹级目标能够直接引导控制学习。一种衰减的专家引导课程初始化有效的追踪行为，并逐步将学习转向这些任务目标。在部署阶段，预测性安全锁检查短时域内的障碍物间隙，当预测运动不安全或目标预测无效时，调用经典规划与控制回退机制。在三种模拟障碍物密度下，LECO相较于该指标上最优的对比方法，将均方根线性加加速度降低了14.1%至31.2%，并取得了最高的追踪成功率，每周期计算时间为4.25至5.63毫秒。在两个机器人平台上的实验进一步证明了其在室内狭窄通道和室外森林环境中的追踪能力。这些结果表明，从优化中学习直接控制能够实现平滑且鲁棒的动态目标追踪。
tldr: LECO learns a direct-control policy for dynamic target tracking by transferring online trajectory optimization into offline learning, using a differentiable kinematic model and a predictive safety lock to ensure robust, smooth navigation across diverse environments.
tldr_zh: LECO 将在线轨迹优化转化为离线学习直接控制策略，通过可微运动模型和安全预测机制，实现移动机器人在动态目标跟踪中的平滑、鲁棒控制。

title: MMGNet: Multi-Modal 6-DoF Grasp Synthesis for Cluttered Scenes
summary: Grasping is a foundational capability in robotic manipulation. Scene-level 6-DoF grasp synthesis relies on point clouds for metric geometry, yet real-world point observations are often noisy, incomplete, and over-smoothed. RGB images provide object-region, boundary, and appearance cues, yet two bottlenecks limit their effective use in scene representation and local grasp reasoning. We present MMGNet, a Multi-Modal Grasp Synthesis Network that addresses these bottlenecks through hierarchical image-to-3D feature injection and rotational graspness modeling. Hierarchical injection integrates multi-scale image features throughout 3D representation formation, while the rotational graspness jointly predicts the grasp approach direction and in-plane rotation before organizing local image-informed features through grasp-shaded grouping. Ablation studies show that these two modules provide complementary gains. MMGNet achieves a mean AP of 60.34 on GraspNet-1Billion with RealSense, surpassing all compared methods. In real-world experiments with adversarial grasp objects, MMGNet improves the grasp success rate over AnyGrasp by 8.46 percentage points. \emph{Code, models, and data will be released upon publication.}
summary_zh: 抓取是机器人操作中的基础能力。场景级六自由度抓取合成依赖点云获取度量几何信息，然而现实中的点云观测往往包含噪声、不完整且过度平滑。RGB图像提供了物体区域、边界和外观线索，但两个瓶颈限制了其在场景表示和局部抓取推理中的有效利用。我们提出了MMGNet，一种多模态抓取合成网络，通过层级图像到三维特征注入和旋转抓取性建模来解决这些瓶颈。层级注入在三维表示形成过程中整合了多尺度图像特征，而旋转抓取性在组织基于抓取分组的局部图像感知特征之前，联合预测抓取接近方向和面内旋转。消融实验表明，这两个模块提供了互补性的性能提升。MMGNet在GraspNet-1Billion数据集上使用RealSense时达到了60.34的平均精度，超越了所有对比方法。在包含对抗性抓取物体的真实世界实验中，MMGNet相比AnyGrasp将抓取成功率提升了8.46个百分点。\emph{代码、模型和数据将在发表后公开。}
tldr: MMGNet introduces a multi-modal 6-DoF grasp synthesis network that combines RGB and point cloud data through hierarchical image-to-3D feature injection and rotational graspness modeling, achieving state-of-the-art grasp success on benchmarks and real robots.
tldr_zh: MMGNet 提出了一种多模态 6-DoF 抓取合成网络，通过层次化图像到 3D 特征注入和旋转抓取性建模，结合 RGB 和点云数据，在基准测试和真实机器人上实现了最先进的抓取成功率。

title: Behavioural Quality Is Not Learning Utility: Objective Mismatch in Human Behaviour Models for Robot Learning
summary: Human behaviour models are increasingly used to provide simulated human interactions for training robots via reinforcement learning (RL). Existing approaches primarily evaluate these models according to how closely their generated behaviours resemble real human data, while their usefulness as training partners is less commonly assessed. This creates a potential objective mismatch: a model that performs well according to behavioural evaluation metrics may not necessarily provide useful training experiences for downstream robot policy learning. Across two human-robot interaction (HRI) domains, highway driving and object handover, we evaluate different types of human behaviour models using common generative-model evaluation metrics. We consider multiple human trajectory representations and compare the resulting evaluations with the downstream performance of RL policies trained using the corresponding models. We find that existing behavioural evaluation metrics do not consistently predict downstream policy performance across domains and trajectory representations, while their evaluations are sensitive to the choice of trajectory representation. We also show that even when the true testing behaviour distribution is known, training against a different distribution may yield better downstream performance than training directly against the true distribution.
summary_zh: 人类行为模型 increasingly 被用于通过强化学习（RL）为机器人训练提供模拟的人类交互。现有方法主要根据这些模型生成的行为与真实人类数据的相似程度来评估其性能，而它们作为训练伙伴的实用性则较少被考量。这造成了一个潜在的目标错配：在行为评估指标上表现良好的模型，未必能为下游机器人策略学习提供有用的训练经验。在两个人类-机器人交互（HRI）领域——高速公路驾驶和物品交接——中，我们使用常见的生成模型评估指标对不同类型的人类行为模型进行了评估。我们考虑了多种人类轨迹表示方式，并将评估结果与使用相应模型训练的RL策略的下游性能进行比较。我们发现，现有行为评估指标无法在不同领域和轨迹表示下一致地预测下游策略性能，而其评估结果对轨迹表示的选择十分敏感。我们还表明，即使已知真实的测试行为分布，针对不同分布进行训练可能比直接针对真实分布训练获得更好的下游性能。
tldr: This paper investigates whether human behavior models that faithfully reproduce human data are effective for training downstream robot RL policies, finding a mismatch between behavioral quality and learning utility across highway driving and object handover domains.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了在训练下游机器人强化学习策略时，能忠实再现人类数据的人类行为模型是否有效，发现在高速公路驾驶和物体交接领域中，行为质量与学习效用之间存在不匹配。

title: Networked Humanoid Intelligence: Communication, Coordination, Collaboration, and Social Interaction
summary: Humanoid robots are moving from laboratory platforms toward connected fleets that share workspaces, infrastructure, tasks, and knowledge with other robots and humans. As deployments grow, the operation and improvement of each humanoid depend on information exchanged across the network. However, existing research has largely studied humanoids as individual systems. This survey examines networked humanoid intelligence through four functions of information exchange: communication, coordination, collaboration, and social intelligence with human interaction. We first establish the foundations of networked humanoid systems, define the question addressed by each function, and connect them through a common factory scenario. We review the literature along six dimensions: interaction architecture, exchanged information, physical coupling, operating timescale, system scale, and embodiment. We separate results obtained with physical and simulated humanoids from those based on other robotic platforms or disembodied agents, because the latter do not fully capture humanoid-specific constraints such as balance, whole-body motion, contact, and physical interaction. We examine hardware, datasets, and benchmarks, and distinguish risks handled locally from those networking introduces, such as stale information or unsafe knowledge propagation. Finally, we identify open problems in control-aware networking, compact body-centric messages, physically grounded coordination, network- and embodiment-aware knowledge sharing, fleet-level social consistency, and accountable human oversight.
summary_zh: 人形机器人正从实验室平台迈向互联集群，这些集群与其它机器人和人类共享工作空间、基础设施、任务与知识。随着部署规模不断扩大，每台人形机器人的运行与改进都依赖于网络中交换的信息。然而，现有研究大多将人形机器人视为独立系统来考察。本综述通过信息交换的四个功能审视网络化人形智能：通信、协调、协作以及与人类交互的社交智能。我们首先建立网络化人形系统的基础框架，明确各功能所解决的问题，并通过一个共同的工厂场景将它们联系起来。我们沿六个维度对文献进行综述：交互架构、交换信息、物理耦合、运行时间尺度、系统规模及具身性。我们将基于实体和仿真人形机器人获得的结果与基于其它机器人平台或无实体智能体的结果区分开来，因为后者无法完全捕捉人形机器人特有的约束条件，如平衡、全身运动、接触及物理交互。我们考察了硬件、数据集和基准测试，并区分了局部处理的风险与网络化引入的风险，例如信息陈旧或不安全的知识传播。最后，我们指出了控制感知网络、紧凑的以身体为中心的讯息、具物理基础的协调、网络与具身性感知的知识共享、机队级社交一致性以及可问责的人类监督等方面的开放性问题。
tldr: This survey explores networked humanoid intelligence, analyzing communication, coordination, collaboration, and social interaction in multi-humanoid systems, and identifies open problems in networking and embodiment.
tldr_zh: 本调查探讨了网络化人形智能，分析了多人形系统中的通信、协调、协作和社交互动，并指出了网络与具身结合中的开放问题。

title: What Does World Modeling Actually Improve in Robot Action Learning?
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) combine future-video prediction with robot action learning, yet improvements in task success alone do not reveal how predictive supervision manifests in execution behavior or whether its benefits persist under task and environmental shifts. We conduct controlled future-video prediction loss ablations within FastWAM and OpenWAM, keeping model architecture, initialization, robot training data, and training steps fixed within each model family. Under clean conditions on seen tasks, predictive supervision increases success rates by 24.38 and 72.91 percentage points, respectively. Trajectory clustering further reveals higher success rates within several coarse trajectory clusters, including cases where cluster frequencies change little, indicating that the gains are not solely reflected in changes in the prevalence of trajectory patterns. However, these benefits do not consistently persist under distribution shifts: improvements on unseen tasks vary across models and tasks, while both models exhibit low success rates under the evaluated environmental randomizations, without a consistent advantage from predictive supervision. We further introduce future-video prediction as an auxiliary training objective for $π_{0.5}$, where a lightweight Transformer predictor used only during training increases success from 82.94% to 89.19%. These findings support future-video prediction as effective auxiliary supervision for action learning, while distinguishing improved execution on familiar tasks from reliable transfer and showing that such gains need not rely on a large pretrained video diffusion transformer (DiT) in the evaluated setting.
summary_zh: 世界行动模型（WAMs）将未来视频预测与机器人动作学习相结合，然而，任务成功率的提升本身并不能揭示预测监督如何在执行行为中体现，也无法说明其益处是否能在任务与环境变化下持续存在。我们在FastWAM和OpenWAM中进行了受控的未来视频预测损失消融实验，在每个模型系列内保持模型架构、初始化、机器人训练数据和训练步数固定。在所见任务的干净条件下，预测监督分别将成功率提高了24.38和27.91个百分点。轨迹聚类进一步揭示，在若干粗略轨迹簇内成功率更高，其中包括簇频率变化较小的情况，这表明收益并非仅体现在轨迹模式分布的变化上。然而，这些益处并未在分布偏移下持续存在：未见任务上的提升因模型和任务而异，而两种模型在评估的环境随机化条件下成功率均较低，预测监督并未带来一致的优势。我们进一步引入未来视频预测作为\( \pi_{0.5} \)的辅助训练目标，其中仅在训练期间使用的轻量级Transformer预测器将成功率从82.94%提升至89.19%。这些发现支持未来视频预测作为动作学习的有效辅助监督，同时区分了在熟悉任务上改进执行与可靠迁移之间的差异，并表明此类收益在所评估的设置中并不一定依赖于大型预训练视频扩散Transformer（DiT）。
tldr: This paper investigates whether future-video prediction as auxiliary supervision improves robot action learning, showing success gains on seen tasks but inconsistent transfer under distribution shifts, and demonstrating benefits can come from a lightweight transformer rather than a large video DiT.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了未来视频预测作为辅助监督是否提升机器人动作学习，发现在熟悉任务上成功率提升，但在分布偏移下迁移不一致，并证明了轻量Transformer而非大型视频DiT即可带来收益。

title: Sparse Recovery Bird's-Eye View Model Soup for Robust Camera-Based 3D Object Detection
summary: Camera-based bird's-eye view (BEV) perception methods such as Fast-BEV have demonstrated promising results with fast inference speed and competitive accuracy. However, their robustness to real-world corruptions remains insufficiently explored, posing risks for autonomous driving deployment where environmental variations are inevitable. In this paper, we propose Sparse Recovery Bird's-Eye View Model Soup (SR-BEVS), a sparse recovery learning approach that simultaneously improves clean accuracy and corruption robustness without requiring additional data or architectural modifications. Our method identifies pruning candidates based on layer-wise weight magnitudes, applies random pruning to create diverse sparse models, and retrains each model with a randomly sampled learning rate. By averaging these diverse recovered models into a single dense model, we achieve enhanced robustness against various corruptions while introducing zero inference overhead. We further provide a mode connectivity analysis demonstrating that our pruning-based diversification preserves the connected low-loss basin necessary for stable weight averaging. Experiments on the nuScenes dataset demonstrate up to 33.8% improvement in corruption robustness and a 1.8% gain in clean accuracy over the Fast-BEV baseline, with consistent improvements across sensor noise, weather distortions, and illumination changes. Our simple yet effective approach may be applicable to other BEV models.
summary_zh: 基于摄像头的鸟瞰图感知方法，如Fast-BEV，已展现出快速推理速度和竞争力精度的良好效果。然而，这些方法对现实世界环境退化的鲁棒性尚未得到充分探索，这给自动驾驶部署带来了潜在风险，因为环境变化不可避免。本文提出了稀疏恢复鸟瞰图模型汤（SR-BEVS），一种稀疏恢复学习方法，可在无需额外数据或架构修改的情况下，同时提升干净精度和退化鲁棒性。该方法基于层间权重幅值确定剪枝候选，应用随机剪枝生成多样化的稀疏模型，并以随机采样的学习率对每个模型进行重训练。通过将这些多样化的恢复模型平均融合为单一稠密模型，我们在引入零推理开销的同时增强了对多种退化的鲁棒性。我们进一步提供了模式连通性分析，表明基于剪枝的多样化策略保留了稳定权重平均所需的连通低损失盆地。在nuScenes数据集上的实验表明，相较于Fast-BEV基线，退化鲁棒性提升了高达33.8%，干净精度提升了1.8%，并在传感器噪声、天气失真和光照变化方面均取得了一致的改进。我们提出的方法简单有效，或可推广至其他BEV模型。
tldr: SR-BEVS applies sparse recovery weight averaging to Fast-BEV, improving both clean accuracy and corruption robustness for camera-based 3D object detection in autonomous driving, with zero inference overhead.
tldr_zh: SR-BEVS 通过对 Fast-BEV 应用稀疏恢复权重平均，在零推理开销下同时提升了干净精度和损坏鲁棒性，适用于自动驾驶中的相机三维目标检测。

title: RSKD: Grounding Semantic Consistency in Driving VLMs via Distillation
summary: Knowledge distillation can transfer large multimodal models to compact models for autonomous driving, but uniform token-level matching can dilute planning-relevant semantics and amplify teacher errors. We propose RSKD, a semantic-consistency-guided distillation framework that routes supervision according to both the task importance of an answer phrase and its semantic consistency with the teacher prediction. Task-critical semantic phrases are localized in the ground-truth answer, and a phrase-level consistency score controls the balance between Jensen--Shannon divergence (JSD) distillation and ground-truth supervision. Teacher information is emphasized only where it is semantically consistent, while semantically inconsistent phrases receive stronger ground-truth supervision. We evaluate RSKD on DrivingVQA, LingoQA, and MapLMv2. RSKD improves over the compared student-based baselines on DrivingVQA and LingoQA and remains competitive on MapLMv2.
summary_zh: 知识蒸馏能够将大型多模态模型迁移至适用于自动驾驶的紧凑模型，但统一的词元级匹配可能会稀释与规划相关的语义信息，并放大教师模型的错误。为此，我们提出RSKD——一种基于语义一致性引导的蒸馏框架，该框架根据答案短语的任务重要性及其与教师预测之间的语义一致性来分配监督信号。在基准真实答案中定位任务关键语义短语，并通过短语级一致性分数来调节杰森-香农散度（JSD）蒸馏与基准真实监督之间的平衡。仅在语义一致的部分强调教师信息，而对于语义不一致的短语则加强基准真实监督。我们在DrivingVQA、LingoQA和MapLMv2上对RSKD进行了评估。与所比较的基于学生的基线方法相比，RSKD在DrivingVQA和LingoQA上均有提升，并在MapLMv2上保持竞争力。
tldr: RSKD proposes a semantic-consistency-guided knowledge distillation framework for compact driving vision-language models, routing between distillation and ground-truth supervision based on phrase-level semantic consistency.
tldr_zh: RSKD 提出一种语义一致性引导的知识蒸馏框架，用于紧凑型驾驶视觉语言模型，基于短语级语义一致性在蒸馏与真实标注监督之间进行路由。

title: From Language to Drives: A Multimodal Framework for Aligning Autonomous Robots with Human Purposes
summary: This work explores a multimodal approach to the alignment of the behavior of open-ended learning autonomous robots with human purposes through the use of large language models as cultural enablers. While autonomous robots can generate their own skills and goals through interaction with the environment, they often lack mechanisms to ensure that these remain relevant and aligned to those of human users. The proposed approach makes use of the general and cultural knowledge contained in LLMs and VLMs to establish a multimodal interactive alignment process in which human purposes, expressed in natural language, are transformed into motivational components of a robot architecture in the form of robot missions and drives that guide the behavior of the robot. The system is structured into three layers for semantic alignment, mission generation, and drive modeling. This design enables a bidirectional interaction loop: human inputs define high-level purposes, robots expand them into executable missions making use of multimodal information relayed by LLMs and VLMs, and feedback maintains alignment with human intent. Experiments in simulation and with a physical robot demonstrate that the process produces valid missions and behaviors, supporting effective human-agent alignment in interactive scenarios with autonomous robots.
summary_zh: 本工作探索了一种多模态方法，通过利用大型语言模型作为文化使能器，实现开放式学习自主机器人行为与人类意图的对齐。尽管自主机器人可以通过与环境交互生成自身技能和目标，但它们往往缺乏相应机制来确保这些技能和目标与人类用户的相关性及一致性。所提出的方法利用大型语言模型和视觉语言模型中所包含的通用知识与文化知识，建立了一个多模态交互式对齐过程，在这一过程中，以自然语言表达的人类意图被转化为机器人架构中的动机组件，具体表现为引导机器人行为的机器人任务与驱动力。该系统分为三个层次：语义对齐层、任务生成层和驱动力建模层。这一设计实现了双向交互回路：人类输入定义高层次意图，机器人借助大型语言模型和视觉语言模型传递的多模态信息将意图扩展为可执行任务，同时反馈机制维持与人类意图的对齐。在仿真环境及物理机器人上的实验表明，该过程能够生成有效的任务和行为，支持在与自主机器人的交互场景中实现高效的人机意图对齐。
tldr: This paper presents a multimodal framework that uses LLMs and VLMs to translate human natural-language purposes into robot missions and drives, enabling alignment of autonomous robot behavior with human intent in interactive scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种多模态框架，利用LLM和VLM将人类自然语言意图转化为机器人任务和驱动力，在交互场景中实现自主机器人行为与人类意图的对齐。

title: Distributed Predictive Flocking for a Swarm of Miniature Vibration-Driven Robots in a Confined Arena
summary: Coordinating many miniature robots in a confined arena, with no leader, central planner, or global map, is a core challenge for swarm robotics. As the swarm grows denser, collision avoidance becomes the limiting factor, and the number of safely coexisting robots depends on the formulation of the inter-robot safety constraint. We present a distributed predictive flocking controller in which each robot solves its own nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) problem, optimizing swarm cohesion and alignment costs, inter-robot and obstacle safety, and a task objective, while exchanging only predicted trajectories with local neighbors. Within this generalized controller architecture, solved in real time, we compare six barrier and control-barrier-function (CBF) safety formulations on a digital twin of an open-source vibration-driven bristlebot in a $0.64\,\mathrm{m^2}$ arena. A look-ahead discrete-time CBF performs best overall, with the fewest collisions and the widest inter-robot margins across nearly every swarm size tested. We deploy it on phototaxis, phototactic orbiting, and cohesion without a stimulus tasks, using swarm sizes starting from ten robots and up to the geometric packing limit. The swarm holds well: collisions stay low in small swarms, rising steeply as the packing limit approaches, while coordination and cohesion degrade gently rather than collapsing. The swarm is found not to trade safety for order, keeping both across the confined arena, with local alignment high at every swarm size.
summary_zh: 协调大量微型机器人在受限场地中运动，且没有领导者、中央规划器或全局地图，是群体机器人学的核心挑战。随着群体密度增大，碰撞避免成为限制因素，能够安全共存的机器人数量取决于机器人间安全约束的设定形式。我们提出了一种分布式预测群集控制器，其中每个机器人独立求解自身的非线性模型预测控制问题，优化群体内聚与对齐代价、机器人间及障碍物安全约束以及任务目标，同时仅与局部邻居交换预测轨迹。在该可实时求解的通用控制器架构下，我们在一个开放源码的振动驱动 bristlebot 的数字孪生平台上，于 $0.64\,\mathrm{m^2}$ 的场地中比较了六种障碍函数与控制障碍函数安全设定形式。前瞻式离散时间控制障碍函数在整体上表现最佳，在几乎所有测试的群体规模下均实现最少碰撞次数和最宽的机器人间距裕度。我们将其部署于趋光、趋光环绕以及无刺激条件下的内聚任务中，群体规模从十台机器人起步，直至几何堆积极限。群体保持良好：小规模群体中碰撞率保持低位，随接近堆积极限而急剧上升，而协同与内聚性能则平缓退化而非骤然崩溃。研究发现，该群体并未以牺牲安全换取秩序，在受限场地中两者兼得，且在所有群体规模下局部对齐度均保持较高水平。
tldr: This paper presents a distributed predictive flocking controller for miniature vibration-driven robots in a confined arena, comparing safety formulations for collision avoidance and demonstrating successful coordination at high densities.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于受限竞技场中微型振动驱动机器人集群的分布式预测聚集控制器，比较了碰撞避免的安全公式，并展示了高密度下的协调能力。

title: VisGeo-PipeTrack: A Visual Geometric Servo Control Framework with MPC-RCAPID Control for UAV-Based Dynamic Pipes Tracking
summary: While unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are increasingly deployed for pipeline inspection, prevailing research predominantly assumes static pipes. In real-world industrial environments, pipes often exhibit dynamic movements, such as vibrations. This imposes more stringent requirements on UAVs' adaptive control and computational efficiency than in static scenarios. Therefore, this paper proposes a servo control framework named VisGeo-PipeTrack, which utilizes geometric constraints to enable UAV tracking of dynamic pipes. To achieve efficient UAV positioning, YOLOv5 is employed to detect labels on the pipe. The positions are derived from visual geometric constraints based on these detected labels to enable precise localization. To address tracking control challenges, a model predictive control based real-time corrected adaptive PID (MPC-RCAPID) controller is proposed. This controller employs the Recursive Least Squares method for real-time model estimation and integrates rolling horizon optimization to dynamically adjust PID parameters. Experiments conducted on both the AirSim simulator and the Tello UAV platform validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework. Simulation comparisons with standard PID, fractional-order PID, adaptive PID, and fuzzy PID demonstrate that MPC-RCAPID achieves the shortest settling time (3.26 s) and the lowest average tracking error (3.52%). In physical experiments on the Tello platform, compared with standard PID control, MPC-RCAPID reduces the average tracking error by 55.52%, 26.72%, and 26.52% across the three test dimensions. These results demonstrate that VisGeo-PipeTrack facilitates efficient autonomous tracking in dynamic pipe environments.
summary_zh: 虽然无人机在管道巡检中的应用日益广泛，但现有研究大多假设管道是静态的。然而，在真实的工业环境中，管道往往表现出动态运动，例如振动。这相较于静态场景，对无人机的自适应控制和计算效率提出了更为严苛的要求。为此，本文提出了一种名为VisGeo-PipeTrack的伺服控制框架，利用几何约束实现无人机对动态管道的跟踪。为实现高效的无人机定位，采用YOLOv5检测管道上的标签，并基于这些检测到的标签，通过视觉几何约束推导出无人机位置，从而实现精确定位。针对跟踪控制难题，提出了一种基于模型预测控制实时校正的自适应PID控制器（MPC-RCAPID）。该控制器采用递归最小二乘法进行实时模型估计，并集成滚动时域优化，以动态调整PID参数。在AirSim仿真器和Tello无人机平台上进行的实验验证了所提框架的有效性。与标准PID、分数阶PID、自适应PID和模糊PID的仿真对比结果表明，MPC-RCAPID具有最短的调节时间（3.26秒）和最低的平均跟踪误差（3.52%）。在Tello平台的物理实验中，与标准PID控制相比，MPC-RCAPID在三个测试维度上的平均跟踪误差分别降低了55.52%、26.72%和26.52%。这些结果表明，VisGeo-PipeTrack能够在动态管道环境中实现高效的自主跟踪。
tldr: This paper proposes a visual geometric servo control framework for UAVs to track dynamic pipes, using YOLOv5 for detection and an MPC-based adaptive PID controller for real-time tracking, validated in AirSim and on a Tello UAV.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于视觉几何伺服控制的无人机动态管道跟踪框架，利用YOLOv5检测和MPC自适应PID实现实时跟踪，并在AirSim和Tello平台上验证。

title: Reward-Guided RRT* for Budgeted Task and Motion Planning
summary: Robotic missions involving spatially distributed tasks often require jointly selecting rewarding locations and planning feasible motions under limited travel budgets. This paper proposes Reward-Guided RRT*, a new sampling-based framework that constructs a budget-feasible mission through a sequence of locally joint task-selection-and-motion-planning stages, evaluated directly in the continuous state space, without requiring a precomputed task-transition graph. The method incrementally builds a mission using reward-guided RRT* searches, while a return-feasibility procedure ensures that each selected task can be visited without violating the mission budget. Experiments with increasing obstacle complexity and number of tasks show solutions comparable to VNS-PRM* while requiring substantially fewer sampled states. We also extend the framework to Dubins steering and evaluate it in CoppeliaSim with a scaled car-like robotic platform, demonstrating its ability to incorporate vehicle kinematic constraints.
summary_zh: 机器人任务中涉及空间分布的多目标任务时，通常需要在有限的行程预算下，联合选择高价值位置并规划可行运动路径。本文提出了一种名为奖励引导RRT*的新颖基于采样的框架，该框架通过一系列局部联合任务选择与运动规划阶段，直接连续状态空间中进行评估，构建预算可行的任务方案，且无需预计算任务转换图。该方法利用奖励引导的RRT*搜索逐步构建任务方案，同时通过返回可行性检查过程确保所选每个任务均可在不违反任务预算的前提下被访问。在障碍复杂度与任务数量逐步增加的实验中，该方法所得解与VNS-PRM*相当，但所需采样状态数量显著更少。此外，我们将该框架扩展至Dubins转向模型，并在CoppeliaSim仿真环境中使用缩比类车机器人平台进行了验证，展示了其纳入车辆运动学约束的能力。
tldr: The paper introduces Reward-Guided RRT*, a sampling-based method for budgeted task and motion planning that jointly selects tasks and plans motions in continuous state space without a precomputed task graph, and validates it on car-like robots in simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Reward-Guided RRT*，一种基于采样的预算受限任务与运动规划方法，在连续状态空间中联合选择任务并规划运动，无需预计算任务转移图，并在类车机器人仿真中验证。

title: Context-dependent Runtime Construction of Safe Regions of Attraction from Design-Time Identification for Multi-Candidate Simplex Architectures
summary: Deploying safety-critical cyber-physical systems requires control strategies that reconcile high performance and adaptability with rigorous safety guarantees. Classical control strategies offer stability proofs but are conservative, while advanced optimization- and learning-based controllers achieve high performance but lack formal verification. Runtime Assurance (RTA) architectures bridge this gap by introducing their own (dis-)advantages. Safety filters use online optimization and introduce chattering, while Simplex permissiveness is bounded by the tightness of the certified Region of Attraction (RoA) of its High-Assurance (HA) controller. Targeting this conservatism, we present a two-stage RoA certification procedure leveraging contraction-based stability to establish a target set for Taylor-model-based reachability analysis. We then treat the closed-loop system under HA control as a switched system, enabling: (a) runtime construction of context-dependent safe RoA and (b) safe switching between HA candidates to optimize recovery and maximize the operating envelope of the uncertified High-Performance (HP) controller. We validate this framework on a robotic path-tracking task using a three-stage evaluation: Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE) simulation for theoretical verification, high-fidelity Gazebo simulation under unmodeled dynamics, and experiments on physical hardware. Results show that the Simplex architecture maintains safety under fault injection and successfully shields a behavioral-cloning-trained HP controller. Crucially, the decision module introduces negligible overhead (0.028 ms average, 4.13 ms worst-case), consuming under 10 % of the control period.
summary_zh: 部署安全关键的网络物理系统，需要控制策略在兼顾高性能与适应性的同时，严格保证安全性。经典控制策略虽能提供稳定性证明，但偏于保守；而先进的基于优化与学习的控制器虽实现了高性能，却缺乏形式化验证。运行时保障（RTA）架构通过引入自身的利弊来弥合这一鸿沟。安全滤波器采用在线优化，会引入抖振现象；而Simplex架构的许可性受限于其高保障（HA）控制器所认证的吸引域（RoA）的紧密程度。针对这一保守性问题，我们提出了一种两阶段RoA认证程序，利用基于收缩的稳定性来为基于泰勒模型的可达性分析建立目标集。随后，我们将HA控制下的闭环系统视为切换系统，从而实现：（a）运行时构建依赖于情境的安全RoA，以及（b）在HA候选控制器之间安全切换，以优化恢复过程并最大化未经认证的高性能（HP）控制器的运行包络。我们通过三阶段评估在机器人路径跟踪任务上验证了该框架：常微分方程（ODE）仿真用于理论验证，高保真Gazebo仿真在未建模动态下进行，以及物理硬件实验。结果表明，Simplex架构在故障注入下保持了安全性，并成功防护了经行为克隆训练的HP控制器。关键在于，决策模块引入了可忽略的开销（平均0.028毫秒，最坏情况4.13毫秒），占控制周期不到10%。
tldr: This paper presents a two-stage RoA certification procedure using contraction-based stability and Taylor-model reachability to enable runtime construction of context-dependent safe regions for multi-candidate Simplex architectures, validated on a robotic path-tracking task with simulations and hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种两阶段RoA认证程序，利用基于收缩的稳定性和泰勒模型可达性，为多候选Simplex架构实现上下文相关的安全区域运行时构建，并在机器人路径跟踪任务中通过仿真和硬件进行了验证。

title: Localization-Uncertainty-Aware UAV Swarm Search for GNSS-Denied Maritime Surveillance
summary: This paper studies UAV swarm search in GNSS-denied maritime environments, where inter-UAV ranging drives cooperative localization and uncertainty propagates along the multi-hop reference chain, affecting connectivity, collision avoidance, and search effectiveness. We propose an uncertainty-aware control barrier function (CBF) framework approximating cascading localization covariance through Fisher information matrices. First, the cascading covariance model captures how ranging noise and neighbor uncertainty accumulate along the localization chain. Second, uncertainty-tightened CBFs incorporate the covariance model and its rate into margins for connectivity maintenance and collision avoidance, with conditional invariance and graceful-degradation bounds. Third, a hierarchical Voronoi-target strategy with formation keeping supports efficient forward-looking coverage. The distributed controller is validated with a standard unbiased extended Kalman filter in the loop. The framework is demonstrated on several polygon shapes and swarm sizes from 6 to 30 sUAVs. An estimator-in-the-loop run completes the search in 302.5 s, 20 Monte Carlo deployments confirm repeatable completion with all local QPs feasible and containment in at least 98.97% of UAV-frames, and six MBZIRC runs provide estimator-in-the-loop evidence. The source code is publicly available.
summary_zh: 本文研究了全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）拒止环境下无人机集群的海上搜索问题。在此场景中，无人机间的测距驱动协同定位，而不确定性沿多跳参考链传播，影响连通性、避碰性能及搜索效率。为此，本文提出一种基于不确定性感知控制障碍函数（CBF）的框架，通过费希尔信息矩阵近似级联定位协方差。首先，级联协方差模型刻画了测距噪声与邻居不确定性沿定位链的累积过程；其次，不确定性收紧的CBF将协方差模型及其变化率引入连通性维持和避碰的安全裕度中，并具备条件不变性与优雅退化界；最后，结合编队保持的分层Voronoi目标分配策略，实现高效的前视覆盖。所提分布式控制器通过标准无偏扩展卡尔曼滤波器（EKF）进行闭环验证，并在多种多边形构型及6至30架小型无人机（sUAV）规模下完成实验。估计器在环运行在302.5秒内完成搜索任务；20次蒙特卡洛部署确认任务可重复完成，所有局部二次规划（QP）可行，且至少98.97%的无人机框架满足约束包含条件；六次MBZIRC实验进一步提供了估计器在环的实证支持。源代码已公开。
tldr: This paper proposes an uncertainty-aware control barrier function framework for UAV swarm search in GNSS-denied maritime environments, using cascading localization covariance models and hierarchical Voronoi-target strategies to maintain connectivity and collision avoidance while ensuring efficient coverage.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向GNSS拒止海事环境中无人机群搜索的不确定性感知控制屏障函数框架，通过级联定位协方差模型和分层Voronoi目标策略来维持连通性和避碰，同时保证高效覆盖。

title: SceneAgent: An Agentic Pipeline from 3D and 4D Captures to Simulation Environments
summary: Visual captures provide detailed scene appearance, but converting them into interactive simulation environments requires object reconstruction, physical modeling, and correction of intermediate errors. We present SceneAgent, an agentic pipeline that coordinates these steps through simulator-based visual inspection and repair. The pipeline processes 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), photogrammetry, LiDAR captures, AI-generated 3DGS scenes, and 4D videos of dynamic scenes, and combines object segmentation, physical parameter estimation, part decomposition, articulation, and deformable simulation. To support policy learning, SceneAgent generates diverse object variants ("digital sisters") and scripted demonstrations. On a cluttered bin scene from GraspClutter6D, SceneAgent raises F1 at 1 cm for every coding agent with scorable outputs both with and without its skills, and its reconstructions are better than SimFoundry: all agent configurations exceed SimFoundry's F1 score, with a best of 60.75% versus 6.9%. On three dynamic scenes from 4DCodeBench, SceneAgent raises the mean dynamic IoU of Gemini 4 Argon from 0.86% to 99.09%. We further demonstrate diverse simulated interactions and preliminary policy transfer to a real robot.
summary_zh: 视觉捕获能够提供详细的场景外观，但将其转化为交互式模拟环境需要对象重建、物理建模以及中间误差的修正。我们提出了SceneAgent，一个智能体流水线，通过基于模拟器的视觉检查与修复来协调这些步骤。该流水线可处理3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）、摄影测量、激光雷达捕获、AI生成的3DGS场景以及动态场景的4D视频，并整合对象分割、物理参数估计、部件分解、关节化以及可变形仿真。为支持策略学习，SceneAgent生成多样化的对象变体（“数字孪生姐妹”）以及脚本化演示。在来自GraspClutter6D的杂乱料箱场景中，SceneAgent将每个可输出评分的编码智能体在1厘米处的F1分数提升，无论是否使用其技能，其重建效果均优于SimFoundry：所有智能体配置的F1分数均超过SimFoundry，最佳达到60.75%，而SimFoundry仅为6.9%。在来自4DCodeBench的三个动态场景中，SceneAgent将Gemini 4 Argon的平均动态IoU从0.86%提升至99.09%。我们进一步展示了多样化的模拟交互以及向真实机器人初步的策略迁移。
tldr: SceneAgent is an agentic pipeline that converts 3D/4D captures into interactive simulation environments via simulator-based visual inspection and repair, enabling policy learning and transfer.
tldr_zh: SceneAgent 是一个智能体流水线，通过基于模拟器的视觉检查和修复，将3D/4D捕捉转换为交互式模拟环境，支持策略学习和迁移。

title: Intrinsic Goals for Autonomous Agents: Hierarchical Exploration Captures Future Volitional Action in Drosophila
summary: Animals have a remarkable capacity for autonomy---driven by intrinsic motivation---without external sensory cues or extrinsic objectives, yet the computational mechanisms behind this ability largely remain a mystery. We combine whole-brain recordings in the fruit fly (Drosophila melanogaster), which reveal neural representations of spontaneous exploratory decisions more than 10 seconds in advance, with a neuromechanical digital twin to test whether optimizing intrinsic goals yields realistically embodied artificial agents that quantitatively match fly behavior and internal representations of future volitional action during exploration. Our hierarchical policy selects from a discrete library of low-level motor primitives, consistent with ethological theories of behavioral syllables. We train agents without external reward using 20 intrinsic motivation algorithms spanning curiosity, entropy, and competency methods. The agents are evaluated in a virtual tethered-ball assay modeled on the fly experiment, comparing spontaneous locomotor statistics and internal representations and decoding future turn direction from kinematics and neural activity on the same timescales observed in flies. DIAYN, a hierarchical competency algorithm learning discrete policies that maximize behavioral entropy and the separability of induced sensory observations, achieves the strongest joint behavioral and neural prospective coding performance relative to flies. Its learned policies closely capture individual variability in fly exploration strategies, suggesting that this diversity serves to maximize state-space coverage at the population level. DIAYN's latent activity also closely captures the sum-difference rule for interhemispheric encoding of kinematics in biological flies. These results establish hierarchical, intrinsically motivated agents as a powerful framework for reverse-engineering animal autonomy.
summary_zh: 动物具有通过内在动机驱动的显著自主能力，这种能力无需外部感官线索或外在目标即可实现，然而其背后的计算机制在很大程度上仍是未解之谜。我们将果蝇（黑腹果蝇）的全脑记录——该记录揭示了自发性探索决策在提前10秒以上的神经表征——与神经力学数字孪生相结合，以检验优化内在目标是否能够产生逼真的具身人工代理，使其在行为上定量匹配果蝇，并在内部表征上复现探索过程中未来意志性动作的神经编码。我们的层级策略从离散的低层运动原语库中进行选择，这与行为音节学的动物行为学理论相一致。我们使用涵盖好奇心、熵和能力方法的20种内在动机算法，在无外部奖励的条件下训练代理。代理在模拟果蝇实验的虚拟拴球装置中接受评估，比较自发运动统计量及内部表征，并在与果蝇观察相同的时标上，从运动学和神经活动中解码未来转向方向。DIAYN——一种学习离散策略以最大化行为熵和所诱发感官观测可分离性的层级能力算法——在与果蝇的对比中，实现了最强的行为与神经前瞻编码联合表现。其学习到的策略紧密捕捉了果蝇探索策略中的个体差异，表明这种多样性在群体层面上旨在最大化状态空间覆盖。DIAYN的潜在活动还紧密复现了生物果蝇中运动学半球间编码的和差规则。这些结果确立了层级内在动机代理作为逆向工程动物自主性的强大框架。
tldr: This paper uses whole-brain recordings in Drosophila and a neuromechanical digital twin to show that hierarchical intrinsically motivated agents, particularly DIAYN, can match fly exploratory behavior and neural representations of future volitional action, providing a framework for reverse-engineering animal autonomy.
tldr_zh: 本文利用果蝇全脑记录和神经力学数字孪生，证明层次化内在动机智能体（特别是DIAYN）能够匹配果蝇的探索行为和未来意志动作的神经表征，为逆向工程动物自主性提供了框架。
