title: Rendering-Free Event Frame Simulation for Fast Reinforcement Learning of Autonomous Robot Navigation
summary: Event cameras offer low latency, high dynamic range, and milliwatt-level power consumption, making them ideal for agile robots such as tiny drones navigating through cluttered environments. However, existing simulators generally render photorealistic images before converting them into events, making large-scale reinforcement learning prohibitively slow. We propose an analytic event simulator that exploits what event cameras fundamentally measure - moving contrast edges - to synthesize event streams directly from scene geometry and ego-motion without visual rendering. Our simulator generates a 64x64 event observation in 17 microseconds on a single GPU - over 400x faster than a state-of-the-art rendering pipeline - enabling end-to-end reinforcement learning for goal-directed obstacle avoidance to converge in under 30 minutes - three orders of magnitude faster than training on rendered events. Policies transfer zero-shot to physically based event simulations (ray-traced Isaac Sim). Our policy reaches 83% success in cluttered courses unseen during training (mid-difficulty, traversability probability approx. 0.57), at 2.4 m/s average goal velocity, and retains 70% in a simulated texture-dense indoor hall. Furthermore, we quantized the policy to a 1.2 MB int8 network running fully onboard a 56-gram Crazyflie equipped with a Prophesee GenX320 event camera and an OpenMV N6 microcontroller board. Without any fine-tuning, external processing, or positioning, the policy achieves an average success rate of 82% (5/5, 5/6, 4/6 flights) across three real-world obstacle courses of increasing difficulty. Code: https://github.com/tudelft/rendering-free-event-nav
authors: Guido C. H. E. de Croon
summary_zh: 事件相机具有低延迟、高动态范围和毫瓦级功耗等优势，使其非常适合在杂乱环境中导航的微型无人机等敏捷机器人。然而，现有模拟器通常先渲染逼真图像再将其转换为事件，导致大规模强化学习速度极慢。我们提出了一种解析式事件模拟器，利用事件相机的基本测量原理——运动对比度边缘——直接从场景几何和自运动合成事件流，无需视觉渲染。我们的模拟器在单个GPU上仅需17微秒即可生成64×64的事件观测，比最先进的渲染管线快400倍以上，从而使得目标导向避障的端到端强化学习能在30分钟内收敛，比基于渲染事件的训练快三个数量级。训练得到的策略可零样本迁移至基于物理的事件模拟（光线追踪的Isaac Sim）。在训练中未出现的杂乱场景中（中等难度，可通过性概率约0.57），我们的策略实现了83%的成功率，平均目标速度达2.4米/秒，在模拟的高纹理室内大厅中保持了70%的成功率。此外，我们将策略量化为1.2MB的int8网络，完全部署在一架配备Prophesee GenX320事件相机和OpenMV N6微控制器板的56克Crazyflie无人机上。在无任何微调、外部处理或定位辅助的情况下，该策略在三个难度递增的真实世界障碍物场景中实现了82%的平均成功率（5/5、5/6、4/6次飞行）。代码地址：https://github.com/tudelft/rendering-free-event-nav
tldr: The paper introduces a rendering-free analytic event camera simulator that synthesizes event streams directly from scene geometry and ego-motion, enabling fast reinforcement learning for autonomous drone navigation. The policy transfers to real-world flights on a tiny drone with high success rates.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种免渲染的解析事件相机模拟器，直接从场景几何和自身运动合成事件流，从而加速自主无人机导航的强化学习。策略能迁移到真实世界的小型无人机上并取得高成功率。

title: World Dreamer v5-lite: A Multi-Robot World Action Model with One Dreamer
summary: Multi-robot control requires integrating distributed camera views while predicting separate action sequences. Most vision-language-action and world-action models target one robot. Combining multiple views alone does not establish spatial correspondence between them. World Dreamer v5-lite is a multi-robot world-action model built around a shared world state for robot-specific action prediction. Calibrated features from a pretrained video encoder populate this state in workspace coordinates; its spatial size remains fixed as views are added. A vision-language model provides scene context and one query per robot. The queries read the shared state and exchange pose-aware information, while their action streams remain separate. Masked-view cooperative training withholds selected camera views from both visual branches while retaining all action targets. This encourages the use of observations shared by other robots. Pretraining uses more than 10,000 hours of trajectories from 20 simulated robot types, RoboFactory, and real robots. On RoboFactory, World Dreamer v5-lite achieves 74.0% mean success, 23.7 percentage points above the strongest evaluated baseline. Across four real-robot tasks, it reaches 78.8% mean success, a margin of 13.8 points. It also reaches 58.08% overall on RoboCasa365.
summary_zh: 多机器人控制需要在预测各自独立动作序列的同时，整合分布于不同摄像头的视角信息。大多数视觉-语言-动作模型及世界-动作模型均面向单一机器人设计。仅拼接多个视角并不能建立它们之间的空间对应关系。World Dreamer v5-lite 是一种多机器人世界-动作模型，围绕共享世界状态实现面向特定机器人的动作预测。来自预训练视频编码器的标定特征以工作空间坐标填充该状态；随着视角数量的增加，其空间尺寸保持不变。视觉-语言模型提供场景上下文，并为每个机器人生成一个查询向量。这些查询读取共享状态并交换携带位姿信息的内容，而其动作流则保持相互独立。掩蔽视角协作训练从两个视觉分支中同时剔除部分选定的相机视角，同时保留全部动作目标，从而鼓励模型利用其他机器人共享的观测信息。预训练数据包含来自20种仿真机器人类型、RoboFactory以及真实机器人的超过10,000小时轨迹。在RoboFactory上，World Dreamer v5-lite 取得了74.0%的平均成功率，较最强评估基线高出23.7个百分点。在四项真实机器人任务中，其平均成功率达到78.8%，领先13.8个百分点。此外，在RoboCasa365上，其整体成功率达到58.08%。
tldr: World Dreamer v5-lite introduces a multi-robot world-action model with a shared workspace-coordinate world state, robot-specific queries, and masked-view cooperative training, achieving strong simulated and real-robot success rates.
tldr_zh: World Dreamer v5-lite 提出了一种多机器人世界动作模型，通过共享工作空间坐标的世界状态、每机器人查询和掩码视图协作训练，在仿真和真实机器人任务中取得了显著成功率。

title: VLA-Stem: A Lightweight Safety Mechanism for Vision-Language-Action Models via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate high-level reasoning with low-level action execution for end-to-end robotic control. However, most VLA models target static manipulation in unconstrained environments, overlooking spatial constraints and dynamic obstacles. Fine-tuning VLAs on obstacle-avoidance data is a straightforward solution, but collecting such data is costly, especially for dynamic scenarios, and may degrade their original task capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose VLA-Stem, a lightweight, reinforcement-learning-based safety mechanism for VLA systems. Without fine-tuning the underlying VLA policy, VLA-Stem converts its action chunks into motion references and uses trajectory-level guidance to preserve their spatial intent while allowing flexible motion and timing adjustments. Conditioned on these references, robot proprioception, and local obstacle information, the Stem policy adaptively modifies execution at inference time, preserving the original task intent while enabling responsive adaptation to spatial constraints and dynamic obstacles. For robust and sample-efficient training, we combine teacher-student distillation with curriculum learning. We evaluate VLA-Stem on reference following, static spatial constraints, and dynamic obstacle avoidance. Across six constrained simulation settings, VLA-Stem achieves 52.8% average collision-free task success versus 23.7% for the strongest safety baseline, while preserving base-policy performance in obstacle-free settings; real-world experiments further show consistent collision reductions under static and dynamic obstacles. These results demonstrate that VLA-Stem couples high-level VLA task intent with rapid, reflex-like responses to immediate physical risks, providing a brainstem-inspired mechanism for robust robot execution.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型将高层推理与低层动作执行相结合，用于端到端机器人控制。然而，大多数VLA模型面向无约束环境中的静态操作，忽视了空间约束和动态障碍物。在避障数据上微调VLA是一种直接的解决方案，但收集此类数据成本高昂，尤其对于动态场景，且可能削弱其原有任务能力。为应对这些局限，我们提出VLA-Stem，一种基于强化学习的轻量级VLA系统安全机制。在不微调底层VLA策略的前提下，VLA-Stem将其动作片段转换为运动参考，并利用轨迹级引导保留其空间意图，同时允许灵活的运动与时序调整。以这些参考、机器人本体感知及局部障碍物信息为条件，Stem策略在推理时自适应地调整执行过程，既保留原始任务意图，又能对空间约束和动态障碍物做出响应性适应。为实现鲁棒且样本高效的训练，我们将师生蒸馏与课程学习相结合。我们在参考跟随、静态空间约束和动态避障三种场景下评估VLA-Stem。在六种受限仿真设置中，VLA-Stem的平均无碰撞任务成功率达52.8%，而最强安全基线仅为23.7%，同时在无遮挡环境中保持了基础策略的性能；真实世界实验进一步表明，在静态和动态障碍物下均能持续降低碰撞率。这些结果表明，VLA-Stem将VLA高层任务意图与对即时物理风险的快速反射式响应相结合，为机器人鲁棒执行提供了一种受脑干启发的机制。
tldr: VLA-Stem is a lightweight, reinforcement-learning-based safety mechanism that adaptively modifies a frozen VLA policy's action chunks at inference time to avoid static and dynamic obstacles while preserving task intent, improving collision-free task success in constrained simulation and real-world settings.
tldr_zh: VLA-Stem 是一种基于强化学习的轻量级安全机制，在推理时自适应调整冻结的 VLA 策略的动作块以避开静态和动态障碍物，同时保留任务意图，在受限仿真和真实环境中提高了无碰撞任务成功率。

title: Tokens of Motion: Primitive Motion Learning for Human-Humanoid Skill Transfer
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide a promising paradigm for scalable robotic manipulation, yet their reliance on success-only behavioral cloning leaves them brittle; lacking corrective training signals, minor execution errors rapidly compound into unrecoverable, out-of-distribution failures. To address this limitation, we propose Adaptive Failure-Informed Learning (AFIL), an end-to-end framework that leverages failure trajectories as adaptive negative guidance for diffusion- and flow-based VLA policies. AFIL uses a pretrained VLA to generate failure rollouts online, avoiding the need for handcrafted failure-mode design or human-in-the-loop recovery. It then jointly trains Dual Action Generators (DAGs) for successful and failed behaviors while sharing a common vision-language backbone, enabling efficient failure-aware policy learning with limited parameter overhead. During sampling, the failure generator adaptively steers action generation away from failure-prone regions and toward more reliable success modes, with guidance strength determined by the per-diffusion-step distance between success and failure distributions. Experiments across in-domain and out-of-domain robotic manipulation tasks, covering both short- and long-horizon settings, show that AFIL consistently improves task success rates and robustness over existing VLA baselines, demonstrating its effectiveness, efficiency, and generality.
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为可扩展的机器人操作提供了一种有前景的范式，然而其仅依赖成功行为克隆的机制使其显得脆弱；由于缺乏纠正性训练信号，微小的执行误差会迅速累积为不可恢复的分布外失败。为解决这一局限，我们提出了自适应失败信息学习（AFIL），这是一种端到端框架，利用失败轨迹作为基于扩散和流的VLA策略的自适应负向引导。AFIL使用预训练的VLA在线生成失败回放，避免了对手工设计失败模式或人工介入恢复的需求。随后，它联合训练成功与失败行为的双动作生成器（DAGs），同时共享共同的视觉-语言骨干网络，从而在有限参数开销下实现高效的失败感知策略学习。在采样过程中，失败生成器自适应地将动作生成从易失败区域引导至更可靠的成功模式，引导强度由每个扩散步骤中成功与失败分布之间的距离决定。跨领域内和领域外机器人操作任务的实验，涵盖短程和长程两种设置，表明AFIL相比现有VLA基线持续提升了任务成功率和鲁棒性，验证了其有效性、高效性和泛化能力。
tldr: AFIL improves VLA policies by using failure trajectories as adaptive negative guidance during diffusion/flow-based training and sampling, enhancing robustness and success rates in robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: AFIL 利用失败轨迹作为自适应负向引导，改进扩散/流式 VLA 策略的训练与采样，提升机器人操作的鲁棒性和成功率。

title: Vision-Language-Action or World-Action? Just Action Models
summary: The vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action model (WAM) communities debate whether control policies should inherit pretrained knowledge from vision-language models or from visual generators. The debate, however, bundles three separable choices: backbone initialization, the objective applied to future observations, and whether the machinery for that future loss is kept at inference. A gap between a VLA and a WAM therefore cannot simply be attributed to any one of them. We show that decoupling these choices yields a common framework for both families, which we term Just Action Model (JAM): a pretrained visual backbone with an action expert, trained with an action loss and a foresight loss. The foresight loss trains current-observation features to predict frozen encodings of the recorded future through a prediction head discarded after training, so no visual generation is involved in either training or inference, and the backbone can be chosen freely. We first compare objectives within fixed policy architectures, then evaluate the foresight recipe across backbone families. The resulting JAM policies outperform their matched FastWAM and ImageWAM counterparts on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, and achieve similar or slightly higher success rates on RoboTwin. Compared with FastWAM, JAM improves the success rates from 97.0%/55.3%/91.2% to 98.2%/64.5%/91.4%, respectively. With cached foresight targets, JAM reduces estimated online training FLOPs per sample per update by 73% relative to FastWAM. Our results show that future supervision improves control without visual generation or additional inference machinery, and strong foresight performance is attainable with either generator-initialized or vision-language backbones. Project Page: https://y0uroy.github.io/JAM
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型与世界-动作模型（WAM）两个研究阵营围绕控制策略应当继承来自视觉-语言模型还是视觉生成器的预训练知识展开了争论。然而，这一争论实际上混淆了三个可分离的选择：骨干网络初始化方式、未来观测所施加的损失目标，以及该未来损失所需机制在推理阶段是否保留。因此，VLA与WAM之间的性能差距不能简单地归因于其中任何一个因素。我们证明，将这三个选择解耦后可以得到一个统一框架，涵盖上述两个模型家族，我们将其称为“纯动作模型”（Just Action Model, JAM）：即一个预训练的视觉骨干网络搭配一个动作专家模块，以动作损失和前瞻损失联合训练。前瞻损失通过一个在训练后被丢弃的预测头，训练当前观测特征去预测已录制未来的冻结编码，因此在训练和推理过程中均不涉及视觉生成，且骨干网络可以自由选择。我们首先在固定策略架构内比较不同损失目标， затем在多种骨干网络家族上评估前瞻训练方案。由此得到的JAM策略在LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus基准上均优于对应的FastWAM和ImageWAM模型，在RoboTwin上则达到相近或略高的成功率。与FastWAM相比，JAM将成功率分别从97.0%/55.3%/91.2%提升至98.2%/64.5%/91.4%。借助缓存的前瞻目标，JAM在每次更新的每个样本上的估计在线训练FLOPs较FastWAM减少了73%。我们的结果表明，未来监督能够在无需视觉生成或额外推理机制的条件下提升控制性能，并且无论是使用生成器初始化的骨干网络还是视觉-语言骨干网络，均可实现强劲的前瞻性能。项目页面：https://y0uroy.github.io/JAM
tldr: The paper proposes Just Action Model (JAM), a framework that decouples backbone initialization, future-observation objective, and inference machinery to unify VLA and WAM approaches, showing that future supervision improves robot control without visual generation, outperforming FastWAM on LIBERO benchmarks with reduced training FLOPs.
tldr_zh: 本文提出Just Action Model (JAM)框架，将骨干网络初始化、未来观测目标和推理机制解耦，统一VLA和WAM方法，证明未来监督可在无视觉生成的情况下提升机器人控制性能，在LIBERO基准上超越FastWAM并降低训练计算量。

title: Retrieve to Act: Motion Primitive Graph Retrieval for Robust VLA Execution
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies demonstrate remarkable semantic generalization, yet remain highly vulnerable to out-of-distribution (OOD) visual shifts during execution. While existing test-time methods attempt to suppress spurious visual cues, they fundamentally overlook the rich, uncorrupted kinematic priors embedded in the policy's own training experience. We introduce Retrieve to Act (R2A), a test-time scaling framework that formulates OOD robustness purely as a geometric motion primitive retrieval problem. R2A bypasses fragile visual features by structuring successful training demonstrations into an offline spatiotemporal motion primitive graph. During inference, a query-dependent Graph Neural Network dynamically localizes the robot's ongoing execution within this graph, retrieving structurally compatible future motion primitives. These retrieved geometric priors are then seamlessly harmonized with the frozen VLA's predicted actions via a learned, dimension-wise gating mechanism, adaptively rectifying erroneous spatial trajectories while preserving the policy's local reactivity. Extensive experiments across three state-of-the-art VLA architectures, GR00T N1.7, $π_{0.5}$, and StableVLA, demonstrate that R2A consistently and significantly enhances robustness against diverse contextual perturbations. R2A achieves absolute success rate improvements of up to +12% in simulation benchmarks (LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin2.0-Plus) and +40% in real-world deployments, without requiring any finetuning of the base policies. Project page: https://retrieve2act.github.io/r2a/
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略展现出卓越的语义泛化能力，但在执行过程中对分布外（OOD）视觉变化仍高度敏感。现有测试时方法虽然试图抑制虚假视觉线索，但本质上忽视了策略自身训练经验中蕴含的丰富且未受损的运动学先验。我们提出“检索以行动”（R2A），一种测试时扩展框架，将OOD鲁棒性纯粹建模为几何运动基元检索问题。R2A通过将成功的训练演示构建为离线时空运动基元图，绕过了脆弱的视觉特征。在推理阶段，查询相关的图神经网络动态定位机器人当前执行在图中的位置，检索结构兼容的未来运动基元。这些检索到的几何先验随后通过习得的逐维度门控机制与冻结的VLA预测动作无缝融合，在保持策略局部响应性的同时自适应纠正错误的空间轨迹。在三种最先进的VLA架构——GR00T N1.7、$π_{0.5}$和StableVLA——上的广泛实验表明，R2A在各种上下文扰动下持续且显著地增强了鲁棒性。R2A在仿真基准（LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin2.0-Plus）中实现了高达+12%的绝对成功率提升，在真实世界部署中提升达+40%，且无需对基础策略进行任何微调。项目页面：https://retrieve2act.github.io/r2a/
tldr: R2A is a test-time scaling framework that improves VLA robustness to out-of-distribution visual shifts by retrieving geometrically compatible motion primitives from an offline graph and blending them with frozen policy outputs via learned gating, showing consistent gains across simulation and real robot benchmarks.
tldr_zh: R2A 是一种测试时扩展框架，通过从离线图中检索几何上兼容的运动基元，并使用学习到的门控机制与冻结的 VLA 策略输出融合，从而提升 VLA 策略对分布外视觉变化的鲁棒性，在仿真和真实机器人基准上均显示出一致提升。

title: From 12 to 200 Demonstrations: How ACT, Diffusion Policy, SmolVLA and $π_{0.5}$ Scale on a Low-Cost Arm
summary:
We trained four widely used imitation-learning policies, ACT, Diffusion Policy, SmolVLA and $π_{0.5}$, on nested subsets of 12, 25, 50, 100 and 200 teleoperated demonstrations of one pick-and-place task with distractor objects, using one fixed training recipe per policy. Every trained model was then run on a physical SO-101 arm on a fixed set of object placements: 1,340 scored episodes in 126 blocks.
  ACT, trained from scratch, rose from 1 success in 40 episodes at 12 demonstrations to 37 in 40 at 100. $π_{0.5}$ with its action expert fine-tuned was the best policy when data was scarce (16 of 40 at 12 demonstrations, 28 of 40 at 25) and then stayed near 70%; from 100 demonstrations ACT was ahead, by a margin this study does not fully resolve. SmolVLA and Diffusion Policy peaked near 50%, and both were affected by a failure to start: SmolVLA's arm never started moving in 47% of episodes, and Diffusion Policy hardly ever started until an idle lead-in was trimmed from the demonstrations. For $π_{0.5}$ the fine-tuning recipe mattered more than the amount of data: low-rank adaptation succeeded in 4 of 110 episodes, against 130 of 200 for action-expert fine-tuning.
  From the joint and camera recordings we place every episode on a four-stage ladder (started, reached the ball, carried it, delivered it) and show that for ACT more data moves failures from reaching, to grasping, to none, while the failures $π_{0.5}$ retains are in grasping. We also measure how weak a ten-episode block is as a measurement (the same checkpoint tested twice differs by 2 successes in 10 on average), separate seed-to-seed variation from that noise, and audit the human scoring against the recordings. Training length was fixed within each recipe, so the amount of data and the number of times it was seen change together; we state which conclusions survive that confound and which do not.
summary_zh:
我们针对一个包含干扰物的抓放任务，在12、25、50、100和200次遥操作演示的嵌套子集上，采用每种策略固定不变的训练配置，训练了四种广泛使用的模仿学习策略：ACT、Diffusion Policy、SmolVLA和$π_{0.5}$。随后，每个训练好的模型均在物理SO-101机械臂上，针对一组固定的物体摆放位置进行测试：共126组、1，340次计分回合。

从零训练的ACT，其成功率从12次演示时的40回合中成功1次，提升至100次演示时的40回合中成功37次。在数据稀缺场景下，采用动作专家微调的$π_{0.5}$表现最佳（12次演示时40回合成功16次，25次演示时40回合成功28次），之后稳定在70%左右；从100次演示开始，ACT反超领先，但本研究所显示的领先幅度尚不完全明确。SmolVLA和Diffusion Policy的成功率峰值接近50%，且两者均受到启动失败的影响：SmolVLA的机械臂在47%的回合中从未开始运动，而Diffusion Policy在从演示中去除空闲引导段之前几乎无法启动。对于$π_{0.5}$而言，微调方法比数据量更为关键：低秩适配在110回合中仅成功4次，而动作专家微调在200回合中成功130次。

基于关节和相机记录，我们将每个回合划分为四个阶段阶梯（启动、到达球体、抓取球体、投放球体），并表明对于ACT，更多数据使失败从“到达”阶段转移到“抓取”阶段，再最终消除；而$π_{0.5}$剩余的失败集中在“抓取”阶段。我们还量化了十回合组作为评估样本的薄弱性（同一检查点测试两次，平均差异为10回合中相差2次成功），将种子间变异与上述噪声区分开，并根据记录对人工评分进行了审核。每种配置的训练时长固定，因此数据量和数据被观测的次数同时变化；我们明确指出哪些结论在该混杂因素下依然成立，哪些则不再成立。
tldr: This paper systematically benchmarks four imitation learning policies (ACT, Diffusion Policy, SmolVLA, and π0.5) on a low-cost robotic arm across varying numbers of demonstrations, revealing scaling trends and failure modes, with π0.5 excelling in low-data regimes and ACT dominating with more data.
tldr_zh: 论文在低成本机械臂上系统比较了ACT、Diffusion Policy、SmolVLA和π0.5四种模仿学习策略在不同演示数量下的扩展性能，揭示了各自的扩展趋势和失效模式，其中π0.5在数据稀缺时表现最佳，而ACT在数据充足时更优。

title: GAWM: A Compact Latent World-Action Model for Multi-Task Robot Manipulation
summary: World-action models (WAMs) incorporate the prediction of future observations into robot policy learning. However, most WAMs build on billion-parameter vision-language or video-generation backbones, which incur high training cost and inference latency. In this letter, we present GAWM (Geometry-Aware World Model), a compact multi-task WAM that predicts future observations in the latent space of a frozen DINOv3 encoder. GAWM compresses the features of each camera view into a small set of tokens. A lightweight predictor, conditioned on the task rather than on actions, forecasts these tokens at two future horizons. The forecast is supervised with the dense patch features of future frames, which requires it to encode the spatial layout of the future scene. An action decoder directly regresses a chunk of future actions from the current and predicted tokens. With fewer than 100M parameters and no robot or video pretraining, GAWM outperforms billion-parameter WAMs on RoboTwin 2.0 and performs comparably to billion-parameter VLAs on LIBERO. On a dual-arm robot, it achieves lower action-prediction error on held-out demonstrations than a fine-tuned billion-parameter VLA, with substantially lower inference latency. Ablation studies show that the latent world model substantially improves performance when training data or training time is limited. Code is available at https://github.com/gaoxiang12/ga-wm.
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）将未来观测的预测融入机器人策略学习之中。然而，大多数WAMs基于数十亿参数的视觉-语言或视频生成骨干网络，导致训练成本高、推理延迟大。本文提出GAWM（几何感知世界模型，Geometry-Aware World Model），一种紧凑的多任务WAM，在冻结的DINOv3编码器的潜空间中预测未来观测。GAWM将每个相机视角的特征压缩为一小组令牌。一个轻量级预测器以任务而非动作为条件，在两个未来时间范围内预测这些令牌。预测结果以未来帧的密集块特征作为监督信号，要求其编码未来场景的空间布局。动作解码器直接从当前及预测令牌中回归出一段未来动作序列。在参数少于1亿且无需机器人或视频预训练的情况下，GAWM在RoboTwin 2.0上超越了数十亿参数的WAMs，并在LIBERO上与数十亿参数的VLAs表现相当。在双臂机器人上，其在留存演示上的动作预测误差低于微调后的数十亿参数VLA，且推理延迟显著更低。消融研究表明，当训练数据或训练时间有限时，潜世界模型能够显著提升性能。代码已开源至 https://github.com/gaoxiang12/ga-wm。
tldr: This paper proposes GAWM, a compact latent world-action model for multi-task robot manipulation that predicts future observations in the latent space of a frozen visual encoder, using a task-conditioned predictor and an action decoder, achieving strong performance with under 100M parameters and low inference latency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出GAWM，一种紧凑的潜在世界动作模型，用于多任务机器人操作，在冻结视觉编码器的潜在空间中预测未来观测，通过任务条件预测器和动作解码器，以不到1亿参数和低推理延迟实现强劲性能。

title: Keeping Contact: Task-Adaptive Friction Margins for Bimanual Non-Prehensile Manipulation
summary: Maintaining contact in non-prehensile manipulation requires more than nominal friction cone feasibility: a force barely inside the cone and one well inside it are both feasible, but they provide different margins against slip and contact loss. This paper uses signed friction distance to measure friction margin in force space and derives a task-adaptive margin from the force correction needed to balance pivot moment deviations in bimanual tilting. The resulting contact margins are embedded in a sequence of second-order cone programs (SOCPs), each giving a globally optimal contact force solution at a tilt angle. The optimizer balances the object about an environmental pivot while keeping robot and pivot contact forces away from the nominal friction boundary. Optimizer-level results show interpretable force redistribution and adaptation to object property changes. Real-world experiments demonstrate successful execution under object property variations and model mismatch, while fixed margin and no-margin comparisons illustrate the importance of adapting the margin to task demand. These results support signed friction distance margins as a force planning mechanism for maintaining contact in bimanual non-prehensile manipulation. Project page: https://keeping-contact.github.io/
summary_zh: 维持非抓取操作中的接触，其要求并不仅限于名义上的摩擦锥可行性：一个恰好位于锥内的力和一个深度位于锥内的力虽均可行，但二者在抵御滑动和接触丧失方面所提供的裕度却有所不同。本文采用有符号摩擦距离来度量力空间中的摩擦裕度，并基于平衡双臂倾斜操作中枢轴力矩偏差所需的力修正量，推导出一种任务自适应的裕度。由此得到的接触裕度被嵌入一系列二阶锥规划（SOCP）中，每个规划在给定倾斜角度下提供全局最优的接触力解。该优化器在使机器人及环境枢轴接触力远离名义摩擦边界的同时，实现物体绕环境枢轴的平衡。优化器层面结果展示了可解释的力再分配及对物体属性变化的适应性。真实世界实验验证了在物体属性变化和模型失配条件下的成功执行，而与固定裕度及无裕度方案的对比则凸显了根据任务需求调整裕度的重要性。上述结果支持将有符号摩擦距离裕度作为双臂非抓取操作中维持接触的一种力规划机制。项目页面：https://keeping-contact.github.io/
tldr: This paper introduces a task-adaptive friction margin based on signed friction distance for bimanual non-prehensile manipulation, embedded in SOCPs to maintain contact and balance objects against environmental pivots, validated in real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文针对双臂非抓取操作，提出基于符号摩擦距离的任务自适应摩擦裕度，并嵌入二阶锥规划中以维持接触并平衡物体，通过真实实验验证。

title: ActiveAlign: Aligning Egocentric Manipulation via Active Perception
summary: Real-to-Sim-to-Real (Real2Sim2Real) enables structured world representations for planning, interpretability, and safe execution. Most existing approaches rely on passive perception, which creates real2sim gaps due to imperfect observation. Inspired by how humans perceive actively through actions, we propose ActiveAlign, a framework that leverages active perception to align the Real2Sim2Real gap from interactions. ActiveAlign introduces two complementary modules: (i) ActiveAlign-Waving, which performs hand-eye calibration by exploiting active hand motions and differentiable rendering, and (ii) ActiveAlign-Touching, which refines object alignment through tactile feedback to achieve millimeter-level precision. Together, these capabilities enable strong real2sim alignment. We demonstrate that ActiveAlign-Waving can be used to curate simulation environments for open-sourced uncalibrated robot manipulation datasets, and demonstrate on a real Unitree G1 robot that ActiveAlign enables fine manipulation of millimeter-scale objects such as pressing buttons and moving sliders.
summary_zh: 真实到仿真再到真实（Real2Sim2Real）通过结构化的世界表示，为规划、可解释性和安全执行提供了支持。然而，大多数现有方法依赖被动感知，由于观测不完善，容易产生真实与仿真之间的差距。受人类通过动作进行主动感知方式的启发，我们提出了ActiveAlign框架，利用主动感知来弥合Real2Sim2Real中的差距。ActiveAlign引入了两个互补模块：(i) ActiveAlign-Waving，通过主动手部运动和可微渲染实现手眼标定；(ii) ActiveAlign-Touching，通过触觉反馈优化物体对齐，达到毫米级精度。这两种能力的结合实现了强大的真实与仿真对齐效果。我们验证了ActiveAlign-Waving可用于为开源未标定机器人操作数据集构建仿真环境，并在真实的宇树G1机器人上展示了ActiveAlign能够实现毫米级物体的精细操作，如按压按钮和拨动滑块。
tldr: ActiveAlign uses active perception (waving and touching) to align Real2Sim2Real gaps for robot manipulation, achieving millimeter-level precision on a real Unitree G1 robot.
tldr_zh: ActiveAlign通过主动感知（挥手和触摸）来对齐真实到仿真到真实的差距，在真实的Unitree G1机器人上实现了毫米级精度的精细操作。

title: Trace-WAM: Learning to Act via 3D Motion Prediction for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) learn representations for robot control by coupling future visual prediction with action generation. Successful manipulation depends primarily on how the robot and task-relevant objects evolve, whereas future-video prediction must also reconstruct the appearance and background of the entire scene. We therefore propose Trace-WAM, which augments video-action learning with future 3D motion prediction as an auxiliary objective. This objective supervises temporal point correspondence together with image-plane displacement and depth change, directly describing the interaction dynamics and spatial changes involved in manipulation. To this end, we adopt a three-branch Mixture-of-Transformer (Tri-MoT) architecture to jointly learn video prediction, motion prediction, and action generation. The motion expert predicts future trajectories from current visual features, allowing motion supervision to shape the representations used for action generation. Because the action expert does not consume predicted trajectories, inference retains the current-observation policy path: a single visual forward pass followed by action denoising. Experiments on RoboCasa-GR1, LIBERO, and LIBERO-Plus demonstrate strong in-distribution performance and out-of-distribution generalization, with particularly clear gains over Fast-WAM under limited demonstrations and distribution shifts.
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过将未来视觉预测与动作生成相结合，学习用于机器人控制的表现形式。成功操作主要取决于机器人与任务相关物体如何演变，而未来视频预测还必须重建整个场景的外观与背景。为此，我们提出Trace-WAM，将未来三维运动预测作为辅助目标，增强视频-动作学习。该目标同时监督时间点对应关系以及图像平面位移和深度变化，直接描述操作中涉及的交互动态与空间变化。为实现此目标，我们采用三分支Transformer混合架构（Tri-MoT），联合学习视频预测、运动预测和动作生成。运动专家根据当前视觉特征预测未来轨迹，使运动监督能够塑造用于动作生成的表现形式。由于动作专家不消耗预测轨迹，推理过程保持当前观测的策略路径：一次视觉前向传播，随后进行动作去噪。在RoboCasa-GR1、LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus上的实验表明，该方法具有出色的分布内性能和分布外泛化能力，尤其在有限演示样本和分布偏移情况下，相较于Fast-WAM表现出显著优势。
tldr: Trace-WAM enhances World Action Models by adding 3D motion prediction as an auxiliary objective, improving robot manipulation performance and generalization with a three-branch Mixture-of-Transformer architecture.
tldr_zh: Trace-WAM 通过添加 3D 运动预测作为辅助目标来增强世界动作模型，利用三分支混合 Transformer 架构提高机器人操作性能和泛化能力。

title: HC2Robot: Hyper-Connection Transformers with Predicted Foresight for Multi-Terrain Humanoid Parkour
summary: Humanoid parkour requires robots to reason about future footholds and whole-body motions over highly discontinuous terrain. We revisit the information asymmetry in asymmetric actor-critic learning for perceptive humanoid locomotion: the critic exploits privileged simulator signals during training, whereas the deployable actor operates solely from onboard perception. We argue that the key is not exposing privileged information to the actor, but learning a deployable approximation of it to narrow the information gap between training and deployment. We present HC2Robot, a deployable perceptive humanoid parkour framework consisting of a Predicted Foresight Module (PFM) and a Hyper-Connection (HC) Transformer. PFM predicts from deployable observations the policy-conditioned timing, location, and support quality of each foot's next touchdown event, converting privileged supervision into a deployable latent representation that provides the actor with predicted touchdown information without privileged runtime sensing. The HC Transformer further enhances temporal reasoning through learnable multi-stream routing, while a future motion prediction head provides short-horizon motion priors for regularization. Across stairs, gaps, high platforms, and slopes, HC2Robot achieves a mean simulated traversal success rate of 97.60% and consistently higher safe foothold rates than strong perceptive locomotion baselines, supporting improved traversal performance and geometric foothold support under deployable sensing.
summary_zh: 类人机器人跑酷要求机器人在高度不连续的地形上推理未来的落脚点及全身运动。我们重新审视了非对称演员-评论家学习框架中用于感知类人机器人运动的信息不对称问题：在训练过程中，评论家利用特权模拟器信号，而可部署的演员仅依赖机载感知信息。我们认为，关键不在于将特权信息直接暴露给演员，而在于学习其可部署的近似形式，以缩小训练与部署之间的信息差距。我们提出了HC2Robot，一个可部署的感知类人机器人跑酷框架，包含预测前瞻模块（PFM）和超连接（HC）Transformer。PFM从可部署观测中预测每个脚下一次触地事件的策略条件化时间、位置及支撑质量，将特权监督转化为可部署的潜在表征，使演员无需特权运行时感知即可获得预测的触地信息。HC Transformer通过可学习的多流路由进一步增强时序推理能力，同时未来的运动预测头提供短视界运动先验用于正则化。在楼梯、间隙、高平台和坡道上，HC2Robot实现了97.60%的平均模拟穿越成功率，并且安全落脚点率始终高于强感知运动基线，从而在可部署感知条件下提升了穿越性能和几何落脚点支撑能力。
tldr: This paper introduces HC2Robot, a framework for humanoid parkour that uses a Predicted Foresight Module and a Hyper-Connection Transformer to predict future foothold timing, location, and support quality from deployable observations, bridging the information asymmetry between teacher and student policies and achieving high traversal success and safe foothold rates in simulation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了HC2Robot，一种用于人形跑酷的框架，通过预测前视模块和超连接Transformer从可部署观测中预测未来落脚点的时机、位置和支撑质量，弥合教师与学生策略之间的信息不对称，并在仿真中实现了高穿越成功率和安全落脚点率。

title: TAPESTRY: A Single Backbone for Video Generation and Robot Control
summary: Pretrained video generation models encode rich priors about physical interactions, but leveraging them for robot control typically requires either resource-intensive video generation at test time or action heads trained from scratch that do not fully utilize the pretrained backbone. We introduce Tokenizing Actions as Video Patches in a Shared Transformer Policy (TAPESTRY), a world action model that repurposes a pretrained video diffusion transformer into a robotic policy without requiring video generation at inference. Our key idea is to treat robot actions as single-patch tokens in the video model's latent space. A lightweight linear projection maps each action timestep to the patch dimensions of the pretrained VAE, and the resulting tokens are processed by the same patchifying layers and transformer backbone used for video. The shared backbone is optimized through three diffusion objectives sampled per minibatch element: Video diffusion uses VAE latents from robot and human videos to establish dynamics priors. Joint video+action diffusion trains on robot demonstrations using a coupled diffusion timestep and an asymmetric attention mask. Action-only diffusion denoises actions conditioned on clean image latents. At test time, the model generates a compact action token sequence in a single DDIM step from pure noise, producing smooth action chunks at 84 ms per action chunk on consumer hardware and avoiding the cost of full video generation. Across simulation benchmarks and real-robot experiments, TAPESTRY achieves strong performance with substantially lower inference cost than comparable joint video--action policies. More information can be found at https://tapestry-wam.github.io.
summary_zh: 预训练的视频生成模型编码了关于物理交互的丰富先验知识，但将其用于机器人控制通常需要在测试时进行资源密集型的视频生成，或从头训练未能充分利用预训练主干网络的动作头。我们提出了一种名为TAPESTRY（Tokenizing Actions as Video Patches in a Shared Transformer Policy）的世界动作模型，该模型将预训练的视频扩散Transformer重新用作机器人策略，而无需在推理时进行视频生成。我们的关键思想是将机器人动作视为视频模型潜空间中的单块（single-patch）令牌。一个轻量级线性投影将每个动作时间步映射到预训练VAE的块维度，生成的令牌由用于视频的相同分块层和Transformer主干网络处理。共享主干网络通过每个小批量元素采样的三个扩散目标进行优化：视频扩散利用来自机器人和人类视频的VAE潜变量建立动力学先验；联合视频+动作扩散在机器人示范数据上训练，采用耦合扩散时间步和非对称注意力掩码；仅动作扩散在干净图像潜变量条件下对动作进行去噪。在测试时，模型通过单步DDIM从纯噪声中生成紧凑的动作令牌序列，在消费级硬件上以每个动作块84毫秒的速度产生平滑的动作块，避免了完整视频生成的代价。在仿真基准测试和真实机器人实验中，TAPESTRY实现了强性能，且推理成本远低于同等联合视频-动作策略。更多信息请访问 https://tapestry-wam.github.io。
tldr: TAPESTRY repurposes a pretrained video diffusion transformer into a robotic world action model by tokenizing actions as video patches, enabling efficient action generation without full video synthesis at inference.
tldr_zh: TAPESTRY 将预训练的视频扩散变压器改造为机器人世界动作模型，通过将动作视为视频补丁，在不生成完整视频的情况下高效生成动作。

title: RynnWorld-Latent: A Cross-Embodiment World Model Conditioned on Universal Latent Actions
summary: Learning controllable world dynamics from heterogeneous interaction videos is challenging because robot embodiments use incompatible action spaces, while human videos lack native control labels. We present RynnWorld-Latent, a cross-embodiment video world model that uses the 3D-grounded latent actions introduced by RynnLAM as a shared conditioning interface. This representation enables joint pretraining on human interaction videos, robot demonstrations, and simulation rollouts without requiring a common native action space. Built on a pretrained video transformer, RynnWorld-Latent combines global action tokens with an identity-initialized local pathway that aligns actions with future video latents. We pretrain on 23 datasets comprising approximately 553.5M frames and adapt the model to target robots through post-training. The framework supports two data-generation routes: digital teleoperation uses target robot commands to generate action-video demonstrations, while latent-action synthesis transfers source motion to an edited initial frame and pairs the resulting rollout with retargeted pseudo robot actions. Experiments show improved video prediction metrics on public benchmarks and two real-robot platforms, alongside qualitative action following when different action sequences share the same initial observation. Synthetic mid-training improves policy success rates on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, and both generation routes improve real-world policy success rates over real-demonstration-only training in the evaluated settings. These results support universal latent actions as a scalable interface for learning controllable visual dynamics across heterogeneous embodiments.
summary_zh: 从异构交互视频中学习可控的世界动力学颇具挑战性，原因在于机器人本体采用不兼容的动作空间，而人类视频缺乏原生控制标签。我们提出RynnWorld-Latent，一种跨本体视频世界模型，利用RynnLAM引入的基于三维接地潜在动作作为共享条件接口。该表示使得在人类交互视频、机器人演示和仿真 rollout 上的联合预训练成为可能，且无需共同的原生动作空间。RynnWorld-Latent 基于预训练的视频 transformer 构建，将全局动作令牌与身份初始化的局部路径相结合，使动作与未来视频潜在表示对齐。我们在包含约5.535亿帧的23个数据集上进行预训练，并通过后训练将模型适配到目标机器人。该框架支持两条数据生成路径：数字遥操作利用目标机器人命令生成动作-视频演示，而潜在动作合成则将源动作迁移到编辑后的初始帧，并将生成的 rollout 与重定向的伪机器人动作配对。实验表明，在公开基准和两个真实机器人平台上，视频预测指标有所提升，且在不同动作序列共享同一初始观测时，动作跟随表现呈现定性改善。合成中期训练提升了LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus上的策略成功率，且在评估设置中，两条生成路径均较仅使用真实演示的训练提升了真实世界策略成功率。这些结果支持通用潜在动作作为跨异构本体学习可控视觉动力学的可扩展接口。
tldr: RynnWorld-Latent introduces a cross-embodiment video world model conditioned on 3D-grounded latent actions from RynnLAM, enabling joint pretraining on human and robot data for controllable video prediction and policy data generation. Experiments show improved world model metrics and real-robot policy success via synthetic mid-training and data generation.
tldr_zh: RynnWorld-Latent 提出了一种基于通用潜在动作的跨具身视频世界模型，利用RynnLAM的3D潜在动作作为共享条件接口，在人类与机器人异构数据上联合预训练，并通过合成数据生成提升真实机器人策略成功率。

title: TOPS: Reshaping Flow Source and Transport for Multi-Task Robot Manipulation
summary: Flow-based policies for language-conditioned multi-task manipulation commonly share a single $\textit{Gaussian}$ source prior and a common linear transport path across tasks. However, reliably executing multiple tasks with distinct motion requirements remains challenging for a shared policy. We introduce $\textbf{TOPS}$ ($\textbf{T}$ask-$\textbf{O}$riented $\textbf{P}$riors and $\textbf{S}$chedules), which adapts the flow source prior and interpolation schedule to each task without modifying the network architecture. TOPS first constructs multimodal task sources from reverse-mapped expert action sequences, allowing language instructions to select where generation begins. Guided by source-target covariance mismatch, it then slows the transition toward expert actions early in denoising and accelerates it later along directions requiring expansion. Under a $\textit{Gaussian}$ endpoint model, our analysis shows that this schedule adjustment can lower an upper bound on velocity-prediction risk. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and CALVIN demonstrate improved performance across in-distribution, perturbation and cross-environment settings, alongside better data efficiency. Using one integration step, TOPS raises LIBERO-10 success from $53.44\%$ to $69.67\%$ compared with ten-step Standard Flow Matching (FM), while reducing inference time to approximately one-sixth of the baseline. TOPS also yields consistent gains when transferred to the large-scale flow-based $π_{0.5}$ policy across all four evaluated settings. Real-world experiments further demonstrate improved task success, including an increase from $20\%$ with standard FM to $80\%$ with TOPS on the upper-drawer opening task.
summary_zh: 基于流的语言条件多任务操作策略通常共享单一的高斯源先验和跨任务的线性传输路径。然而，对于共享策略而言，可靠执行具有不同运动需求的多个任务仍具挑战性。我们提出**TOPS**（**任**务**导**向先验与**调**度），该方法在不修改网络架构的前提下，将流源先验和插值调度分别适配至每个任务。TOPS首先从反向映射的专家动作序列中构建多模态任务源，使语言指令能够选择生成的起始位置。随后，在源-目标协方差不匹配的引导下，TOPS在去噪早期放慢向专家动作的过渡，并在需要扩展的方向上加速后期过渡。在高斯端点模型下，我们的分析表明，这种调度调整可以降低速度预测风险的上界。在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和CALVIN上的实验表明，TOPS在分布内、扰动及跨环境场景中均提升了性能，同时具备更高的数据效率。仅使用单步积分，TOPS即将LIBERO-10的成功率从十步标准流匹配（FM）的$53.44\%$提升至$69.67\%$，同时将推理时间缩减至基线的约六分之一。将TOPS迁移至大规模基于流的$π_{0.5}$策略时，在全部四个评估场景中均取得一致增益。真实世界实验进一步验证了任务成功率的提升，其中上抽屉开启任务的成功率从标准FM的$20\%$提升至TOPS的$80\%$。
tldr: TOPS adapts the flow source prior and interpolation schedule per task for language-conditioned robot manipulation, improving success rates and inference efficiency on LIBERO, CALVIN, and real-world tasks without changing the network architecture.
tldr_zh: TOPS针对语言条件下的机器人操作任务，按任务调整流生成源和插值调度，在不改变网络结构的情况下提升成功率与推理效率，在LIBERO、CALVIN及真实任务上效果显著。

title: RoboSTD: Zero-Shot Single-to-Dual Transfer via Sagittal Mirroring for Bimanual Learning
summary: Bimanual robot manipulation plays an important role in real-world robotic applications, but the high cost of collecting bimanual demonstrations limits the scalable development of bimanual policy learning. Meanwhile, existing single-arm manipulation data are difficult to directly transfer to bimanual systems due to the Single-to-Dual gap in action spaces, coordination requirements, and arm-side spatial preference. To address this issue, we propose RoboSTD, a zero-shot Single-to-Dual data construction method for bimanual robot learning. RoboSTD first applies sagittal-plane mirroring to observations, proprioception, and actions to construct executable contralateral pseudo-demonstrations. It then uses an LLM to generate structured spatio-temporal coordination constraints that guide the reconstruction of pseudo-bimanual supervision across workspace regions and task stages. We evaluate RoboSTD on the AgileX ALOHA platform in both RoboTwin simulation and real-world settings. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of RoboSTD for bimanual policy learning. Without requiring additional bimanual demonstrations, RoboSTD increases the average number of collected cups to 2.11x that of the single-arm baseline in the cup collection task. Project page: https://huahungy.github.io/RoboSTD/
summary_zh: 双臂机器人操作在现实世界的机器人应用中扮演着重要角色，但采集双臂示范数据的高昂成本限制了双臂策略学习的规模化发展。与此同时，由于动作空间中的单臂到双臂差异、协调性要求以及臂侧空间偏好等问题，现有的单臂操作数据难以直接迁移至双臂系统。为解决这一问题，我们提出了RoboSTD，一种面向双臂机器人学习的零样本单臂到双臂数据构建方法。RoboSTD首先对观测、本体感觉和动作应用矢状面镜像，以构建可执行的对侧伪示范数据。随后，它利用大语言模型生成结构化的时空协调约束，指导在工作空间区域和任务阶段中重建伪双臂监督信号。我们在AgileX ALOHA平台上，于RoboTwin仿真环境和真实世界场景中评估了RoboSTD。实验证明了RoboSTD在双臂策略学习中的有效性。在不额外采集双臂示范数据的情况下，RoboSTD在杯子收集任务中使收集杯子的平均数量达到单臂基线的2.11倍。项目主页：https://huahungy.github.io/RoboSTD/
tldr: RoboSTD proposes a zero-shot method to convert single-arm manipulation demonstrations into bimanual pseudo-demonstrations using sagittal-plane mirroring and LLM-generated coordination constraints, enabling bimanual policy learning without extra bimanual data.
tldr_zh: RoboSTD 提出了一种零样本方法，通过矢状面镜像和 LLM 生成的协调约束将单臂操作演示转换为双臂伪演示，从而无需额外双臂数据即可学习双臂策略。

title: Mimetic Embodiment Transfer of Human-Humanoid Interaction from In-the-Wild Videos
summary: Enabling a humanoid to interact naturally with human partners requires preserving not only individual motions but also the spatial, semantic, and contact relationships underlying the interaction (i.e., hugging, dancing, hand-shaking, etc.). Furthermore, a practical solution should generalize across various humanoid embodiments with distinct morphologies and kinematic constraints. To tackle this challenge, we propose HumiTransfer, a mimetic embodiment transfer framework that converts in-the-wild human-human interaction videos into physically plausible human-humanoid interactions. HumiTransfer first reconstructs 3D human motion with consistent foot-ground contact, then transfers one participant to a target humanoid embodiment via interaction modeling, using weighted joint-relative directions and anatomical offsets to prioritize interaction-critical inter-body relationships, while post-retargeting optimization enforces balance, contact, and collision avoidance. Subsequently, we apply HumiTransfer to 1,200 in-the-wild videos, producing approximately 500,000 frames of diverse interactions for the 26-DoF Unitree R1 Edu and the 23-DoF HighTorque Mini-hi humanoid robot, resulting in our HumiMimic dataset. Across both robots, HumiTransfer achieves superior motion fidelity, preserves inter-body relationships, and maintains contact accuracy compared with existing baselines. Moreover, we demonstrate that HumiMimic supports motion generation methods for synthesizing interactive humanoid motions following a human partner. Finally, our real robot deployments confirm the physical executability of the transferred motions in real-world settings.
summary_zh: 摘要：实现人形机器人与人类伙伴的自然互动，不仅需要保留个体动作，还需维持互动背后蕴含的空间、语义及接触关系（如拥抱、舞蹈、握手等）。此外，一种实用的解决方案还应能够适应具有不同形态和运动学约束的多种人形机器人平台。为应对这一挑战，我们提出HumiTransfer——一种模仿式具身迁移框架，旨在将真实环境中的人类-人类互动视频转化为物理上可行的人形机器人-人类互动。HumiTransfer首先重建具有一致足地接触的三维人体运动，随后通过互动建模将其中一名参与者迁移至目标人形机器人平台，采用加权关节相对方向和解剖学偏移量来优先保留互动关键的人体间空间关系，并通过重定向后的优化确保平衡、接触和碰撞规避。随后，我们将HumiTransfer应用于1200段真实场景视频，生成了约50万帧多样化互动数据，涵盖26自由度Unitree R1 Edu和23自由度HighTorque Mini-hi两款人形机器人，从而构建了HumiMimic数据集。在两款机器人上，与现有基线方法相比，HumiTransfer在运动保真度、人体间关系保持和接触准确性方面均表现更优。此外，我们验证了HumiMimic能够支持运动生成方法，用于合成跟随人类伙伴的互动式人形机器人动作。最后，我们在真实机器人上的部署实验证实了迁移动作在实际环境中的物理可执行性。
tldr: HumiTransfer converts in-the-wild human-human interaction videos into physically plausible human-humanoid interactions, preserving inter-body spatial, semantic, and contact relationships, and supports real-robot deployment on multiple humanoid embodiments.
tldr_zh: HumiTransfer将野外人与人交互视频转化为物理上可行的人-人形机器人交互，保持体间空间、语义和接触关系，并支持多种人形机器人的实际部署。

title: REACH: An RL-based Hierarchical Humanoid Crawling Framework for Adaptable Confined Space Traversal
summary: Humanoid locomotion in confined spaces requires continuous height adaptation across multiple locomotion modes, yet most existing approaches remain limited to height-adjustable bipedal walking. We present REACH, an RL-based hierarchical framework that enables a Unitree G1 humanoid to traverse height-constrained environments through variable-height bipedal walking and crawling. The learned policies regulate body height over complementary command ranges of 1.27--0.50m in bipedal locomotion and 0.50--0.20m in crawling, extending traversal beyond the clearance limits of crouched walking. To address contact-rich crawling dynamics, we employ a history-conditioned latent representation that captures terrain and interaction context from proprioceptive observations. A bidirectional transition policy further connects crouched bipedal locomotion and crawling across large kinematic and contact discontinuities. These skills are integrated with a LiDAR-based planner that converts point clouds into collision-free three-dimensional paths and locomotion commands, including proactive height targets. Real-world experiments demonstrate accurate height and velocity tracking, robust terrain traversal, reliable mode transitions and confined-space traversal with the proposed pipeline. Code and videos are available at https://aislab-sustech.github.io/REACH/.
summary_zh: 在受限空间内的人形机器人移动要求跨越多种移动模式进行连续高度自适应，然而现有方法大多仍局限于可调高度的双足行走。我们提出了REACH，一种基于强化学习的分层框架，使Unitree G1人形机器人能够通过变高度双足行走和爬行穿越高度受限环境。学习到的策略在双足移动中调节身体高度至互补指令范围1.27—0.50m，在爬行中调节至0.50—0.20m，从而将穿越能力拓展至低于蹲姿行走净空极限的范围。为应对接触丰富的爬行动力学，我们采用一种基于历史状态的潜变量表示，从本体感觉观测中捕捉地形和交互上下文。一种双向转换策略进一步连接了蹲姿双足移动与爬行，跨越了大的运动学和接触不连续性。这些技能与基于LiDAR的规划器集成，该规划器将点云转换为无碰撞的三维路径和移动指令，包括前瞻性高度目标。真实世界实验展示了所提管线在精确高度与速度跟踪、稳健地形穿越、可靠模式转换及受限空间穿越方面的性能。代码和视频可在 https://aislab-sustech.github.io/REACH/ 获取。
tldr: REACH introduces a hierarchical RL framework enabling a Unitree G1 humanoid to traverse confined spaces via variable-height bipedal walking and crawling, with a LiDAR-based planner for collision-free paths and real-world validation.
tldr_zh: REACH 提出了一种分层强化学习框架，使 Unitree G1 人形机器人能够通过变高度双足行走和爬行穿越受限空间，并利用 LiDAR 规划器实现无碰撞路径，已在实际环境中验证。

title: CARD: Contact-Anchored Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Humans are dexterous, but traditional data collection paradigms such as teleoperation, kinesthetic teaching, and wearable exoskeletons force humans to act through the robot embodiment, bottlenecking their dexterity. Retargeting can avoid this. However, existing methods purely translate kinematics and ignore the real-world contact dynamics essential for task success. We present CARD: Contact-Anchored Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation, a simulator and object-free framework that retargets human demonstrations to robot actions by explicitly preserving contact force targets. CARD unifies human data sources including video, motion capture, and tactile gloves via a shared hand--contact representation and generates explicit contact force targets in addition to kinematics. To maintain these contact targets during hardware open-loop replay, CARD also introduces a tactile tracking controller. For video which does not contain an explicit tactile source, we present Vid-HACO, our video-to-contact model that sets a new state of the art. Across our video, glove, motion-capture data and the GRAB dataset, CARD maintains contact on $43$--$78\%$ of contact frames, while kinematic and object-aware retargeting methods maintain contact on $<10\%$ and $22.5\%$ of the frames respectively. Further, integrating our formulation into physics-based retargeting improves strict task success from 12\% to 32\% on GRAB dataset. Finally, we show that our tactile tracker is critical to reproduce demonstrated forces during hardware replay. These results establish that contact preservation via CARD is a scalable interface for transferring human dexterity to robots.
summary_zh: 人类灵巧非凡，但传统的数据采集范式，如远程操作、动能教学和可穿戴外骨骼，迫使人类通过机器人本体来行动，从而限制了其灵巧性的发挥。重定向技术则可避免这一问题。然而，现有方法仅纯粹地转换运动学信息，忽略了对于任务成功至关重要的真实接触动力学。我们提出了CARD：面向灵巧操作的接触锚定重定向框架，这是一个无需模拟器及物体的框架，通过显式保留接触力目标，将人类示范重定向为机器人动作。CARD通过共享的手-接触表示统一了包括视频、动作捕捉和触觉手套在内的人类数据源，并生成除运动学之外的显式接触力目标。为在硬件开环回放过程中维持这些接触目标，CARD还引入了一种触觉跟踪控制器。对于不含显式触觉源的视频，我们提出了Vid-HACO，这是一种视频到接触的模型，达到了当前最先进的水平。在我们的视频、手套、动作捕捉数据及GRAB数据集上，CARD在43%至78%的接触帧上保持了接触，而运动学重定向和物体感知重定向方法分别在不到10%和22.5%的帧上保持了接触。此外，将我们的公式整合到基于物理的重定向中，使得GRAB数据集上的严格任务成功率从12%提升至32%。最后，我们展示了触觉跟踪器对于在硬件回放过程中再现示范力的关键作用。这些结果表明，通过CARD实现接触保持，是向机器人迁移人类灵巧性的可扩展接口。
tldr: CARD introduces a contact-anchored retargeting framework that preserves contact force targets from human demonstrations to robot actions, improving dexterous manipulation success across various data sources and enabling hardware replay via a tactile tracking controller.
tldr_zh: CARD 提出了一种以接触为锚定的重定向框架，通过保持接触力目标将人类演示转化为机器人动作，提高了多源数据下的灵巧操作成功率，并通过触觉跟踪控制器支持硬件回放。

title: A Trainable CPG Framework for Quadruped Locomotion
summary: We present CPG-ENN, a trainable quadruped locomotion framework that combines explicit neural coordination with learned motion realization. A symmetry-based eight-neuron central pattern generator (CPG) supplies gait rhythms, while a pretrained, leg-shared execution neural network (ENN) maps rhythmic signals and trajectory parameters to joint-angle references without online inverse kinematics. A single feedback policy modulates six physically interpretable trajectory variables. The controller tracks planar velocity and yaw-rate commands across walk, trot, pace, bound, and pronk without gait-specific learned controllers or transitionspecific rewards. Simulation yields 99.39% transition success across all 20 directed gait pairs and all source-target speed combinations from {0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0} m/s. Ablations show high cross-gait transition feasibility without transition exposure; exposure mainly refines gait acquisition and velocity transients. Comparisons with AllGaits and Walk These Ways demonstrate accurate gait-speed regulation, and Unitree Go2 experiments validate five gaits and their transitions.
summary_zh: 我们提出了CPG-ENN，一个可训练的四足运动框架，将显式神经协调与学习到的运动实现相结合。一个基于对称性的八神经元中央模式发生器（CPG）提供步态节律，而一个预训练的、腿部共享的执行神经网络（ENN）将节律信号和轨迹参数映射为关节角度参考值，无需在线逆运动学计算。一个单一的反馈策略调节六个具有物理可解释性的轨迹变量。该控制器能够在行走、小跑、溜步、跳跃和弹跳五种步态下跟踪平面速度与偏航角速度指令，无需步态特定的学习控制器或转换特定的奖励。仿真实验在全部20个定向步态对以及所有来自{0.5，1.0，1.5, 2.0} m/s的源-目标速度组合中，实现了99.39%的转换成功率。消融实验表明，在没有转换暴露的情况下，跨步态转换可行性很高；暴露主要优化了步态习得和速度瞬态响应。与AllGaits及Walk These Ways方法的对比验证了精确的步态-速度调节能力，Unitree Go2实验则验证了五种步态及其转换的有效性。
tldr: This paper introduces CPG-ENN, a quadruped locomotion framework combining a symmetry-based CPG for gait rhythm generation with a learned execution network and a feedback policy for velocity/yaw tracking, achieving high cross-gait transition success in simulation and validated on a Unitree Go2 robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了CPG-ENN，一种四足运动框架，结合基于对称性的CPG产生步态节律与学习执行网络及反馈策略实现速度/偏航跟踪，仿真跨步态转换成功率高，并在Unitree Go2机器人上验证。

title: GRAFT: Geometry-Aware Residual Adaptation for Foundation Trackers
summary: Humanoid behavior foundation models (BFMs) provide reusable whole-body motion priors: given a kinematic reference, they generate coordinated joint commands for motion replay, teleoperation, and VLA control. However, trained primarily on flat-ground motion, BFMs lack an explicit mechanism to adapt foot placement, swing clearance, and contact timing to local terrain. Many terrain-aware BFM approaches address this limitation by retraining or fine-tuning the tracker together with perception, incurring substantial data and computation costs while coupling ordinary tracking to the perception pathway. To bridge this gap, we propose GRAFT, a geometry-aware residual adaptation framework for frozen behavior trackers. GRAFT preserves the BFM parameters and motion-reference interface, while a lightweight adapter adds terrain-conditioned corrections only to lower-body execution targets. The adapter is trained with task and foot-geometry rewards, regularized to suppress unnecessary corrections on flat ground, and distilled from privileged terrain observations to onboard depth. Because the frozen BFM already provides whole-body reference tracking and nominal locomotion, GRAFT reduces terrain learning to a focused execution-adaptation problem. We instantiate the framework on four frozen trackers and evaluate stairs, gaps, and platforms in simulation. We further validate it through real-world deployment on a Unitree G1, where the adapted SONIC tracker traverses terrain with onboard depth and unmodified references.
summary_zh: 类人行为基础模型（BFMs）提供了可复用的全身运动先验：给定运动学参考，它们能够生成协调的关节指令，用于运动重放、遥操作和VLA控制。然而，由于主要在平地运动数据上训练，BFMs缺乏将足部落点、摆动离地高度和接触时序适应局部地形的显式机制。许多地形感知型BFM方法通过将跟踪器与感知一起重训练或微调来解决这一局限，但此举带来了大量数据和计算成本，同时将普通跟踪与感知通路耦合在一起。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了GRAFT——一种面向冻结行为跟踪器的几何感知残差自适应框架。GRAFT保留了BFM参数和运动参考接口，而一个轻量级适配器仅对下半身执行目标添加地形条件化的修正。该适配器通过任务奖励和足部几何奖励进行训练，并通过正则化抑制平地上的不必要修正，同时从特权地形观测中蒸馏到机载深度信息。由于冻结的BFM已经提供了全身参考跟踪和标称运动能力，GRAFT将地形学习简化为一个聚焦的执行自适应问题。我们在四个冻结跟踪器上实例化了该框架，并在仿真中评估了楼梯、间隙和平台场景。我们进一步通过Unitree G1上的真实世界部署验证了该方法，其中适配后的SONIC跟踪器利用机载深度和未修改的参考成功穿越了复杂地形。
tldr: GRAFT introduces a lightweight, terrain-conditioned residual adapter for frozen humanoid behavior foundation model trackers, enabling them to traverse complex terrain without retraining or modifying the base tracker. The adapter is trained with task and foot-geometry rewards, regularized for flat ground, and distilled from privileged terrain observations to onboard depth, validated in simulation and on a real Unitree G1 robot.
tldr_zh: GRAFT 为冻结的人形行为基础模型追踪器引入轻量级、地形条件化的残差适配器，使其无需重新训练或修改基础追踪器即可穿越复杂地形。适配器通过任务和脚部几何奖励训练，在平地正则化，并从特权地形观测蒸馏到机载深度，在仿真和真实 Unitree G1 机器人上得到验证。

title: Whole-Body Humanoid Control via Stochastic Motion Tokenization
summary: While velocity-commanded RL policies are effective for controlling quadrupeds, they are a limited interface for humanoids that need to perform complex whole-body motions. Furthermore, RL tracking policies for whole-body motions typically have limited information about the desired future motion, preventing them from performing controlled deviations to achieve long-term task success; such information is particularly relevant when a controller must prepare for transitions between behaviors. We address these challenges using concise motion representations that can be generated by a high-level controller, given a behavior label or text command. These representations can be fed directly into a tracking policy to provide a detailed motion reference. Our method exhibits a high degree of flexibility in performing real-world robot motions such as dancing, fighting, or walking based on conditional information. At matched capacity, our adopted stochastic motion tokenizer reconstructs motions from the Unitree G1 at a level that exceeds state-of-the-art approaches such as finite scalar quantization (FSQ) and the vector-quantized autoencoder (VQ-VAE). The resulting discrete interface conditions whole-body tracking policies that execute generated dance, fight, and walk motions lasting 16.8 s each and a 35 s fight-to-dance sequence on a physical Unitree G1.
summary_zh: 虽然基于速度指令的强化学习策略在控制四足机器人方面行之有效，但对于需要执行复杂全身动作的人形机器人而言，这种接口存在局限。此外，用于全身动作跟踪的强化学习策略通常缺乏对预期未来动作的充分信息，使其无法通过受控偏差来实现长期任务成功；当控制器需要为行为之间的转换做准备时，这类信息尤为重要。我们通过由高层控制器根据行为标签或文本指令生成的简洁动作表示来解决这些挑战。这些表示可直接输入跟踪策略，以提供详细的动作参考。我们的方法在执行真实世界机器人动作（如跳舞、搏击或行走）时展现出高度的灵活性，且能够基于条件信息进行生成。在同等容量下，我们采用的随机动作分词器对宇树G1动作的重建质量超过了有限标量量化（FSQ）和向量量化自编码器（VQ-VAE）等现有最优方法。由此产生的离散接口为全身跟踪策略提供了条件，使其能够在实体宇树G1上分别执行持续16.8秒的生成式舞蹈、搏击和行走动作，以及一段35秒的搏击转舞蹈连续动作。
tldr: The paper introduces stochastic motion tokenization to create concise, conditioned motion representations for whole-body humanoid control, enabling a tracking policy to execute complex behaviors like dancing, fighting, and walking on a physical Unitree G1 robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了随机运动标记化方法，生成简洁的条件运动表示，用于控制全身人形机器人，使跟踪策略能够在真实的Unitree G1机器人上执行舞蹈、格斗和行走等复杂行为。

title: SG^2SLAM: Spatial Geometry-Informed 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Monocular Outdoor Navigation
summary: Monocular outdoor navigation requires robust camera motion estimation and a dense, navigable map, where 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM serves this task through an explicit differentiable parameterization and closed-form projection. However, typically, the geometry is recovered by associating 2D pixels with 3D points, so a modular SLAM system absorbs tracking error into the map, leading to cascading degradation. To address these gaps, we present SG^2SLAM, which couples streaming spatial geometry with a ray-conditioned 3DGS kernel. Streaming spatial geometry replaces the per- frame cross-dimensional correspondence with a chunk-level metric prior that supervises tracking and mapping from one source. A ray-conditioned kernel extends each primitive with a viewing-direction subspace that senses the monocular camera viewpoints. The joint optimization over spatial geometry and poses ensures a globally consistent map and trajectory outcome. Experiments on the KITTI and Waymo Open datasets show that our SG^2SLAM surpasses the per-frame association baselines in the monocular outdoor navigation task. Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
summary_zh: 单目户外导航需要鲁棒的相机运动估计和稠密、可导航的地图，其中3D高斯泼溅SLAM通过显式可微参数化和闭式投影来完成此任务。然而，典型的几何恢复依赖于将2D像素与3D点关联，因此模块化SLAM系统会将跟踪误差吸收到地图中，导致级联退化。为解决这些问题，我们提出了SG^2SLAM，它将流式空间几何与射线条件化3DGS核相结合。流式空间几何用块级度量先验替代逐帧跨维度对应，从单一来源监督跟踪和建图。射线条件化核为每个基元扩展了一个视角方向子空间，以感知单目相机视点。空间几何与位姿的联合优化确保了全局一致的地图和轨迹结果。在KITTI和Waymo Open数据集上的实验表明，我们的SG^2SLAM在单目户外导航任务中超越了逐帧关联基线方法。代码将在论文接收后公开发布。
tldr: SG^2SLAM introduces a monocular outdoor SLAM system that couples streaming spatial geometry with a ray-conditioned 3D Gaussian Splatting kernel, improving tracking and mapping consistency for navigation.
tldr_zh: SG^2SLAM 提出了一种单目户外SLAM系统，将流式空间几何与射线条件3D高斯溅射核结合，提高了导航中跟踪与建图的一致性。

title: ASPEN: Adaptive Semantic Reasoning via Command Persistence Prediction for Efficient Navigation VLAs
summary: Navigation vision-language-action (VLA) policies repeatedly invoke costly semantic reasoning even when the next command remains unchanged. Command reuse can reduce computation but risks missing instruction-dependent turns or stops. We introduce ASPEN, an event-triggered scheduler based on command persistence prediction: estimating whether the frozen base policy would reissue its previous command. A lightweight multimodal predictor combines temporal observations, language instructions, execution history, and cached VLA confidence. At eligible command boundaries, sufficient predicted persistence permits command reuse. Otherwise, ASPEN triggers fresh semantic reasoning from the VLA. Evaluated with frozen NaVILA on cross-dataset RxR-CE val-unseen, ASPEN reduces VLA calls by 9.5% and estimated inference time by 8.1%, including scheduling overhead. It maintains comparable navigation performance and preserves identical baseline action sequences on 92.1% of episodes.
summary_zh: 导航视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略即使在下一指令保持不变的情况下，也会反复调用代价高昂的语义推理。指令复用可以减少计算量，但存在遗漏依赖指令的转向或停止的风险。我们提出ASPEN，一种基于指令持续性预测的事件触发调度器：预测冻结的基础策略是否会重新发出其先前的指令。一个轻量级多模态预测器结合了时间观测、语言指令、执行历史以及缓存的VLA置信度。在符合条件的指令边界处，足够的预测持续性允许指令复用；否则，ASPEN触发VLA重新进行语义推理。在跨数据集的RxR-CE val-unseen上使用冻结的NaVILA进行评估，ASPEN将VLA调用减少了9.5%，估计推理时间减少了8.1%（含调度开销），同时保持相当的导航性能，并在92.1%的片段中保留了与基线完全一致的动作序列。
tldr: ASPEN introduces an event-triggered scheduler for navigation VLAs that predicts command persistence to reuse previous commands, reducing VLA calls and inference time while maintaining navigation performance.
tldr_zh: ASPEN为导航VLA提出了一种基于命令持续性预测的事件触发调度器，通过复用先前命令减少VLA调用和推理时间，同时保持导航性能。

title: Learning Multi-Phase Robot Loco-Manipulation via Phase-Conditioned Policy Optimization
summary: Complex whole-body loco-manipulation requires executing diverse maneuvers, such as crouching, grasping, and locomotion, within a single long-horizon task. While performing simple pick-and-place behaviors is well-established, scaling to complex, long-horizon tasks remains difficult. Currently, this challenge is addressed by relying on human motion data and correspondingly humanoid platforms, which limits platform independence and introduces substantial data processing overhead. Instead, we extend proximal policy optimization (PPO) to train a single policy for multi-phase tasks across diverse robotic hardware, leveraging prior task structure to shape behavior. Our method adapts PPO using a phase-conditioned critic, phase-gated reward functions, and a multi-phase reset curriculum to guide exploration. To support varied hardware, we employ a decoupled hierarchical control architecture that separates lower-level balancing dynamics from high-level phase execution. We demonstrate multi-stage loco-manipulation skills on hardware on both the Unitree G1 and a Boston Dynamics Spot equipped with a manipulator arm, and validate our design choices through ablations. Our approach enables the acquisition of complex loco-manipulation behaviors purely through environment interaction while directly incorporating high-level task structure into policy learning.
summary_zh: 复杂的全身移动操控需要在单一的长时程任务中执行多种操作，如蹲伏、抓取和移动。虽然实现简单的拾取-放置行为已较为成熟，但扩展到复杂的长时程任务仍然困难重重。目前，这一挑战通常依赖人体运动数据及相应的人形平台来解决，这限制了平台的独立性，并引入了大量的数据处理开销。为此，我们扩展了近端策略优化（PPO）算法，以在不同机器人硬件上训练适用于多阶段任务的单一策略，并利用先验任务结构来塑造行为。我们的方法通过相位条件评论家、相位门控奖励函数以及多阶段重置课程来调整PPO，从而引导探索过程。为支持多样化的硬件平台，我们采用了一种解耦的分层控制架构，将底层平衡动力学与高层相位执行分离开来。我们在Unitree G1以及配备机械臂的Boston Dynamics Spot上展示了多阶段移动操控技能，并通过消融实验验证了我们的设计选择。我们的方法使得仅通过环境交互即可习得复杂的移动操控行为，同时将高层任务结构直接融入策略学习之中。
tldr: This paper extends PPO with a phase-conditioned critic, phase-gated rewards, and a multi-phase reset curriculum to train a single policy for long-horizon loco-manipulation tasks, demonstrated on both a humanoid and a quadruped with an arm.
tldr_zh: 本文通过相位条件评论家、相位门控奖励和多阶段重置课程扩展了PPO，以训练单一策略完成长期操作任务，并在人形机器人和带臂四足机器人上进行了验证。

title: Closed-Loop Aware Planning via Imitation-Free Speed Scoring for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving has predominantly relied on open-loop imitation learning for training, which presents two limitations. First, expert demonstrations show only one behavior per scenario, so the model cannot learn alternative valid behaviors and, in turn, cannot adapt to user-specified preferences at test time. Second, noise or ambiguity in these demonstrations can produce inconsistent, unreliable supervision for the end-to-end models. Driving is inherently multi-modal: multiple different behaviors can be valid responses to the same scene, and this diversity arises largely from speed rather than path. We introduce a planning paradigm that learns the path through imitation while scoring a set of candidate speeds across multiple criteria with a learned function supervised by physically grounded safety constraints. We realize this paradigm as Closed-Loop Aware Planning for Autonomous Driving (CLAP-AD), a plug-in planning head that integrates with existing end-to-end driving models and, to our knowledge, is the first to enable explicit test-time control over their speed selection without speed-conditioned training. On Bench2Drive-Speed, CLAP-AD sets a new state of the art Speed-Adherence Score of 82.53, topping TFv6, the strongest baseline on this metric, by 12.9 points while retaining strong closed-loop driving performance. On Bench2Drive, it improves driving score by +28.5 and +32.7 over UniAD and VAD, and on NAVSIM v2, built on real-world driving data, EPDMS by +6.1 over its backbone. Project page: https://clap-ad.github.io
summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶主要依赖开环模仿学习进行训练，这存在两个局限性。首先，专家示范在每个场景中仅展示一种行为，因此模型无法学习其他有效行为，进而在测试时无法适应用户指定的偏好。其次，这些示范中的噪声或歧义会产生不一致、不可靠的监督信号，影响端到端模型的训练效果。驾驶本质上是多模态的：同一场景可能存在多种不同的有效行为响应，且这种多样性主要源于速度而非路径。我们提出了一种规划范式，通过模仿学习路径，同时利用由物理基础安全约束监督的学习函数，对一组候选速度进行多标准评分。我们将该范式实现为自动驾驶闭环感知规划（CLAP-AD），这是一个即插即用的规划头模块，可集成到现有端到端驾驶模型中，并且据我们所知，这是首个无需速度条件训练即可在测试时实现对速度选择显式控制的方案。在Bench2Drive-Speed上，CLAP-AD以82.53的速度符合分数刷新了最先进水平，在该指标上比最强基线TFv6高出12.9分，同时保持强大的闭环驾驶性能。在Bench2Drive上，相较于UniAD和VAD，其驾驶分数分别提升了+28.5和+32.7；在基于真实驾驶数据构建的NAVSIM v2上，其EPDMS比骨干网络提升了+6.1。项目页面：https://clap-ad.github.io
tldr: CLAP-AD is a plug-in planning head for end-to-end autonomous driving that learns path from imitation and scores candidate speeds with a learned function, enabling test-time speed control and improving closed-loop driving performance on Bench2Drive and NAVSIM v2.
tldr_zh: CLAP-AD是一个用于端到端自动驾驶的即插即用规划头，通过模仿学习路径并使用学习函数对候选速度进行评分，实现了测试时的速度控制，并在Bench2Drive和NAVSIM v2上提升了闭环驾驶性能。

title: Adapting Video Models for Robot Control via Motion-guided Asymmetric Prediction
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) leverage pretrained video generative models for robotic control by jointly predicting future visual observations and actions. The visual prediction objective plays a key role in adapting pretrained video representations to the target robot domain. Yet standard visual prediction inherited from video pretraining treats all visual regions uniformly, despite their differing relevance to robotic control. We therefore investigate the spatial allocation of visual supervision in WAMs and show that focusing supervision on dynamic regions can substantially improve policy performance. Building on this finding, we introduce Motion-Guided Asymmetric Prediction (MoGAP), which augments WAM training with motion-focused visual prediction. MoGAP allocates noise asymmetrically across regions, training the model to reconstruct more heavily corrupted dynamic regions using less corrupted static regions as context. MoGAP is trained alongside standard video-action prediction through a training-only auxiliary prediction path within the shared video diffusion backbone. It uses motion cues derived directly from training videos, requiring neither an external teacher nor additional modalities. Across robot manipulation benchmarks and WAM architectures, MoGAP consistently improves policy performance, increasing success rates on the GR-1 tabletop benchmark from 38.8% to 47.5% for Fast-WAM (Wan2.2-5B) and from 52.3% to 62.3% for Cosmos3-Nano.
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）利用预训练的视频生成模型进行机器人控制，通过联合预测未来的视觉观测和动作。视觉预测目标在将预训练视频表示适配到目标机器人领域方面发挥着关键作用。然而，从视频预训练中继承的标准视觉预测将所有视觉区域一视同仁地处理，尽管它们与机器人控制的相关性各不相同。因此，我们研究了WAMs中视觉监督的空间分配问题，并表明将监督聚焦于动态区域可以显著提升策略性能。基于这一发现，我们提出了运动引导的非对称预测（MoGAP），该方法通过运动聚焦的视觉预测来增强WAM训练。MoGAP在不同区域间非对称地分配噪声，训练模型利用噪声较少的静态区域作为上下文，重建噪声破坏更严重的动态区域。MoGAP通过共享视频扩散骨干网络中的训练专用辅助预测路径，与标准视频-动作预测联合训练。它直接利用训练视频中提取的运动线索，既不需要外部教师模型，也不需要额外的模态。在机器人操作基准测试和WAM架构上，MoGAP consistently提升了策略性能，将GR-1桌面基准上Fast-WAM（Wan2.2-5B）的成功率从38.8%提高到47.5%，将Cosmos3-Nano的成功率从52.3%提高到62.3%。
tldr: MoGAP improves World Action Models for robot control by focusing visual prediction supervision on dynamic regions through asymmetric noise corruption, enhancing policy performance on manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: MoGAP 通过将视觉预测监督聚焦于动态区域，并采用非对称噪声破坏，提升了世界动作模型在机器人控制中的策略性能。

title: GameVerse: A Minute-Scale Gameplay Dataset for Long-Horizon Interactive World Modeling
summary: Recent advances in interactive world models have made it possible to generate controllable, dynamic environments from action inputs. Yet current models struggle to maintain coherence beyond roughly one minute of rollout, a limitation rooted not in model capacity but in the scarcity of long-horizon training data. Existing gameplay video datasets typically consist of clips under ten seconds, with captions that describe whole clips in coarse and undifferentiated text, which is insufficient for controllable long-horizon generation. We address this with GameVerse, a minute-scale gameplay video dataset purpose-built for long-horizon interactive world modeling. GameVerse contains 69.7K clips spanning 1,655 hours and 349.6 million frames across diverse first- and third-person gameplay, including 1,358 hours of continuous two-minute sequences, an order of magnitude longer than prior datasets. Clips pass through a unified pipeline of scene-consistent segmentation, quality filtering, camera pose estimation, and event-based caption annotation. Each clip is paired with a temporally stable camera trajectory that remains coherent across minutes, together with captions that separate static scene context from dynamic foreground events and align to event boundaries rather than fixed time windows. Comprehensive analysis shows that GameVerse surpasses existing public datasets in scale, diversity, and annotation quality. Experiments further demonstrate that training on GameVerse substantially extends the temporal horizon of interactive world models.
summary_zh: 近期在交互式世界模型方面的进展使得从动作输入生成可控、动态环境成为可能。然而，现有模型在生成超过约一分钟的展开内容时难以保持连贯性，这一局限的根源并非模型容量，而在于长时间跨度训练数据的稀缺。现有的游戏视频数据集通常由时长不足十秒的片段组成，其标题以粗粒度、无区分性的文本描述整个片段，难以支撑可控的长时间跨度生成。为此，我们提出了GameVerse——一个专为长时间跨度交互式世界建模而构建的分钟级游戏视频数据集。GameVerse包含69.7K个片段，总时长1,655小时，共计3.496亿帧，涵盖多样化的第一人称和第三人称游戏画面，其中包含1,358小时的连续两分钟序列，比现有数据集长一个数量级。所有片段均经过统一的流水线处理，包括场景一致性分割、质量过滤、相机位姿估计和基于事件的标题标注。每个片段都配有时序稳定的相机轨迹，可在数分钟内保持连贯，同时标题将静态场景上下文与动态前景事件分离，并与事件边界对齐，而非固定时间窗口。综合分析表明，GameVerse在规模、多样性和标注质量上均超越现有公开数据集。实验进一步证明，在GameVerse上训练可显著延长交互式世界模型的时间范围。
tldr: GameVerse introduces a minute-scale gameplay dataset with 1,658 hours of footage, event-aligned captions, and stable camera trajectories, significantly extending the temporal coherence of interactive world models.
tldr_zh: GameVerse 提出了一个分钟级游戏数据集，包含1658小时视频、事件对齐标注和稳定相机轨迹，显著提升了交互式世界模型的时间连贯性。

title: Hy-Nomas: Towards Free-form Interactive World Generation
summary: Interactive world generation requires models to follow successive commands while preserving relevant history and action consequences. We present Hy-Nomas, a video world model with an 8B diffusion backbone that supports free-form text instructions and continuous camera control across multiple interaction turns. It generates variable-length segments conditioned on current inputs and cached history. Our central design aligns structured video captions with action-aware causal attention: descriptive context remains accessible across segments, while action instructions are restricted to their intended temporal windows. A vision-language Prompt Enhancer (PE) translates user requests and multimodal interaction histories into structured conditions for the next segment. A multi-stage curriculum progressively introduces causal generation, text interaction, camera control, and training on model-generated histories, followed by diffusion distillation. In human evaluation, Hy-Nomas shows superior performance over existing world models. We release model weights, code and benchmarks, together with a lightweight adaptation workflow, to support reproducible research on interactive world generation.
summary_zh: 交互式世界生成要求模型在遵循连续指令的同时，保留相关历史信息与行为后果。我们提出Hy-Nomas，一个基于8B扩散主干网络的视频世界模型，支持自由形式文本指令及跨多轮交互的连续摄像机控制。该模型根据当前输入与缓存历史生成可变长度片段。我们的核心设计将结构化视频字幕与行为感知的因果注意力对齐：描述性上下文在片段间保持可访问，而行为指令则被限制在其预期的时间窗口内。一种视觉-语言提示增强器（PE）将用户请求和多模态交互历史转换为下一片段的结构化条件。多阶段课程依次引入因果生成、文本交互、摄像机控制以及基于模型生成历史的训练，随后进行扩散蒸馏。在人工评估中，Hy-Nomas展现出优于现有世界模型的性能。我们公开模型权重、代码与基准测试，并附带轻量级适配工作流，以支持交互式世界生成的可复现研究。
tldr: Hy-Nomas is an 8B diffusion-based video world model that generates interactive, free-form video segments by conditioning on text instructions and camera control, using a high-quality video captioner, a vision-language prompt enhancer, and a multi-stage curriculum. It demonstrates superior performance in human evaluation for multi-turn interactive world generation.
tldr_zh: Hy-Nomas 是一个基于80亿参数扩散骨干的视频世界模型，通过文本指令和相机控制生成自由形式的交互式视频片段，采用高质量视频描述器、视觉语言提示增强器及多阶段课程训练，在人机交互式世界生成评测中表现优于现有模型。

title: SO-101 Bench: Accessible Spatial Manipulation
summary: Low-cost arms such as the SO-101 have become the most common entry point to robot learning, yet no released policy performs spatially constrained, language-conditioned tasks on them out of the box, and existing SO-101 benchmarks run only on physical hardware with simple tasks and few held-out objects. We introduce SO-101 Bench, a simulated benchmark for language-conditioned spatial manipulation built on an Isaac Lab digital twin of a real SO-101 setup. It has four tasks scored as five families, 138 objects in seen, unseen-instance and unseen-class splits, 916 evaluation episodes with subsets for held-out appearances, rotate-to-fit planning and occlusion memory, and 3,629 simulated demonstrations on which every learned policy is fine-tuned under an equal compute budget. The twin ranks policies as the real robot does: five policies trained without real data, four VLAs and an LLM agent, keep their exact ranking when the same weights run on the physical arm in an unseen environment with unseen objects (Spearman rho = 1.00, MMRV = 0.000), although simulation overestimates success. Across nine VLAs and world-action models, the best learned policies score near 61%, with spatial placement, unseen object classes and rotate-to-fit planning remaining open. An LLM agent that writes code and hands grasping to a learned policy scores 83.2%, and an ablation shows that this lead comes from the choice of harness and the choice of language model.
summary_zh: 低成本机械臂（如SO-101）已成为机器人学习最普遍的入门平台，然而目前尚无任何已发布的策略能够开箱即用地在其上执行受空间约束的语言条件任务，且现有SO-101基准仅在物理硬件上运行，任务简单且留出对象稀少。我们提出SO-101 Bench，一个基于真实SO-101装置Isaac Lab数字孪生的语言条件空间操作模拟基准。该基准包含四个任务，按五个家族评分，涵盖138个对象（分为已见、未见实例和未见类别三种划分），916个评估片段（包含留出外观、旋转适配规划和遮挡记忆子集），以及3,629条模拟演示，所有学习策略在同等计算预算下基于这些演示进行微调。数字孪生体与真实机器人对策略的排序一致：五种未使用真实数据训练的策略、四种视觉语言模型（VLA）和一个LLM智能体，在相同权重部署于物理机械臂且面对未见环境与未见对象时，保持了完全相同的排名（Spearman rho = 1.00，MMRV = 0.000），尽管模拟会高估成功率。在九种VLA和世界动作模型（world-action models）中，最佳学习策略得分接近61%，而空间放置、未见对象类别和旋转适配规划仍为开放问题。一个编写代码并将抓取交由学习策略执行的LLM智能体得分达83.2%，消融实验表明，这一领先优势源于对控制框架（harness）和语言模型的选择。
tldr: SO-101 Bench provides a simulated Isaac Lab benchmark for language-conditioned spatial manipulation on low-cost SO-101 arms, with 138 objects and 916 evaluation episodes. Experiments show that simulated policy rankings match real-robot rankings exactly, and top learned policies reach ~61% success while an LLM agent with a learned grasping policy achieves 83.2%.
tldr_zh: SO-101 Bench 在 Isaac Lab 中为低成本 SO-101 机械臂构建了一个语言条件空间操作仿真基准，包含 138 个物体和 916 个评估片段。实验表明仿真中的策略排名与真实机器人完全一致，最佳学习策略达到约 61% 的成功率，而结合 LLM 智能体与学习抓取策略的方法达到 83.2%。

title: Structured Representation Probing for Risk Anticipation in End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end driving policies form structured internal representations of traffic, ego behavior, and road constraints. These representations offer a monitoring interface for anticipating failures, complementing risk signals from trajectories, controls, and manually designed features. We introduce the Structured Representation Probe (SRP), a lightweight monitor that reads actor, ego, and map representations from a frozen policy. SRP learns a separate linear risk direction for each source and aggregates element scores through cardinality-normalized log-mean-exp pooling, retaining sensitivity to salient evidence while reducing dependence on token count. Event-window supervision links the readout to upcoming hard failures, and auxiliary event type heads jointly train the source directions across failure modes. Online alerting uses a single generic score without modifying the driving policy. Bench2Drive experiments on DriveTransformer, UniAD, and VAD show higher frame-level PR-AUC and ROC-AUC than the evaluated runtime baselines. On DriveTransformer at a horizon of 2 seconds, ROC-AUC reaches 0.833 versus 0.715 for temporal consistency, with 2.67% readout runtime overhead. The trained probes also retain the ability to distinguish impending failures on new routes.
summary_zh: 端到端驾驶策略能够形成对交通、自我车辆行为及道路约束的结构化内部表征。这些表征为预测失败提供了一种监测接口，可补充来自轨迹、控制及人工设计特征的风险信号。我们提出了结构化表征探针（SRP），这是一种轻量级监测器，能够从冻结策略中读取参与者、自我车辆及地图表征。SRP为每个数据源学习独立的线性风险方向，并通过基数归一化的对数均值指数池化聚合各元素得分，从而在保持对显著证据敏感性的同时，降低对令牌数量的依赖。事件窗口监督将读取结果与即将发生的硬失败相关联，辅助事件类型头则联合训练各风险方向以覆盖不同失败模式。在线警报使用单一通用得分，且无需修改驾驶策略。基于DriveTransformer、UniAD和VAD的Bench2Drive实验表明，该方法在帧级PR-AUC和ROC-AUC上均优于所评估的运行时基线。在2秒预测时域下，DriveTransformer的ROC-AUC达到0.833，而时间一致性方法为0.715，读取运行时开销仅为2.67%。训练后的探针在新路线上仍能保持区分即将发生失败的能力。
tldr: This paper introduces a lightweight Structured Representation Probe (SRP) that reads internal representations from frozen end-to-end driving policies to anticipate hard failures, achieving higher frame-level PR-AUC and ROC-AUC than runtime baselines on Bench2Drive with minimal overhead.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种轻量级结构化表征探针（SRP），从冻结的端到端驾驶策略中读取内部表征以预测困难故障，在Bench2Drive上相较于运行时基线实现了更高的帧级PR-AUC和ROC-AUC，且开销极小。

title: Learning Visuomotor Quadrotor Flight Through Dynamic Narrow Gaps via Differentiable Simulation
summary: Threading a quadrotor through a moving narrow gap is a demanding test of agile flight, requiring centimeter-level spatial alignment and precise temporal execution. We address this challenge using a control policy that operates directly on onboard visual and inertial measurements to output collective thrust and body-rate commands. The task is difficult because success lies on a thin feasible manifold: small errors in timing, position, attitude, or visual observability cause collision. Prior planning and learning methods rely on privileged state, teachers, planners, or distillation; learning dynamic narrow-gap traversal directly, from scratch, remains open. We introduce a differentiable moving-gap formulation that gates centering, alignment, and smooth collision terms by signed distance to a time-varying gap plane, turning a sparse traversal event into a dense pathwise objective. We integrate this formulation into a visual-feature-to-command policy trained in one stage from random initialization, without a teacher, planner, or distillation. We validate our approach in both synthetic and real-world experiments. In controlled benchmarks, we demonstrate that pathwise gradients significantly outperform score-function gradients for precision-critical tasks, yielding a 99.3% success rate in simulation after only a few minutes of training on a single GPU. Furthermore, the policy transfers directly to a real quadrotor, successfully crossing a dynamic narrow gap from varied initial conditions using onboard sensing and inertial measurements, achieving an 80% success rate over 10 physical trials.
summary_zh: 让四旋翼飞行器穿过移动的狭窄间隙，是对敏捷飞行的严苛考验，需要厘米级的空间对齐和精确的时间执行。我们通过一种直接基于机载视觉和惯性测量输出总推力和机体角速率指令的控制策略来应对这一挑战。该任务的难点在于成功仅存在于一条狭窄的可行流形上：时间、位置、姿态或视觉可观测性上的微小误差都会导致碰撞。以往的规划与学习方法依赖于特权状态、教师模型、规划器或知识蒸馏；而直接从零开始学习动态窄间隙穿越，仍然是一个未解决的问题。我们提出了一种可微分的移动间隙模型，通过符号距离函数对时变间隙平面进行门控，将居中、对齐和平滑碰撞项整合起来，从而将稀疏的穿越事件转化为密集的路径目标。我们将该模型集成到一个从随机初始化开始、无需教师模型、规划器或知识蒸馏的单阶段训练视觉特征到控制指令的策略中。我们在合成环境与真实世界实验中均验证了该方法。在受控基准测试中，我们证明对于精度关键型任务，路径梯度显著优于评分函数梯度，在单块GPU上仅需数分钟训练即可在仿真中达到99.3%的成功率。此外，该策略可直接迁移至真实四旋翼飞行器，利用机载感知与惯性测量从多种初始条件下成功穿越动态狭窄间隙，在10次物理试验中实现了80%的成功率。
tldr: This paper presents a differentiable simulation-based method for training a visuomotor quadrotor policy to fly through dynamic narrow gaps, achieving high success in simulation and direct real-world transfer without a teacher or planner.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于可微仿真的方法，训练视觉运动四旋翼策略穿越动态窄间隙，在仿真中取得高成功率，并无需教师或规划器即可直接迁移到真实世界。

title: Kinematic Constraint-Referenced Evaluation for Articulated Object Manipulation
summary: Manipulation policies are evaluated predominantly by binary task success, which cannot tell whether the commanded gesture is the one the object's kinematics admit. We introduce Constraint-Referenced Strategy (CRS), which projects the commanded end-effector twist onto the object's joint axis, separating progress along the joint from off-constraint waste. CRS requires a joint model and a joint-following scripted controller derived from it, but no recorded demonstration or learned judge. On 74 simulated articulated objects, success registers three transfer failures as lower rates but attributes none, while the two CRS channels give each a distinct signature. A door-trained behavior-cloning policy opens drawers in 59 of 110 episodes, and in these passes it commands about $40\times$ the off-axis rotation of a drawer-trained policy's passes ($1.27$ vs.\ $0.032$~rad/s). Relative to a scripted controller scored with the same axis, CRS verdicts are unchanged under joint-axis errors up to $30^\circ$; absolute thresholds tolerate about $8^\circ$.
summary_zh: 操作策略的评估主要依据二元任务成功与否，这无法判断所指令的手势是否与物体运动学所允许的一致。我们引入了约束参考策略（CRS），该方法将指令的末端执行器旋量投影到物体的关节轴上，从而将沿关节的进展与偏离约束的浪费区分开来。CRS需要一个关节模型以及基于该模型推导出的关节跟踪脚本控制器，但无需记录演示或学习判别器。在74个模拟铰接物体上，成功指标将三次迁移失败记录为较低的比率，但无法归因于具体原因，而CRS的两个通道各自呈现出独特的特征。一个以门为训练对象的行为克隆策略在110个回合中有59个回合成功打开了抽屉，在这些成功回合中，指令的离轴旋转量约为以抽屉为训练对象策略的40倍（1.27对0.032弧度/秒）。相对于使用同一轴评分的脚本控制器，CRS的判定在关节轴误差高达30度时保持不变；绝对阈值约可容忍8度的偏差。
