summary_zh: 视觉-语言-行动（VLA）策略可以从带有偏好标签注释的示范中学习遵循执行偏好，例如在何处抓取物体或如何绕开障碍物移动。然而，为每个新任务提供这些注释成本高昂。我们研究了学习到的偏好控制能否迁移到那些示范包含期望行为但缺乏偏好注释的新任务上。我们发现，经过偏好注释训练的策略可以在适应前遵循新任务上的偏好，但任务成功率有限。在没有这些注释的目标示范上进行微调可以提高任务成功率，但同时会削弱偏好控制能力。基于这一发现，我们提出了自标注偏好迁移（SPT）方法。SPT在带有注释的源示范上联合训练一个共享的视觉-语言骨干网络，用于偏好条件动作预测和偏好识别。随后，它冻结识别器以保留其跨任务的偏好识别能力，并利用该识别器对目标示范进行自标注，用于策略微调。在仿真中的五类执行偏好上，识别器达到了96.4%的准确率，SPT在偏好遵循和任务成功率上分别达到了84.8%和89.2%，而朴素微调仅为59.4%和88.0%。我们进一步扩展到多偏好场景，偏好遵循率达到了93.8%，而基线方法仅为42.5%。在真实世界实验中，在两项任务迁移中，相对于朴素微调，SPT将偏好遵循率从52.5%提升到了92.5%。这些结果表明，SPT能够在保持任务成功率的同时支持跨任务和跨物体的偏好适应，且无需额外的人工偏好注释。
tldr: This paper introduces Self-Labeled Preference Transfer (SPT), a method that uses a frozen preference recognizer trained on annotated source demonstrations to self-label target demonstrations, enabling VLA policies to follow execution preferences on new tasks without manual preference annotations while maintaining high task success.
tldr_zh: 本文提出自我标记偏好迁移（SPT），利用在带标注源演示上训练的冻结偏好识别器来自动标注目标演示，使VLA策略能够在没有人工偏好标注的情况下在新任务中遵循执行偏好，同时保持较高的任务成功率。

title: FORGE: Feasible Online Reduced-Order Reference Generation and Whole-Body Execution for Agile Humanoid Locomotion
summary: This paper presents a two-stage learning framework for versatile and agile humanoid locomotion that couples online reduced-order model (ROM) reference generation with whole-body tracking control. In the first stage, we train a command-conditioned whole-body reference generator using single rigid body dynamics combined with full humanoid kinematics. In the second stage, the frozen ROM policy is rolled out online to generate references for training a whole-body tracking policy on the full-order dynamics model. Learning a kino-dynamically consistent reference generator in the simplified ROM space enables us to generate references over a broad command space and over multiple locomotion strategies using a single unified framework. We demonstrate the approach on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, achieving longitudinal velocities from -2.0 m/s to 2.8 m/s, lateral velocities up to +-1.0 m/s, angular velocities up to +-3.0 rad/s, one-legged hopping, and continuous transitions across the commands, all using one unified reference policy and one whole-body tracking policy.
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种两阶段学习框架，用于实现多功能且敏捷的人形机器人运动，该框架将在线降阶模型（ROM）参考生成与全身跟踪控制相结合。在第一阶段，我们结合单刚体动力学与完整人形运动学，训练了一个命令条件化的全身参考生成器。在第二阶段，冻结的ROM策略被在线展开，以生成参考，用于在全阶动力学模型上训练全身跟踪策略。在简化的ROM空间中学习具有运动动力学一致性的参考生成器，使我们能够在一个统一框架内，在广泛的命令空间和多种运动策略下生成参考。我们在Unitree G1人形机器人上展示了该方法，实现了纵向速度从-2.0米/秒到2.8米/秒、横向速度最高±1.0米/秒、角速度最高±3.0弧度/秒、单腿跳跃以及各命令之间的连续转换，所有功能均使用一个统一的参考策略和一个全身跟踪策略完成。
tldr: This paper introduces a two-stage learning framework for agile humanoid locomotion, coupling a reduced-order model-based reference generator with whole-body tracking control, and demonstrates versatile gaits including hopping and wide velocity ranges on a Unitree G1 robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种两阶段学习框架，将基于简化模型的参考生成器与全身跟踪控制相结合，实现敏捷的人形机器人运动，并在Unitree G1上展示了多种步态和宽广的速度范围。

title: What Actually Matters? A Paired Evaluation of Inference Settings for $π_{0.5}$ on BEHAVIOR-1K
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising paradigm for general-purpose household robotics. However, inference and data-collection strategies that have been deployed in smaller-scale settings do not necessarily generalize to large-scale, diverse task suites. To address this gap, we conduct a systematic, paired evaluation of previously proposed inference and data-collection strategies across all 100 tasks. Our evaluation uses a fine-tuned $π_{0.5}$ model based on the 2025 BEHAVIOR Challenge winner, which achieves a Q-score of 0.39 on the public test set. These results show that proposed strategies do not transfer uniformly to new environments and tasks. Project page, videos, and detailed analysis: https://rubenhammele.github.io/behavior2026
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为通用家庭机器人提供了一种有前景的范式。然而，在较小规模场景中部署的推理和数据采集策略，未必能推广至大规模、多样化的任务套件。为弥补这一差距，我们对先前提出的推理和数据采集策略在所有100项任务上进行了系统性的配对评估。该评估基于微调后的\( \pi_{0.5} \)模型，该模型源自2025年BEHAVIOR挑战赛冠军，其在公开测试集上取得了0.39的Q分数。结果表明，所提出的策略并不能统一迁移至新环境和任务。项目页面、视频及详细分析：https://rubenhammele.github.io/behavior2026
tldr: This paper systematically evaluates inference and data-collection strategies for the π0.5 VLA model across all 100 BEHAVIOR-1K tasks, finding that prior strategies do not transfer uniformly to large-scale, diverse task suites.
tldr_zh: 本文系统评估了π0.5 VLA模型在BEHAVIOR-1K全部100个任务上的推理与数据收集策略，发现此前策略并不能统一迁移至大规模、多样化任务集。

title: Echo: Scaling Visual Reinforcement Learning with Off-policy Experience
summary: Scaling visual reinforcement learning (RL) with GPU-accelerated simulation is computationally expensive due to rendering and visual-policy inference costs. Consequently, two-stage teacher--student distillation is commonly used to train visual policies, but introduces an imitation gap. In this preliminary study, we introduce \echomethod{}, \textbf{a single-stage off-policy RL framework that scales experience collection without proportionally increasing visual computation}. Through \textbf{inverse distillation}, a state-based auxiliary policy imitates the evolving visual policy and collects inexpensive, unrendered experience. Echo leverages this experience for off-policy value learning, directly improving the visual policy through a shared privileged critic. We instantiate \echomethod{} with FastTD3 and evaluate it on three visual control tasks and two dexterous manipulation tasks in Genesis. Relative to \sdpgmethod{} under the evaluated configurations, Echo reduces time to reference returns by an average of \textbf{60\% across the three locomotion tasks} and \textbf{56\% across both hand tasks}, while improving peak mean returns by \textbf{62\% and 12\%}, respectively. Both hand tasks also achieve higher mean returns at matched simulator-transition budgets. These initial results suggest that scaling off-policy experience is a promising approach to efficient direct visual RL.
summary_zh: 利用GPU加速仿真来扩展视觉强化学习（RL）在计算上代价高昂，原因在于渲染和视觉策略推理的成本。因此，两阶段的教师-学生蒸馏通常被用于训练视觉策略，但这引入了模仿差距。在本初步研究中，我们提出\echomethod{}，\textbf{一种单阶段离策略强化学习框架，在不按比例增加视觉计算量的情况下扩展经验收集}。通过\textbf{逆向蒸馏}，基于状态的辅助策略模仿不断演化的视觉策略，并收集廉价的、无需渲染的经验。Echo利用这些经验进行离策略价值学习，通过共享的特权评论家直接改进视觉策略。我们以FastTD3实现了\echomethod{}，并在Genesis中的三个视觉控制任务和两个灵巧操作任务上对其进行了评估。在评估配置下，与\sdpgmethod{}相比，Echo在三个运动任务上平均将达到参考回报的时间减少了\textbf{60\%}，在两个手部任务上减少了\textbf{56\%}，同时分别将峰值平均回报提高了\textbf{62\%}和\textbf{12\%}。在匹配的模拟器转移预算下，两个手部任务也实现了更高的平均回报。这些初步结果表明，扩展离策略经验是高效直接视觉RL的一种有前景的方法。
tldr: Echo introduces a single-stage off-policy RL framework for visual control that uses inverse distillation to train a state-based auxiliary policy to imitate the visual policy and generate inexpensive unrendered experience, reducing training time and improving performance on locomotion and dexterous manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: Echo 提出了一种用于视觉控制的单阶段离策略强化学习框架，通过逆蒸馏训练基于状态的辅助策略来模仿视觉策略并生成廉价的未渲染经验，从而在运动控制和灵巧操作任务上缩短训练时间并提升性能。

title: DexSuite: An All-in-One Framework for Dexterous Manipulation Across Arms, Hands, and Tasks
summary: Human-level dexterity remains a central open problem in robotics, yet few simulation frameworks cover the full workflow of dexterous manipulation, from setting up a robot to collecting dexterous demonstrations and evaluating policies. We present DexSuite, an all-in-one simulation framework for dexterous manipulation built on the Genesis simulator. DexSuite provides 30 tasks and assembles its 10 arms and 12 end-effectors, from parallel-jaw grippers to dexterous hands, into more than 100 single-arm robots and thousands of bimanual pairs. It also ships a standardized environment API, integrated teleoperation, and simulated tactile sensing. Moreover, we define a benchmark of 16 task-embodiment pairs spanning diverse contact complexities and horizons, and release a dataset of 4,700 successful episodes in simulation from human teleoperation, scripted experts, and learned policies. We release DexSuite as open source and hope others will build on it. Videos and datasets are available at https://dexsuiteorg.github.io
summary_zh: 灵巧操作达到人类水平仍是机器人领域的一个核心开放难题，然而，能够覆盖从机器人搭建、灵巧示教数据采集到策略评估这一完整流程的仿真框架却鲜有出现。我们提出了DexSuite，一个基于Genesis仿真器构建的一体化灵巧操作仿真框架。DexSuite提供30项任务，并将其10种机械臂与12种末端执行器（从平行夹爪到灵巧手）组合，形成超过100种单臂机器人和数千种双臂配对。该框架还配备了标准化的环境接口、集成遥操作以及模拟触觉感知功能。此外，我们定义了一个包含16项任务-具身组合的基准测试集，覆盖了多样的接触复杂度和任务时间跨度，并发布了一个包含4，700个成功轨迹的数据集，这些数据来源于仿真环境中的人类遥操作、脚本化专家和习得策略。我们将DexSuite开源，期待更多人能基于此展开研究和开发。相关视频和数据集可在 https://dexsuiteorg.github.io 获取。
tldr: DexSuite is an open-source simulation framework and benchmark for dexterous manipulation, offering 30 tasks, over 100 robot embodiments, a standardized API, teleoperation, tactile sensing, and a dataset of 4,700 successful episodes.
tldr_zh: DexSuite 是一个用于灵巧操作的开源仿真框架和基准，提供30个任务、超过100种机器人形态、标准化API、遥操作、触觉感知以及包含4,700个成功轨迹的数据集。

title: The Reality Gap in Automated Driving Systems Testing: Landscape, Challenges, and Research Directions
summary: Simulation is essential for testing automated driving systems (ADS), but discrepancies between simulation and reality can undermine testing conclusions. It remains unclear which discrepancies the literature addresses and what evidence supports correspondence claims. We present a systematic mapping of 235 primary studies that measure or mitigate the reality gap in ADS testing, selected from 4,195 publications. We characterise objectives, targets, approaches, experimental setups, and evaluation evidence. Our classification distinguishes simulated and real-world execution across six ADS test components, separately for each approach and its evaluation reference. This distinguishes real-world information used to construct an approach from evidence used to evaluate its claims. Of the included studies, 76% address mitigation, primarily targeting scenario and actor realism and perception, while 94% report validation or measurement procedures. Only 61 studies report metrics from multiple families covering sensor/perception correspondence, ADS behaviour, vehicle dynamics, or safety outcomes; this coverage does not establish causal links between discrepancies and test verdicts. The synthesis highlights that real-world content and physical execution must be interpreted against the claim evaluated. The findings motivate claim-specific evaluation and component-level reporting to establish which discrepancies affect testing conclusions and when simulation evidence supports conclusions about real-world ADS behaviour.
summary_zh: 仿真对于自动驾驶系统（ADS）的测试至关重要，但仿真与现实之间的差异可能削弱测试结论的有效性。目前尚不清楚现有文献涉及哪些差异，以及支持对应性声明的证据是什么。本文对从4,195篇出版物中筛选出的235项主要研究进行了系统映射，这些研究旨在测量或缓解ADS测试中的现实差距。我们对其目标、对象、方法、实验设置和评估证据进行了特征化描述。我们的分类区分了在ADS测试的六个组成部分中，每种方法及其评估参照各自的仿真执行与真实世界执行情况，从而区分了用于构建方法的真实世界信息与用于评估其声明有效性的证据。在被纳入的研究中，76%侧重于缓解措施，主要针对场景和参与者真实性及感知方面，而94%报告了验证或测量程序。仅有61项研究报告了涵盖传感器/感知对应性、ADS行为、车辆动力学或安全结果等多个类别的指标，但这种覆盖面并未建立差异与测试结论之间的因果关系。综合结果表明，真实世界内容及物理执行必须依据所评估的声明进行解读。研究结论支持应针对具体声明进行评估，并按组件级别进行报告，以确定哪些差异会影响测试结论，以及模拟证据在何种情况下能支持关于真实世界ADS行为的结论。
tldr: This paper systematically maps 235 studies on the reality gap in automated driving system (ADS) testing, characterizing objectives, approaches, and evaluation evidence, and highlighting the lack of causal links between simulation discrepancies and test verdicts.
tldr_zh: 本文系统梳理了235项关于自动驾驶系统测试中现实差距的研究，分析了目标、方法和评估证据，并指出模拟差异与测试结论之间缺乏因果联系。

title: Force-Driven Hook Disassembly via Constraint-Aware Object-Centric Reinforcement Learning
summary: The growing volume of end-of-life products has intensified the need for automated disassembly, yet hook-type connections remain challengin: their orientations vary, they deform under load, and their geometry is hidden, so vision alone cannot identify a feasible non-destructive disassembly direction. This work proposes a constraint-aware reinforcement learning framework that infers feasible extraction directions online from contact forces. The policy is trained in a robot-agnostic, object-centric simulation on a simplified peg-in-hole pair and deployed zero-shot on a physical robot, where it transfers to real connections with unseen, multi-stage constraint structures. Because instantaneous contact forces are noisy and locally ambiguous, the policy is coupled with a particle filter belief that provides the policy with temporally integrated directional information and reduces redundant exploratory motion. The approach is validated on four real-world tasks, from peg-in-hole pairs to the inner propeller and front cover of an end-of-life air-conditioning unit. The full method achieves success rates of 100%, 100%, 90%, and 75% with the highest path efficiency on every task, and raises the success rate on the air-conditioning cover from 45% to 75% relative to a policy trained without the belief. These results indicate that force-driven reinforcement learning can enable disassembly without product-specific models or demonstrations.
summary_zh: 日益增长的报废产品数量使得自动化拆解需求愈发迫切，然而钩式连接仍具挑战性：其朝向各异、负载下易变形、且几何形状被遮蔽，仅凭视觉无法确定可行的无损拆解方向。本文提出一种基于约束感知的强化学习框架，通过接触力在线推断可行提取方向。该策略在与机器人无关、以对象为中心的仿真环境中，基于简化销孔配合对训练，并零样本部署至实体机器人，可迁移至具有未见过多阶段约束结构的真实连接件。由于瞬时接触力噪声大且局部存在歧义，该策略与粒子滤波置信度相结合，为策略提供时间上整合的方向信息，并减少冗余探索动作。该方法在四项真实任务上得到验证，涵盖从销孔配合对到报废空调机组的内置风扇叶片及前盖板。完整方法在各项任务上分别取得100%、100%、90%和75%的成功率，且路径效率均最高；相较于未使用置信度训练的策略，在空调盖板任务上的成功率从45%提升至75%。结果表明，基于力驱动的强化学习能够在无需产品特定模型或示教的情况下实现拆解作业。
tldr: This paper presents a constraint-aware reinforcement learning framework that uses contact forces and a particle filter belief to infer feasible extraction directions for hook disassembly, achieving zero-shot transfer from simulation to real-world tasks with high success rates.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于约束感知的强化学习框架，利用接触力和粒子滤波信念推断钩子拆卸的可行提取方向，实现了从仿真到真实世界的零样本迁移，并在实际任务中取得了较高的成功率。

title: OmniQuad: a Wheeled-Legged Hybrid Robot with Omnidirectional Wheels
summary: Combining wheeled and legged locomotion within a single robotic platform offers the potential to harness the advantages of both systems. The development of such hybrid systems remains an active area of research. While legged robots exhibit remarkable adaptability for traversing uneven and rugged terrains, their relatively low speed limits their practicality in indoor environments. Conversely, wheeled robots demonstrate higher efficiency on flat surfaces but often encounter difficulties when navigating obstacles such as steps. This paper introduces OmniQuad, a novel hybrid robot that integrates mecanum wheels with legged locomotion to exploit the benefits of both modalities. Mecanum wheels provide omnidirectional mobility, enhancing the robot's manoeuvrability by enabling agile movement in confined spaces and the ability to maintain a consistent orientation during task execution. In this work, we first present the design of a custom wheeled-foot featuring mecanum wheels. Subsequently, we describe the complete robot assembly, comprising these wheeled feet and EM-Act actuators. Finally, we detail the control scheme developed to govern the OmniQuad and evaluate its performance through experimental trials conducted in both indoor and outdoor environments.
summary_zh: 摘要：在单一机器人平台上结合轮式与腿式运动，有望兼取两种系统的优势。此类混合系统的开发仍是一个活跃的研究领域。腿式机器人在穿越不平坦和崎岖地形时展现出卓越的适应性，但其相对较低的速度限制了其在室内环境中的实用性。相比之下，轮式机器人在平坦表面上表现出更高的效率，但在应对台阶等障碍物时往往面临困难。本文介绍了OmniQuad，一种新颖的混合机器人，它将麦克纳姆轮与腿式运动相结合，以充分利用两种模式的优点。麦克纳姆轮提供全向移动能力，增强了机器人的机动性，使其能够在狭窄空间中灵活运动，并在执行任务时保持一致的朝向。在本研究中，我们首先介绍了一种配备麦克纳姆轮的定制轮足设计。随后，我们描述了包含这些轮足和EM-Act执行器的完整机器人组装。最后，我们详细阐述了用于控制OmniQuad的控制方案，并通过在室内和室外环境中进行的实验测试评估了其性能。
tldr: OmniQuad introduces a wheeled-legged hybrid robot with mecanum wheels, enabling omnidirectional mobility and legged adaptability, with a custom control scheme validated in indoor and outdoor trials.
tldr_zh: OmniQuad 提出了一种融合麦克纳姆轮与腿式运动的新型混合机器人，实现全向移动与地形适应能力，并通过室内外实验验证了其控制系统。

title: SpaceAct: Benchmarking 3D Spatial and Temporal Reasoning via Closed-Loop Action and Active Perception
summary: To solve problems in 3D space rather than merely describe images, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) need 3D spatiotemporal reasoning: reconstructing 3D geometry from occluded 2D views, anticipating physical dynamics, and executing precise, closed-loop actions. Prior studies test passive VQA on static images or symbolic planning, requiring no execution or supplying privileged coordinates while ignoring collision, statics, and timing. We introduce SpaceAct, an interactive benchmark evaluating 3D spatiotemporal reasoning via closed-loop physical action and active perception, with SAPA, a Spatiotemporal Active-Probing Agent framework. Built on interlocking bricks and mechanical puzzles, it has 108 verified instances across 36 task families in six categories, without privileged coordinates, and diagnostic modes (+plan, +state, no-camera, blind, L7 levers). In brick-bridging or aperture-threading, models rotate the camera to resolve occlusion, read in-scene rulers, output 6-DoF poses under swept-collision and statics checks, and self-correct via split-screen rollback feedback (dynamic tasks freeze time during deliberation and give five strobe frames). Across 10 frontier MLLMs on the 44 hardest instances, scores span 4.8-79.1 (seven solve at most 27.3% of 6-DoF tasks); for the top three, a reference plan (+plan) closes 44% of the gap while leaving collisions at 5.2 per episode, whereas adding exact 3D state (+state) closes 90% and cuts collisions to 0.5; for four others, +plan lifts the mean score from 10.9 to 35.3 and +state to 81.8; and 46% of failures are collision or observation loops. SpaceAct and SAPA advance evaluation to closed-loop physical interaction, showing that even with a valid plan, MLLMs remain bottlenecked by 3D visual grounding and action refinement, while offering a testbed for active multi-view exploration and explicit 3D grounding.
summary_zh: 为了解决三维空间中的问题，而不仅仅是描述图像，多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）需要具备三维时空推理能力：从被遮挡的二维视角重建三维几何结构，预测物理动力学，并执行精确的闭环动作。以往的研究主要测试静态图像上的被动视觉问答或符号规划，既不要求实际执行，也不考虑碰撞、静力学和时序，甚至直接提供特权坐标。我们提出了SpaceAct，一个通过闭环物理动作和主动感知来评估三维时空推理能力的交互式基准，并配套提出了SAPA，一种时空主动探测智能体框架。该基准基于互锁积木和机械谜题构建，包含36个任务族、6个大类下的108个验证实例，不提供特权坐标，并设有诊断模式（+plan、+state、无相机、盲模式、L7杠杆）。在搭桥穿洞等任务中，模型需旋转相机以解决遮挡问题，读取场景内的标尺，在扫掠碰撞和静力学检查下输出六自由度位姿，并通过分屏回滚反馈进行自我修正（动态任务在推理期间冻结时间并提供五个频闪帧）。在44个最难实例上对10个前沿MLLM的评估结果显示，得分范围从4.8到79.1（其中7个模型在六自由度任务上的解决率最多仅为27.3%）；对于排名前三的模型，提供参考规划（+plan）可弥合44%的差距，但每次回合仍有5.2次碰撞，而提供精确三维状态（+state）则可弥合90%的差距并将碰撞降至0.5次；对于另外四个模型，+plan将平均得分从10.9提升至35.3，+state则提升至81.8；此外，46%的失败源于碰撞或观测循环。SpaceAct和SAPA将评估推进到闭环物理交互层面，表明即使拥有有效规划，MLLMs在三维视觉锚定和动作细化方面仍是瓶颈所在，同时为主动多视角探索和显式三维锚定提供了测试平台。
tldr: SpaceAct is an interactive benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on 3D spatiotemporal reasoning through closed-loop physical actions and active perception, revealing that current models are bottlenecked by 3D visual grounding and action refinement even with valid plans.
tldr_zh: SpaceAct 是一个交互式基准测试，通过闭环物理动作和主动感知评估多模态大语言模型在三维时空推理方面的能力，结果显示即使在有效计划下，当前模型仍受限于三维视觉接地和动作细化。

title: HERON: Real-Time Obstacle-Aware Reachability Maps for Mobile Manipulators
summary: Mobile manipulator robots rarely reposition their base during manipulation, because doing so requires real-time knowledge of how well the arm can reach its surroundings among obstacles. Reachability maps (RMs) encode this knowledge, but existing methods are slow, coarse (typically 5 cm), or ignore real obstacles. This article asks whether a neural network can predict an obstacle-aware RM at 2 cm resolution from a live depth camera, on embedded hardware, fast enough for online use. We present HERON, a 3D U-Net trained on RMs computed with the GPU-accelerated inverse kinematics of cuRobo, first on synthetic scenes and then on real depth data, and deployed on a Jetson AGX Orin with TensorRT and INT8 quantization. HERON predicts the RM of a 2.56 m cube around the arm in 115 ms on average, for a measured system rate of 8.57 Hz, close to the 10 Hz update rate of the obstacle map, whereas computing the same map with cuRobo takes about 90 min. Against the cuRobo ground truth, 95% of the voxels lie within 1 class out of 51 with the FP32 model and within 3 classes with the INT8 model, with a Pearson correlation of 0.99 and a quadratic weighted kappa above 0.9. Accuracy degrades mainly at the workspace boundaries.
summary_zh: 移动操纵机器人在操作过程中很少重新定位其基座，因为这需要实时掌握机械臂在障碍物环境中能多好地触及其周围空间的知识。可达性图（RMs）编码了这一知识，但现有方法速度慢、分辨率粗糙（通常为5厘米），或忽略真实障碍物。本文探讨了是否可以通过神经网络，在嵌入式硬件上，从实时深度相机预测分辨率为2厘米的障碍物感知可达性图，并且速度足够快以供在线使用。我们提出了HERON，一种基于3D U-Net的架构，其训练数据使用cuRobo的GPU加速逆运动学计算得到的可达性图，先在合成场景上训练，再在真实深度数据上微调，并部署于Jetson AGX Orin上，采用TensorRT和INT8量化。HERON在平均115毫秒内预测机械臂周围2.56米立方体的可达性图，实测系统频率为8.57 Hz，接近障碍物地图10 Hz的更新率，而使用cuRobo计算相同地图约需90分钟。与cuRobo的真实值相比，FP32模型下95%的体素误差在51个类别中的1个类别以内，INT8模型下误差在3个类别以内，皮尔逊相关系数为0.99，二次加权卡帕系数高于0.9。精度衰减主要发生在工作空间边界处。
tldr: HERON proposes a neural network that predicts obstacle-aware reachability maps for mobile manipulators in real time on embedded hardware, replacing a computationally expensive inverse kinematics method.
tldr_zh: HERON 提出一种神经网络，可在嵌入式硬件上实时预测移动操作器考虑障碍物的可达性图，取代计算量大的逆运动学方法。

title: CuraEval: Evaluating Demonstration Curation on Mixed-Skill Robot Data
summary: Robot imitation learning uses demonstrations from operators of varying skill, but selecting training data remains challenging. Existing methods score demonstrations using smoothness, diversity, or estimated influence on policy performance, but differences in selection and evaluation protocols make it difficult to determine whether they outperform simple baselines. We introduce \textbf{CuraEval}, a framework combining mathematical analysis of demonstration scores with controlled comparisons against fixed size-matched random subsets and full-data training on mixed-skill robomimic data using Diffusion Policy and BC-RNN. We show that the evaluated PSD score depends only on episode length and squared position magnitudes, and produces nearly the same ranking as episode length on \textit{square} ($ρ=0.999$). With Diffusion Policy, selecting the shortest 50\% of demonstrations improves \textit{square} success from 70.7\% under random selection to 76.5\%. Compared with random selection, our adapted geometric-entropy LOO selector reduces success at 25\% retention from 94.7\% to 74.0\% on \textit{can} and achieves 41.7\% on \textit{square}, below the mean success rates of all three independently sampled random subsets (59.8--62.5\%). On the same 3 \textit{square} Diffusion Policy training seeds, length-based selection at 75\% retention improves success over full-data training from 76.7\% to 86.7\% under the original protocol, but lowers it from 80.5\% to 79.5\% after checkpoint reporting, rollout count, and evaluation seed change jointly. No evaluated curated condition significantly outperforms full-data training after Holm correction, although confidence intervals still permit useful gains. Code is available at https://github.com/jiuyixu25/CuraEval.
summary_zh: 机器人模仿学习利用不同技能水平的操作员提供的示范，但如何选择训练数据仍然具有挑战性。现有方法使用平滑性、多样性或对策略性能的估计影响来对示范进行评分，但选择与评估协议之间的差异使得难以判断这些方法是否优于简单基线。我们提出了\textbf{CuraEval}框架，该框架结合了示范评分的数学分析与受控比较，对比对象包括固定大小的匹配随机子集以及使用Diffusion Policy和BC-RNN在混合技能robomimic数据上的全量数据训练。我们证明，所评估的PSD评分仅取决于片段长度和位置平方的幅度，并且在\textit{square}任务上与片段长度产生的排名几乎一致（$ρ=0.999$）。使用Diffusion Policy时，选择最短的50\%示范将\textit{square}任务的成功率从随机选择下的70.7\%提升至76.5\%。与随机选择相比，我们改编的几何熵LOO选择器在25\%保留率下将\textit{can}任务的成功率从94.7\%降至74.0\%，在\textit{square}任务上达到41.7\%，低于三个独立采样的随机子集的平均成功率（59.8--62.5\%）。在相同的3个\textit{square} Diffusion Policy训练种子上，基于长度的选择在75\%保留率下，按照原始协议将全量数据训练的成功率从76.7\%提升至86.7\%；但在检查点报告、评估次数和评估种子共同改变后，该成功率从80.5\%降至79.5\%。在Holm校正后，没有任何经过评估的精选条件显著优于全量数据训练，尽管置信区间仍允许存在有意义的提升空间。代码可在https://github.com/jiuyixu25/CuraEval获取。
tldr: CuraEval is a framework for evaluating demonstration curation methods on mixed-skill robot manipulation data, revealing that many existing curation scores do not significantly outperform simple baselines like length-based selection or full-data training under rigorous statistical analysis.
tldr_zh: CuraEval 是一个用于评估混合技能机器人操作数据中演示数据筛选方法的框架，其结果表明在严格的统计分析下，许多现有的筛选方法并未显著优于简单的基线方法（如基于长度的选择或全数据训练）。

title: SKiD-SLAM: Resource-Aware Distributed Multi-Robot LiDAR SLAM for Planetary Missions with Field Deployments at Analog Sites
summary: Future planetary exploration missions require teams of robots to collaboratively map unknown environments under severe communication limits, constrained onboard computation, and no central infrastructure. In this field report, we present SKiD-SLAM, a distributed multi-robot LiDAR simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) system for such environments, and report its deployment across two mission concepts: cave exploration and scientific surface exploration. We survey the communication and computation budgets of actual planetary missions and select modules that fit these budgets for inter-robot place recognition, relative pose estimation, and distributed trajectory fusion. Before field deployment, we verify the assembled system on public datasets resembling planetary environments and in a simulator built on NASA JPL's Open Source Rover. We then validate SKiD-SLAM through field deployments in South Korea: a team of wheeled rovers explores the Majang lava-tube cave on Jeju Island, and quadruped robots carry out a crater-and-rock science scenario on a planetary analog terrain at the Korea Institute of Civil Engineering and Building Technology (KICT) in Yeoncheon. Across both deployments, SKiD-SLAM reliably performed distributed multi-robot LiDAR SLAM within a 250 kbps inter-robot communication budget, demonstrating its feasibility under challenging field conditions. Supplementary materials, including code and field data, are available at https://sparolab.github.io/research/skid_slam/.
summary_zh: 未来行星探测任务要求机器人团队在严苛通信限制、机载计算资源受限且无中央基础设施的条件下，协同绘制未知环境地图。在本实地报告中，我们介绍了SKiD-SLAM，一种面向此类环境的多机器人激光雷达同时定位与建图（SLAM）分布式系统，并报告了其在两个任务场景中的部署情况：洞穴探测与科学表面探测。我们调研了实际行星任务的通信与计算预算，并选取适合这些预算的组件，用于机器人间的位姿识别、相对位姿估计及分布式轨迹融合。在实地部署之前，我们在类似行星环境的公开数据集以及基于NASA JPL开源火星车构建的模拟器中验证了系统整体性能。随后，我们通过在韩国的实地部署对SKiD-SLAM进行了验证：一组轮式火星车在济州岛马场熔岩管洞穴中开展探测，四足机器人在韩国建设技术研究院（KICT）涟川分院的行星模拟地形上执行陨石坑与岩石科学探测场景。在两次部署中，SKiD-SLAM均在250 kbps的机器人间通信预算内可靠地完成了分布式多机器人激光雷达SLAM，验证了其在挑战性野外条件下的可行性。补充材料（包括代码和实地数据）可在 https://sparolab.github.io/research/skid_slam/ 获取。
tldr: SKiD-SLAM is a distributed multi-robot LiDAR SLAM system designed for planetary missions under low bandwidth and computation constraints, validated in field deployments at analog sites with wheeled and quadruped robots.
tldr_zh: SKiD-SLAM 是一种为行星任务设计的分布式多机器人 LiDAR SLAM 系统，在低带宽和计算限制下运行，并在模拟场地的轮式和四足机器人现场部署中得到验证。

title: Same Label, Different Interface: Beyond Action-Space Labels in Robot Learning
summary: Robot-learning studies often compare position and velocity actions as though each label identified a single experimental treatment, yet the label alone does not determine what the robot executes. Before affecting robot motion, bounded policy output passes through filtering, physical scaling, reference construction, feedback, timing, and effort limits. We study how these omitted properties affect attribution under one shared learner and training budget. Across three contact-rich Factory tasks (PegInsert, GearMesh, and NutThread), we compare five joint-space interfaces, with ten independently trained policies per condition. We first remain within the same position-feedback law and vary the executed interface: substituting only the physical action scale as the directly modified component changes sample-median evaluation success by 0.645-1.000 across tasks, while removing an exponential moving average produces task-dependent changes. We then move to a cross-law comparison and choose a velocity scale that exactly matches the position interface's local raw-torque command gain. This calibration raises the sample median on GearMesh and NutThread, with no median change on PegInsert. Yet clear residual sample-median gaps remain on PegInsert and GearMesh, while the NutThread interval includes zero. Thus, even this explicit equality leaves feedback and held-action dynamics unmatched and does not establish position-velocity trained-outcome equivalence. Action-interface comparisons should therefore report the executed pathway and state the physical quantity they match.
summary_zh: 机器人学习研究常常将位置动作与速度动作进行对比，仿佛每个标签都对应一种单一的实验处理方式，然而标签本身并不能决定机器人实际执行的内容。在影响机器人运动之前，有界策略输出需经过滤波、物理缩放、参考构建、反馈、时序及力矩限制等多个环节。本研究探讨了在共享同一学习器和训练预算的条件下，这些被忽略的属性如何影响归因结果。我们在三个接触密集的工厂任务（PegInsert、GearMesh和NutThread）中，比较了五种关节空间接口，每种条件下独立训练十个策略。首先，我们保持相同的位置反馈律不变，仅改变实际执行的接口：仅替换作为直接修改组件的物理动作尺度，样本中位评估成功率在各项任务中变化范围为0.645至1.000；而去除指数移动平均则导致任务依赖性的变化。随后，我们进行跨控制律比较，选择与位置接口局部原始力矩指令增益完全匹配的速度尺度。这一校准在GearMesh和NutThread上提升了样本中位数，而PegInsert的中位数未发生变化。然而，在PegInsert和GearMesh上仍存在明显的残差样本中位差距，而NutThread的区间则包含零。因此，即使实现了这种显式相等，反馈和保持动作动态仍无法匹配，且不能确立位置与速度训练结果之间的等价性。因此，动作接口比较应报告实际执行路径，并明确其所匹配的物理量。
tldr: This paper investigates how different robot action interfaces (position vs. velocity) with varying filtering, scaling, and feedback properties affect the trained outcomes in robot learning, showing that action-space labels alone do not determine executed behavior and that explicit matching of command gains is insufficient for equivalence.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了机器人学习中不同的动作接口（位置 vs 速度）及其滤波、缩放和反馈属性如何影响训练结果，表明动作空间标签本身并不能决定实际执行行为，且仅匹配命令增益不足以实现等价。

title: Learning from Relative Action Credit for Escaping Local Minima
summary: Reinforcement learning holds the promise of robots that learn manipulation skills from interaction alone, without pretrained priors or demonstration data. In practice, on-policy methods such as PPO routinely stall on long-horizon, contact-rich tasks: dense reward shaping carries the policy through stages, yet stitching them together and discovering sparsely rewarded events rarely succeeds. We trace this failure to the missing action discrimination in state-value credit assignment: a state-value critic judges progress only by episode outcomes, so when the policy converges to a partial solution all outcomes coincide, and improvement stops because no action can prove better than another. We therefore extend PPO with an action conditioned value critic which, can compare the executed action with alternatives sampled at the same state and aid the learning signal. Combined with Generalized Advantage Estimation and a bound on exploration noise, we show how the extended algorithm escapes the plateau and completes precise peg insertion within a training budget where PPO with identical exploration fails.
summary_zh: 强化学习有望使机器人仅通过交互即可学习操作技能，而无需预训练先验或示范数据。然而在实践中，诸如PPO之类的同策略方法在处理长时程、高接触任务时往往会陷入停滞：密集的奖励塑形引导策略分阶段推进，但将这些阶段衔接起来并发现稀疏奖励事件却鲜有成功。我们将这一失败归因于状态值信用分配中缺乏动作区分能力：状态值评论家仅凭回合结果判断进展，因此当策略收敛到部分解时，所有结果趋于一致，改进随之停止，因为没有任何动作能证明优于其他动作。为此，我们对PPO进行了扩展，引入一个以动作条件为基础的价值评论家，该评论家能够将执行的动作与在同一状态下采样的替代动作进行比较，从而增强学习信号。结合广义优势估计以及对探索噪声的约束，我们展示了扩展算法如何脱离平台期，并在相同探索条件下PPO无法成功的训练预算内完成精确的销钉插入任务。
tldr: PPO is extended with an action-conditioned critic that compares executed actions against alternatives to improve credit assignment and escape local minima in long-horizon, contact-rich manipulation, demonstrated on precise peg insertion.
tldr_zh: 本文在PPO中引入动作条件价值评论家，通过比较已执行动作与替代动作来增强信用分配，从而在长视野、接触丰富的操作任务中帮助策略逃离局部最小值，并在精密插孔任务中验证了有效性。

title: Active Constraints for Simultaneous Guidance and Safety in Handheld Micromanipulation
summary: In micromanipulation, erroneous hand motion limits unaided manipulation accuracy, which can affect task performance and safety in critical applications like microsurgery. Handheld robots (micromanipulators) enable motion accuracy beyond human limits by providing robotic assistance in a low-cost, compact, intuitive form factor. Particularly, active constraints are an effective form of robotic assistance, which aids the operator by restricting the robot's permissible motion based on task-specific requirements or objectives, thereby providing task guidance and enforcing safety. However, existing formulations of active constraints for handheld systems are limited, most notably because of the inability to provide guidance and enforce safety simultaneously. Implementing active constraints with optimization-based methods can address these limitations, but existing implementations are designed for free-standing robots, and neglect that handheld robots actuate relative to the operator's hand with a limited workspace. In this work, we propose an optimization-based active constraint framework for handheld micromanipulation that enables simultaneous guidance and safety enforcement. The formulation was implemented in a handheld robot and demonstrated on a medically relevant artificial task. Results show that the proposed formulation reduced safety violation rate by more than two orders of magnitude relative to baselines, while recovering the threefold accuracy loss from enforcing safety alone.
summary_zh: 在显微操作中，手部错误运动会限制非辅助操作的精度，进而影响关键应用（如显微手术）中的任务表现与安全性。手持式机器人（显微操作器）通过以低成本、紧凑且直观的形式提供机器人辅助，实现超越人体极限的运动精度。其中，主动约束是一种有效的机器人辅助形式，它根据任务特定要求或目标限制机器人的允许运动，从而为操作者提供任务引导并确保安全性。然而，现有针对手持系统的主动约束方案存在局限性，最显著的是无法同时提供引导和保障安全。基于优化的方法实现主动约束可以解决这些局限，但现有实现主要针对独立式机器人设计，忽略了手持机器人是在操作者手部相对运动且工作空间有限的情况下执行操作。在本研究中，我们提出了一种面向手持显微操作的基于优化的主动约束框架，能够同时实现引导与安全保障。该方案已在一款手持机器人上实现，并在医学相关的模拟任务中进行了验证。结果表明，与基线方法相比，所提方案将安全违规率降低了两个数量级以上，同时弥补了仅实施安全约束所带来的三倍精度损失。
tldr: This paper introduces an optimization-based active constraint framework for handheld micromanipulators that simultaneously provides task guidance and safety enforcement, demonstrating a significant reduction in safety violations and recovery of accuracy on a medically relevant artificial task.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于优化的主动约束框架，用于手持微操作机器人，可同时提供任务引导和安全约束，在医学相关的人工任务中显著降低了安全违规率并恢复了操作精度。

title: TACOS: Terrain-Aware COntact Supervision for Visual Footstep Planning
summary: Humans navigate their environment based on their vision system, anticipating how the ground will respond before committing to a step. Self-supervised learning could provide legged robots the same ability, but the supervisory signal is typically chosen on intuition, and its effect on what the model learns is rarely examined. We present Terrain-Aware COntact Supervision (TACOS), which proposes a meaningful and consistent footstep instability score, based on the residual of a factor graph in legged state estimation. It projects the continuous score into preceding images to supervise a dense visual predictor. We propose two variants, a hard score that exploits hindsight and a causal soft score available immediately. Both metrics are compared against state-of-the-art alternatives in two independent evaluations that share no data or labels. On 1716 manually annotated contacts, both variants outperform every evaluated alternative at detecting instability and ranking its severity, improving pooled severity ranking by 28 % over the strongest baseline. On three outdoor test runs, our metric also trains the most accurate visual predictor, improving rank correlation by 58 % over the strongest alternative, and by a further 25 % when supplemented with onboard context. In a real-world experiment over a 50 m forest trajectory, the trained predictor handles non-geometric terrain properties such as mud and vegetation, while stepping around geometric obstacles like fallen branches. Code is available for reproducibility at https://github.com/norlab-ulaval/TACOS.
summary_zh: 人类在环境中导航时依赖视觉系统，在迈出一步之前会预判地面将如何响应。自监督学习可以为腿式机器人提供相同的能力，但监督信号通常凭直觉选择，且其对模型学习内容的影响很少被审视。我们提出了地形感知接触监督（TACOS），该方法基于腿式状态估计中因子图的残差，提出了一种有意义且一致的脚步不稳定度评分。该评分被投影到之前的图像上，以监督密集视觉预测器的训练。我们提出了两种变体：一种利用后见之明的硬评分，以及一种可即时获得的因果软评分。两种指标均在两个独立评估中与最新替代方法进行比较，这两项评估不共享数据或标签。在1716个手动标注的接触点上，两种变体在检测不稳定性和对其严重程度排序方面均优于所有评估的替代方法，在汇总严重性排名上较最强基线提高了28%。在三次户外测试运行中，我们的指标也训练出了最准确的视觉预测器，在排名相关性上较最强替代方案提高了58%，并在补充机载上下文后进一步提高了25%。在一条50米森林轨迹的真实世界实验中，训练得到的预测器能够处理泥泞和植被等非几何地形属性，同时绕开倒下的树枝等几何障碍物。代码已公开以便复现，网址为 https://github.com/norlab-ulaval/TACOS。
tldr: TACOS proposes a terrain-aware footstep instability score derived from factor-graph residuals in legged state estimation, and uses it to supervise a dense visual predictor for legged robots, demonstrating improved instability detection and real-world traversal over forest terrain.
tldr_zh: TACOS 提出一种基于腿部状态估计中因子图残差的地形感知脚步不稳定度评分，用于监督密集视觉预测器，并在真实森林地形上验证了其有效性和鲁棒性。

title: An Empirical Study of Wrist-Target Construction and Joint-Angle Limits in Humanoid Arm Retargeting
summary: Motion retargeting maps a demonstrated human movement onto a robot to compute its joint motion. This study examines how the construction of the desired wrist position affects whether computed arm joint angles reach their permitted limits on a Unitree H1-2. A reconstructed target is formed from demonstrated arm directions and robot segment lengths, so its shoulder-to-wrist distance depends on the demonstrated angle between the segments even when no posture-matching preference is applied. A reach-normalized target retains that direction while rescaling the distance, using the same processed demonstrations and the same joint-angle method. Across a forward-reach sweep the reconstructed target places a joint angle at a bound in 10 of 20 repetitions and the reach-normalized target in none. Across 25 recordings from one participant the corresponding counts are 8 and 6 on the reaching arm and 14 and 5 on the supporting arm, and a second participant repeats the bricklaying and lifting comparison. In hardware replay a joint is commanded to a bound in 12 of 16 direction-matching arm-records and in none of the 16 normalized records, and within the eligible records both tracking error and executed torque at those frames exceed their values elsewhere in the same run. Cross-body reach and arm-to-arm clearance identify limits of radial adjustment. The findings support treating target construction and posture matching as separate retargeting decisions, and evaluating both alongside the wrist positions and clearance that manipulation requires.
summary_zh: 运动重定向将演示的人体动作映射到机器人上，以计算其关节运动。本研究考察了期望腕部位置的构建方式如何影响Unitree H1-2上计算出的手臂关节角度是否达到其允许极限。由演示的手臂方向和机器人肢体段长度构成一个重建目标，因此其肩到腕的距离取决于演示中肢体段之间的夹角，即使不施加任何姿态匹配偏好也是如此。可达性归一化目标保留该方向的同时重新缩放距离，使用相同的处理后演示数据及相同的关节角度计算方法。在向前伸够扫描中，重建目标在20次重复中的10次中将关节角度置于边界处，而可达性归一化目标则从未触及边界。基于一名参与者的25次记录，在伸够手臂上对应次数分别为8次和6次，在支撑手臂上为14次和5次；第二名参与者重复了砌砖和提举动作的对比实验。在硬件回放中，16个方向匹配手臂记录中的12个中，某一关节被指令到达边界，而16个归一化记录中无一到达边界；在符合条件的记录中，这些帧处的跟踪误差和执行转矩均超过同一次运行中其他帧的数值。交叉身体伸够和手臂间间隙识别出径向调整的极限。研究结果支持将目标构建和姿态匹配视为两个独立的重定向决策，并应将两者与操作所需的腕部位置及间隙一同评估。
tldr: This paper investigates how wrist-target construction in humanoid arm retargeting affects joint-angle limit violations on a Unitree H1-2, showing that reach-normalized targets reduce limit hits compared to reconstructed targets. It recommends separating target construction from posture matching in retargeting design.
tldr_zh: 本文研究人形机械臂重定目标中手腕目标构建对关节角限制的影响，在Unitree H1-2上实验表明，距离归一化的目标比重构目标更少触发关节限位，建议将目标构建与姿态匹配分离考虑。

title: A Multi-Layer Navigation System for Smart Wheelchairs with a Limited Input Interface
summary: Smart wheelchairs are robotic devices that gather information from the surroundings and allow people to safely drive through various environments. They usually rely on the interpretation of high-level user's intentions, typically decoded through human-robot interface (HRI) or brain-machine interface (BMI). However, navigating in an unknown environment and accurately understanding user commands remain significant challenges. Misinterpretation of commands or the environment can lead to user frustration, distrust of the system, or even unsafe situations. In this paper, we present a novel Multi-Layer Navigation System (MLNS) for a smart wheelchair that enables navigation in unknown environments while interpreting and safely contextualizing user's intentions even in the case of limited and faulty commands. The stack relies on a Virtual Sensors-Driven Potential Fields (ViSPF) method for obstacle detection that accounts for the wheelchair's actual size, a Model Predictive Control (MPC) module for trajectory generation, and an open-vocabulary computer vision algorithm for target identification. Finally, a system based on Priority Queue (PQ) was implemented for target selection. We validated our system on a real smart wheelchair with experiments involving 10 participants without disabilities, including scenarios with faulty input interfaces. The results demonstrate the robustness and effectiveness of our system in real-world environments, proving its potential for practical applications in assistive technologies.
summary_zh: 智能轮椅是一种机器人设备，它从周围环境中收集信息，使人们能够在各种环境中安全驾驶。这类设备通常依赖于对用户高层次意图的解读，这种意图通常通过人机接口或脑机接口进行解码。然而，在未知环境中导航以及准确理解用户指令仍然是一项重大挑战。指令或环境的误读可能导致用户产生挫败感、对系统不信任，甚至引发不安全的情况。本文提出了一种用于智能轮椅的新型多层导航系统，该系统能够在未知环境中导航，同时即使在指令有限或存在错误的情况下，也能解读并安全地情境化用户的意图。该系统栈依赖于一种考虑轮椅实际尺寸的虚拟传感器驱动势场障碍物检测方法、用于轨迹生成的模型预测控制模块，以及一种开放词汇的计算机视觉算法用于目标识别。最后，系统实现了一种基于优先级队列的目标选择机制。我们在真实的智能轮椅上进行了验证实验，共有10名无残疾参与者参与，其中包括故障输入界面的场景。实验结果表明，该系统在真实环境中具有良好的鲁棒性和有效性，证明了其在辅助技术实际应用中的潜力。
tldr: This paper presents a Multi-Layer Navigation System for smart wheelchairs that combines potential fields, model predictive control, and open-vocabulary computer vision to enable safe navigation in unknown environments with limited or faulty user input, validated on a real wheelchair.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种智能轮椅多层导航系统，结合势场、模型预测控制和开放词汇计算机视觉，在未知环境中实现安全导航并处理有限或有故障的用户输入，并在真实轮椅上进行了验证。

title: Recursive Self-Improvement in Physical AI: Mechanisms, Evidence, and Evaluation
summary: Embodied systems can update policies, world models, skills, and executable programs from deployment experience, allowing one interaction to benefit later tasks. When a system also revises and reuses its data-acquisition, feedback, or learning procedures, experience changes the process that produces capability, introducing recursive self-improvement. This paper surveys research in physical AI through the connection between persistent capability and its improvement process. We first explain the functional distinction between learner updates and improvers, then compare policy learning, imagined experience, memory and skill accumulation, and executable harnesses. These approaches connect to revisions of curricula, rewards, and research programs in different ways. Contact validity, recovery, retention, and resource costs determine whether the resulting gains accumulate during continued deployment. An L0-L3 rubric distinguishes task-local adaptation, persistent capability gain, inherited process revision, and verified improver gain. Representative benchmarks and within-study contrasts relate these distinctions to existing results. We further propose common-data and interactive comparisons that evaluate reference and revised improvers from shared learner starts, separating the use of experience from its acquisition. This perspective connects the diverse methods, physical operating conditions, and evaluation evidence, underpinning embodied RSI. A comprehensive list of studies in this survey is available at https://github.com/nkd-lkz/physical-ai-rsi-survey.
summary_zh: 具身系统能够根据部署经验更新策略、世界模型、技能及可执行程序，使一次交互惠及后续任务。当系统还对其数据采集、反馈或学习流程进行修正与复用时，经验便改变了产生能力的过程，从而引入递归式自我改进。本文通过持久能力与其改进过程之间的联系，对物理AI领域的研究进行了综述。我们首先阐明学习者更新与改进者之间的功能区分，随后比较策略学习、想象经验、记忆与技能积累以及可执行框架等方法。这些方法以不同方式关联到课程、奖励及研究方案的修订。接触有效性、恢复能力、保留性以及资源成本决定了所获增益能否在持续部署中不断累积。一个L0-L3分级标准区分了任务局部适应、持久能力增益、继承式流程修订以及经验证的改进者增益。代表性基准与组内对比将这些区分与现有结果联系起来。我们进一步提出公共数据与交互式比较方法，从共享学习者起点评估参考型与修订型改进者，从而将经验的使用与其获取分开。这一视角将多样方法、物理运行条件及评估证据联系起来，为具身递归自我改进奠定基础。本综述所涵盖研究的完整列表见 https://github.com/nkd-lkz/physical-ai-rsi-survey。
tldr: This paper surveys recursive self-improvement (RSI) in physical AI, distinguishing between learner updates and improvers, proposing an L0-L3 rubric for capability gain and process revision, and advocating for common-data evaluations to measure embodied RSI.
tldr_zh: 本文综述了物理AI中的递归自我改进（RSI），区分了学习器更新与改进器，提出了L0-L3能力增益与过程修订的评估标准，并倡导用共享数据评测来度量具身RSI。

title: 3D Occupancy-Language Fields from mmWave Radar
summary: Radar systems can recover scene geometry and recognize predefined categories, but these outputs do not provide a persistent spatial representation for open-ended language queries. Such queries require linking observations from different viewpoints to the same physical locations. We present TextRadar, a framework that constructs a scene-level 3D occupancy-language field from panoramic radar observations. The field combines occupancy with scale-dependent language features at surface locations, allowing the reconstructed scene to be queried with new descriptions. A single-frame radar distillation model predicts aligned ranges and language features from each radar observation. Using radar-estimated poses, we register these predictions to reconstruct the field from radar alone in a new scene. Experiments on approximately 20k synchronized observations across seven buildings demonstrate scene-level natural-language querying and prompt-free semantic visualization. Analysis of camera-to-radar concept transferability shows stronger agreement for structures, materials, and human poses than for colors and printed text.
summary_zh: 雷达系统能够恢复场景几何结构并识别预定义类别，但这些输出无法为开放式语言查询提供持续的空间表征。此类查询需要将不同视角的观测关联到相同的物理位置。我们提出TextRadar，一种从全景雷达观测构建场景级三维占据-语言场的框架。该场结合了占据信息与表面位置处的尺度相关语言特征，使得重建场景可通过新描述进行查询。单帧雷达蒸馏模型从每次雷达观测中预测对齐的距离和语言特征。利用雷达估计的位姿，我们配准这些预测，仅凭雷达即可在新场景中重建该场。在七栋建筑约两万次同步观测上的实验表明，该方法支持场景级自然语言查询和无提示语义可视化。对相机到雷达概念可迁移性的分析显示，在结构、材质和人体姿态方面的一致性优于颜色和印刷文本。
tldr: TextRadar constructs a scene-level 3D occupancy-language field from mmWave radar observations, enabling open-ended natural language queries and semantic visualization without cameras.
tldr_zh: TextRadar利用毫米波雷达观测构建场景级3D占用-语言场，支持开放式自然语言查询和无需相机的语义可视化。

title: GOFish: Full Field-of-View Gaussian Splatting and Mesh Extraction
summary: Robots, autonomous vehicles, and consumer 360° cameras use fisheye lenses for wide fields of view (FoVs). Simulation-ready digital twins require photorealistic rendering across the full FoV and an aligned collision mesh. However, prior fisheye Gaussian Splatting methods only rasterize up to 180° and do not produce meshes, while Gaussian surface reconstruction methods assume pinhole training images. We present GOFish, the first 3D Gaussian Splatting surface reconstruction method to train directly on fisheye images, rasterize FoVs beyond 180°, and extract an aligned mesh from the same scene. Calibrated densification recovers the surface across the entire FoV, while Calibrated Mip Filtering and Wide-Angle Appearance Modeling keep pixel blur and lens falloff out of the scene and mesh. Across the 200° FIORD and 205° FullCircle benchmarks, GOFish improves PSNR over the best prior method by 2.28 and 1.97 dB, respectively. It also outperforms fisheye rendering baselines within their own FoVs and achieves the highest mesh F-score on FIORD and the main ScanNet++ set. Together, the Gaussian scene and mesh form a LiDAR-free, simulation-ready digital twin that renders in real time, ray traces the full FoV, and provides collision geometry.
summary_zh: 机器人、自动驾驶车辆及消费级360°相机采用鱼眼镜头以获取宽视场角（FoV）。仿真就绪的数字孪生需要在整个视场角内实现照片级逼真渲染，并具备对齐的碰撞网格。然而，现有的鱼眼高斯泼溅方法仅能光栅化至180°，且不生成网格，而高斯表面重建方法则假设使用针孔相机训练图像。我们提出GOFish，这是首个直接在鱼眼图像上训练的3D高斯泼溅表面重建方法，可光栅化超过180°的视场角，并从同一场景中提取对齐网格。标定致密化可在整个视场角内恢复表面，而标定Mip滤波与广角外观建模则避免像素模糊与镜头衰减影响场景及网格。在200°FIORD与205°FullCircle基准测试中，GOFish的PSNR分别较最优现有方法提升2.28 dB和1.97 dB。同时，其在自身视场角内的鱼眼渲染性能亦优于基线方法，并在FIORD及主要ScanNet++数据集上取得最高网格F分数。综合而言，高斯场景与网格共同构成无需激光雷达、仿真就绪的数字孪生，可实时渲染、光线追踪整个视场角，并提供碰撞几何体。
tldr: GOFish is a 3D Gaussian Splatting surface reconstruction method that trains directly on fisheye images, supports rasterization beyond 180° FoV, and extracts aligned collision meshes for simulation-ready digital twins.
tldr_zh: GOFish 是一种直接基于鱼眼图像训练的 3D 高斯泼溅表面重建方法，支持超过 180° 视场的光栅化，并提取对齐的碰撞网格，用于仿真就绪的数字孪生。

title: SSQA: Sibling-Selective Quadtree Attention for Hierarchical Modeling in Perception Tasks
summary: Perception tasks for navigation in robotics, including aerial platforms such as drones and autonomous driving systems, are inherently structured. Drone-mounted cameras typically capture sky above, terrain below, and obstacles or man-made structures in between, while driving data often contains organized road layouts, lane markings, and surrounding agents. Motivated by these axis-aligned structural priors, we note that such information is typically more structured than in generic image tasks. We hypothesize that processing information in a quadtree-esque manner can not only model features effectively in a hierarchical manner, but also offers an efficient linear-time alternative to vanilla attention mechanisms, which run in quadratic time. In this paper, we propose Sibling-Selective Quadtree Attention (SSQA), which models image tokens hierarchically as a structured, full quadtree. We show analytical complexity analysis that guarantees linear-time feature modeling, in addition to empirical experiments comparing inference speeds with other popular modeling approaches, such as Mamba 2 and Quadtree Attention. Our results, benchmarked across several tasks, show that we achieve results at least as good, if not notably better, as others at a fraction of the computational costs.
summary_zh: 针对机器人导航中的感知任务，包括无人机等空中平台及自动驾驶系统，其本质具有高度结构化特征。无人机搭载的摄像头通常捕获上方天空、下方地形以及介于两者之间的障碍物或人造结构，而驾驶数据则常包含规整的道路布局、车道标线和周边交通参与者。受这些轴对齐结构先验的启发，我们注意到此类信息通常比一般图像任务中的信息更具结构性。我们假设，以四叉树方式处理信息不仅能以分层方式有效建模特征，还能为以二次时间运行的普通注意力机制提供一种高效的线性时间替代方案。本文提出了兄弟选择四叉树注意力机制（SSQA），它将图像令牌分层建模为结构化的完整四叉树。我们通过解析复杂度分析证明了其线性时间特征建模的可行性，并与主流建模方法（如Mamba 2和四叉树注意力）进行了推理速度的实证对比实验。在多个任务上的基准测试结果表明，我们的方法在计算成本大幅降低的情况下，性能至少与其他方法相当，甚至显著更优。
tldr: The paper proposes Sibling-Selective Quadtree Attention (SSQA), a linear-time attention mechanism that hierarchically models image tokens using a quadtree structure, targeting structured perception tasks in robotics and autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种线性时间注意力机制——兄弟选择性四叉树注意力（SSQA），利用四叉树结构对图像令牌进行分层建模，面向机器人和自动驾驶中的结构化感知任务。

title: TRIM: Temporal Run-Time Monitoring of 3D Object Detection via Activation Statistics
summary: Reliable perception is essential to intelligent transportation systems, yet deep neural networks can silently miss safety-critical objects while continuing to produce apparently plausible outputs. Existing run-time monitors for 3D object detection generally assess each frame independently and therefore cannot exploit the temporal evolution of occlusion, point sparsity, and scene complexity. We present TRIM, a lightweight temporal monitor that detects missed-object failures without modifying or retraining the underlying detector. TRIM summarises intermediate activations using compact channel-wise statistics and processes short sequences of these summaries with a temporal convolutional network. Experiments on NuScenes show that temporal monitoring improves AUROC from 0.686 to 0.704 and reduces the false alarm rate at 95% recall from 0.818 to 0.759 compared with single-frame monitoring. Early and intermediate backbone features provide the strongest monitoring signal, while the temporal inference head requires only 0.159 ms on a CPU.
tldr: TRIM is a lightweight temporal monitor that detects missed-object failures in 3D object detection for intelligent transportation by summarizing intermediate activations and processing sequences with a temporal convolutional network, improving monitoring performance on NuScenes without modifying the detector.
tldr_zh: TRIM 是一种轻量级时间监控方法，通过汇总中间激活并用时间卷积网络处理序列，在不修改检测器的情况下检测智能交通中 3D 目标检测的漏检故障，在 NuScenes 上提升了监控性能。

title: Minimum Sufficient Communication for Independent Behaviour Tree Robot Teams
summary: We present an experimental framework for determining sufficient communication in robot teams running fixed, independent Behaviour Trees with private blackboards. Within a declared policy family, we vary message content and admission frequency and measure traffic in recipient-weighted bits per robot decision. A dense sweep identifies candidate policies for comparison with full-state communication. We retest selected candidates and the reference on fresh, paired scenarios, using one-sided simultaneous confidence bounds to assess whether success remains within five percentage points of the full-state reference. The bounds also assess whether tested cheaper policies can be ruled out as insufficient. Depending on the evidence, the framework reports an exact minimum, a positive bracket, a sufficient upper bound, or an unresolved boundary. Experiments with eight content policies across four warehouse conditions identify zero communication as the exact minimum under low contention. In the scaled condition, the no-release policy at gate $q=0.992222$ is confirmed sufficient, achieving 96.33% success at an estimated rate of 738.55 bits per robot decision, or 0.544% of full-state traffic. The positive minimum remains unresolved. These claims apply only to the declared policy family, sampled gate values and operating conditions.
tldr: This paper presents an experimental framework to find minimum sufficient communication policies for robot teams using independent Behavior Trees, showing that zero communication can be sufficient in low-contention warehouse conditions and reducing traffic to 0.544% of full-state in scaled scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个实验框架，用于确定使用独立行为树的机器人团队的最低足够通信策略，在低竞争仓库条件下零通信即足够，在扩展场景中可将通信量降至全状态通信的0.544%。

title: EARS-Info: Information-Aware Event-Driven Reallocation for Multi-Robot Exploration
summary: We introduce EARS-Info, an information-aware extension of Event-Driven Ant Reallocation Search for multi-robot exploration on OpenStreetMap-derived grids. It combines marginal sensing gain, feasible relocation, return-aware routing, sensing reservations, and cached shortest paths. Across 168,000 episodes comparing 30 implementations on eight city maps, EARS-Info achieves the highest mean operational score in every evaluation panel. With eight robots and 3% communication dropout, it improves the score over EARS-Safe by 5.43%, increases weighted discovery from 88.88% to 98.46%, and reduces mean energy use by 2.62%. Score differences are positive in all eight cities ($p=0.0078125$; descriptive 95% city-bootstrap interval $[0.0159,0.0694]$), with no simulated incidents across 5,600 EARS-Info episodes. These results support the complete controller; individual component advantages remain uncertain. Generalization is limited by reused geography, one training replicate, coarse maps, and adapted comparison methods.
tldr: EARS-Info enhances multi-robot exploration by adding information-aware reallocation, marginal sensing gain, and return-aware routing, achieving higher operational scores and lower energy use on OpenStreetMap-derived grids.
tldr_zh: EARS-Info 通过增加信息感知重分配、边际感知增益和回归感知路由，在多机器人探索中实现了更高的操作分数和更低的能耗。

title: When "No Worries" Went Wrong: HRI Lessons for Foundation-Model Robots
summary: When a person declined our robot's invitation to play, Alice turned her shoulder away and said "No worries, it's all good." Only after a brief pause did she drive off. The words and gestures were plausible but their order changed the message. In another episode, Alice informed a host that his visitor had arrived---while the visitor stood right beside him. Both came from a three-year ROS 2 HRI consortium that integrated large language and vision models as they emerged. Today's foundation models give robots broader capabilities to perceive their surroundings, reason about situations and generate behavior. Yet capability alone does not ensure that a changed situation shapes the action that reaches a person. Evidence may never be acquired, or a purpose or constraint may fail to survive planning and execution. A system may even report Success when an action no longer serves its intended purpose. Drawing on the consortium's engineering experience, we develop five design lessons about attention, knowledge, commitments, embodied timing and action authority. We then introduce TRACE, a lightweight review that changes one interaction premise, follows it to a decision or enforcement boundary, and produces an actionable architecture finding. A bounded analysis of a published LLM-generated behavior-tree system illustrates how an available clarification mechanism can go unused. The engineering lesson is to preserve accountability boundaries, not the computational pipelines that once exposed them.
tldr: This paper presents five design lessons for human-robot interaction with foundation-model robots, drawn from a three-year ROS 2 HRI consortium, and introduces TRACE, a lightweight review method to identify accountability boundaries in robot behavior architectures.
tldr_zh: 本文基于为期三年的ROS 2人机交互联盟经验，提出了针对基础模型机器人的五条设计教训，并介绍了TRACE轻量级审查方法，以识别机器人行为架构中的责任边界。

title: Compositional Diffusion Planning with Chunk Selection and Reachability Measure
summary: Compositional diffusion planners have demonstrated remarkable success on long-horizon diffusion planning by sampling short trajectories, namely chunks, and composing them into a long trajectory. However, averaging overlapping chunks can induce the mode-averaging problem, resulting in discontinuous trajectories. Several works aim to address this problem, whereas a non-negligible portion of plans remains infeasible. In this work, we propose Selective Compositional Diffuser (SCD), handling this problem by measuring reachability. To this end, we present a self-supervised learning method for the reachability classifier. This is trained on offline data and generated chunks jointly to address potential distributional mismatch, while reducing the bias inherited from the generated data. Based on this, we construct a graph whose edge costs represent whether consecutive chunks are reachable, and traverse the graph to find effective yet efficient routes. Lastly, we generate bridging trajectories and refine the composed trajectory for smooth transitions. We evaluate our method on OGBench stitching tasks. It practically reduces incompatible mode compositions and the mode-averaging problem compared to the studied baselines. Across tasks, SCD improves success rates, reaching state-of-the-art results on HumanoidMaze-Large and Giant tasks.
tldr: This paper introduces Selective Compositional Diffuser (SCD), a method that improves long-horizon diffusion planning by using a self-supervised reachability classifier to select and compose trajectory chunks, reducing mode-averaging and improving success rates on OGBench tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了选择性组合扩散器（SCD），通过自监督可达性分类器选择和组合轨迹块，减少模式平均问题，并在OGBench任务上提高了成功率。

title: Efficacy of Monocular Depth Estimation in Lunar Environments
summary: Recent advances in monocular depth estimation have demonstrated highly accurate 3D reconstructions within in-distribution terrestrial domains. This study investigates the efficacy of several state-of-the-art approaches to reconstruct out-of-distribution lunar environments using the NASA Ames Polar Optical Lunar Analog Reconstruction (POLAR) stereo dataset and Apollo 17 surface imagery. By leveraging these datasets, we establish a robust analog-to-field validation pipeline that evaluates quantitative performance against ground-truth physical analogs and qualitative performance against historical field data. Our results indicate that select state-of-the-art techniques can successfully generalize to produce high-fidelity relative 3D reconstructions of the unstructured lunar surface.
tldr: This paper evaluates monocular depth estimation models on lunar datasets, an out-of-distribution environment, using a NASA stereo dataset and Apollo 17 imagery to assess generalization to unstructured terrain.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了单目深度估计模型在月球数据集上的表现，利用NASA立体数据集和阿波罗17号图像，检验其在非结构化地形上的泛化能力。

title: Influence of Agent Number and Behavior on Users' Psychological Responses in VR Evacuation Training
summary: This study aims to build effective drill software by combining a virtual simulation of a disaster with multiple agents capable of expressing emotions. We evaluated how the number of agents and their emotional and behavioral actions during evacuation influence users in a virtual space. The results showed that users tended to act more confidently when many agents evacuated with them, and that the evacuation route chosen by the agents influenced the users' decision-making. These findings indicate that users' evacuation behavior is shaped not only by the environment itself but also by the collective behavior of surrounding agents, underscoring the need to consider how agent behavior affects users' psychological states during training.
tldr: This paper presents a VR evacuation training study examining how the number and emotional/behavioral actions of virtual agents influence users' evacuation behavior and psychological states, finding that agent behavior significantly impacts decision-making and confidence.
tldr_zh: 该论文通过VR疏散训练实验，研究了虚拟代理的数量及其情绪和行为对用户疏散行为和心理状态的影响，发现代理行为显著影响用户的决策和自信心。

title: Minimum-Time Escape from the Conic Field of View of a Reeds--Shepp Pursuer: the Faster Evader
summary: We continue the study of minimum-time escape of an omnidirectional evader from the forward conic field of view of a Reeds--Shepp pursuer, now for a faster evader, and solve the game for every speed ratio $ν>1$ and every half-angle $0<α<π/2$: the escape time is characterized by explicit characteristics and the selection of roots of a scalar equation, and it is the value of the game in nonanticipative strategies at every state. Above the end $E$ of the evader's dispersal line on the front axis, the evader chases the reversing pursuer along a universal line fed by tributaries. The characteristic from the boundary of the usable part is an involute of a circle of radius $ν$ ending at a cusp, and two explicit thresholds decide whether it reaches the axis before the cusp and whether the jump of the escape time across it ends before the cusp or runs to it; in the latter case primaries fold back next to the barrier. The pursuer's optimal strategy is the relay of the slower case. The evader follows the tributaries and switches once to a primary, or commits in advance to a heading certified by the scalar equation of the primaries. Level-set and semi-Lagrangian computations are compared with the value.
tldr: This paper solves a min-time pursuit-evasion game where a faster evader escapes the conic field-of-view of a Reeds-Shepp pursuer, providing explicit escape-time maps and optimal strategies validated by level-set/semi-Lagrangian computations.
tldr_zh: 本文求解了一个更快的逃逸者从Reeds-Shepp追踪者锥形视野中最小时间逃逸的博弈问题，给出了显式的逃逸时间映射和最优策略，并通过水平集/半拉格朗日计算进行了验证。

title: Forward-Backward Map Matching for Airborne Magnetic Anomaly Navigation
summary: Airborne magnetic anomaly navigation provides a passive, unjammable alternative to Global Navigation Satellite Systems positioning by matching magnetometer measurements against a lithospheric magnetic anomaly map. Existing map-matching algorithms either assume a Gaussian posterior (extended Kalman filter), require Monte Carlo sampling (particle filter), or discard posterior uncertainty in favour of a single optimal path (Viterbi algorithm). Here we formulate map matching as inference on a chain-structured factor graph and solve it segment by segment using the forward-backward algorithm, which yields a discrete posterior over candidate positions and its Shannon entropy $H_t$ at time $t$. Over the \texttt{Renfrew\_395} map, $10^3$ synthetic trials yield a median position error of $32.7$ m, $91\%$ below the median inertial drift of $362$ m. On these trials and $10^3$ flight paths, the median error is $43\%$ below the extended Kalman filter and particle filter. Across these paths, a threshold on segment-level entropy detects $47\%$ of segments with errors above two map cells and $94\%$ of those above three, at a $10\%$ false-alarm rate. The foregoing results indicate that $H_t$ provides a truth-free diagnostic of map-conditioned navigation ambiguity.
tldr: This paper introduces a forward-backward map-matching algorithm for airborne magnetic anomaly navigation, formulated as inference on a chain-structured factor graph to yield a discrete posterior and its entropy for uncertainty quantification. It demonstrates improved position error over EKF and particle filters on synthetic trials and uses entropy as a truth-free diagnostic for navigation ambiguity.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于航空磁异常导航的前向-后向地图匹配算法，将其表述为链式因子图上的推断，以获得离散后验及其熵用于不确定性量化。在合成试验中相对于EKF和粒子滤波提高了位置误差，并利用熵作为无真值的导航模糊度诊断。

title: When More Planning Hurts: Learned Planners for World Models
summary: On PushT, our fixed action updater (1,505 parameters) solves 8 of 16 scenes reserved from our configuration selection. The comparison planners perform as follows: Selected Adam (7 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 218.440s), adapted iCEM (2 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 49.309s), released LePlanner (16 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 5.652s). The total planning and encoding time for our action updater is 59.079s. Note that our action updater does not satisfy the task-cost criterion we fixed before evaluation. We also conduct another matched experiment where we only replay the first ten commands in each context and then allow the next solve 4, 8 or 12 updates (subsequent solves all get 8 updates). Among all 16 contexts (8 scene clusters), the 3 budgets get 9, 8 and 7 successes, respectively. Interestingly, the extra updates did not rescue any failing task in this experiment. All the changes in success/failure happen in one scene cluster, where we observe that the extra updates decrease the costs of the selected latent world-model trajectories for our updater, while the tasks that used to be successes become failures. The code, weights, evaluators, execution traces and cost accounting accompany the paper.
tldr: The paper investigates the counterintuitive effect that increasing planning effort in a world-model-based planner can degrade task performance, presenting a learned fixed action updater that is efficient yet fails to meet task-cost criteria, and showing that extra updates do not rescue failures.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了基于世界模型的规划器中增加规划工作量反而会降低任务性能的反直觉现象，提出了一种高效的固定动作更新器，并表明额外的更新无法挽救失败的场景。

title: Accelerating Nonlinear MPC by Behavior Cloning with Separated Timescales: Application to Nuclear Reactor Load-Following
summary: Behavior Cloning (BC) of expert controllers for multiscale dynamical systems is challenging: state variables evolving at widely separated timescales induce highly nonlinear couplings that a shared latent space may fail to adequately represent, degrading closed-loop generalization. We propose Structured Representation Learning for Behavior Cloning (SRLBC), an architecture designed to leverage the physical knowledge of multiscale systems in which slow state variables, fast (stiff) state variables, and predictable exogenous inputs evolve at different timescales. On 500 long-horizon roll-outs of a pressurized water reactor (PWR) load-following benchmark -a high-dimensional, stiff industrial system with challenging safety constraints -and across 20 training seeds, separated embeddings systematically outperform shared embedding baselines on cumulative cost, imitation accuracy and constraint satisfaction. The resulting standalone policies approach NMPC closed-loop performance at a computational cost 15 times lower on average. Since standalone policies still leave a few percent of trajectories infeasible, we embed the learned policies in a safety-augmented approximate NMPC framework, in which the optimizer is only called when the predicted input sequence is not certified as safe. This yields controllers still 6.8 times faster than the NMPC controller on average, with a feasibility (i.e., constraint satisfaction) of at least 99.8% for all architectures, SRLBC retaining the lowest closed-loop cost. Under distribution shift, standalone BC policies degrade sharply: SRLBC degrades the least, and once safety-augmented, it retains a feasibility above 98% with the lowest closed-loop cost. Beyond the quantitative results, Jacobian-based sensitivity analysis shows that the resulting controller relies on a sparse and less redundant set of latent features, each attributable to a single group of physical variables, and aligned with the physical timescale decomposition of the system.
tldr: This paper introduces SRLBC, a behavior cloning architecture with separated timescales for multiscale dynamical systems, applied to accelerate NMPC in nuclear reactor load-following while maintaining safety via a safety-augmented framework.
tldr_zh: 本文提出SRLBC，一种针对多尺度动力系统的分离时间尺度行为克隆架构，应用于核反应堆负荷跟踪中加速NMPC，并通过安全增强框架保持安全性。

title: Predict the Reward, Not the World: World Reward Models for ML Agents
summary: Search-based machine-learning (ML) agents improve a solution by writing candidate programs, executing them, and keeping the best. Execution gives the search reliable feedback, but a single run can take hours, and most runs end in programs the agent discards. Recent agents try to save these runs by letting a large language model act as a world model that predicts how each program would perform. However, a wrong prediction feeds the search false information. We argue that an agent does not need to predict the outcome of execution, only the decision that execution would support. We propose World Reward Models (WRMs), which learn from real execution results to choose directly which candidate will perform better, without predicting any intermediate outcome. We prove that a selector which predicts execution from the same inputs cannot outperform the best direct selector, that predicted outcomes add an error which can make a likelihood-trained world model prefer the worse program on every instance, and that cross-entropy on executed winners drives a WRM toward the optimum. Our WRM, ForeCritic, adapts a 9B typed decision model to 5k executed program pairs. On 12,438 held-out pairs from 26 ML tasks, it picks the better program 79.4% of the time, while general-purpose LLM judges reach 53--62%, and its probabilities are calibrated. Inside AIDE, ML-Master, and ForeAgent, it cuts mean task time by 4.4--7.5 times while keeping their mean scores within 0.01 or raising them.
tldr: This paper introduces World Reward Models (WRMs), which learn directly from execution outcomes to select better candidate programs in search-based ML agents, avoiding the need to predict full execution results. The proposed ForeCritic model improves selection accuracy and reduces task time in multiple agent systems.
tldr_zh: 本文提出世界奖励模型（WRMs），直接从执行结果学习，在选择搜索式机器学习代理的候选程序时避免预测完整执行结果。所提出的ForeCritic模型提高了选择准确率并缩短了多个代理系统的任务时间。

title: PulmoWorld: An Asynchronous Multimodal Medical World Model for Longitudinal Pneumonia Dynamics
summary: Pneumonia changes across respiration, inflammation, and organ function, while the measurements that describe it arrive at different times and are often incomplete. We introduce PULMOWORLD, a world model for longitudinal pneumonia dynamics that connects asynchronous state estimation, recursive simulation, and evidence-constrained planning. History-aware filtering separates state propagation from observation-driven correction, so a measurement updates the shared belief only when it is observed. That belief supports recursive forecasts of clinical values and modality representations, and summaries of future prognosis. Cap-MBRL searches imagined continuations inside an authorized action set and replaces a frozen fallback only when a candidate meets the risk budget and a predicted-cost margin. On the pneumonia cohort MASS, recursive forecasts are competitive with task-trained sequence models, and simulated future states retain prognostic information. Trained separately on public MIMIC-IV-CXR chest radiographs and clinical trajectories, this model improves prognostic discrimination over latest-value fusion in development and is competitive on long-horizon error on the locked pneumonia panel. In five known-mechanism MASS-Syn environments, Cap-MBRL lowers selection regret relative to direct fallback execution.
tldr: PULMOWORLD introduces a multimodal medical world model for pneumonia that performs asynchronous state estimation, recursive forecasting, and risk-bounded planning, showing improved prognostic discrimination and long-horizon error on clinical and synthetic cohorts.
tldr_zh: PULMOWORLD 提出了一种用于肺炎的多模态医学世界模型，通过异步状态估计、递归预测和风险受限规划，在临床和合成队列上改善了预后判别和长期误差。

title: "Close enough?" An investigation into multiplication errors in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) frequently fail at multi-digit arithmetic, but the underlying mechanisms governing these failures remain poorly understood. While recent work demonstrates that addition errors follow a "noisy quantisation" model localised around carry boundaries, whether this framework generalises to multiplication remains an open question. In this work, we evaluate multiplication capabilities across several small base LLMs on a dataset of 16,991 problems spanning varied operand lengths. We show that multiplication errors do not conform to the addition-style noisy quantisation model. Instead, we uncover a novel error regime in small Qwen models: errors in lower-order columns predominantly preserve parity. Conversely, higher-order digit errors shift toward off-by-one carry failures. Our findings suggest that arithmetic computation in LLMs relies on distinct, multi-periodic internal representations where parity is tracked more robustly than exact digit identity, providing new mechanistic insights into numerical reasoning in transformers.

title: "It Would Make a Geordie Feel at Home": Regional Accent Perceptions and Speech Accommodation in Voice AI
summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems often perform less accurately for speakers of regional dialects, but less is known about how users respond to these limitations and how regional voices produced by voice assistants (VAs) are evaluated through a sociolinguistic lens. This study investigates these issues among speakers of Newcastle English (Geordies), examining both linguistic accommodation to voice technologies and perceptions of regional versus mainstream-accented VA voices. Participants interacted with a simulated VA that spoke either Newcastle English or Standard Southern British English (SSBE). They subsequently completed semi-structured interviews about their experiences with the experimental VA and voice technologies, language use, accent attitudes, and place orientation. The findings reveal a two-way process of sociolinguistic bias. The Geordie VA was associated with familiarity, warmth, personality, and local belonging, but also with concerns about professionalism and authority, whereas the SSBE voice was perceived as more neutral, clear, and credible. Participants also reported adapting their speech when voice technologies failed to recognise them, most commonly by shifting to a more mainstream accent, enunciating more clearly, and speaking more slowly. These strategies are similar to accommodation in human-human interaction and reflect users' perceptions of what technologies can recognise, also known as perceived intelligibility pressures. Overall, the findings demonstrate that voice technologies can reproduce existing accent biases both by encouraging users to suppress regional features and by activating established social stereotypes through synthetic voices. The study positions sociolinguistics as a bridge between understanding human-AI interaction and designing inclusive technologies around users' own linguistic priorities.

title: 3DCodeEdit: Benchmarking Instruction-Guided 3D Program Editing
summary: Language models increasingly create 3D content through code, with practical workflows often relying on editing existing programs rather than regenerating them, for speed and precise control. Such edits require understanding what a program builds and foreseeing how a change reshapes it, yet prior benchmarks mostly evaluate generation or simple edits against a reference. In this paper, we introduce 3DCodeEdit, a benchmark of 2,592 instruction-guided editing tasks over 108 Blender programs that construct objects entirely in code. Its edits range from parameter to structural changes, style redesign, and scene composition, and are judged from renders against human-reviewed checklists. Across 17 models, the average success rate is only 37%, and even the strongest models complete fewer than 60% of structural and style edits. As models become more capable, their failures shift to geometric foresight, where the code runs but builds the wrong shape. We therefore study whether multi-turn feedback can compensate for this missing foresight. Feedback from a separate reviewer model that describes how the renders differ from the request helps most, more than maximum reasoning effort or an agent harness, and can let a 27B model surpass the single-shot rate of a 2.8T-parameter model.

title: A Case Study of a Multi-Agent Kernel-Optimization Loop That Learns a New AI Accelerator
summary: Frontier large language models write correct CUDA kernels for most single-operator benchmark tasks, yet their accuracy collapses on accelerators whose architecture and programming language they have rarely seen. We present a case study of an LLM agent loop built for such accelerators. Our example is the FuriosaAI RNGD NPU, programmed in a recent, sparsely documented Rust DSL, where the loop optimized three Gemma-4-12B decode kernels over 12 days on a shared, scarce device. The loop builds its own target knowledge: it writes and checks a summary of the DSL documentation, measures the chip with microbenchmarks, records compiler-derived legality rules, and revisits this knowledge when the toolchain changes, rechecking rules and measurements where it can. A role-based search over per-kernel Design Trees explores whole-kernel designs and accumulates small accepted changes in the best version of each kernel. Because device time is scarce and readings are noisy, cheap checks screen new designs before any device run, and late in the run a change was accepted only after repeated comparisons with the best kernel on the device. The final kernels reach a 9.293x geomean speedup over the official baseline, each within 1.25x of the cycles needed just to move its weights. Our prompts, profiler and acceptance test are available at https://github.com/bgchun-fs/multi-agent-kernel-gen-loop.

title: A Gradient based Adversarial Augmentation Framework for Mitigating Unlearnable Datasets
summary: Unlearnable data methods (ULD) protect public data from unauthorized model training by adding imperceptible perturbations that create a learning shortcut. A deep neural network can exploit the shortcut learning path to minimize training loss without learning generalizable features. Intuitively, finding adversarial versions of perturbed images that can substantially increase the model's loss can force the model to learn generalizable features. Existing data augmentation based attacks rely on heuristic search strategies/random sampling over a curated augmentation set to identify adversarial augmentation operations, an approach that often does not scale when the number of candidate operations is large. To address the challenge of a large search space, we propose {\techname}, a gradient based adversarial augmentation framework that learns an augmentation policy via stochastic gradient ascent. {\techname} leverages a differentiable data augmentation pipeline to efficiently search a set of up to 18 augmentation techniques, from which a grid search selects a protection-specific subset. The augmentation subset is trained to maximize a surrogate model's classification loss. We introduce a perceptual-plus-pixel regularization to learn operation parameters that preserve image semantics. Under a controlled ablation, {\techname} consistently outperforms an equivalent random sampling baseline (80.0\% vs. 77.29\% clean test accuracy on EMIN-protected CIFAR-10 for ResNet-18 and 83.28\% vs. 66.45\% on NTGA-protected CIFAR-10 for MobileNet-V2), demonstrating that gradient guidance drives the clean test accuracy recoverability rather than the expanded search space. {\techname} offers an effective and scalable adversarial augmentation framework for stress-testing ULD methods, a critical tool for developing robust ULD methods.

title: A Hybrid Physics-informed holomorphic neural networks Method
